chapters.title: Chapter 801: Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade
paragraphs: In the Xi Clan, Xi Hongyan finally received news of the changes in the situation in the Red Sun Realm, which infuriated her. "Aunt, I didn't expect Hong Quan to move so quickly, and the Dai Clan has already changed sides and joined his group. His group captured all the members of the Wang Clan, and they also subdued all the minor clans that used to side with the Shang Clan. According to the news, Fei Shuya has also separated her Fei Clan from that clan, and it happened because of Zhang Fei, so the Shang Clan is completely isolated now."
"Hmm?" Xi Qiuwei raised her eyebrows. "Has Shang Huaqiang made a move to counter all that?

Xi Hongyan shook her head. "According to Xi Wuya, Shang Huaqiang was not in his clan in the past ten days or so, and he was out looking for Zhang Fei. He suspected that the kid had poisoned both him and Fei Qinyuan, leading him to believe that he was also responsible for causing chaos in his clan two weeks prior. Fei Qinyuan couldn't do anything without her husband, and Shang Ziyuan was still holed up in her room with Shi Wuxian."

"Shang Huaqiang's guess is accurate, but he will never be able to find Zhang Fei." Xi Qiuwei let out a soft sigh. "I still can't understand how he could do all that to the Shang Clan, but that clan has already fallen into his clutches. If not for the presence of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, he would have destroyed them by now."

Xi Hongyan nodded in agreement with her aunt. "That kid has many extraordinary abilities, but his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, so he wouldn't dare to fight Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun openly."

"Are you sure about that?" Xi Hongyan raised an eyebrow. "That kid dared to face the two of us by himself, and he also forced Fei Shuya to separate her Fei clan from the Shang Clan, remember? In my opinion, the Shang Clan will be destroyed in the near future, so we have to prepare a new plan to deal with the situation."
"What plan do you have in mind, Aunt? Don't mention Lin Moxian, or I'll really get angry with you." Xi Hongyan emphasized her last sentence.

Xi Qiuwei could only sigh in her heart because Xi Hongyan was too stubborn. There was an easy path ahead of them to improve their situation, but she preferred the hard path. "The only solution is to meet Zhang Fei and the Hong Clan to discuss this matter, but we must involve Huo Jiguang and his Huo Clan in the discussion. If the Shang Clan is destroyed, then only three groups are left, so we must divide the territory of this realm equally."
Xi Hongyan pondered for a while before making a decision. "Aunt, I want you to go to the eastern region to meet Huo Jiguang, and I will go to the southern region to meet Hong Quan and Zhang Fei."
"All right."
After Xi Hongyan gave several orders to their clan members, both women immediately left their clan and headed to two different regions.
Inside the bedroom, Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian lay weakly, and their faces were extremely pale; even their bodies had become thinner.

"Damn it!" Shang Ziyuan cursed under her breath. "We have been in this condition for more than two weeks, but the effects still haven't subsided. If it weren't for those recovery pills, we would have died long ago due to Qi depletion. Do you have another way to recover our condition, Wuxian? If we continue like this, we will really die sooner or later."

"I did not expect that the effect of the demon's ability was stronger than the one I encountered in the past, so I have no other solution to restore our condition." An idea suddenly crossed Shi Wuxian's mind. "Ziyuan, we became like this when we attacked the Ji Clan, so I think we should go there to meet the demon, especially since he is the only one who can restore our condition."

Shang Ziyuan turned to Shi Wuxian with a look of disbelief, especially since their condition was awful with their lusts constantly overflowing. If they went to meet the demon, she was afraid that she would not be able to control herself and surrender her body to him. It would be deleterious for her, and she didn't want such a thing to happen to her.
"I know your thoughts, but we have no other choice, right? Or would you rather die from Qi depletion?" Shi Wuxian questioned her.
Although she was fully aware of the risks, Shang Ziyuan still could not accept Shi Wuxian's idea, and she would rather die than surrender herself to a demon.
*Crack*
Both women turned to Fei Qinyuan, who walked into their room. "Has your lust still not subsided?"
"Not yet."
Shi Wuxian then spoke. "Qinyuan, I want you to take me and Ziyuan to the Jin Clan. I'm sure we can recover our condition if we go there."

"Hmm?" Fei Qinyuan raised an eyebrow before sitting down on the side of the bed. Before she met Zhang Fei, she had never thought of such a possibility. However, their meeting and his actions toward her and her husband made her realize that he was also responsible for Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian's condition. "To tell you the truth, I might know the mastermind behind the condition of both of you. That person put me and my husband in such a terrible condition, and he was also responsible for the chaos that occurred in our clan some time ago."
"Who is that person?"

Fei Qinyuan wanted to say Zhang Fei's name, but the words couldn't come out from her mouth, irritating her. "I don't know his name, but he is Hun Di's newest disciple and Hong Xinxin's fiancé, and he has helped the Hong Clan to reverse the situation."

"What has that person done?" Fei Qinyuan released a heavy sigh and told the two women about the current situation in their realm, causing their expressions to turn completely ugly. "How could he do all that? Does that mean Hun Di decided to support the Hong Clan?"

With a shake of her head, Fei Qinyuan dismissed Shang Ziyuan's guess. "Hun Di would never interfere in other clans' affairs, and his disciple did everything on his initiative because he was Hong Xinxin's fiancé. I have discussed this matter with the two ancestors, but they also dare not take action, especially since that guy also has ties with the Lin Clan."
"Which Lin Clan are you referring to?"

"Lin Jingxia." Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuhei froze as soon as Fei Qinyuan said that name. "Some time ago, Lin Moxian came to this realm, and our spies saw them together because they had the same master. If we chose to attack him, we would be dealing with Hun Di and the Lin Clan, and they would probably destroy us outright."

Shang Ziyuan clenched her fists tightly, and she never expected that their situation would become so precarious just because of one person. "Do you think the disappearance of my daughter and Shang Baishi has something to do with that man? Could he be holding them hostage somewhere else?"
"That might be true." Fei Qinyuan replied with a nod. "Hun Di's newest disciple first appeared in the Wasteland Realm, and the two of them also disappeared from there."
Hearing that, Shang Ziyuan tried to get up from the bed, but her body was too weak to move. "Qinyuan! Help me find that man, and you must catch him for me."

'Do you think I can do that? That brat has taken control of my soul, and I can't move to face him at all.' Fei Qinyuan inwardly muttered in annoyance. "I have instructed our people to monitor the Hong Clan, but they were unable to locate that man, so we must wait for the time being." However, the two of you must remain vigilant, especially since there is a possibility that he will sneak into our clan again. I will leave now, and I will inform the two of you if any other changes occur."
After Fei Qinyuan left, Shang Ziyuan spoke to Shi Wuxian. "Try calling your friends and asking them to help us search for that man."

Shi Wuxian weakly took out a teleportation device to contact some of his friends, and he asked them to come to the Red Sun Realm as soon as possible. "Some of them will arrive here in a few days, and some others will follow. I didn't tell them that the man was Hun Di's newest disciple, or they wouldn't have the guts to help us."
"That's good." Shang Ziyuan then sighed. "Sigh! I'm still so horny, but my body is weak now."
Shi Wuxian nodded. "Try to suppress your lust first so you can rest."
"Yeah."
*Vomit*
In another room, Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun suddenly vomited blood, making their old faces even paler.

Shang Yanjun wiped the blood from his mouth before speaking. "What exactly happened to us, brother? I feel like something has affected us for the past few days, and my Qi flow immediately went haywire every time I tried to cultivate."

"I also experienced the same thing as you." Shang Yanhan swallowed a pill before continuing. "I've checked the area around this room, but I didn't find anything unusual. Perhaps our condition has something to do with the mastermind who caused chaos in our clan, and the effects only appeared recently."
After that, the two old men closed their eyes again to recover from their internal injuries, and that was also what prevented them from taking action against the Hong Clan.
Fei Qinyuan had already arrived at Fei Shuya's residence, and an old woman was already waiting for her there.

"Release your soul, Qinyuan." Fei Qinyuan nodded and released her soul immediately. The old woman and Fei Shuya immediately observed her soul, but they did not see anything strange in it. "Is there anything you can do to free my granddaughter from that man, Bao Fuyi?"

Bao Fuyi shook her head directly. "You said that kid replicated her soul, so I couldn't do anything to free her from him. The only solution was to beg him to free her, but I don't think he would be willing to do that."

"You're right." Fei Shuya released a heavy sigh. "This matter happened because of Shang Huaqiang's ambition, and my granddaughter helped him to fulfill his ambition. Unfortunately, they had to deal with the wrong person, and she became like this as a result."

Bao Fuyi pushed Fei Qinyuan's soul back into his body before speaking. "My understanding of the soul cultivation path is indeed shallow compared to Hun Di, but I know that he does not have such an ability to replicate another person's soul. Perhaps that kid got his abilities from another soul cultivator, but I have never met a soul cultivator who can surpass his master."

Fei Qinyuan was disappointed to hear Bao Fuyi's words. Despite her desire to escape Zhang Fei's control, no one could assist her at this point. After she spoke to the two old women, she immediately returned to the Shang Clan again. 'Sigh! I will do anything to be free from his control, and if necessary, I will humble myself to beg him, so I hope he will come to see me again soon.'
"Why are you looking at me like this, Senior?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Tian Yishen, who looked curious about him.

Tian Yishen first sealed the room with his aura, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to frown. "I won't do anything to you, and Little Moxian has already explained some things to me about you, so I purposely sealed this room. How can you create such a perfect clone, kid?"
"Why would you suspect that, Senior?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] calmly inquired, despite being shocked by his question.

Tian Yishen immediately explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3] about his suspicions after Xiao Laoshu told him the incident that happened when he was treating him in the healing chamber. "Based on the incident, I am confident that this is your clone, and it has a direct connection to your original body, correct?"

"You're right, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately admitted it. "To tell you the truth, this is indeed my clone, but I created it without a cultivation technique, and I created it using my innate ability."
"An innate ability?"

"This is really my innate ability, so I can't teach it to anyone." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique to create an avatar, surprising Tian Yishen. "I used a technique to create this avatar."

Tian Yishen could immediately tell that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s avatar was much weaker than his clone, but he felt that it was still more special than other techniques. "All right, you can cancel your avatar, and I will not probe further about your clone. I will take you to another place, and it can help you to stabilize your cultivation foundation faster, so you can come with me now."

In a few minutes, they had arrived at another room, which was similar to a healing chamber, but there was no healing capsule there. Instead, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw several beds made of jade and other materials, and Tian Yishen asked him to cultivate on one of them.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately approached one of them and sat cross-legged on it, but he felt a flow of Qi enter his body, which quickly spread throughout his body.

"Can you feel the Qi?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Tian Yishen. "It is pure Qi that can only be produced by this Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade, and you won't be able to find it from other items. For now, let the Qi spread throughout your body, and it will help your cultivation stabilize faster. Additionally, it can also help you heal if there are any sequelae left from your previous injuries."
"How many jewels do I need if I want to buy this jade, Senior?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked.
"Hahaha." Tian Yishen laughed and showed the number ten using his fingers. "One Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade is worth ten million gold jewels."1
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Xiaolong [3] coughed and looked at him in shock. "The price is costly, Senior! I only have fifty million blue jewels, so I won't be able to buy this jade."
Tian Yishen laughed as he stroked his beard. "All right, I will leave you now, and you can focus on stabilizing your cultivation here."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh and closed his eyes. 'The effects of this jade are truly extraordinary, and I would like to have at least one. If I can stabilize my cultivation faster every time I break through, my cultivation can increase even faster.'

[Ten million gold jewels are truly expensive, Master. You might need tens or hundreds of years to collect them, but you can collect them easily if you sell the Beauty Restoring Pill and the Youthful Retaining Pill. Unfortunately, that will only bring you great trouble, and those cultivators will definitely be after you.]
'Do you think we can look for this jade, Mei?'
[Unfortunately, the system does not have any information about this jade, so I don't know where we can look for it, Master.]
Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke to him. 'Kid, if you want to look for this jade, you should go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm quickly, and you might be able to find one there.'

'The Sovereign Heaven Realm, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. 'I'll think about that, Old Ma. For now, I need to stabilize my cultivation foundation as quickly as possible so I can bring them all to challenge the Star Tower.'
Gold jewel is the highest jewels: Red, Green, Blue, Purple, Gold.

paragraphs: Xi Hongyan leisurely walked behind the guard from the Hong Clan, who led her towards the back area of the clan, especially since Hong Quan and his family were there.
"What brought you here, Hongyan?" Hong Quan immediately asked.

Xi Hongyan sat down in front of them. "Uncle Quan, you must already know my purpose in coming here, right? So I don't need to beat around the bush, and I want to talk to you about the division of territory in this realm."

"Haha." Hong Quan laughed upon hearing that. "If you think I want to control most of our territory, then you have thought wrong about me. I have never been interested in dominating this realm like you or Shang Huaqiang, and I only want a quiet life for my family. Nothing to discuss regarding the division of this realm; we should focus on our regions. After the Shang Clan is gone, I will solely focus on this region, the Huo Clan will focus on the eastern region, and you can focus on the western region. As for the northern region, I will leave the affairs of that region to the native clans of that region."

"Then, what about your future grandson-in-law?" Xi Hongyan asked with a serious tone because she felt that Zhang Fei's ambitions were much greater than hers, and she was afraid that he would want to take over her Xi Clan after he destroyed the Shang Clan.

Cai Yinzhi immediately answered her. "Our future grandson-in-law does not have such an ambition, and he wants to destroy the Shang Clan because of his personal issues with them. Furthermore, he told us that he will not stay in this realm, and he is looking for the most suitable realm for his family, so you don't have to worry about him taking over your Xi Clan."
"Is that true, Aunt Yinzhi?" Xi Hongyan doubtfully asked.

"You—"

"What is your one condition?"

"Based on my disciples' stories, Zhang Fei will probably come to this realm soon. If he finds out that you opened a shop here, he might also snatch it from you, so you should reconsider your plan." chapters.title: Chapter 803: Phoenix Ancestors
paragraphs: They had arrived at a clearing, but there was nothing there except a sea of fire filled with small fire beasts on its surface. The salamander suddenly came out of Zhang Fei [4]'s body and jumped into the sea of fire, joining those fire beasts.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "I knew that your fire spirit would like this place."

Zhang Fei [4] turned to her. "Why did you choose to stay near me? The fire element here is much stronger than in the volcano in the Nine Stars Realm, so this place is much better for studying the fire elemental law, right?"
"Don't you already know the answer?" With a faint smile, Feng Yao responded, then put her little finger to her lips and whistled.
*Rumble... Rumble...*

The surrounding ground shook quite violently, and the sea of fire repeatedly exploded upwards. In a few seconds, a giant fire phoenix shot out from within it, and its size was several times larger than Feng Yao's phoenix form, with each of its wings stretching out to the side about 300 ft.
Zhang Fei [4] took a deep breath as his body trembled before the presence of the fire phoenix ancestor. Ever since he became a cultivator, he had never felt such fear in his heart.

The fire phoenix opened its eyes and stared at Zhang Fei [4] with its fiery eyes, exerting even heavier pressure on him. Even though they were mythical beasts, it was older and stronger than him, and its aura intimidated him. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
Name: Feng Shen
Gender: Male
Race: Phoenix
Rank: Mythical Beast
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Element: Fire [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law [Perfection Stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Fire Core
Physique: Phoenix Bird

'What the fuck! His cultivation has already reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm!' Zhang Fei [4] screamed in his heart after he saw that. 'Back then, Feng Yao said that the Nameless One was the strongest in the universe, but this old phoenix is much stronger than him! Furthermore, how can I beat him? He's already at the peak of mortal cultivation!'
'Are you surprised by his cultivation?' Feng Yao playfully asked.
Zhang Fei [4] slightly nodded at her. 'What exactly is going on? His cultivation is already at the peak of mortal cultivation, but you said that the Nameless One is the strongest.'

'As an active cultivator, the Nameless One is the strongest.' Zhang Fei [4] responded to Feng Yao by folding his forehead. 'Actually, my ancestors and the ancestors of the other mythical beasts are the strongest in this universe, but they never appear on the surface again, and they live in solitude to break through to the next stage. However, they can never do so because the Qi in the three mortal realms is too weak, and they must go to the Paradise Realm first to be able to break through to that stage.'
'What are the stages of cultivation after the Seven Divine Realms?' Feng Yao shook her head with a smile, causing Zhang Fei [4] to sigh in his heart.
"Why did you bring him here, Little Yao?" Feng Shen suddenly asked.

Feng Yao looked up at him. "Ancestor, Zhang Fei [4] is considering staying in this realm, but there are many humans and demons on his side. Additionally, he wants to know about the lost treasure, so I brought him here to talk to you."

Feng Shen narrowed his eyes at Zhang Fei [4]. "If you want to talk to me, you have to bring your original body here. The current you is no different from your original body, but I can tell that you are a clone."
Zhang Fei [4] released a soft sigh, but he quickly switched places with his original body. "Are you satisfied now, Old Phoenix?"

Feng Shen changed to his human form first. Despite his old age, his appearance is no different from a man in his fifties, and his figure is tall and sturdy, with long red hair. He then landed in front of Zhang Fei, touched his forehead with his index finger, and tried to read his memories.
*Swoosh*

The powerful Qi wave that emerged from Zhang Fei's body immediately pushed Feng Shen back, causing him to stumble several steps back. "I didn't expect that you had such a powerful protector internally, which could push me back even though I'm stronger."
"I met my protector because of death, Old Phoenix." Zhang Fei casually answered.
"Oh?" Feng Shen naturally knew that Zhang Fei was a heavenly fox, and he knew that the fox race did not have the ability to rebirth like the phoenix. "Have you really died before?"

"I died once." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "Fortunately, someone brought me back to life, so I can stand before you today. Old Phoenix, I know it's none of my business, but can you tell me about the lost treasure?"

"The lost treasure is the Divine Phoenix Totem." Feng Yao and Zhang Fei looked at Feng Shen with questioning looks. "The totem is a sacred relic that amplifies all phoenix bloodlines, both fire and ice phoenixes."
'Can you locate the totem, Mei?'
[Master, the system is still mapping this realm, so we have to wait for it to finish, and I will find it after that.]
Feng Yao then asked Feng Shen. "How could such a sacred relic disappear, Ancestor?"

"Have you heard of the dark phoenix?" Feng Yao nodded to Feng Shen. "The dark phoenixes are actually ordinary fire phoenixes like us, but they are tainted by the demon aura and turned dark, and their dark flames can scorch the souls of living beings, preventing them from reincarnating. In the past, one of my peers was contaminated by the demon aura and turned into the dark phoenix, and he stole the Divine Phoenix Totem to strengthen himself. At that time, a big fight occurred between them, and the totem disappeared after the fight was over. For hundreds of thousands of years, we have searched all corners of this realm and nearby realms, but we have never managed to find it."
"Did the dark phoenix survive that battle, Old Phoenix?" Zhang Fei asked.

Feng Shen nodded in response. "The dark phoenix managed to escape after killing several phoenixes, but he suffered heavy injuries. Since then, he never returned to this realm again, and we initially thought he had died from his heavy injuries. Unfortunately, our guess was wrong; one day we heard news that someone saw him together with a demon, and he helped the demon to destroy several realms, one of which was the Starry Sky Realm."
"The demon is Xereth." Zhang Fei muttered with a glimmer of killing intent in his eyes.
"How did you know about that name?" Feng Shen asked in surprise.

Zhang Fei immediately told him. "I am acquainted with a demon from the Abyssal Realm, and she told me that Xereth was once one of the ancestors of the demons from that realm. After he killed their demon emperor, he disappeared from their realm, but he reappeared by destroying many realms."

"I see." Feng Shen nodded in understanding before warning Zhang Fei. "If you are thinking of hunting down Xereth, then you should forget about that desire before you reach the peak of mortal cultivation. The dark phoenix's strength should be equal to or higher than mine, so I'm sure the demon is stronger than him, or else he wouldn't submit to him."

"Did you forget about the tower, Ma Kuangyu, and Nalan Yushu?" Feng Yao asked Zhang Fei back.

"You are mistaken if you think these three are useless to them." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows as Feng Yao provided a clear explanation. "Even though the Qi here is useless, the cultivation resources are still very useful, especially for demons. In that realm, it is difficult for demons to move freely, so their best choice for finding resources is to descend here."

"Why did you bring this little fox to my place, Little Yao?"

chapters.title: Chapter 804: Ice Elemental Seed
paragraphs: "Are you sure you want to dive into this lake?"

"You know that I can't let my big sister go through the ritual by herself, right? Even if my chances of getting the ice element are slim, I must get the ice elemental seed first." Zhang Fei then stood up and prepared to dive into the icy lake.
"Wait a minute." Feng Yao stopped Zhang Fei by grabbing his shoulder. 'Huo Ling, please help him get the ice elemental seed.'

Huo Ling sighed in Feng Yao's mind, but he didn't say anything and entered Zhang Fei's body directly, surprising him. 'Dive in now! You won't freeze as long as I'm with you. The ice phoenix can freeze anything, but it can't freeze a fire spirit like me.'

Even though Huo Ling helped him, Zhang Fei still activated his fire element to warm his body. He immediately jumped into the icy lake and swam down at high speed, surprising Feng Xueying. "How can he dive underwater without Qi protection?"
"Are you still unaware of Zhang Fei's other identity, Ancestor?" Feng Xueying turned to Feng Yao. "That kid has three identities: human, a heavenly fox, and a demon."
"How is that possible?" Feng Yao told Feng Xueying about the writings left behind by the ten-tailed fox. "So you mean that he is his potential successor?"

"Yes." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "Zhang Fei is the main candidate to become the next ten-tailed fox, but the conditions are difficult to fulfill, especially since he needs the hearts of both of the heavenly fox ancestors to be able to evolve into the ten tails."

Feng Xueying fell into a daze upon hearing that. "Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have long desired to evolve into the ten tails, but they have never been able to achieve it. It turns out that the conditions for them to evolve are really harsh, and they have to kill each other to be able to do it."

"Ancestor, do you know how strong Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing really are?" Feng Yao curiously asked. "All this time, everyone has always said that their strength is equal to my parents', but I think that's impossible, and I'm sure their strength is higher than that."
Feng Xueying confirmed it with a nod. "Tian Baitian's and Tian Baixing's cultivation should have long reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but something inside their bodies suppressed theirs."
"Hmm?" Feng Yao raised an eyebrow.
"I don't know anything about it, but I heard it from Tian Baixing long ago, so it should be true."

Feng Yao propped her chin with her hand and thought about several possibilities. 'Could it be that the old ten-tailed fox left that thing in their bodies? What was his reason for doing that? Since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing's cultivation has been suppressed for so long, it would enter that stage directly if they managed to get rid of it from their bodies. If that happened, Zhang Fei would never be able to defeat them, and he needed a special way to do so.'
"What are you thinking, Little Yao?"
Feng Xueying's question woke Feng Yao from her thoughts. "I'm thinking about Zhang Fei's chances of defeating Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing to take their hearts."
"Why do you care so much about Zhang Fei? I've watched you since you were little, so I know that this is not your usual character."
"Haha." Feng Yao chuckled. "I want to tell you the truth, but this is not the right time, and I will tell you everything when Zhang Fei is ready to leave these three mortal realms."
Feng Xueying was shocked to hear that. "What do you mean by that? Are there other realms after the upper realms?"

"The realms after the upper realms do exist, but it is difficult to reach those places." Feng Xueying looked at Feng Yao with suspicion. "Even with your cultivation having reached the peak of mortal cultivation, you still won't be able to go there by yourself, and your best choice is to join Zhang Fei."
"Zhang Fei?"
Feng Yao nodded. "Zhang Fei has met people from those places, and they also helped him to do some things."
"Where did Zhang Fei meet those people?"

"Since you have closed yourself off from the outside world for hundreds of thousands of years, it is natural that you do not know about the appearance of many towers in the middle realms; those towers are the key to going to those places." Feng Xueying did not refute Feng Yao because she had only focused on her cultivation for the past hundreds of thousands of years, and she had never left her icy lake, so she did not understand the changes in the outside world. "I learned about those towers from Zhang Fei, and we've challenged one of them, but we've only cleared the first floor. In fact, my parents are in one of those towers right now, and they went there together with the Nameless One and the others."
Feng Xueying looked annoyed because Feng Yao's parents didn't tell her about the tower. "Does this mean you and Zhang Fei will challenge the tower again soon?"
"Yes." Feng Yao then asked. "Do you want to join us? If the people in the tower know about your cultivation, they might give you a chance to go to those places."
"All right, I will join you two." Feng Xueying spontaneously made a decision.

Sometime later, Zhang Fei had already dived halfway, but he didn't feel the slightest bit of cold, which was thanks to Huo Ling. No ice beasts dared to approach him because of his heavenly fox aura. 'Can you tell me about you and Feng Yao?'
'Humph!' Huo Ling snorted in his mind. 'If you want to know about me, you must conquer the Paradise Realm first. If you can't do that, you are not worthy to know about me or my master.'

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly at that. 'Why do you always look down on me? You already know that I have only been a cultivator for a little over a year, so there is no way I can reach your level in a short time.'
Huo Ling snorted again. 'Humph! I don't want to talk to you much!'

'Tch! This haughty spirit! I really want to spank her ass!' Zhang Fei then spoke to Huo Ling again. 'You should have experienced being in my position in the past, right? There is no way you were powerful from birth; it must have taken you tens or hundreds of thousands of years to reach your current level.'
'Stop asking questions and focus on diving to the bottom of this lake, or I'll leave you to freeze to death.' Huo Ling shouted in annoyance.
[Master, you should stop bothering this female spirit, or you will freeze to death if she leaves you here.]

Zhang Fei sighed in his heart and dove faster, but the temperature inside became colder and colder as he dived deeper, and his fire element disappeared because of the cold. However, it had no impact on Huo Ling, so his body was still warm, even though the surroundings were extremely cold.
After he dived for several hours, Zhang Fei finally arrived at the bottom of the ice lake, and he found the ice elemental seed inside a block of ice.
'Take that seed and return to the surface as soon as possible!' Huo Ling urged him.
Zhang Fei did not reply to Huo Ling, as he did not want to further irritate her. He then took the ice block, stored it in the inventory, and swam to the surface as quickly as possible.
A few hours later, Zhang Fei jumped out of the icy lake, and Huo Ling immediately returned to Feng Yao's body.

Feng Xueying looked at the ice block in surprise as Zhang Fei took it out, but she then touched it and melted the ice. She gave the ice elemental seed to him. "Your chance of getting the ice element is only about 10 to 20 percent, so you don't have to be disappointed if you fail to get it."
"Can you help me to obtain the ice element?" Zhang Fei asked her.

Feng Xueying acknowledged it with a nod. "I can help you, but I won't. Little Yao has already helped you get this seed, so you have to try to get the ice element yourself. You also don't need to ask Feng Jinqiu for help, especially since I've forbidden him from helping you."

Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao, but the Phoenix Princess refused with a shake of the head because she had already helped him obtain the ice elemental seed, so she wanted him to make his own efforts to obtain the ice element.

"Well? Not everything can be obtained easily, right? Since you are not willing to help me, and you also forbid Feng Jinqiu from doing so, I will ask my big sister for help." Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the training space and asked Zhang Yue to come out of it.
Feng Xueying and Zhang Yue immediately looked at each other, as their ice phoenix bloodline resonated with each other.
Zhang Yue bowed slightly to Feng Xueying. "Ancestor Ice Phoenix, I have heard about you from Senior Jinqiu, but I didn't expect that we would meet so soon."
"Yeah." Feng Xueying nodded at her. "You are still unable to undergo the ritual with your current cultivation, so you can come to me again after your cultivation reaches the quasi-divine realm."
"I understand, Ancestor." Zhang Yue then turned to Zhang Fei. "Fei'er, I do have the bloodline of the ice phoenix, but I am not sure I can help you obtain the ice element."

"It's okay, fail or succeed, let luck decide." Zhang Fei then brought Zhang Yue to sit floating above the icy lake with their palms pressed against each other. "It would be great if I managed to obtain the ice element, but I won't regret it if I fail to obtain it, so let's do it now."
"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Yue in confusion. "Lan Zhe is a frost lynx, so you can summon her and let her help you too."
Zhang Fei wasted no time and summoned Lan Zhe, who immediately transformed into her human form and sat behind him. "What should I do, Master?"
"Place your palms on my back and channel as much of your ice qi as possible into my body." Lan Zhe immediately followed his orders, and Zhang Fei rushed to swallow the ice elemental seed.
[Ding]
[Ice elemental seed was detected.]
[The process of absorbing the ice elemental seed begins.]
[The chance for the host to get the ice element is 20%.]
"Let's start."
Zhang Yue and Lan Zhe immediately channeled their ice qi into Zhang Fei's body, directing it at the ice elemental seed to activate it.
[Ding]
[The chance for the host to obtain the wind element has increased to 40%.]
'My chance of getting the ice element increased to 40%, huh?'
Mei immediately spoke to him. [Master, I'm not sure if you can get the ice element with such a low chance, so you should ask other ice cultivators for help, or the ice elemental seed will be wasted.]
'Who should I ask for help? There are no other ice cultivators by my side, Mei.'

[Master, you sometimes act like a senile person! Don't you have many allies? Xue Jingling is an ice elf, and there are many ice fairies in the fairy race, so you can go to the natural race kingdom and ask them for help.]
'Oh! That's right!'

Xin Xianzi immediately led the two of them into the royal palace to meet Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling.

"Yes." Zhang Fei immediately spoke to Xue Jingling. "Empress Xue, I have already obtained the ice elemental seed, but my chances of obtaining the ice element are too small. I need some ice cultivators with a high affinity for the ice element to help me, so I hope you are willing to help me."

"The Phoenix Realm." Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling exchanged surprised glances. "How? Are you willing to help me?"
Xue Jingling nodded. "I'll help you, but you have to take my husband there too."

Xin Xianzi took Zhang Fei [4] to meet several ice fairies and helped him persuade them, but only one of them was willing to help him.
Zhang Fei [4] did not mind it and sent the ice fairy to the Phoenix Realm. "Do you two want to stay here for the time being?"
"Yes." Xin Xianzi and Zefyr. "We have been training for too long, so we want to freshen up first."
"All right." Zhang Fei [4] immediately left them and returned to the training space, continuing to stabilize his cultivation.

Above the icy lake, Xue Jingling and the ice fairy were already sitting on either side of Zhang Fei, and they immediately channeled their ice qi into his body before directing it into the ice elemental seed.
[The chance for the host to obtain the wind element has increased to 70%.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh in his heart, especially since his chances were still not 100%. 'Sigh! I hope the goddess of luck will bless me and help me obtain the ice element.'
By the lake, Feng Xueying asked the elf emperor. "Are you willing to help him because he is a heavenly fox?"

"The old nine-tailed fox is a hero to our natural races, and Zhang Fei is the leading candidate to be his successor, so we choose to be on his side." Feng Xueying was not too surprised by Xian Lianghua's answer.
"Do you know that he is also a demon?"

Xian Lianghua turned to Feng Xueying. "Senior Ice Phoenix, almost everyone in our realm knows Zhang Fei's identity as a demon, but none of them have a problem with it because he has done a lot for our realm, and our realm was able to regain peace thanks to him."
"I see." Feng Xueying nodded in understanding and looked at Zhang Fei, but she still had no intention of helping him obtain the ice element.
[Master, your body temperature is turning cold too quickly due to the effects of their ice Qi.] Mei warned Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei himself was aware of this, but he decided not to use his fire qi to warm his body, especially since he thought it would reduce his chances of obtaining the ice element. Moreover, the cold was still not as cold as when he dual cultivated with Zhang Yue, so he was confident in enduring it.
*Crack*

Zhang Fei suddenly heard a cracking sound from within his body, and he immediately inspected the ice elemental seed within it. He found the seed starting to release the ice element, and it slowly spread throughout his body, which made his body temperature even colder. 'Damn it! No matter how cold it is, I have to endure it to be able to obtain the ice element!'
Unexpectedly, the ice elemental seed within Zhang Fei's body began to absorb the ice Qi within the icy lake, causing his body to slowly freeze.

The four women immediately realized it, and they wanted to withdraw their ice qi, but Zhang Fei right away stopped them. "Don't stop! I have to face this challenge or I will fail to obtain the ice element."
"But—"
"Continue, Big Sis! I can endure it!"
Zhang Yue and the three women sighed softly at Zhang Fei's stubbornness, but they dropped their intention and continued their action of channeling their ice qi into the ice elemental seed.

chapters.title: Chapter 805: Obtained Ice Element
paragraphs: Xiao Laoshu, Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was sitting cross-legged on the heavenly rejuvenation jade in confusion.

Xiao Laoshu originally wanted to check Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s condition, but she found that his body was so cold, and it was freezing. She then contacted Lin Moxian to come, but Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan decided to join him.
"What exactly happened to him, Senior Brother? How could his body freeze like this?" Yan Yinqing worriedly asked.

Tantai Lingyan touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I can feel the source of the coldness in his body, and it should come from the ice elemental seed. Additionally, I can feel the ice Qi from four different people, and one of them is similar to the ice phoenix's ice Qi."

"According to him, one of his wives does have the ice phoenix bloodline, and he wants to take her away to the Phoenix Realm." Lin Moxian instantly noticed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s situation. "This kid must be in that realm right now, and he must have found the ice elemental seed there."

Tantai Lingyan nodded. "If this kid is really in the phoenix realm, then it is true that the source of his cold is the ice elemental seed. After all, the seed can only appear in extremely cold places, and the ice phoenix's lake is one of the coldest places in the upper realms."
"Has he gone mad? Why did he do such a reckless act?" Yan Yinqing inquired, her tone tinged with a hint of worry and irritation.

"You are mistaken, Yinqing." Lin Moxian refuted his junior sister. "If someone else did this, then I could say that that person was too reckless, especially since the cold would kill that person. However, our junior brother is different from other cultivators, and our master recognizes him. I don't know if he will succeed in obtaining the ice element, but he will become the first cultivator with the five elements if he manages to obtain it."
"Five elements?" Tantai Lingyan and Xiao Laoshu were shocked to hear that.

Lin Moxian nodded to them. "He already has the light, fire, wind, and darkness elements. If he manages to obtain the ice element, it will become his fifth element. As for his reason for doing this, I believe he is doing it for his big sister, who will face the ice phoenix trials in the future."
"The ice phoenix trials?"

Xiao Laoshu explained to Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan directly. "Humans who inherit the ice phoenix bloodline must undergo the ice phoenix trials to prove their worthiness. However, I have never heard of any human passing the trials, and they all froze to death there, including my big sister."
"Eh?" Xiao Laoshu's last words shocked Lin Moxian and the two women. "Did your big sister really die in the phoenix trials?"

"My big sister accidentally obtained the ice phoenix bloodline five hundred years ago, and a woman from the ice phoenix race came to her not long after that. Even though the woman had explained to her about the risks, she still insisted on undergoing the trials, and she eventually died because of her foolish decision." Xiao Laoshu looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You must make sure that this kid forbids his big sister from undergoing the trials, or she will die like my big sister."

Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan turned to Lin Moxian, who immediately shook his head. "Since I got to know him a month ago, I have known quite a bit about his character, and I can tell that he would never forbid his big sister from undergoing the trials. Instead, he would accompany her to undergo the trials, so he deliberately tortured himself like this."
"Young Master Lin, he—"

"I can understand your loss, Laoshu. However, your big sister didn't have a companion when she underwent the trials, right?" Xiao Laoshu nodded to Lin Moxian, who patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "This kid is much weaker than us in terms of cultivation, but he is wittier and more calculating than we are in dealing with many things. He even dared to face Xi Hongyan and the Shang Clan with his current strength, and they couldn't fight back against him. Since he has decided to accompany his big sister, I am sure he has considered everything well, and I believe that he will succeed in helping her pass the trials."

Tantai Lingyan nodded in agreement with Lin Moxian. "I spoke with Yizhen yesterday, and he told me a lot about this kid, especially his actions against the Shang Clan. Currently, the situation in the Red Sun Realm is under control, and the Shang Clan is in a precarious position as all their former allies have switched sides, leaving them isolated. She also told me that Xi Hongyan came to the Hong Clan because she was afraid that this kid wanted to control her Xi Clan, so she came to offer peace."

"Hahaha." Lin Moxian burst out laughing upon hearing that. "Aunt Lingyan, Xi Hongyan owes my junior brother her life, or else she will die in a few months. Moreover, he came alone to the Xi Clan and managed to take her hostage; even Shang Huaqiang or Grandpa Hong dared not to do that, and Xi Qiuwei couldn't stop him with her superior cultivation. Since she already knows his strength and abilities, I'm not surprised that she chose to make peace with the Hong Clan."
Hearing that, Yan Yinqing leaned forward and took a close look at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I hope he will recover faster so I can spar and compete in speed with him."

Huangfu Xiaoying did the same. "Please, big brother, release us from this place."

"Sister Yueyi, I'm sorry, but I can't defy Li Tiannan's orders." The fake Ruo Yanxi replied by pretending to be sad.

Moreover, Zhang Fei had already erased most of Heian Yueyi's memories, especially about his fake father's identity. She no longer remembered him or their communication in the past few months, and in her eyes, Li Tiannan was the main villain who killed Huangfu Shou.

Huangfu Lian also answered her mother. "Li Tiannan has controlled all of us, Mother. He also arranged everything so that Aunt Fei Yan and Aunt Guang Yi fell to me, so the four of us are together now. Please forgive me; I wish I could free the three of you from here, but his order prevents it."

"Yes." Huangfu Lian nodded at her. "I buried my father's corpse in the family cemetery, and I asked them to build the best tombstone for him."

[Ding]
[The chance for the host to obtain the wind element has increased to 100%.]

*Crack... Crack...*
Gradually, the ice covering Zhang Fei's body cracked, and the cracks continued to spread until it shattered into pieces.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the ice element.]
[The host's ice element has reached the lower stage.]
Seeing that, the four women immediately withdrew their ice Qi back, and they returned to the edge of the lake.
Feng Xueying hurriedly floated in front of Zhang Fei, touched his forehead with her index finger, and imparted the method to learn the ice elemental law.

After that, Zhang Fei slowly entered the icy lake, but no one stopped him as they realized his intention. As they expected, he attempted to form his ice element core, and he also studied the method to learn the ice elemental law at the same time.

In a few minutes, a vortex of cold air emerged from the ice lake and soared high into the air, which increased the cold in the area. After a while, the cold vortex gradually shrank and formed an icy white ball, which became clearer with each passing second.
Soon, the icy white ball was completely formed, and it quickly entered the ice lake before entering Zhang Fei's body.
[Ding]
[The host successfully formed the peak grade ice core.]

Zhang Fei did not immediately come out of the ice lake, and he took advantage of the cold inside the lake to learn the ice elemental law. Meanwhile, his fourth clone appeared in the sea of fire area where Feng Shen lived, and he immediately dived into it to raise his fire elemental law to the half-perfection stage.

Feng Shen, who was flying above the sea of fire, could only shake his head at the actions of Zhang Fei and his clone. "This kid's actions are truly absurd, and his clones serve as his primary advantage in accelerating his cultivation. If he continues like this, he might be able to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension much faster than me and the others."

chapters.title: Chapter 806: Jian Wufeng - Wang Yourou
paragraphs: Zhang Fei's first and second clones went straight to the Nine Hells Realm to complete the first and third quests. He brought all the demons by his side to that realm so they could train and increase their strength at the same time. Meanwhile, his third clone cultivates in the Xianjin Realm, as he helps him to learn the ice elemental law.
"What is he doing now? Why hasn't he opened his eyes yet?" Yan Yinqing touched then Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulders "Half of his body became burning hot, and the other half became extremely cold."
Lin Moxian immediately remembered the situation in the phoenix realm. "Yinqing, our junior brother was practicing in the sea of fire and icy lake at the same time, so his body became like this now."
"He probably wants to train the fire and ice elemental laws."

"That's right." Lin Moxian nodded in agreement with Tantai Lingyan. "His fire elemental law has reached the intermediate stage, and he probably wants to break through to the half-perfection stage. Since he has just obtained the ice element, he will start studying the ice elemental law."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly opened both of his palms. His ice qi appeared on his left palm, and his fire qi appeared on his right palm, making Lin Moxian and the two women wonder.
They were shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought the two opposing elements close to each other, and Yan Yinqing wanted to stop him because it was very dangerous.
However, Tantai Lingyan stopped her daughter straight away. "No need to panic."
"But—"
"Look at both of them, Yinqing." Lin Moxian pointed at the two elements. "The two of them are obviously stable and don't reject each other, which means he has often combined the two."
"How is that possible, Senior Brother? Ice and fire conflict with each other, so there is no way the two can combine." Yan Yinqing asked with an incredulous look.
"Just watch him."
Just as his fire and ice Qi were approaching each other, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s dark Qi suddenly enveloped both of them and pulled them closer.
Tantai Lingyan nodded her head a few times. "This kid intentionally used his dark Qi as a counterbalance to both of them."
After a while, the three elements merged to form an ice lotus, encircled by dark flame, leaving the three people stunned.
Yan Yinqing's mouth opened the widest, forming a wide O shape. Her eyes could not move from the lotus, as if captured by its beauty.

"This lotus is a combination of the three elements, and it is truly beautiful." Tantai Lingyang was mesmerized by the beauty of the ice lotus, and she felt that it was really pretty, even though the dark flame encircled it.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the ice elemental law.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes. "This lotus is the Hellflame Frost Lotus, and I first created it with my big sis. At first, I had a hard time believing in the idea, and we failed many times. After trying for so long, we finally managed to create it as our combined technique, but I can now use it by myself after I obtained the ice element."
"Does this mean you can combine all your elements?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] dispelled the lotus and combined his other elements in turn, making Tantai Ling Yan and the others sigh in their hearts. Like fire and ice, light and darkness were also opposites, and the resistance of both was much stronger. They should never be able to merge, like day and night, but he was able to effortlessly merge the two.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled all his elements back. "Incredible, right?"
"All your actions always leave me speechless." Lin Moxian uttered these words with a shake of his head. "How about your cultivation foundation? Has it become more stable?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Thanks to this jade and my clones, my cultivation foundation has become quite stable now, and it will be fully stable much sooner than I previously estimated. I would like to stay here longer, but I don't have the time to relax. So please help me talk to Senior Yishen, and we will go to Cheng Gaoji's residence after this."
"All right." Lin Moxian immediately left them to look for Tian Yishen.
Yan Yinqing then asked him. "Is it really okay for you to leave this place? This jade is very useful, so I think you should stay here longer."
"How did you get to know Cheng Gaoji?" Tantai Lingyan asked him too.

"Senior sister, there are many problems at hand, so I have to prepare some things to deal with them. Moreover, my condition is not as bad as you think, so you don't need to worry." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Tantai Lingyan about his relationship with Cheng Gaoji. "Since then, he is my subordinate, and I will bring him back to this realm after we arrive at his residence."

Before long, Lin Moxian returned with Tian Yishen, who immediately checked Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s condition. "Are you sure you don't want to stay here longer? Your cultivation foundation has improved a lot, but it's still far from stable."

"Senior, I still have some things to prepare, and I want to go to the Void Heaven Realm too, so I have to go now." Since Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s condition was much better than before, Tian Yishen allowed him to leave his hospital.
Sometime later, they had arrived at Cheng Gaoji's residence in another sector, and they were able to enter it easily by following the old man's instructions.

Once they arrived inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate and disappeared inside. However, he was gone for only a few minutes, and he returned to the residence again together with Cheng Gaoji, Duan Zhao, Gang Zhishou, Ah Hu, and Lu Zhong. As for Xian Xian, he deliberately left her to train inside the training space, especially since the Qi inside was no different from the one in the Xianjin Realm.
"Oh?" Cheng Gaoji was surprised by the presence of the two women. "I didn't expect you to be here too, Tantai Lingyan."
Tantai Lingyan nodded at him. "I checked with Tian Yishen, and Little Moxian told me about Zhang Fei, so here I am now. However, I was surprised to hear that you decided to follow him, Cheng Gaoji."
"Tch!" Cheng Gaoji chose not to discuss that matter and asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Have you bought those materials?"

"I arrived in this realm yesterday in an unconscious state, and I just left Senior Yishen's hospital today, so I haven't had an opportunity to look for those materials." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Lin Moxian. "Senior brother, we will go to the Blacksmith Union's shop now, and I hope Ji Changlan is there."

Every time she walked, Wang Yourou's movements looked so graceful, and her long purple hair fluttered in the wind. Her ample bosoms swayed, and her curves wove like a slithering snake.

Arriving in front of them, Wang Yourou ignored Jian Wufeng and Lin Moxian. She bent down slightly and sniffed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Who are you, little brat? Did you meet Xi Hongyan not long ago? Even though her scent on your body is quite faint, I can still smell it."

"Senior sister, this little brat is not what you think, so you should keep your distance from me." Wang Yourou wrinkled her brows as she stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You are right; I met Xi Hongyan some time ago, and we discussed some important matters."

Wang Yourou propped her chin, and her lips curled up into a faint smile, but her eyes were clearly condescending. "Why would she be willing to meet a weak brat like you? What did you discuss with her?"

"You may be Xi Hongyan's ex-lover, but we don't even know each other, so I have no obligation to tell you about our conversation, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] then walked towards the building. "I apologize, but I don't have time to talk nonsense with you, and I want to see the inside of this building."

chapters.title: Chapter 807: Surround The Shang Clan
paragraphs: Annoyed by his treatment, Wang Yourou took out a purple whip and lashed it toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], but her attack passed through his illusion, leaving her and Jian Wufeng stunned.

"At first, I thought your character was similar to Xi Hongyan, but I was wrong, and your character was far worse than hers." Wang Yourou spun around and swung her leg towards Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s dick, but her attack once again only passed through his illusion. "You should stop before I lose my patience, and I'll make you regret it."

Instead, Wang Yourou released her aura to suppress Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was already standing on top of the building. Despite this, he remained unfazed and folded his arms across his chest, which caused her to frown. "How can you resist my aura?"

"I told you that this brat is not what you think." As soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, a powerful pressure dispelled Wang Yourou's aura and pressed down on her from above, forcing her to bend her knees. 'Thank you, Old Ma.'
[Don't mind it; I never liked a foolish and arrogant woman like her.]

"Ugh!" Wang Yourou's face turned red and blue as she tried to fight back against Ma Kuangyu's pressure, but she pressed her down even harder, making her knees almost touch the ground. 'How is this possible? How can a brat with a cultivation in the ten mortal realms suppress me to this extent?'

Witnessing that, Jian Wufeng turned to his friend, but Lin Moxian responded by shrugging his shoulders. 'Your lover is looking for trouble with the wrong person, Wufeng. My junior brother is more terrifying than you can imagine, and he could subdue Wang Yourou in a matter of seconds if he wanted to.'

"Yourou, you should stop this." Wang Yourou did not respond to Jian Wufeng; to be precise, she couldn't say anything under Ma Kuangyu's pressure. "That kid is Senior Hun Di's newest disciple, and you should already know the risk if he finds out that you attacked his disciple. Even your father will not be able to save you from his wrath."

Wang Yourou was shocked in her heart after learning about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s status as the Soul Emperor's disciple, but she did not regret attacking him, and she still struggled hard to escape from Ma Kuangyu's pressure.

Lin Moxian could only shake his head at Wang Yourou's expression. "Junior Brother, spare her this once. You want to open a shop in this realm, and you need the Wang Clan for that, so you don't need to prolong this matter."
'Let her go, Old Ma.' Ma Kuangyu immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s wishes and withdrew his aura back.
Unfortunately, Wang Yourou was already too furious, and she charged toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], leaving Lin Moxian speechless.
Jian Wufeng wanted to move to stop Wang Yourou, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was faster than him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] teleported behind Wang Yourou, touched her back, and used the enhanced demon touch directly.
"Hyannn!" Wang Yourou let out a loud moan that attracted the attention of the people around them, and she slid towards the ground.

Jian Wufeng hurriedly jumped up and caught her, but Wang Yourou's body kept spasming as she experienced an extreme orgasm, causing her sticky liquid to wet his hands and clothes. 'What the hell is this? How did that kid make Yourou have such a powerful orgasm?'
"Ahhh!" Wang Yourou kept moaning and twitching while hugging Jian Wufeng tightly. "Help me, Wufeng!"
Jian Wufeng looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he refused by shaking his head slightly, making him sigh in his heart.

After five minutes, Wang Yourou had stopped moaning, and her body no longer twitched. Her face turned completely red with embarrassment, and her bosoms heaved up and down as she gasped for air. After such a lengthy orgasm, her body went limp and her eyes became blurry.
"You two wait here; I'll take Yourou back to the Wang Clan first." Jian Wufeng immediately took Wang Yourou flying with him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] landed beside Lin Moxian and asked. "Will this bring me big problems?"

"I don't think so." Lin Moxian looked towards the tower. "Wang Zhemin is no less wise than our master, and he knows his granddaughter's character by heart, so I'm sure he won't do anything to you. However, your action of suppressing Wang Yourou just now was witnessed by many people, and it will draw people's attention to you, so you must be careful.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Which clans should I be wary of in this realm, Senior Brother?"

"You have to be wary of Lei Xuanfeng and his Lei Clan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] folded his forehead after Lin Moxian mentioned the two, especially since Yan Leibao once told him about them. "Your guess is right; they are the fastest clan in the upper realms, and they have a grudge with the Yan and Hong clans."
"Which other clans are next?"
"The Xiong, Jiao, Wu, and Pan Clans." Lin Moxian then asked. "What will happen to Wang Yourou? Will she suffer like Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "I used another ability on Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, and they would continue to suffer before I withdrew it. I have no real problem with Wang Yourou, so I didn't use that ability on her."
Lin Moxian then led him into the building. "We can look around first while we wait for Jian Wufeng to return."

[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]

There was a small commotion within the Wang Clan residence after Jian Wufeng brought Wang Yourou back, and he explained to Wang Zhemin about the incident that happened to his granddaughter. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he is a disciple of Senior Hun Di. He was talking to me and Lin Moxian earlier, but Yourou came to us and belittled him. She attacked him, even though he tried to avoid her.

"I see." Wang Zhemin nodded in understanding before saying to the others. "Gong Yulei, take your daughter back to her room and don't let her leave our residence for now, or she will find trouble with Hun Di's disciple again."
"Yes, Father." Gong Yulei directly took Wang Yourou from Jian Wufeng's hands before taking her away.

Jian Wufeng immediately said goodbye. "Grandpa Wang, I will return to them now, and you must not send someone to spy on Zhang Fei. Otherwise, the situation will become even more complicated, especially if Senior Hun Di finds out about this matter."

After Jian Wufeng left, Wang Yourou's father, Wang Xiaotang, immediately asked, "Have you heard that Hun Di took a new disciple, Father? As far as I remember, his last disciple was Shang Yingyue, who was a member of the Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm."

"I haven't heard that, but that kid came to this realm with Lin Moxian, so I think he is indeed Hun Di's disciple." Wang Zhemin then got down from his chair. "Xiotang, tell the others not to approach that kid for now. I heard that Cheng Gaoji has returned, so I will go see him now."
"Yes, Father."
Jian Wufeng had already returned to the building, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told him that he wanted it. "Are you sure about this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 808: Attack The Shang Clan
paragraphs: "Phew." Fei Qinyuan let out a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei returned her to her adult self, but she immediately ran to another area and tied up her dress. 'This brat is annoying! His abilities are also weird.'
After she tidied up her dress, Fei Qinyuan returned to their midst. However, Murong Qianying and a few people from other clans landed by their side, causing her to sigh inwardly.
They were people from the Qiao, Huang, Hao, and Deng clans, who lived in the Southern Region.
"Long'er, this man is Qiao Liangren's grandfather, Qiao Qingfeng." Murong Qianying said as she pointed at an old man. "Old Qiao, he is your grandson's junior brother."

Qiao Qingfeng rubbed his beard as he looked at Zhang Fei. "Liangren has told me many things about you, and he always gets excited every time he talks about you, especially because of your talent in the soul cultivation path."

"Senior, I would never have been able to become a soul cultivator if it weren't for Senior Brother Liangren." Zhang Fei respectfully replied. "At that time, I had only arrived in the Wasteland Realm for two days, and we had not yet known each other, but he was willing to guide me on the soul cultivation path."

"I know." Qiao Qingfeng nodded in return. "Liangren has been interested in the soul cultivation path since he first cultivated, and he dedicated his entire life to pursuing that path. However, he is not someone who likes to teach others, and he was willing to teach you at that time because he could see your talent. He is satisfied with your progress, and you are the youngest cultivator that Hun Di has ever accepted as his disciple. So, what are your plans for the Shang Clan?"

"Capture Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun before taking over the Shang Clan." Fei Qinyuan's expression worsened after Zhang Fei said that. "This woman will assist us in luring Shang Huaqiang back, and we will resolve everything today."
"Do you really want to take over the Shang Clan?" An old woman suddenly asked, but her expression was unpleasant to look at.

Zhang Fei turned to the old woman, and Mei immediately displayed her status. Based on that, he learned that her name was Huang Xiaoting, and her cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm. "Senior Huang, I know your thoughts, but you guys won't be able to do anything to them without my help, so it's only natural that I want to take over their clan, right?"
"You—"

"This kid is indeed right, Old Huang." Another old man hurriedly spoke, and Zhang Fei learned that his name was Hao Xintong, the ancestor of the Hao clan. "It has been hundreds of years since we wanted to get rid of the Shang clan, but we have never been able to do it because their overall strength is higher than our clans'. However, the situation has changed after he came to this realm, and his actions significantly weakened the Shang Clan, which has opened up an opportunity for us to get rid of them. Moreover, our clans are not small clans, and we don't lack resources for our members, so it doesn't matter if he wants to take over their clan."

An old man from the Deng Clan, Deng Guopeng, joined in. "Old Huang, you don't have to be too greedy and let this kid take over the Shang Clan. If we don't get anything from their clan, we'll get the peace we've always wanted, which is best for everyone."
"Tch." Huang Xiaoting gritted her teeth and said no more.

Despite this, Zhang Fei could see that Huang Xiaoting was hostile toward him, especially since her name on the map turned red. "Senior Huang, I respect you as a senior, but I will change my mind if you want to find trouble with me.
"Hmm?" Huang Xiaoting narrowed her eyes.

"I don't know what you are planning in your heart, but I know that you are hostile to me, even though you don't show it in your expression." Hao Xintong and the others were not surprised to hear that from Zhang Fei's mouth, especially since they were familiar with Huang Xiaoting's character. He then released a bit of his aura and killing intent, causing them to instinctively step back and distance themselves from him. "I may be much younger than you, but I am not afraid in the slightest to face you and your schemes. I am not a kind man, and I will have no qualms about destroying you and your Huang clan if you choose to be my enemy, so you better think about your choice carefully."

Hearing that, many questions arose in Murong Qianying's mind, especially since Zhang Fei's killing intent proved that he had killed too many living creatures. 'Who exactly is he? How could he possibly have such a suppressive killing intent?'

Zhang Fei suddenly unleashed his full power killing intent, causing all of them to hold their breaths. "If you think I behave like this because I have my master's support, you can try fighting me for real. Once you make a move, you will become my enemy, and I will not hesitate to kill you."
'This little bastard! How dare he threaten me like this?' Huang Xiaoting's anger was boiling over, and she was seriously thinking of attacking Zhang Fei.
*Thud... Thud...*

The other three people suddenly landed not far from them, but their situation confused them. They could discern Zhang Fei's seriousness due to his intense killing intent, specifically targeting Huang Xiaoting.
'Old Huang must have provoked his anger.' Jin Ruyue, who had just arrived with Ren Dongcheng and Dai Hubai, muttered to herself.

"Ho? Why do you guys want to fight with each other?" The voice surprised them, and they immediately turned to its owner. The owner was Huo Jiguang, who had just arrived with the people from the Tie, Lai, Niu, and Miao clans.
Zhang Fei immediately withdrew his killing intent. "Since everyone has gathered, we will move now."
"Who are you?" Huo Jiguang inquired, unaware of Zhang Fei's identity.
Hong Quan immediately told him. "Old Huo, he is my grandson-in-law, and he was the one who planned all this."

"Oh?" Huo Jiguang was surprised to hear that. "The younger generation always surpasses the old, eh? This kid is even younger than my great-grandson, yet he could plan all this. Let's move then, and the Shang Clan will cease to exist after today."

"Long'er, you should wait here and let us deal with those two old men." After he said that, Hong Quan and Huo Jiguang led the others to attack the Shang clan, shocking the clan's members and the city's citizens.
However, Fei Qinyuan and Fei Shuya did not join them because Zhang Fei forbade them, and they only watched from a distance.

In a few minutes, a big fight broke out within the Shang Clan. Hong Quan and the others quickly immobilized those clan members. In the absence of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, the elders of the clan had difficulty fighting them, especially since all of them were too strong.
However, Hong Quan and the others did not kill indiscriminately, and they only killed those who had committed many crimes in the past.

Witnessing that, Fei Qinyuan clenched his fists tightly, and it never crossed his mind that the Shang Clan would face such a situation, which happened because of Zhang Fei. 'Damn it! Why did the situation become like this? Is there no other way to turn the situation around?'
Zhang Fei, who was watching one of the rooms of the Shang Clan, suddenly grabbed Fei Qinyuan and Fei Shuya by the shoulders. He carried the two of them and teleported them into the room.
Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, who were preparing to help the others, were shocked by their arrival. "What do you mean by this sister-in-law? Are you betraying us?"
"Knock them." As soon as Zhang Fei said that, Fei Qinyuan and Fei Shuya immediately moved.

Luckily, Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian were not in peak condition due to the influence of Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation. Therefore, Fei Qinyuan and Fei Shuya did not face significant resistance from them, and they immediately knocked the two women unconscious.
After Fei Shuya sealed their cultivation, Zhang Fei sent Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian into the Yin-Yang Space, especially since he wanted to utilize their Yin Qi to speed up his cultivation.
Fei Shuya looked outside. "They've come out of their seclusion."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei responded with a nod, keeping a close watch on Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun through his map. He wasn't concerned about them, especially since Hong Quan and the others were more than capable of handling the two old men. "Take me to this clan treasure room."
Fei Qinyuan released a helpless sigh; she and Fei Shuya immediately led Zhang Fei away to the treasure room. Upon arrival, he immediately cleaned all the items in that place, which excited him.
'Tch! This little bastard is no different from a thief!' Fei Qinyuan inwardly cursed.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at her expression. "Call your husband now and ask him to come back as soon as possible."
"Are you going to kill him?" Fei Qinyuan asked with a frown.

"Isn't that obvious? My father-in-law died because of your husband, so I have to avenge him, right?" Fei Qinyuan eventually contacted Shang Huaqiang as Zhang Fei desired, but she was still uncertain about what he planned for her. "The battle in the building over there will start soon, and this clan will be useless after the two of them are dead."

"You two definitely never thought that this day would come, right?" Huo Jiguang asked the two old men. "Your Shang Clan has acted rampantly in this realm for the past hundreds of years, and it is time for you to pay for all your actions in the past."

Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanhun did not reply to Huo Jiguang and released their full strength, but their actions actually harmed themselves. Their Qi immediately spiraled out of control, causing both of them to fall to the ground and spurt a lot of blood from their mouths.
Hong Quan immediately spoke to them. "Old Yanhan and Old Yanhun, just surrender because you have been poisoned by something, and you will never be able to use your cultivation."
"Hahaha." Shang Yanhan laughed loudly. "All of you have considered yourselves righteous cultivators, but you guys use underhanded means to fight us."
"Everything is fair in a fight, especially when facing evils like you." Huang Xiaoting replied with a hint of disdain in her voice.
"Heh!" Shang Yanhun snorted. "All of you are hypocrites! You think we are evil, but you yourself often commit crimes against other clans!"
"You—"
"Speak no more and kill them!" Hao Xintong dashed towards the two old men, followed by Hong Quan and the others.

Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun didn't want to give up so easily, and both of them immediately attacked them back, even though it caused their condition to get worse as their Qi flow became increasingly uncontrollable.

"Help us kill them, Huaqiang!" Shang Yanhan shouted at him.
Shang Yanhun also spoke to him. "Our Shang Clan will continue to exist as long as you are alive, and you can raise our clan again after they are all dead!"

"You bastards! I will eliminate all of you first, and I will destroy all your clans after!" Shang Huaqiang took out his spear and wanted to attack them, but a long black sword suddenly pierced through his back and into his chest, causing him to spurt out blood.

"I never liked your clan." Fei Shuya casually replied.

Shang Huaqiang glared at Zhang Fei. "Who are you? Why did you attack us?"

"Who I am is not important." Zhang Fei pointed the demon extermination sword at him. "I have been waiting for this day ever since I destroyed your portal in the Netherworld Realm, and I will use your blood to honor one of your victims."
Shang Huaqiang could immediately guess Zhang Fei's identity. "So, you are a cultivator from the Sky Jade Realm, huh?"
"That's right!" Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of him and slashed his sword at him, but Shang Huaqiang blocked it with his spear. "Your death is inevitable."
"Humph!" Shang Huaqiang snorted and tried to suppress Zhang Fei with his aura, but Fei Shuya immediately moved and dispelled it, causing him to frown. "You traitor!"

"Your enemy is me." Shang Huaqiang was shocked to hear Zhang Fei's voice from behind, especially since he was still in front of him. He immediately realized that it was just an illusion, so he spun around while stabbing his spear but only hit another illusion. "Where are you attacking?"
"You- Argh!" Shang Huaqiang suffered pain after Zhang Fei slashed his back, leaving a long sword wound on his back. "Bastard! I'll kill you!"
