chapters.title: Chapter 809: The Fall Of The Shang Clan
paragraphs: Up in the sky, the two continued to exchange attacks, or more precisely, Zhang Fei bullied Shang Huaqiang by using his superior speed.
Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun perplexedly watched their fight, finding it hard to believe that Zhang Fei was toying with Shang Huaqiang like a child.
Huo Jiguang and the others were also shocked to witness Zhang Fei's actions, especially Huang Xiaoting, who had previously wanted to attack him.
Fei Shuya had already guessed that Zhang Fei's abilities were beyond her imagination, but she did not expect that he could fight with Shang Huaqiang toe to toe, and he had the upper hand against him.
'This brat! How could he pressure my husband to that extent?' Fei Qinyuan stared at Zhang Fei and Shang Huaqiang in a daze.

All of them misunderstood Zhang Fei's abilities, especially since they didn't know about his secrets, including Huang Quan and Hong Cong. Under normal circumstances, he could never accomplish such feats solely by relying on his speed, particularly given the stark disparity in their cultivation.
Although Zhang Fei had the ability to fight cultivators at the Seven Divine Realms, he could only face cultivators at the Divine Manifestation at max with his current strength.
Fortunately, Ma Kuangyu's soul resided in his soul space, and it was far different from the souls of cultivators in the three mortal realms, which allowed him to help Zhang Fei.
Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun exchanged glances for a moment before releasing his full strength, and both of them wanted to bring Hong Quan and the others down together with them.
However, a portal suddenly opened before them, and Xi Hongyan walked out of it together with Xi Qiuwei. At the same time, Mai Xiaomeng also appeared above the Shang Clan.
Zhang Fei knew that he wouldn't be able to stop Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, so he used his clones to ask them for help.

Even though Xi Hongyan disliked Zhang Fei for his actions toward her some time ago, she would not miss the opportunity to destroy the Shang Clan, and she immediately agreed once he told her everything.

Xi Hongyan, Xi Qiuwei, Mai Xiaomeng, and Fei Shuya immediately attacked Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, making the two old men panic and fly away. However, Hong Quan and the others immediately broke free from their restraints, and they joined the four women to attack the two.
Meanwhile, Xi Yinying realized that Zhang Fei's strength is not his true strength but borrowed strength, and he won't be able to defeat Shang Huaqiang just by relying on that.
Xi Yinying moved to Zhang Fei's side, and the two of them joined forces to fight Shang Huaqiang. Despite the wounds covering his body, he remained superior to the two.
Shang Huaqiang, who was facing the combined attack of Zhang Fei and Xi Yinying, was shocked by the appearance of Fei Qinyuan behind him. "Wife-Gah!"
"I'm sorry, husband! I don't want to fight you, but I can't go against his orders!" Fei Qinyuan spoke as she launched another attack on Shang Huaqiang.
"Damn it!" Shang Huaqiang cursed and flew as fast as he could to escape, especially since Fei Qinyuan's cultivation was on par with his.
*Swoosh*

The demon extermination sword suddenly shot toward Shang Huaqiang and slashed his shoulder, causing it to bleed. Zhang Fei moved in front of him with the Moonlit Whisper Sword in his hand, and he slashed it directly at him.
*Clang*
Shang Huaqiang managed to repel Zhang Fei's attack with his spear, but Fei Qinyuan and Xi Yinying were already behind him, and the two women launched attacks that landed heavily on his back.
*Splurt*
Xi Yinying's attack didn't hurt Shang Huaqiang that much, but Fei Qinyuan's assault was truly painful for him to the point that he spurted a lot of blood from his mouth.
*Slash*
Zhang Fei took advantage of Shang Huaqiang's carelessness by slashing his sword towards his right arm, cutting off his right arm. "Argh!"
Zhang Fei didn't stop there and raised his leg high, and he swung it towards Shang Huaqiang's head.

"Gah!" Shang Huaqiang slid down towards the ground, but he was still able to control himself and landed on the ground with a wobble. He quickly took out some pills and swallowed them to stop the bleeding and numb the pain in his arm.
*Bam... Bam...*
Shang Huaqiang's attention was diverted by the two loud bangs, where he saw Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun nailed to the wall with their bodies covered in blood.

"Cough... Cough..." Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun coughed hard as their bodies were already in a complete mess from their previous injuries, and those people's attacks made their conditions even worse.

Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei floated in front of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun with vicious eyes. The two women were eager to swallow the two old men alive, especially since they had killed many of their Xi clan members in the past.
Zhang Fei suddenly moved to the side of the two women. "I know you two have a deep grudge against them, but I need their souls for my experiment, so I will be the one to end their lives."
"What are you going to do about them?" Xi Hongyan asked with a frown.
"Capture Shang Huaqiang for me, and I will show you after this." Xi Qiuwei immediately moved and captured Shang Huaqiang before bringing him to Zhang Fei's side with his cultivation sealed.
Shang Huaqiang's expression was truly ugly; it had never crossed his mind that their powerful clan would be destroyed in one day.
Hong Quan and the other cultivators immediately landed, surrounded them, and waited for Zhang Fei's next action against Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun.
Fei Qinyuan wanted to say something to Zhang Fei, but Fei Shuya immediately pulled her away and forbade her to say anything.

Zhang Fei quickly pulled Shang Yanhan's and Shang Yanjun's souls out of their bodies before cutting off the connection between their bodies and souls, causing their bodies to fall to the ground lifeless.

Xi Hongyan and the others knew of Hun Di's terrifying abilities in soul cultivation, but they had never witnessed such a thing firsthand, and Zhang Fei's actions were terrifying enough even for experienced cultivators like them.
"What do you want to do with their souls, kid?" Huo Jiguang asked Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei stored the two old men's souls in his soul space before turning to them. "I am a master-rank blacksmith, but I have never tried to forge a true soul weapon because I need the souls of living beings to do so. Therefore, I will use their souls to try to forge one, and it doesn't matter if it fails."
"A master rank blacksmith?" Except for those who already knew Zhang Fei, nearly everyone was in shock.

"Haha." Mai Xiaomeng suddenly laughed, and her next words left them even more stunned. "This kid is not only a master rank blacksmith, but he is also a grandmaster alchemist, and his pills are the best I have ever swallowed."
"Xiaomeng is right." Jin Ruyue said it with a nod. "His basic pills are much better than the ones concocted by Lin Jingxia, and I am much better after swallowing them."

"Can you show me your basic pills?" After all, Huo Jiguang and his Huo Clan were alchemists, and they also worked together with Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang, so it was natural for him to be curious about Zhang Fei's basic pills.

Zhang Fei actually didn't want to reveal his pills to the public, but he needed a lot of jewels to mass produce his new weapon, and he also wanted to buy a large piece of Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade. He then took out a bottle containing his basic pills and handed it to Huo Jiguang, who immediately opened the lid and looked at the pills.

paragraphs: Murong Qianying's cold gaze greeted Zhang Fei's arrival, but he paid no attention to it and walked straight towards her. "Why is your expression like this? Aren't you already aware of my reason for disguising myself as a 10-year-old boy? We wouldn't have a relationship if you never thought of controlling me, and I used my ability on you as retribution. Honestly, I don't care if you want to get angry and blame me for everything, and I won't appear in front of you again forever."
"You—"

"You what?" Zhang Fei interrupted Murong Qianying directly. "I have many women, and none of them have ever thought of controlling me like you. I won't lose anything if I lose you. On the other hand, you will lose if I leave you, and you will continue to miss my presence for the rest of your life."
'Tch! He's such a narcissist!' Despite her annoyance, Murong Qianying couldn't deny that she would continue to miss Zhang Fei, especially after they had been together for the past eight months.
Zhang Fei spoke to her again. "If you continue to behave like this, I'll leave right now, and I'll never come back."
"Don't go!" Murong Qianying shouted and grabbed his hand. "I don't blame you, but I'm annoyed that you never told me the truth, and I learned the truth from Grandpa Hong."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled and pulled her into his embrace. "Unlike you, Grandpa Hong and the others never thought of using me, let alone controlling me. Therefore, I would rather not lie to them, and I chose to tell them my true identity from the start."

"Can you stop bringing up that matter?" Murong Qianying pushed Zhang Fei to sit on a chair before climbing onto his lap. "I know I was wrong because I wanted to control you, but you have already retaliated against me several times over, right? You already have my body and soul, so the problem between us is settled, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded. "You're right, I already own everything you have, so let's call it all even. However, there is still one problem left, and you have to solve it yourself."
"My husband."

"Yes." Zhang Fei then told her about his meeting with Shang Chongyun and others. "Your husband has never done or schemed against me, so I have no thoughts of getting rid of him. I never like it when my official or unofficial women are close to other men, so you should think of a way to end the relationship between the two of you."

"I will contact him and divorce him." Murong Qianying made a decision without giving it much thought, as she had never truly loved Shang Chongyun, and her marriage to him was solely motivated by his status as a Shang Clan member. Furthermore, the Shang Clan was already destroyed, and their remaining members were unable to fight Zhang Fei with so many allies by his side. "What about Yaolin? What are you going to do about her? I know she wronged you because she helped Shang Huaqiang, but we have no choice but to follow his orders, so I hope you don't hurt her feelings because she truly loves you."

Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "I don't have any plans regarding Yaolin yet, and I will wait for her to return from the Sun Tower. By the way, you can coordinate with Grandpa Hong to move your Murong Clan to the residence of the Shang Clan, and you can absorb their remaining members into your clan as long as they are not hostile to you. If they are hostile to you, you just need to get rid of them for good. This way, your clan will become stronger, and the other clans will not dare to attack your clan members."
"I will discuss this matter with Grandpa Hong first." Murong Qianying suddenly remembered four other women. "What are your plans for Fei Qinyuan, Shang Ziyuan, Shang Xishun, and Shi Wuxian?"

"Shang Xishun is basically my slave, and I was thinking of putting him under you. However, I still need her for now, and I will lock her up in my personal space together with Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian." Murong Qianying was curious about that because she still didn't know much about Zhang Fei. "She should be at the Shang Clan right now, so we'll go there to pick her up."
"All right."
They had already arrived at the Shang Clan, and they found Fei Qinyuan speaking with Shang Xishun, whose cultivation had previously been sealed by Hong Quan.
"Master." Xi Yinying greeted Zhang Fei as she stepped out of the shadows.
Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the training space. "Yinying, go back inside and continue your training."
"Yes, Master."

After Xi Yinying disappeared, Zhang Fei pulled the frightened Shang Xishun to his side. "Honestly, I wanted to kill you because you were involved in the incident in the Netherworld Realm back then, but you are lucky because your Yin Qi is strong enough to help me cultivate."
"What... what are you going to do to me?" Shang Xishun asked in a trembling voice.

"Hey! I'm not that kind of guy! I'll harvest your Yin Qi in another way!" Despite Zhang Fei's words, Shang Xishun remained fearful of him, believing he would employ a cruel method to gather her Yin Qi.
"What about me? What are you going to do to me? Are you also considering harvesting my Yin Qi?" Fei Qinyuan asked.
"What do you think?" Fei Qinyuan frowned at that, but Zhang Fei directly opened a portal to his Yin-Yang Space. "Enter it."

The three women were stunned when they arrived inside, especially when they saw the glass tube in the middle of the room that contained a little Qi. They then looked at the ten rooms on the side of the place, but only Murong Qianying and Fei Qinyuan could sense the presence of several other women in the place.
"What kind of place is this? Who are those nine women?" Murong Qianying inquired as she observed the nine women.
Fei Qinyuan was also curious about that place, and she could immediately guess that Zhang Fei harvested the nine women's Yin Qi, all of which was collected into the glass tube.

"They are my old enemies, and they are now my prisoners." Zhang Fei's answer surprised the three women. "I have no interest in dual cultivating with them, so I imprisoned them here, and this glass tub naturally absorbs their Yin Qi. Three of them are cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms, and I cannot absorb their Yin Qi directly due to the difference in our cultivation, but I can absorb it through this tube."
"Where did you get this kind of place?"
"Secret." Zhang Fei's answer annoyed Fei Qinyuan and Murong Qianying. "Even all my official wives and family don't know the origin of this place, so I won't tell you two about it either."
Fei Qinyuan put on a serious face before asking. "Are you going to imprison me in this place too?"
"No." Zhang Fei then lifted Fei Qinyuan's chin. "I have other plans for you, so I won't imprison you here."
"What—"
"You'll know soon." Zhang Fei approached Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, who were still unconscious on the floor, before waking them up.

In a few minutes, Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian opened their eyes, but they panicked after finding themselves in a strange place with their cultivation sealed. They remembered the appearance of Zhang Fei, Fei Shuya, and Fei Qinyuan in their room.
"Hey." Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian hurriedly stood up and moved away from Zhang Fei. "You two don't have to be so afraid of me, especially since I won't make you guys suffer."
Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian glared fiercely at Fei Qinyuan, who was standing beside Murong Qianying. "Traitor!"

"Do you two think I want to betray my family?" Fei Qinyuan pointed at Zhang Fei. "He has already controlled my soul, so I have no choice but to follow his orders. The Shang Clan has been destroyed, and my husband is dead, so we have lost."

Shang Yumei and Hong Xinxin had already seen Zhang Fei [5] fight with other cultivators, demons, and beasts, so they were no longer surprised by his fighting abilities. It was a different case with Luo Xuejia, who witnessed him fighting for the first time. She was truly amazed by his abilities, especially his movements and accuracy.

Zhang Fei [5] then returned to the side of the three women, but he immediately looked up and asked. "Did Feng Yao send you here, Senior Xishui?"
"Huh?" The three women were shocked to hear that, and they immediately searched for the male fire phoenix's whereabouts but to no avail.

Feng Xishui immediately appeared in front of them with a smile. "I've wanted to meet you for a long time, kid. At first I didn't understand why my princess would go to such lengths to help you, but I can understand her reasoning after witnessing your fight just now. Despite your cultivation still being in the ten mortal realms, your fighting ability has already surpassed the cultivators in the seven divine realms, especially your speed. I am one of the fastest in our phoenix race, but I don't have the confidence to catch you with my current speed. Besides, your confidence and accuracy when killing those beasts are simply amazing, and you can kill most of them with just one strike that lands precisely on their weakness."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Senior, you praise me too much. I am confident in my fighting abilities, but there are still many cultivators who are more skilled than me in fighting. Therefore, I cannot slack off, and I must continue to improve myself so that I can surpass them."

"Do you think I can win Feng Yao's heart, senior?"

If she didn't have interest in you, she wouldn't have helped you this far, and she would have driven you away long ago like them."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "You may have known Feng Yao for a long time, but you never knew her true self, and she is much more intriguing than you know. I have always been confident in getting her as my woman, but I know that it won't happen anytime soon, and I still need years to get her."

Feng Xishui nodded. "Huoyun Zhiyan went to the Divine Flame Realm, Sun Jianming went to the Azure Sky Realm, and Xiu Hanyu went to the Blossom Heaven Realm."

Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before opening the gate to the Azure Sky Realm. "Xinxin, go to that realm to capture Sun Jianming, and you can contact me directly after you capture him."

"If any of you dare to move, I will kill that person directly."
"Mercy!" Several old men and women shouted as they descended from the upper floors. "Young master, they are only doing their duty, so I hope you will let them go."
Zhang Fei [5] narrowed his eyes at them. "My name is Zhang Fei, and I come from the Nine Stars Realm."
"What?" They screamed in shock as soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that. "You—"

"Get down!" Shang Yumei immediately suppressed those people with her aura, forcing them to kneel on one leg. "My husband didn't come here for small talk; he came to take over this organization, especially since your leaders and people repeatedly harassed him and my other sisters. Whoever dares to oppose his intentions, I will send that person to the afterlife directly."

Those people broke out in a cold sweat because of Shang Yumei's threat. Moreover, they recognized Feng Xishui because he had already come to their organization several times, and their leaders did not dare to challenge him.
Zhang Fei [5] withdrew his aura and killing intent back, followed by Shang Yumei, who also withdrew her aura back, making them pant heavily. "Bring me to your leaders' room."

Those old men and old women hurriedly stood up and led them to the top floor, where Zhang Fei [5] sat in the head seat usually used by Huoyun Zhiyan. Meanwhile, Feng Xishui and Shang Yumei sat on either side of him, waiting for his decision for those people.
"What... what should we do now, young master?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] thought for a bit before opening a gate and disappearing inside. After a while, he returned to the room together with Nanfeng Yunxi, surprising those people.
Nanfeng Yunxi herself was surprised as soon as she arrived in the room. "Do you want to take over this organization?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to those people. "Gather all the best alchemists in this organization."
"Yes... yes, young master."

sentences.text: In the Wang Clan, Wang Yourou finally opened her eyes, but she felt her body extremely weak after she had experienced such a lengthy orgasm yesterday.
She immediately swallowed a recovery pill to restore her Qi, but it did not reduce her fatigue.
"That little bastard!
How dare he do such a thing to me!
He humiliated me in public by making me have such a long orgasm!"
*Crack*
"Finally awake?" Gong Yulei asked Wang Yourou as she entered her daughter's room.
"Mother." Wang Yourou called weakly.
"No need to say anything." Gong Yulei sat by her daughter's side and checked her condition.
"You're lucky that young man didn't do anything worse to you, you know?
Do you want to destroy our Wang and Gong clans?
You already know that he is Hun Di's disciple, but you still attack him.
If his master finds out about your actions yesterday, we won't be able to save you from him."
"But—"
"Isn't it your fault?" Gong Yulei squinted her eyes, causing Wang Yourou to tremble.
"Jian Wufeng has told us everything; you insulted and belittled that young man first, even though you just met.
He wanted to avoid you because he would rather not find trouble with you, but you insisted on attacking him, so you reaped what you sowed."
Wang Yourou lowered her face in annoyance, but she did not dare to argue with her mother. 'Tch!
I will look for that little bastard and settle accounts with him!'

"Your grandfather has forbidden you to leave your room for now, and he will punish you severely if you dare disobey his orders, so you can forget about your wish to find that young man." Wang Yourou looked up at her mother, but Gong Yulei ignored her and stood up.
"If you don't want to suffer, you should follow your grandfather's orders."
*Bam...
Bam...*
Wang Yourou thrashed her bed like a spoiled girl.
"Ahh!
How annoying!
Why is my grandfather siding with that little bastard?
I want to take revenge on him, but my grandfather will punish me severely!"
Wang Yourou then contacted Jian Wufeng and asked him about Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he didn't want to say anything and asked her to handle the matter herself.
"Tch!
That bastard Wufeng!
How dare he ignore me?"
Wang Yourou remembered Zhang Xiaolong's [3] relationship with her ex-lover, and she contacted Xi Hongyan through the interspatial communication device.
However, the result was beyond her expectations, and her ex-lover asked her not to find trouble with him, especially after he destroyed the Shang Clan.
"Did that little bastard really destroy the Shang Clan?
How did he manage to outsmart Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan?" Wang Yourou wondered to herself with a look of astonishment.
"Tch!
I can't believe he did all that by himself!
I bet he had help from Senior Hun Di and Lin Moxian!"
Wang Yourou then closed her eyes again.
"Sigh!
First, I'll rest to recover, and once my condition fully recovers, I'll look for that little bastard!"

Zhang Fei [1] did not like Wang Yin, especially since her body gave off a pungent stench of corpses.

However, he agreed with Mei that the Demon Purgatory Realm was the best choice for increasing their demon strength and cultivation, and he himself no longer had any goals in the Nine Hells Realm other than daily quests.

Despite their unwillingness, they still followed Zhang Fei [1]'s wishes, and he immediately sent them back to the training space.

"Why are you suddenly meeting us again?"
Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained.
"I want to know the closest distance to go to the Demon Purgatory Realm, so I came to see you.

"Hmm?" Morgana thought for a while and calculated their distance.
"The Demon Purgatory Realm is located east of the Blue Water Realm, and the distance between the two realms is about a week's journey.
I suggest you leave from the Red Sun Realm to go to the Blue Water Realm first to settle your affairs there, and you can go to Wang Yin's realm after that."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I will go to the Red Sun Realm now, and I will take these two foxes to the Blue Water Realm."
After they arrived at the Red Sun Realm, Zhang Fei [1] immediately took out the Pandora Odyssey and took the two female foxes to leave that realm for the Blue Water Realm.
He then summoned Balena out of the training space.
"We will arrive at your realm in two weeks."
"Eh?" Balena stared at Zhang Fei [1] with repeated blinks.
Zhang Fei [1] chuckled at her expression.
"Are you happy?
You have been stranded in the Netherworld Realm for a long time, and you will be able to reunite with your family in two weeks."
"Yes." Balena then looked far away.
"I've missed my family for a long time, so I'm pleased to be able to reunite with them again.
However, I have been missing for decades, so I don't know if they are waiting for me to return or if they think I am dead."
Zhang Fei [1] took Balena's hand.
"I hope they are still waiting for you to return, but if they think you are dead, you don't have to be upset about it.
You have me and the others, and we will always accompany you by your side, so you will never be alone."
"Um." Balena nodded and turned to him.
"I've lived with you and the others for so long now, and I've always enjoyed all the time I spent with you all.
If my parents thought I was dead, I wouldn't blame them because this happened due to my carelessness in entering the portal, which caused me to end up in the Netherworld Realm."
"Let's wait two weeks; you'll know if they're still waiting for you or think you're dead."
"Yeah." Balena glanced at the two female foxes.
"I want to be alone first, so you can take care of your business with them first."
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] then brought Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu into one of the rooms in the flying artifact, which made them feel uneasy.
However, he didn't do anything strange to them; instead, he taught them to cultivate their souls, and their soul power could increase his own soul power.

chapters.title: Chapter 812: Take Over The Organization
paragraphs: In the Azure Sky Realm, it was not difficult for Hong Xinxin to find Sun Jianming, especially since he lived in a building with the Alchemy Union's name plaque.
Hong Xinxin did not want to make a big fuss in the realm, so she casually walked into the building, surprising Sun Jianming, who was arranging items.

Before Sun Jianming could greet her, Hong Xinxin had already moved in front of him and sealed his cultivation directly, causing his eyes to widen in shock. "Who exactly are you? Why would a cultivator from the upper realm like you suddenly come here and do this to me?"
"Zhang Fei is my future husband." Sun Jianming froze after Hong Xinxin said that. "You should already know my purpose for coming here, right?"

"You don't need to say anything to defend yourself." Hong Xinxin calmly interjected. "He just wanted to live a relaxed life in the Nine Star Realms, but the people from your organization kept disrupting his life, and they eventually died at his hands. You and the other two didn't want to stop, and you sent Nanfeng Yunxi to him. Your mistake made her his subordinate, along with Luo Xuejia and the other two. By the way, he is at your organization's headquarters now, and your organization will be his from today onward."
Sun Jianming broke out in cold sweat after Hong Xinxin said all that, which made him think that Zhang Fei had deliberately sent him to kill him.

"You're lucky because he still needs you, so he won't kill you for now, and he asked me to take you back to your headquarters." Hong Xinxin then sent a long-distance message to Zhang Fei, but he told her that Huoyun Zhiyan was on his way to the Azure Sky Realm. He asked her to wait for him, and he also asked her to go to the Blossome Heaven Realm to capture Xiu Hanyu. "How long will it take for Huoyun Zhiyan to arrive in this realm?"
"Zhiyan... he previously went to the Divine Flame Realm, and he will probably arrive in this realm in a week." Sun Jianming answered with a trembling voice.

"Pack all the things in this shop, and I will wait for Huoyun Zhiyan to arrive in this realm. At that time, my future husband will pick you both up, and he will decide the fate of the three of you." Hong Xinxin immediately left the shop and went to Zhang Fei's residence in the Azure Sky Realm, which Murong Qianying had previously bought.

Sun Jianming couldn't stop shaking as he imagined their future fates. He then sat down on an empty chair and thought of a way to contact his two friends, but unfortunately, Hong Xinxin had already sealed his cultivation, preventing him from accessing his storage ring and contacting them. "Shit! We already expected Zhang Fei to target us, but his actions were much faster than our predictions."
[Mapping of the area of the Shrouded Sky Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]

At the Alchemy Union's headquarters, ten old alchemists were already standing in front of Zhang Fei [5] and the others. He then checked their respective statuses, and the strongest among them was only at the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. According to one of them, only Huoyun Zhiyan, Sun Jianming, and Xiu Hanyu had broken through to the Divine Manifestation Realm.
"Release your souls."

The ten people seemed hesitant to obey Zhang Fei [5]'s orders, but Shang Yumei immediately threatened them. "Do you all want to die? Release your souls right now, or I will send you all straight to the afterlife."

After they released their souls, Zhang Fei [5] used his soul manipulation to replicate their souls and merge them into his soul; this method was better than using his soul mark or demon slave mark because it did not burden his soul. Additionally, he used the soulbinding curse on them so he could use their soul power for his benefit. If they thought of betraying him, he could kill them instantly by absorbing their soul power.

After he was done, Zhang Fei [5] returned their souls to their bodies. He explained to them about their situation, and he also threatened to drain their soul power dry, which frightened them. He then gave each of them a set of basic pills. "I concocted those pills myself, and I want you to replicate them as perfectly as possible."
"How can we—"

"All of you are senior alchemists with centuries or thousands of years of experience. Since you guys already have such deep experience, you can think for yourselves about how to concoct those pills." Hearing Zhang Fei's words, the ten alchemists looked at Nanfeng Yunxi, who shrugged her shoulders. "Leave and spread the word to the other members that this organization is mine now! If they want to leave, they can leave, and I won't stop them. However, this organization will no longer provide support to them or their families, so they can think about their own decisions."

After the senior alchemists left, Zhang Fei [5] turned to the three women. "Yumei, assist Xuejia in managing and restructuring the organization's guards. If they resist, you can do what you see fit to them. Yunxi, meet the young alchemists you know and persuade them to join us, but you only need to choose the truly talented ones."
Shang Yumei, Luo Xuejia, and Nanfeng Yunxi immediately left the room to carry out Zhang Fei [5]'s orders.
"What are your plans after this, kid?" Feng Xishui asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] told Feng Xishui that he would send many cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm to spread his demon fox group throughout the lower realms. Additionally, he would prepare more people from the Red Sun Realm to go to all the planets in the middle realms so his group would dominate both lower and middle realms.

"Your ambition is lofty, huh?" Feng Xishui muttered with a faint smile. "However, I like it, and it proves that you are worthy to stand by my princess's side. If all your plans succeed, you will be the first cultivator to do so."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "The Nameless One and all the cultivators from the upper realm can dominate the lower and upper realms, but they don't have that kind of ambition, and they are already satisfied with their conditions in the upper realm. As for me, I have so many people by my side, so I need a large amount of resources to prepare myself and them, and I don't need to worry about clashing with those powerful cultivators. Still, I will keep searching for other opportunities there, and I will start from the Xianjin Realm."
"Have you been to the Xianjin Realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "I'm preparing a shop in that realm with the support of Cheng Gaoji."

Feng Xishui nodded in understanding. "I've heard that Cheng Gaoji is your subordinate now, so you can make use of him and his connections to develop your shop. However, you still have to be careful of some clans, especially since they have a higher status and authority than that old man.
"My senior brother has already told me about the Lei, Xiong, Jiao, Wu, and Pan clans."

"Those five clans might cause you trouble, but you should be more wary of one other clan." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Feng Xishui, who directly told him the clan's identity, making him frown. "According to the news, that clan has close ties with various demon clans from several realms, including the Abyssal Realm. In addition, there are several mysterious figures behind that clan; the Nameless One and the others cannot do anything to that clan because of their existence."
"Even the Nameless One couldn't do anything against that clan, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself, but his expression was full of shock.

"The Nameless One once fought one of them, and he almost lost to that person." Feng Xishui's answer shocked Zhang Fei [5] further. "My Emperor once sent someone to investigate that clan, but he never returned. Even so, he should still be alive now, especially since his life stone is still intact and shining."
"Do you think that person fell under the control of the people from that clan?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a frown.
Feng Xishui nodded at him. It's possible that happened to him, but we can't prove it, mostly because of those mysterious figures."

Zhang Fei [5] pondered each of their conversations seriously, which made him come up with a conjecture. "Does the appearance of those mysterious figures have anything to do with the destruction of the Starry Sky Realm?"
"Oh!" Feng Xishui clapped his hands. "That's right! The appearance of those mysterious figures is indeed related to the destruction of that realm and several others.
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] refused to understand. "I have never met those mysterious figures, but I can probably guess one of them, and I might know the identity of their leader."
"Who are those two people?"

"Have you ever heard of the dark phoenix?" Feng Xishui was shocked to hear that from Zhang Fei [5]. "I have met ancestor Feng Shen, who told me about the dark phoenix. I am certain it is one of them. As for their leader, I am certain that he is Xereth, one of the ancient demons from the Abyssal Realm, especially since he is the one responsible for the destruction of the Starry Sky Realm and others."
"When did you meet Ancestor Feng Shen? Why haven't I heard about the news of your coming to my phoenix realm?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "Senior, this body is my clone, and my other two clones are in the phoenix realm now. One of them is training at the place of Ancestor Feng Shen, and the other is training at the icy lake that belongs to Ancestor Feng Xueying. My other clone is currently in the Xianjin Realm together with my senior brother and senior sister, Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing."

sentences.text: In the Azure Sky Realm, it was not difficult for Hong Xinxin to find Sun Jianming, especially since he lived in a building with the Alchemy Union's name plaque.
Hong Xinxin did not want to make a big fuss in the realm, so she casually walked into the building, surprising Sun Jianming, who was arranging items.
Before Sun Jianming could greet her, Hong Xinxin had already moved in front of him and sealed his cultivation directly, causing his eyes to widen in shock.
"Who exactly are you?

"Zhang Fei is my future husband." Sun Jianming froze after Hong Xinxin said that.

By the way, he is at your organization's headquarters now, and your organization will be his from today onward."
Sun Jianming broke out in cold sweat after Hong Xinxin said all that, which made him think that Zhang Fei had deliberately sent him to kill him.

"You're lucky because he still needs you, so he won't kill you for now, and he asked me to take you back to your headquarters." Hong Xinxin then sent a long-distance message to Zhang Fei, but he told her that Huoyun Zhiyan was on his way to the Azure Sky Realm.

"How long will it take for Huoyun Zhiyan to arrive in this realm?"

At that time, my future husband will pick you both up, and he will decide the fate of the three of you." Hong Xinxin immediately left the shop and went to Zhang Fei's residence in the Azure Sky Realm, which Murong Qianying had previously bought.
Sun Jianming couldn't stop shaking as he imagined their future fates.

He then sat down on an empty chair and thought of a way to contact his two friends, but unfortunately, Hong Xinxin had already sealed his cultivation, preventing him from accessing his storage ring and contacting them.
"Shit!

chapters.title: Chapter 813 813: Meet The Wang Clan
paragraphs: After they left Jian Wufeng's place, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others went to Cheng Gaoji's residence, where they discussed the new shop.

Cheng Gaoji then informed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Yesterday, Wang Zhemin came to see me, and I have already told him about your intention to open your shop. You should still visit the Wang Clan to talk to him in person; he will help you get shop permits."
"Opening a shop in this realm requires those kinds of permits, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself.

"That's right." Cheng Gaoji nodded at him. "Unlike in the Red Sun Realm or other realms, this realm has very strict rules, including shop matters. The Nameless One deliberately left such matters to Wang Zhenmin and his Wang Clan, and he did not make exceptions for anyone, including Lin Jingxia."

"My home realm also has such rules, but they are stricter, and I need various permits to open my shop." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked him. "What about those luminous qi crystals? Have you contacted your customers to get them?"

"I have asked my customers to bring me those crystals; some will arrive in a week, and others later." Cheng Gaoji pointed to the back room. "Because I only have one set of materials, Little Duan is preparing to make another one, and we will finish it in two weeks. Therefore, you have to go to the Blacksmith Union to buy those materials, and we will immediately work on the other four weapons while waiting for my customers to arrive."

"I went to the Blacksmith Union before, but Ji Changlan wasn't there. Since his subordinates cannot access some materials without him, I will wait for him to arrive in this realm in a few days." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then got up from his seat. "I'm going to the Wang Clan now to take care of the permits so I can open my shop as soon as possible."
After they left, Cheng Gaoji went to see Duan Zhao to speed up the making of the weapon.
"Have you started your plans, Junior Brother?"

"I've taken over the Alchemy Union in the Shrouded Sky Realm, and I left Shang Yumei there to take care of everything. Hong Xinxin is currently in the Azure Sky Realm, and she has already captured Sun Jianming. However, she still has to wait for Huoyun Zhiyan to arrive in that realm, and I asked her to capture Xiu Hanyu in the Blossom Heaven Realm after that." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer surprised Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing. "One of my other clones is on his way to the Divine Flame Realm now, and I'm going to meet Jiang Shen to recruit them into my group."

"I envy you, Junior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Yan Yinqing. "You are young, but you act quickly and efficiently. You destroyed and took over the Zhang Clan yesterday, and now you have already taken control of the Alchemy Union. Although the abilities of the people from that organization can't compare to Aunt Jingxia, their popularity and authority in the middle realms are not inferior to those in the upper realms. Since you have absorbed them into your organization, you can easily master the middle realms."

"Senior Sister, I'm lucky to have my clones, or else I couldn't do everything in a short time." Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh before continuing. "Honestly, if only I had more confidence in my abilities, I could have settled everything a long time ago. Back then, I was too careful because those people were much stronger than me, which caused my problems to drag on. However, the problems in the Red Sun Realm gave me more confidence in my abilities, so I won't delay my problems any longer, and I will solve everything as soon as possible, including my problems with the Heavenly Fox Race."
"Does that imply that you plan to confront them directly?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "They will arrive in the middle realms in less than a month, and Tian Jianxia can help me track their location, especially since her brother is one of them. I will not face them all at once, and I will fight them one by one. Once they fall into my hands, I will use them to disrupt the situation in the Heavenly Moon Realm."
Lin Moxian raised her eyebrows. "If you do that, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing might make a move on their own, and you'll be the one at a loss if that happens."

"They will never make a move on their own, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied confidently. "Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu told me that demons from various realms have never stopped attacking their realms, so Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing will never leave their realms. If they do that, their realms will fall into the hands of the demons. As long as the two of them don't come to me, I'm confident I can handle the others. By the way, when will your aunt arrive in this realm?"
"A week or so."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "I can't wait to meet your aunt to talk about alchemy."
Soon, the three of them arrived at the Wang Clan, and a guard hurriedly ushered them inside after Lin Moxian showed his identity plaque.

When they arrived at the main hall, Wang Zhemin, Wang Xiaotang, and Gong Yulei were already waiting for them there. Their gazes were only on Zhang Xiaolong [3], but their expressions were filled with disbelief after they detected his cultivation, especially since he was able to toy with Wang Yourou with such a low cultivation.

Even so, Wang Zhemin and the others did not dare to underestimate Zhang Xiaolong [3] because his status as Hun Di's disciple was obvious, and the Soul Emperor would not take an ordinary cultivator to be his disciple, convincing them that he had many other advantages.
*Drap... Drap...*
Wang Yourou suddenly ran out from inside, especially after a servant informed her of the arrival of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others.

Since her grandfather was present in the room, Wang Yourou didn't say anything and sat beside her mother, Gong Yulei. Still, she didn't stop staring at Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her gaze was so fierce as if she wanted to swallow him alive.
"Senior Sister, stop staring at me like that, or you'll fall in love with me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonchalantly said this.
Wang Zhemin, Wang Xiaotang, and Gong Yulei were stunned by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shamelessness. They were clearly present in front of him, but he paid them no mind.
"You-" Wang Yourou's guts shrank as soon as her grandfather glared at her, forcing her to swallow back her anger. 'Tch! This little bastard! I'll teach him a lesson later!'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled casually before turning to face the three seniors. "Senior Wang, what should I do to get permission for my new shop?"

"First of all, please explain to me about your shop." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and explained to Wang Zhemin about his shop, and he also handed him a bottle of basic pills. The old man and the other two looked shocked as soon as they saw the five pills inside.
Wang Yourou looked confused by her family's expressions, so she walked over to them to look at the pills. She then looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a look full of shock as well.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to them. "Believe it or not, I concocted those pills myself. I am a grandmaster rank alchemist, and I can advance to king rank alchemist whenever I want."
"Do you have your alchemist identification plaque?" Gong Yulei asked him.

"I am a rogue cultivator, and I don't need their recognition, so I have never registered myself with any alchemist organization." Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out Hun Di's plaque. "If my status as my master's disciple is not enough for you to trust me, I will register with the alchemist organization in this realm."
Listening to Zhang Xiaolong [3], Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqin laughed in their hearts, and they believed the Wang Clan would not dare to doubt him after he took out their master plaque.

"Naturally, we dare not doubt you, and Yulei will prepare the necessary permits for your shop right now, so you can open your shop anytime." Gong Yulei immediately left them to take care of everything, and Wang Zhemin returned the bottle to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How much for each of your pills? Do you have more in stock?"

"Senior, I have many shops in other realms, so I can't possibly concoct them in limited quantities, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out several other bottles. "For one set of my basic pills, I usually sell them for ten million blue jewels, and people from other realms never stop buying them."1
"Aren't their prices too expensive?" Wang Xiaotang raised an eyebrow in question.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "Senior, you have never taken my pills, so you do not know their effects. Other alchemists may be able to match basic pills, but the effects and potency of their pills will never be able to match mine. If you are interested in my basic pills, I will give you a chance to use them first. If you feel that their effects are not worth the price I offer, then you do not need to pay for them."

"I agree." Wang Xiaotang immediately agreed because he did not believe that the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s pills were that extraordinary, and he did not need to pay for them if the effects were too ordinary. "You can give them to my daughter and let her try the effects."

"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately threw a bottle at Wang Yourou. "Senior Sister, please swallow them on the spot, so your father and grandfather can feel the changes in you after you swallow my pills."
"Humph!" Wang Yourou snorted and returned to her seat. She then started swallowing the pills one by one without rushing, so her grandfather and father could follow the changes.

Sometime later, Wang Yourou had finished swallowing the pills and tried to absorb Qi from the air, only to be surprised by the speed of her absorption. She could also feel that her dantian, bones, meridians, and soul were much stronger than before.
Wang Zhemin and Wang Xiaotang seriously observed Wang Yourou's body, and the changes in her astonished them.

Yan Yinqing was also astonished by the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s pills, and she was eager to swallow them. Unlike them, Lin Moxian was no longer surprised because he had swallowed them before, so he knew for sure their effects were extraordinary.
"How do you feel now, Senior Sister?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] posed the question with a playful smile.

"Humph!" Wang Yourou looked at the two seniors. "Grandpa, I don't like this little bastard, but I have to admit that his pills are very effective and potent. The basic pills I swallowed in the past were concocted by Senior Jingxia, and his pills are still much better than hers, let alone the pills sold in this realm. Ten million blue jewels are indeed too expensive, but I think the price is commensurate with their quality."
Wang Zhemin nodded in understanding before taking out a storage ring and throwing it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "One hundred thousand purple jewels are inside, so you can give me another set of nine."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave Wang Zhemin another nine bottles, but he then showed them another pill. "Senior Jingxia doesn't have this kind of pill, Junior Brother." Yan Yinqing spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "If the effects of this pill are really like what you just said, one million blue jewels for one pill is already too cheap, and you should be able to sell it at a higher price in your shop later."
Lin Moxian chimed in. "Yinqing is right, Junior Brother. Perhaps you can sell one pill for five million blue jewels, and the people of this realm will flock to your shop to buy it."

Wang Zhemin gave a thousand purple jewels to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately handed the Yin Purifying Pill to Wang Yourou. "You will like the effect so much, Senior Sister."

"Humph!" Wang Yourou swallowed the pill without hesitation, and its effects took effect sometime later. "The pill is truly marvelous, Grandpa! My Yin Qi has truly become two times stronger and purer than before, and I can cultivate faster with this."
Wang Zhemin nodded and asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. "Do you have the same pills for male cultivators?"
"Naturally." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out two Yang Purifying Pills and showed them to them. "This pill's effect is the same, but this one is specifically for male cultivators."
"I'll buy five of this pill and four of the previous pill." Wang Zhemin immediately paid nine thousand purple jewels, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] unable to stop laughing in his heart.

"Thank you, senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored them. "Since my business here is settled, we will be leaving now. I will open my shop in a few days, and there are many other items that I will be selling there later, so you can visit my shop to have a look."

"Are their effects that amazing?" Gong Yulei asked her daughter.

"Yes, Father."
"Hey! Wait for me!"

"Shameless!" Wang Yurou shouted at him. "Where are the three of you going now?"
"I want to look for some materials to renovate my new shop a little."
"Oh." Wang Yourou nodded slightly. "In that case, I will join the three of you, and I will take you to the best material shop in this realm."

Lin Moxian laughed inwardly as he patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. 'Since Wufeng has forgotten Yourou, you can approach her if you want. If you can get her, the Wang Clan will always have your back, and it will be beneficial to you.'
'This woman is not bad, but she is too arrogant, Senior Brother.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then nodded to Wang Yourou. "Please lead us there, Senior Sister."

chapters.title: Chapter 814 814: The Xiong Clan
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly as Wang Yourou led them to a materials shop. The shop was indeed large and had a wide variety of items, but he didn't like its name, especially since it belonged to the Xiong Clan. "Can we go to another shop?"

"Why?" Wang Yourou asked in confusion. "The Xiong Clan owns the largest materials shop in this realm, and they sell almost all kinds of items, from building materials, blacksmithing, alchemy, and many more."
"Nothing." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then walked in front of them. "Let's go in then."
Wang Yourou turned to Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing. "Does he have problems with the Xiong Clan?"

"He didn't have any problems with the Xiong Clan before, but your actions yesterday could cause problems between them." Lin Moxian's answer made Wang Yourou realize something. "Your cultivation is far above his, but he suppressed you to that extent yesterday. Don't you think that will attract their attention?"

Wang Yourou nodded to him. "We cannot change what has already happened. Since he was able to suppress me like that yesterday, he shouldn't have to be afraid of them. Moreover, he has you and Yan Yinqing by his side, so I believe that they won't dare to find trouble with him."
"You have lived for over two thousand years, but you are naive." Lin Moxian immediately followed Zhang Xiaolong [3], leaving Wang Yourou dumbfounded.

Yan Yinqing shook her head at Wang Yourou's expression. "Do you think they wouldn't dare to look for trouble with my junior brother? Since you yourself dared to look for trouble with him yesterday, they certainly wouldn't be afraid to look for trouble with him either."
Yan Yinqing left behind Wang Yourou, who immediately let out a soft sigh before following them.

In the shop, Zhang Xiaolong [3] first went to the alchemist area, and he bought various kinds of herbs that were not available in the alchemy shop he visited yesterday so he could increase the variety of herbs in the sealed world pearl. He also bought several types of ready-to-use herbs, especially since he wanted to concoct rank four pills to increase his alchemist rank to king rank.
Lin Moxian casually followed behind Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Wang Yourou and Yan Yinqing were looking at items in another area.

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the blacksmithing section, and he also bought several types of materials for forging equipment, especially since the materials that Tie Xuan gave him were almost used up. Moreover, Shi Xi was also a blacksmith, and he needed many materials to teach her to perfectly forge a spirit-grade weapon.

"Why did you buy so many forging materials?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Lin Moxian about Shi Xi. "I didn't expect there to be someone among your wives who has the metal element. She must be very useful in helping you, especially regarding blacksmithing. How many alchemists are there in your harem?"

"Three of my wives are alchemists, and they learned about alchemy from Feng Yao." Lin Moxian was not surprised that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s wife learned alchemy from the phoenix princess, especially since her ability in alchemy was quite well known in the upper realms. "One of them has reached the king rank, and the other two are still at the master rank, but I believe they will reach the grandmaster rank soon. When they reach that rank, they will be able to help me to concoct more pills."
Lin Moxian nodded in agreement. "They are not only your wives, but they are also your valuable assets, so you must always protect them, junior brother."

"Of course, I will always keep them safe, and I will kill anyone who tries to harm them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly sensed several gazes directed at him, so he hurriedly searched for those people. He discovered a group of people from the Xiong Clan watching him from upstairs, and some of their names were in red. 'Do you know Xiong Qinglai and Xiong Yinghao, Senior Brother?'

Lin Moxian immediately understood the meaning behind Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question. 'Xiong Qinglai is the first young master of the Xiong Clan, and he will be the one to inherit the clan in the future. Xiong Yinghao was the first child of Xiong Changhe's second wife, and his character was the worst among their generation. You must not bring anyone among your wives into this realm, or that little bastard will use any means to kidnap them.'
'Are there people stronger than Xiong Changhe in the Xiong Clan?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked again.

Lin Moxian gave a light nod. 'Xiong Yehui is Xiong Changhe's father, and his cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. His wife, Duan Menghua, also has the same cultivation as her husband. By the way, that old woman is also a soul cultivator, and her abilities in the soul cultivation path are only below our master's, so you must always be wary of her.'

'I see.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally would not underestimate Lin Moxian's warning, but he was not too afraid of the people from the Xiong Clan. After that, he proceeded to the building materials area and purchased some items to renovate his store to meet his needs.

Xiong Qinglai and Xiong Yinghao suddenly walked down from upstairs while watching Zhang Xiaolong [3], but they did not approach him because of Lin Moxian's presence by his side. Instead, they approached Yan Yinqing and Wang Yourou, who were still looking at items in another area.

Compared to a blacksmith, Xiong Qinglai's appearance was more like a scholar with a plain white hanfu covering his tall body. In contrast, Xiong Yinghao's appearance was more like a scoundrel and a lecher, and he deliberately showed off his well-built body by opening the upper half of his hanfu.

Yan Yinqing herself was quite familiar with the characters of the two men, especially Xiong Yinghao's character. He did not linger there and moved to the side of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian, leaving Wang Yourou alone in that area.

Wang Yourou wanted to run towards them, but the two men immediately blocked her. Xiong Yinghao nonchalantly held her hand and teased her, causing her to scream and threaten him. "If you continue to bother me, I will ask my grandfather to revoke the permits of this shop, and your Xiong Clan will never be able to trade in this realm again."

From a distance, Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in amusement when he heard Wang Yourou's threat to Xiong Yinghao. She was already two thousand years old, but her behavior was far more immature when compared to Xu Ling'er or Wu Lianzhi, who were still 11 and 12 years old.
"Haha." Xiong Yinghao laughed and let go of Wang Yourou's hand. "Young Miss Wang, I was just joking with you, so you don't need to threaten me like this, right?"

"Humph!" Wang Yourou coldly snorted. "You are not worthy of touching me, you lecherous bastard! If you dare to touch me once again, I will immediately complain about you to my grandfather! If necessary, I will complain about you to Uncle Nameless One, and your Xiong Clan will suffer the consequences!"
Xiong Yinghao's face darkened as soon as Wang Yourou mentioned the Nameless One's name, and he wanted to reply to her, but Xiong Qinglai stopped him by pressing his white fan to his chest. "Brother—"

"Forget it." Xiong Qinglai glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and asked Wang Yourou. "Do you know who that young man is, Yourou? You two had some problems with each other yesterday, but you two are together like old friends today."
"Our relationship is none of your business!" Wang Yourou immediately escaped from the two men by running toward Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others. "Have you bought everything you need?"

"Senior Sister, I would rather not have any problems with your admirers, so please don't get too close to me." Wang Yourou flew into a rage as soon as he said that, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] paid her no mind and hurriedly left the shop together with Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing.
*Bam... Bam...*
"That little bastard!" Wang Yourou angrily shouted as she stamped both feet on the floor, but she immediately followed by running behind them.

In the distance, Xiong Qinglai squinted his eyes as he stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s back. Xiong Yinghao patted his shoulder and asked. "Is that kid really the blacksmith that Yuan Kong talked about?"

"Yes." Xiong Qinglai nodded at him. "The kid's characteristics are the same as what Yuan Kong mentioned, and he previously bought a lot of forging materials from our shop, so I'm sure he's the one. Old Yuan told our father that kid had relations with the Murong, Shang, Hong, and Tie Clans. However, I didn't expect that he also had relations with the Lin, Yan, and Wang clans."
"What do you think his purpose in coming to this realm is besides opening a shop?"

Xiong Qinglai folded his white fan, gripped it tightly, and fell into thought. "I heard from a member of the Blacksmith Union that he was looking for Ji Changlan yesterday, but that person didn't know his purpose for looking for Old Ji."
"Should we send someone to follow him?"
"Our father has already sent someone to tail him, so we don't need to bother sending anyone else." Xiong Qinglai then walked out. "Rather than thinking about him, you should focus on your task."

Xiong Yinghao became serious as soon as his brother mentioned that. "When those people come to this realm? The Nameless One and the others have been gone for five months, but they still haven't come."
"There are many eyes and ears, so be careful when you speak." Xiong Yinghao nodded slightly to Xiong Qinglai. "Complete your task as soon as possible."
"All right, I'll take care of it now."
After Xiong Yinghao left, Xiong Qinglai went to another area, where a person wearing a black hood was waiting for him. He then knelt on one knee and greeted him. "Master."

"What about your assignment?" The voice indicated that the person was an old man. Xiong Qinglai informed him of several things, including about Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian. "The others will arrive in a few days, and they will take care of the two kids, so you just need to focus on that."
"Yes, Master." The old man then gave Xiong Qinglai something. "Will the leader also come to this realm, Master?"

"Haha." The old man laughed horribly. "The Nameless One is absent; therefore, the leader will not come to this realm, and we will take care of everything. Go back now, or people will be suspicious of you."
"Yes, Master."

paragraphs: In the phoenix realm, Feltia [2] discussed the Blood Dragon Demon, Long Jiutian, with Feng Shen and Feng Xueying. He told them about his guess that the demon was one of Xereth's subordinates, and he thought that the dark phoenix would appear in the Xianjin Realm. "What do you two think about that?"

"Your guess might be correct." Feng Shen turned to Feng Xueying, who immediately nodded. "For now, you should gather more information about them first. If the demons are indeed Xereth's subordinates, you can come here to pick us up, and we will stop them from wreaking havoc in the Xianjin Realm."

Feltia [2] was relieved by Feng Shen's answer because he wasn't sure that he could fight Long Jiutian, especially if the demons' comrades also came to the Xianjin realm. "My senior brother has already contacted Lin Jingxia, and she will arrive at that realm a few days earlier. The two of you may not be able to stop them, so I hope you can ask the other mythical beasts' ancestors for help."

"You're right about that." Feng Shen replied with a nod. "In that case, I'll go to the Wilderness Expanse Realm to meet the two ancestors of the gold fox race right away, especially since they're as strong as us."

"Wait." Feltia [2] stopped Feng Shen. "Old Phoenix, I have some business in that realm, so I'll go with you there. However, I won't be meeting the members of the fox race, and I'll return to this realm right after."
"What business do you have in the Wilderness Expanse Realm, kid?" Feng Xueying asked him.
Feltia [2] explained to the two phoenix ancestors about Feng Yao's suspicion that Hu Yue had the golden fox bloodline, but her bloodline was still in a dormant state.

"I see." Feng Xueying nodded in understanding. "If Little Yao has said that, then it is likely that your wife does have their bloodline. You cannot help her awaken it; you must take her to their realm."

"Unfortunately, you will not be able to bring your wife there, or they will kill her." Feltia [2] looked at Feng Shen with a frown. "The golden fox race is as arrogant as the heavenly fox race, and they will never allow their bloodline to mix with other beast races. In their eyes, mixed breeds are the most disgusting creatures, and they will eliminate them all to maintain the purity of their bloodline."

Feltia [2] shook his head in response. "Old phoenix, I will do everything possible to strengthen all my wives, including Yue'er. Since she can only become strong by going to that realm, I will take her there one day. If the golden fox race dares to touch her or intends to kill her, I will eliminate that race from this universe, and I will use their beast essence to evolve."
Feng Shen and Feng Xueying looked at Feltia [2] with raised eyebrows, but they didn't doubt his words. Instead, they believed that he could wipe out the golden fox race or even the heavenly fox race.
Feng Shen immediately changed into his phoenix form. "Get on my back, kid. I'll take you to the Wilderness Expanse Realm, and we'll be there in two to three days."
After Feltia [2] jumped on his back, Feng Shen at full speed flew away from the Phoenix Realm.

Feng Xueying looked at Zhang Yue, who was cultivating by the icy lake together with Xuan Lianghua and Xue Jingling. 'Your husband will face great danger in the future, so you must prepare well to pass my trials, little girl. After you have passed all of them, I will give you the best gift from my ice phoenix race, and you will be the strongest ice cultivator then.'

Zhang Fei was already in the Netherworld Realm together with Morgana, and his explanation about Long Jiutian and the possibility that the demon was one of Xereth's subordinates shocked the witch demon.
Morgana thought about all that with an expression full of seriousness. "If your guess is correct, Xereth may have returned, and he may attack other realms soon."
"Which realm do you think Xereth will attack next?"

"I'm sure that the Abyssal Realm is one of Xereth's targets." Morgana's answer did not surprise Zhang Fei, especially since the demon once killed the fourth demon emperor of that realm. "He attacked the Heavenly Moon Realm in the past, but Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were too strong for him, and they managed to repel him. Although he has failed once, I believe he will not give up, and he will probably attack the realm once more."
Zhang Fei suddenly thought of something and asked Morgana again. "Could it be that Xereth is the mastermind behind the attack of the demons from other realms on the Heavenly Moon Realm?"

"The possibility exists." Morgana then took out an interspatial communication device, and she contacted several of her acquaintances in the Abyssal Realm. She asked them to inform their current demon emperor about the matter so they could be prepared if Xereth attacked their realm. "Please let me know if you find out more information about the movements of those demons, especially Xereth's movements. That realm is my home realm, and I can't let it be destroyed in their hands."
"I will contact you immediately if I get any other information about them." Thereafter, Zhang Fei went somewhere else.

Oz the First suddenly approaches Morgana. "Do you want to return to the abyssal realm, wife? I can handle the situation in this realm myself, and I will contact Zhang Fei directly if I am unable to handle it myself."

"No." Morgana refused her husband's offer. "I do think about my home realm, but I am your wife, and your condition has not fully recovered. I am afraid that you will change because of the influence of the sealed soul, so I will continue to stay by your side just in case the worst happens. Moreover, my demon emperor is not weak, and the people around him are also strong, so I believe they can protect our realm."
Oz the First embraced Morgana, who immediately curled up in his embrace. "I'm happy with your concern for me, but I don't want you to focus too much on me, and you also have to think about yourself."
"I chose this myself, so you don't have to think about it, okay?"
"If you change your mind and want to return to your home realm, you must tell me straight away."
"Yeah."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived before the four people from the Shang Clan, but he found Shang Chongyun looking gloomy. Naturally, he knew the reason, which was because Murong Qianying had sent him a long-distance voice message about her decision to part with him.
"Do you guys want to return to the Shang Clan?" Zhang Fei asked the four people, who surprised them. "Shang Huaqiang is dead, and the Shang Clan is mine now."
"Are you serious about that?" Shang Chenguang asked, his tone full of shock.

Zhang Fei shrugged his shoulders. "Not only is Shang Huaqiang dead, but Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun are also dead. Fei Qinyuan, Shang Ziyuan, Shang Xishun, and Shi Wuxian are in my custody now. If the four of you want to go back there, I will take you there right now."
"Husband, let's return to our realm." Ran Keqing spoke to Shang Tinglong, who immediately agreed with her wishes. "What about you two?"
"I will also return to our realm." Shang Chenguang answered with a nod.

"You three can return to our realm, and I will go explore other realms to find a new life." Ran Keqing and the others were not surprised by Shang Chongyun's decision. "Tell me the truth, kid. Did my wife decide that matter because of you?"

"What would you do if that were true?" Zhang Fei replied to Shang Chongyun with a relaxed smile, which convinced him that his guess was correct. "To be honest, initially, I had no plans for Murong Qianying, primarily because I was unfamiliar with her. However, she suddenly came to the Wasteland Realm to control me, and she forced your two daughters to help her. Therefore, I did that to her, and we've been together in the past few months."
Zhang Fei's revelation shocked the four of them, and Shang Chongyun clenched both his fists, making his palms completely red.

Shang Chongyun was completely furious with Zhang Fei, but he had seen his abilities for himself when he and the other three first came to the Netherworld Realm, and they were helpless against him. Moreover, he had managed to defeat Shang Huaqiang and take over the Shang Clan, which they had never been able to do. "I was furious and frustrated because of this matter, but I was aware that I was not your opponent, and you could kill me before I made a move. I'm not afraid of you, but I'm afraid of death, so I admit defeat to you. Please look after Yumei and Yaolin for me."
"I will look after and protect them."
After that, Shang Chongyun took out his flying artifact and left the Netherworld Realm alone, and he did not once look back.

Zhang Fei brought the other three back to the Red Sun Realm and let them go to the Shang Clan, but he did not go to that clan. Instead, he met Hong Quan and the others, and he told them about the situation in the Xianjin Realm.

Hong Quan wanted to help the people in the Xianjin Realm, but Zhang Fei forbade him from going there now. Despite this, he asked them to be prepared in case the situation in the realm worsened once the demons attacked.
Hong Quan contacted all the clans in the Red Sun Realm and informed them about the matter, and they agreed with him because the Xianjin Realm was too important to the cultivators in the upper realms.

Zhang Fei wanted to leave the Hong Clan, but Mai Xiaomeng stopped him and asked him to bring her cat race back to the Red Sun Realm. Therefore, he took him to the Nine Stars Realm, but he didn't immediately take him to see her race members.

Zhang Fei first met the emperors of the six kingdoms, who had prepared several of their subordinates to help him spread his demon fox group in the lower realms. After he sent them to the Sky Jade Realm, he brought Mai Xiaomeng to meet the members of his cat race, and he brought them back to the Red Sun Realm.

Since the Shang Clan's residence was very spacious, Zhang Fei asked Mai Xiaomeng to bring her cat race members there so they could live there together with the Murong Clan and the remaining Shang Clan members, such as Shang Xinyu and Shang Yifen's families.

After completing his task, Zhang Fei proceeded to the Xi Clan, where he encountered an unpleasant reception from Xi Hongyan. He told her and Xi Qiuwei about the situation in the Xianjin Realm, and he asked them to prepare to help the people of that realm if the demons attacked.

Therefore, she agreed to Zhang Fei's request, and she asked her aunt to prepare their clan members.

"That's true." Xi Hongyan nodded in agreement. "The reason I broke up with Wang Yourou was because she was too childish, and she often brought trouble to me."

"Humph!" Xi Hongyan coldly snorted. "You men are lowly and disgusting creatures! I will never be interested in Lin Moxian, so you can tell him not to come to me again!"

Even the person sent by the Phoenix Emperor to investigate the clan disappeared, and that person is probably under their control now."
Lin Moxian released a heavy sigh after hearing that. "If the Nameless One can't defeat them, then how can we defeat them?"

Lin Moxian felt quite relieved after hearing that. "My aunt will arrive in a few days, and Tian Shuxiang has set off for this realm. I hope they won't be late, or the situation here will be really chaotic."

Oz the First suddenly approaches Morgana.

Oz the First embraced Morgana, who immediately curled up in his embrace.

"I chose this myself, so you don't have to think about it, okay?"

"Yeah."
