chapters.title: Chapter 816: King Rank Alchemist
paragraphs: Unlike the other members who were angered by Zhang Fei [5]'s words, Jiang Shen laughed out loud after hearing that. "Hahaha! I wouldn't dare doubt your words, kid. You have connections with so many cultivators from the upper realm, and the senior beside you is also one of them, so you can force me easily."
The people beside Jiang Shen looked at Feng Xishui, and they finally realized that they couldn't detect his cultivation, proving that he was much stronger than them.

Feng Xishui only smiled seeing them like that. "Even without me having to make a move, this kid can easily subdue you all. He has already killed a powerful cultivator from the upper realms, so you guys are not his match, with your cultivation only being in the Divine Expansion Realm and the Divine Manifestation Realm."

They obviously didn't believe Feng Xishui's words because Zhang Fei [5]'s cultivation was still at the ten mortal realms, but Jiang Shen told them straight away. "This kid suppressed Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi with just his killing intent when they went to the Nine Stars Realm three months ago, so you shouldn't doubt his abilities. If you guys fight with him, you will die at his hands."

"So, what do you decide, Senior Jiang? Are you willing to join me?" Zhang Fei [5] casually asked. "As long as you all are willing to join and be obedient to me, I will not treat you badly and will help you reach a higher stage."
*Tap... Tap...*
Jiang Shen lightly tapped his fingers on the table as he thought. "What can you give us, kid?"
Zhang Fei [5] took out a bottle of basic pills and handed it to Jiang Shen, who immediately checked the contents. The people beside him also checked the pills, only to be shocked by their grade.

Zhang Fei [5] sucked the bottle toward him, saved it again, and spoke to them. "After this, I will concoct rank 4 pills, and I will become a king rank alchemist afterwards. Additionally, I have almost succeeded in forging earth-grade equipment perfectly, so I will become a master rank blacksmith soon. Not to mention, I am a rank 4 array master, so you should already know the benefits of joining me."
"Can we watch you concoct the pill?" One of them asked.

"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] stood up from his seat and moved to the floor before taking out the Heaven Creation Furnace. Since Jiang Shen and the others weren't alchemists, he didn't worry too much about them, and he could prove his alchemy abilities more easily.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] took out the herbs to concoct the rank 4 Four-Star Yang Pill, which could increase the amount of his Yang Qi by 80% in one hour.

Jiang Shen and his subordinates carefully watched Zhang Fei [5], who deftly prepared the herbs one by one. In less than ten minutes, all the herbs were ready to be processed into pills, so he heated his furnace directly.

After the furnace reached the desired heat, Zhang Fei [5] immediately threw all the herbs into it, which shocked all of them. They immediately used their senses to see the process inside the furnace, where they could see that he was controlling all the herbs with outstanding precision.

Since the Heaven Creation Furnace had the function of cutting the time for concocting pills by half and upgrading them by one grade, Zhang Fei [5] was able to complete his alchemy in just one and a half hours.
[Ding]
[The Alchemy feature is upgraded to level 4.]
[New items available.]

After that, Zhang Fei [5] took out the five pills inside and showed them to those people. "See? You've watched me do alchemy firsthand, and these pills are superior-grade, rank 4 Four-Star Yang Pills, so you don't need to doubt my abilities anymore, right?"

Jiang Shen and the others nodded in response to Zhang Fei [5], who quickly cleaned up the remaining herbs and stored his furnace again. "Kid, I would like to join you, but this organization is affiliated with the Blacksmith Union in the upper realms, so you should go there to talk to Senior Ji Changlan first. However, I think it's not a difficult matter for you, especially since you have relationships with many famous clans."

"Ji Changlan should be arriving at the Xianjin Realm today or tomorrow, and I'm already waiting for him there, so I'll meet him as soon as he arrives." Jiang Shen and the others looked confused hearing that because Zhang Fei [5] was clearly in front of them, but he would rather not explain to them about it yet. "Senior Jiang, I believe he won't refuse my request, so you should start preparing to join my organization."
"All right, I will prepare what is necessary." Jiang Shen then asked him. "Do you two want to rest at our place?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused. "I heard that there is no alchemy shop in this realm because Huoyun Zhiyan was rejected, so I want to open one here, and you will help me manage it. Therefore, I want to go to the city to find the best building, and I will use it to open a shop and restaurant."
"A restaurant?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Jiang Shen about his other restaurants. "Do you know the best chef in this realm?"
"I do." Jiang Shen then walked to the exit. "Let's go; I'll accompany you around the city, and I'll take you to meet the best chef in this realm."
A while later, they arrived at a simple residence, where Zhang Fei [5] could smell the fragrant aroma of the dishes inside.
"Do you like their fragrant scent?" Jiang Shen asked.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Their aroma is quite fragrant and appetizing, but I'm not sure about their taste. I have no intention of belittling the chef, but the dishes in my restaurant are too delicious to be compared to other dishes."
"Let's go in; I will introduce you to Grandma Wan Xueyuan, and you can taste her dishes yourself." Jiang Shen immediately led Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui into the residence.

In the kitchen, they could see a woman in her fifties cooking with a cheerful expression while whistling a tune, indicating her love for cooking. There were already several dishes on the table, but she was still cooking so many other dishes.

"Grandma Wan." Wan Xueyuan turned her head to Jiang Shen before raising an eyebrow at the presence of Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui. "This kid wants to open a restaurant in our realm, and he's looking for the best chef, so I brought him to you."
"Little Jiang, you know I do not cook for business, so you can take him somewhere else." Wan Xueyuan refused.
"Grandma—"

"Are you satisfied with the quality of your cooking, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] used his Qi to take a bit of one of the dishes and eat it directly, making Wan Xueyuan frown. "As expected, this dish has an aroma that arouses appetite, but the taste is completely bland. If I sell these dishes in my restaurant, the diners will definitely not be interested in eating them."
"Are you looking down on me, little brat?" Wan Xueyuan inquired, her tone filled with anger.

"A chef who can't take complaints will never be a successful chef." Zhang Fei [5] summoned Zhang Chen out of the training space, surprising them, including Feng Xishui. "Grandma, this senior thinks that her dishes are the best, so I want you to prove to her that her dishes are nothing compared to yours."
"Fei'er, you shouldn't talk like that about this senior." Zhang Chen then spoke to Wan Xueyuan. "Please forgive my grandson, Senior. He is indeed too outspoken, so don't take his words to heart."
Wan Xueyuan simply nodded and asked. "Are you a chef?"
"Not really." Zhang Chen replied by shaking her head. "I usually cook for my family, and all of them really like my cooking."

"Your grandson said that my dishes are nothing compared to yours, so I want you to prove it to me." Wan Xueyuan pointed to the kitchen side. "All the ingredients are available there, and you can use them however you like."

Instead, Zhang Chen took out some beast meat and spices from her storage ring, confusing Wan Xueyuan. "My dishes are different from the dishes available in all cultivator realms, so I will use my ingredients."
"It's up to you, and I just want you to prove your grandson's words." Wan Xueyuan continued cooking while waiting for Zhang Chen.
Zhang Chen glared at Zhang Fei [5], who responded with a smile. She could only sigh and start preparing to cook a dish.
In less than an hour, Zhang Chen had finished her dish. Wan Xueyuan, Jiang Shen, and Feng Xishui could smell an aroma that was much more tempting than the aroma of the dishes already on the table.
"Please taste my dish, Senior."

Wan Xueyuan immediately picked up the chopsticks and tasted Zhang Chen's dish, and her expression changed several times as she enjoyed it. Jiang Shen and Feng Xishui, who were curious about the dish, also tasted it.
"Delicious!" Jiang Shen exclaimed quite loudly. "Grandma Wan, her dish is much tastier and richer than yours."

Since Feng Xishui had never tasted Wan Xueyuan's dishes, he decided to try one of them. However, the taste of Zhang Chen's dish had already affected his palate, making it unpleasant in his mouth. "Your dish is too bland compared to hers, and her dish is really rich in flavor."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled triumphantly at Wan Xueyuan's expression, but Zhang Chen immediately pinched his waist. "Ouch! Stop it, Grandma!"
"Don't have to pretend in front of me." Zhang Chen said with a sharp look.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and embraced his grandmother. "Do you still feel that I underestimate you, Senior? My grandmother's dishes are the most delicious, and we already have many restaurants in two different realms; even diners are willing to queue to eat our dishes. If you are willing to help me at the restaurant that I will open in this realm, she will help you to improve your cooking skills. Additionally, I can help you to reach a higher level in cultivation, and you can live longer to improve your cooking skills."

Jiang Shen directly spoke to Wan Xueyuan. "Grandma, this kid is a king-rank alchemist, and I have witnessed his alchemy skills and pills firsthand. He has already taken over the Alchemy Union from the hands of Huoyun Zhiyan and the others, and he will open an alchemy shop in our realm soon."
"Are you for real?" Wu Xueyuan asked in disbelief.

Jiang Shen nodded to her. "I don't need to lie to you, right? In fact, I have already decided to join his organization, but I have to wait for Ji Changlan's decision first. Moreover, you have tasted his grandmother's dish, and her dish is much better than yours. Therefore, you don't need to hesitate to join him anymore, and you will get many benefits by joining him, especially in the culinary field."

"Grandma, I will go look for a building for my shop and restaurant in this realm, so I want you to stay here and chat with this senior." After Zhang Chen agreed, Zhang Fei [5] and Jiang Shen left Wu Xueyuan's residence.
However, Feng Xishu decided to stay at Wan Xueyuan's residence because Zhang Fei [5] did not need protection, allowing him to protect Zhang Chen while he was away.

paragraphs: Feltia [2] nodded at Huli Zhishen. "Previously, I was cultivating in the Phoenix Realm, and my senior brother told me about the situation in the Xianjin Realm. Therefore, I conveyed it to Old Shen and Old Xueying, and I came here with him because I have never been to this realm before."

"Who is your senior brother?" Feltia [2] showed two plaques to Huli Zhishen. One belonged to Hun Di, and the other belonged to the Lin Clan, which Lin Moxian gave to him. "The Soul Emperor's disciple, huh? The other one belongs to Lin Jingxia."
"That's right." Feltia [2] kept the two plaques again. "My master is Master Hun, and my senior brother is Senior Jingxia's nephew, Lin Moxian."

'This kid is quite cunning! He knew that I wouldn't dare do anything to him if he took out those two plaques.' Huli Zhishen then spoke to him. "My husband is different from me, so you must leave this area now, or he will capture you if he manages to detect your presence."
"Yes."

Huli Zhishen fell dumbstruck as soon as Feltia [2] used the nine cloud steps, especially since he immediately disappeared from her senses. "What a terrifying speed! His cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms, but he can escape my senses in just a blink of an eye."
"What are you doing here?" Huli Jinhu suddenly appeared beside her.
Huli Zhishen shook her head. "Since you've already taken care of them, we should go to the Xianjin Realm right now."
"Let's go!" Both Huli Jinhu and Huli Zhishen turned into golden light and flew out of their realm.
Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had returned to Phoenix Realm and went straight to the icy lake. "Do you want to go to the Xianjin Realm now, Old Phoenix?"
"Yes." Feng Xueying immediately agreed. "Old Shen and the others will need some time to get there, so I will go there first to monitor the situation."

Feltia [2] immediately opened the gate leading to the Xianjin Realm, and Feng Xueying hurriedly entered it. Thereafter, he and Zhang Fei [4] went to the Nine Hells Realm to complete all three daily quests, especially since the other clones were still busy with other affairs.

Tantai Lingyan then informed them as well. "The people from my Tantai Clan will also arrive in this realm at the same time as them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Lin Moxian, who immediately informed him. "My aunt is already close to this realm, and she will arrive tonight. The Wang, Gong, and Jian clans have already prepared their clan members. Besides, Uncle Zhemin has already sent his people to keep an eye on the Xiong Clan, so you don't need to be concerned about that clan. Senior Yishen has also contacted the other doctors; he asked them to prepare for the possibility of heavy casualties."
"What about the other clans?" Yan Yinqing asked them.

"Cheng Gaoji has already informed those clans about this matter, but some of them do not believe that demons dare to invade this realm, such as the Jiao and Pan clans." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer did not surprise the three of them. "Feng Xueying has arrived in this realm, and Huli Jinhu and Huli Zhishen from the golden fox race are on their way here. Currently, Feng Shen is going to meet the ancestors of the other mythical beasts; however, their agreement is not guaranteed. Even if they agree, it will take them some time to arrive here. As for the people from the Red Sun Realm, they have been preparing since three days ago, and I will bring them here if the situation becomes serious."

Lin Moxian suddenly received a voice message from someone, and he informed them after listening to it. "Wufeng just told me that You Shen is on his way here to help us, and he brought all his disciples with him. Hey, junior brother, do you have a way to contact our master? If we can contact them and bring them here, we won't have to worry about those demons."

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows for a moment before opening the gate leading to the Nine Stars Realm. "I will return to my realm to go to the Star Tower, and I will try to ask those people for help."
"I'll go with you." Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing both spoke simultaneously.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took the two of them with him, but Tantai Lingyan decided to stay behind to oversee the situation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the other two were already at the Star Tower. "Old man, I need your help."
The old man immediately appeared in front of them, but his presence made Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing tense up. "What kind of help do you need from me, kid?"

"Can you contact your friends at the Sun Tower?" The old man nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Please help me contact them, old man. I need the people who are challenging the tower to deal with a big problem. If we fail to stop it, these three mortal realms will be in danger."
"I'll contact them, and you three can leave this tower now."

As soon as the three of them disappeared, Helian Xun'er and Hua Mei'er appeared beside the old man. "Master, I still don't understand why you keep helping that brat! I believe he's deliberately taking advantage of you for his interests."
The old man ignored Hua Mei'er and contacted the two people in the Sun Tower. He asked them to inform the Nameless One and the others about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s request.
"Do you think he will challenge the second floor soon, Master?" Helian Xun'er asked.

The old man shook his head. "That kid has indeed broken through to the Heaven Realm, but his cultivation is still far from stable because he advanced too quickly, breaking through three minor stages and one major stage in quick succession. With his unstable cultivation, he will not be able to face the challenges on the second floor, so he has to wait for his cultivation to completely stabilize."

"I think so too." Helian Xun'er replied with a nod. "I don't understand why that kid forced himself, but he was lucky that his cultivation foundation didn't collapse because of his recklessness. Otherwise, he would have become a cripple, and his talents would have been wasted."
"Master—"
"Let's go back." The old man and Helian Xun'er immediately disappeared, leaving behind the annoyed Hua Mei'er.

"Bring me there."
"Let's go." Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought the three of them to the Xianjin Realm directly.
At the Sun Tower.

Feng Jiu and the others, who were resting in one area, were surprised by the arrival of the two tower caretakers. They immediately cupped their hands toward the two of them. "Are the two of you in charge of controlling this tower, seniors?"

"We didn't come here to talk to you, especially since you still don't have the qualifications to talk to us." If someone else said that to them, the Nameless One and others would be furious. However, the two people in front of them were clearly stronger than them, especially since they came from the Paradise Realm. "A young man named Zhang Fei asked our friend to contact us, and he wants us to send you all out, especially since your realms are facing a great danger."
"Zhang Fei?" Most of them were surprised to hear that name, and only a few of them recognized him.
"Zhang Fei is my newest disciple." Hun Di then asked the two people. "Can you tell us about that danger, seniors?"
"He didn't explain anything to our friend, and he only said that the danger would have a bad impact on the three mortal realms." The old man answered Hun Di.

The old woman didn't say anything else and sent all of them out of the Sun Tower directly. "That senile old man is simply too much! Why did he repeatedly help Zhang Fei? Is he really not afraid of getting punished by our higher-ups?"

"Hahaha." The old man laughed, listening to her complaints. "That guy must know something we don't about Zhang Fei, or else he wouldn't have taken such risks to help him this far. Since he dared to take risks for that kid, I can't wait to meet him, but we will meet him after he ascends to our realm."
The old woman sighed softly, and the two of them immediately disappeared from that place.

Outside the Sun Tower, the Nameless One and the others were wondering about the great danger. Since the old man and the old woman mentioned Zhang Fei's name to them, Feng Jiu contacted her daughter to ask about the danger.
Meanwhile, Hun Di contacted Zhang Fei directly to get answers to their questions.

Feng Jiu and Hun Di's expressions turned serious after Feng Yao and Zhang Fei told them the main problem. The Soul Emperor then informed those people. "My disciple accidentally discovered a demon infiltrating the Xianjin Realm, and the Xiong Clan is his accomplice."

"Yao'er told me the same thing. She is in the Xianjin Realm with Zhang Fei and the others." Feng Jiu spoke. "By the way, my daughter asked us to go to the Wasteland Realm, and she will pick us up there. This way, we won't spend much time going to the upper realms, and we can get there much faster."
"How can your daughter pick us up?" Huli Xianniang, the Golden Nine-Tailed Fox, asked her.

Instead of answering Huli Xianniang's question, Feng Jiu took out her flying artifact. "We don't have much time, and we have to leave for the Wasteland Realm right now. With the speed of my flying artifact, we will arrive at that realm in a few days, and I hope we won't be late."
Without wasting any more time, they immediately boarded Feng Jiu's flying artifact, and it left the Blossom Heaven Realm in the blink of an eye.
"How do you think the demons were able to infiltrate the Xianjin Realm?" The Nameless One asked them. "Moreover, the Xiong Clan is also working together with the demons, and I never realized it."

"Did you forget about the Huang Clan?" The Nameless One turned to Hun Di. "We have always suspected that they were colluding with those demons, but we have never managed to find any authentic evidence. If my suspicions are correct, they brought the Xiong Clan to their side, and some other clans might have also joined them."

After that, the senior cultivators discussed their plans to face the worst-case scenario. However, they were quite relieved after they got the information that some other powerful cultivators would arrive at the Xianjin Realm soon, and they hoped that those people could buy some time.

"That's—"

"His real name is Zhang Fei, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] is just his alias." Shang Yaolin turned her head to Murong Mengying. "I can't tell you more about him, and you can ask him directly the next time you two meet."
Shang Yaolin nodded in understanding. "All right, I will ask Long'er directly."

"Did you just contact Zhang Fei?" Wu Xueming asked his wife.

Shang Yingyue nodded at him. "We left our daughter for five months, and I missed her very much. I contacted Zhang Fei to ask about her whereabouts, and he told me that she has two close friends now. They are Xu Ling'er and Tasha, and the three of them became like sisters."
"I see." Wu Xueming nodded in understanding. "Entrusting our daughter to Zhang Fei was the right decision."

After hearing that, all the young cultivators present immediately contacted their respective families, and they got the same answer as the information from Shang Guangming.

"Hahaha!" Tie Xuan suddenly laughed. "I always believed that Long'er was no ordinary cultivator, but I didn't expect that he would destroy the Shang Clan. Since Shang Huaqiang and the others are dead, our realm will be safe again without their presence."
*Slap*

Murong Mengying slapped Tie Xuan's shoulder. "Hey! You better not get excited just yet! The problems in our realm have been resolved now, but new problems await us in the Xianjin Realm. Zhang Fei is clearly in the midst of this problem because he asked those people to send us out of the tower, so we will follow him to that realm to help him."

"My father already told me about it, and Zhang Fei asked them to prepare to leave for the Xianjin Realm." Miao Miao turned to Hun Di and the others. "They're definitely going there, so we'll join them."

Qiao Liangren nodded in agreement with Miao Miao. "Junior Brother Fei has helped us sort out the problems in our realm, so we will join him and our seniors to solve the problems in the Xianjin Realm. However, all of you must be cautious because those demons are obviously strong, or else the Nameless One will not be that serious."
"All right, we should focus on resting so we will be fully refreshed when we arrive at the Wasteland Realm, and we will fight those demons with our full strength." Lai Minhua spoke to them.
All of them agreed with Lai Minhua, and they rested in place while swallowing some pills to speed up their recovery.

sentences.text: Feltia [2] nodded at Huli Zhishen.
"Previously, I was cultivating in the Phoenix Realm, and my senior brother told me about the situation in the Xianjin Realm.
Therefore, I conveyed it to Old Shen and Old Xueying, and I came here with him because I have never been to this realm before."
"Who is your senior brother?" Feltia [2] showed two plaques to Huli Zhishen.
One belonged to Hun Di, and the other belonged to the Lin Clan, which Lin Moxian gave to him.
"The Soul Emperor's disciple, huh?
The other one belongs to Lin Jingxia."
"That's right." Feltia [2] kept the two plaques again.
"My master is Master Hun, and my senior brother is Senior Jingxia's nephew, Lin Moxian."
'This kid is quite cunning!
He knew that I wouldn't dare do anything to him if he took out those two plaques.' Huli Zhishen then spoke to him.
"My husband is different from me, so you must leave this area now, or he will capture you if he manages to detect your presence."
"Yes."
Huli Zhishen fell dumbstruck as soon as Feltia [2] used the nine cloud steps, especially since he immediately disappeared from her senses.
"What a terrifying speed!
His cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms, but he can escape my senses in just a blink of an eye."
"What are you doing here?" Huli Jinhu suddenly appeared beside her.
Huli Zhishen shook her head.
"Since you've already taken care of them, we should go to the Xianjin Realm right now."
"Let's go!" Both Huli Jinhu and Huli Zhishen turned into golden light and flew out of their realm.
Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had returned to Phoenix Realm and went straight to the icy lake.
"Do you want to go to the Xianjin Realm now, Old Phoenix?"
"Yes." Feng Xueying immediately agreed.
"Old Shen and the others will need some time to get there, so I will go there first to monitor the situation."
Feltia [2] immediately opened the gate leading to the Xianjin Realm, and Feng Xueying hurriedly entered it.
Thereafter, he and Zhang Fei [4] went to the Nine Hells Realm to complete all three daily quests, especially since the other clones were still busy with other affairs.
"My grandfather and the others will arrive in this realm in a week, but I don't know whether they will be late or not." Yan Yinqing informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian.
Tantai Lingyan then informed them as well.
"The people from my Tantai Clan will also arrive in this realm at the same time as them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Lin Moxian, who immediately informed him.
"My aunt is already close to this realm, and she will arrive tonight.
The Wang, Gong, and Jian clans have already prepared their clan members.
Besides, Uncle Zhemin has already sent his people to keep an eye on the Xiong Clan, so you don't need to be concerned about that clan.
Senior Yishen has also contacted the other doctors; he asked them to prepare for the possibility of heavy casualties."
"What about the other clans?" Yan Yinqing asked them.

"Cheng Gaoji has already informed those clans about this matter, but some of them do not believe that demons dare to invade this realm, such as the Jiao and Pan clans." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer did not surprise the three of them.
"Feng Xueying has arrived in this realm, and Huli Jinhu and Huli Zhishen from the golden fox race are on their way here.
Currently, Feng Shen is going to meet the ancestors of the other mythical beasts; however, their agreement is not guaranteed.
Even if they agree, it will take them some time to arrive here.
As for the people from the Red Sun Realm, they have been preparing since three days ago, and I will bring them here if the situation becomes serious."
Lin Moxian suddenly received a voice message from someone, and he informed them after listening to it.
"Wufeng just told me that You Shen is on his way here to help us, and he brought all his disciples with him.
Hey, junior brother, do you have a way to contact our master?
If we can contact them and bring them here, we won't have to worry about those demons."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows for a moment before opening the gate leading to the Nine Stars Realm.
"I will return to my realm to go to the Star Tower, and I will try to ask those people for help."
"I'll go with you." Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing both spoke simultaneously.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took the two of them with him, but Tantai Lingyan decided to stay behind to oversee the situation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the other two were already at the Star Tower.
"Old man, I need your help."
The old man immediately appeared in front of them, but his presence made Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing tense up.
"What kind of help do you need from me, kid?"
"Can you contact your friends at the Sun Tower?" The old man nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Please help me contact them, old man.
I need the people who are challenging the tower to deal with a big problem.
If we fail to stop it, these three mortal realms will be in danger."
"I'll contact them, and you three can leave this tower now."
As soon as the three of them disappeared, Helian Xun'er and Hua Mei'er appeared beside the old man.
"Master, I still don't understand why you keep helping that brat!
I believe he's deliberately taking advantage of you for his interests."
The old man ignored Hua Mei'er and contacted the two people in the Sun Tower.

"Do you think he will challenge the second floor soon, Master?" Helian Xun'er asked.
The old man shook his head.

With his unstable cultivation, he will not be able to face the challenges on the second floor, so he has to wait for his cultivation to completely stabilize."
"I think so too." Helian Xun'er replied with a nod.
"I don't understand why that kid forced himself, but he was lucky that his cultivation foundation didn't collapse because of his recklessness.
Otherwise, he would have become a cripple, and his talents would have been wasted."
"Master—"
"Let's go back." The old man and Helian Xun'er immediately disappeared, leaving behind the annoyed Hua Mei'er.
"Is this your home realm, junior brother?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Yan Yinqing.
"My home realm is in the lower realms, and it is not a cultivation world.
My first realm, the Sky Jade Realm, is also there.
I arrived in this realm seven and a half months ago, and I met several of my wives here, so I already considered this to be my third home realm."
"Oh." Yan Yinqing nodded in understanding.
"Where is your family?
Can you please take me to meet them?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to him.
"Senior sister, we are facing a serious problem right now, so I will take you to meet them after that problem is resolved."
"All right then." Yan Yinqing responded by pouting her lips, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] itch to pinch her cheeks.
*Swoosh*
They turned to Feng Yao, who had just arrived.
"Why are the three of you here?"

"A serious problem is about to occur in the Xianjin Realm, so I came back here to ask for help from the old man." Feng Yao raised an eyebrow at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately explained to her about the situation.
"Do you want to participate in facing them?"
"Bring me there."
"Let's go." Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought the three of them to the Xianjin Realm directly.
At the Sun Tower.
Feng Jiu and the others, who were resting in one area, were surprised by the arrival of the two tower caretakers.
They immediately cupped their hands toward the two of them.
"Are the two of you in charge of controlling this tower, seniors?"
"We didn't come here to talk to you, especially since you still don't have the qualifications to talk to us." If someone else said that to them, the Nameless One and others would be furious.
However, the two people in front of them were clearly stronger than them, especially since they came from the Paradise Realm.
"A young man named Zhang Fei asked our friend to contact us, and he wants us to send you all out, especially since your realms are facing a great danger."
"Zhang Fei?" Most of them were surprised to hear that name, and only a few of them recognized him.
"Zhang Fei is my newest disciple." Hun Di then asked the two people.
"Can you tell us about that danger, seniors?"
"He didn't explain anything to our friend, and he only said that the danger would have a bad impact on the three mortal realms." The old man answered Hun Di.
The old woman didn't say anything else and sent all of them out of the Sun Tower directly.
"That senile old man is simply too much!
Why did he repeatedly help Zhang Fei?
Is he really not afraid of getting punished by our higher-ups?"
"Hahaha." The old man laughed, listening to her complaints.
"That guy must know something we don't about Zhang Fei, or else he wouldn't have taken such risks to help him this far.
Since he dared to take risks for that kid, I can't wait to meet him, but we will meet him after he ascends to our realm."
The old woman sighed softly, and the two of them immediately disappeared from that place.
Outside the Sun Tower, the Nameless One and the others were wondering about the great danger.
Since the old man and the old woman mentioned Zhang Fei's name to them, Feng Jiu contacted her daughter to ask about the danger.
Meanwhile, Hun Di contacted Zhang Fei directly to get answers to their questions.
Feng Jiu and Hun Di's expressions turned serious after Feng Yao and Zhang Fei told them the main problem.
The Soul Emperor then informed those people.

chapters.title: Chapter 819 819: The Demons
paragraphs: In a dark realm, dozens of demons gathered on a mountain that was intentionally flattened. They formed several lines and were led by several powerful demons, one of whom was Long Jiutian. They lined up around a giant demon statue with a rather terrifying appearance, and dozens of women from various races of living beings were lying under it.

"How about your tasks in the lower realm, Fa Ling? Did you succeed in finding the ten demon seeds?" Long Jiutian asked a female demon with a completely red body covered by a little black cloth, which accentuated her voluptuous body.
Fa Ling has two behemoth-like horns on her head, two bloody red eyes, two wings that are a combination of dragon wings and demon wings, and a long black tail behind her hips.

Fa Ling turned to Long Jiutian. "One of my subordinates has succeeded in taking over the Tian Realm, but a human kid disrupted his plans by liberating it from him. The kid also brought many strong cultivators with him at that time. Furthermore, he has the ability to go to the Xian Realm, so I ordered one of them to exterminate the people from that realm."
"Oh?" Long Jiutian and the other demons were shocked to hear that. "Do they know that kid's identity?"

"No." Fa Ling answered by shaking her head. "As for the ten demon seeds, I haven't managed to find them because there was a big change in the Diyu Realm. All the demon rulers who cooperated with those birdmen were killed by someone, and that person also destroyed the portals connecting the two realms, which made me certain that the culprit was that human kid. I wanted to go to Earth myself to look for that kid, but our lord asked me to wait."
"Where are your other subordinates now, Fa Ling?" A male demon with an appearance similar to Zhang Fei's lust demon lord form asked.

"I ordered them to go to the Wasteland Realm to wait for the appearance of the Abyssal Demon Heart, which I believe will appear in a few months." Fa Ling then turned to ask a question. "What about your tasks in the Blue Water Realm, Chao Mojie? Have you made any progress in capturing the Abyssal Leviathan Demon?"

"Not yet." Chao Mojie replied with a soft sigh. "That Abyssal Leviathan Demon is hiding in the Shunken Empire, and its location is too deep at the bottom of the sea. There are no water demons among us, and that beast is too powerful if we fight in the sea, so I repeatedly failed in my fights against it. My subordinates have been controlling the demons in that region, but for some reason, they are unable to enter the ruins."
Fa Ling then asked Long Jiutian. "What about the preparations to attack the Xianjin Realm? Have those humans carried out the plan?"

"Haha." Long Jiutian laughed and answered confidently. "I have long strengthened the people of the Huang Clan using my demon dragon blood, so they are strong now, and my subordinates are also assisting them from behind. With the absence of the Nameless One and the powerful cultivators in these upper realms, I am confident that we can swiftly conquer the realm.
"I hope you're right."
*Scree*
A giant dark red bird suddenly descended from the sky towards the statue, and it quickly turned into a mature woman.

The woman has long, flowing dark red hair; her eyes were piercing dark with flickering dark red flames. Her face was incredibly alluring. Her waist was as lithe as a snake; she was able to mesmerize people with a single glance. She was wearing a simple and flimsy-looking black dress, which further accentuated her perfect figure.

However, the woman's demeanor was cold and aloof, and her aura gave off a chilling yet scorching presence, radiating both the cold of deathly stillness and the heat of dark red flames. Her dark red wings exuded both a destructive and ominous energy.

As soon as the woman touched the giant demon statue, it immediately glowed red, and all the demons present at that place right away knelt on one knee. Shortly, the statue came to life and stretched its body as he stared at them.
"Lord Xereth!" Long Jiutian and the others immediately greeted.

Xereth simply nodded at them and pulled the woman beside him into his arms. "Are you ready to return to your realm, Feng Yichen? Your phoenix race is one of the obstacles for us to execute our main plans, so it's time for us to exterminate them."
"I'm ready." Feng Yichen curtly answered.

"That's good." Xereth moved Feng Yichen aside and looked at the dozens of women below him. He raised his fingers and made them float in midair, but the next scene was extremely gruesome, especially since he absorbed everything in their bodies, including their blood, flesh, vitality, souls, and everything else. He also absorbed their skeletons, ensuring they died with nothing left behind.
After that, Xereth turned into one of the male demons. "Have you managed to find the whereabouts of the demon extermination sword, Mo Xieshen?"
"Please forgive me, Lord Xereth. I have explored almost the entire universe, but I have not managed to find the whereabouts of the sword." Mo Xieshen respectfully replied.

Fa Ling then spoke to Xereth. "My lord, one of my subordinates saw a human kid holding a black sword when he disrupted my plans in the lower realms, and the sword might be the demon extermination sword you have been looking for."

"Hmm?" Xereth pulled Fa Ling to him, placed his hands on her temples, and read her memories. His expression changed with excitement after he saw everything. "Hahahaha! After several thousand years, I finally found that damn sword! The sword in that human kid's hand is truly the demon extermination sword!"
"Do you want me to go there to look for that human kid, Lord?" Fa Ling asked.

Xereth immediately released Fa Ling. "Go to that realm and find that human kid for me! If he is hiding from you, you can destroy the realm to lure him out, and you must bring him and the sword to me afterward."
"Yes, Lord." Fa Ling took out her flying artifact and took her other subordinates to leave that realm.

Xereth then requested reports from the other demons, and they took turns reporting the progress of their plans. However, some of their reports made him angry, especially since they had not succeeded in carrying out their duties. "Mo Xieshen, I want you to accompany Chao Mojie to the Blue Water Realm right now. I have run out of patience to capture the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, so I need you to destroy that realm and force that ancient demon out of hiding."
"Yes, Lord." Mo Xieshen and Chao Mojie did not stay there for long and took their subordinates away.
"When will we attack the Xianjin Realm, Lord?" Long Jiutian asked.

"We can't openly attack that realm because of their defense mechanism against our demon races, so you should order those foolish humans to start attacking them. Tell them to concentrate their attacks on their defense mechanism first, and our demon armies will invade that realm once they have destroyed their defense." Long Jiutian immediately contacted the Huang Clan and ordered them to move according to Xereth's orders. "Xue Yuemozi."
"Yes, Lord Xereth." A female demon with a jet-black body and bloody red eyes replied.
"What about the Blackthorn Abyss Realm? Have they found that female white demon wolf?" Xue Yuemozi shook her head at Xereth. "What exactly happened there? How did they lose her?"

Xue Yuemozi immediately told Xereth about everything that happened in the Blackthorn Abyss Realm. "I don't understand how Alder managed to escape from them, and he secretly took his daughter away from their realm. Since then, their whereabouts are unknown, and I suspect that they are hiding in one of the human realms or in the realm of other living creatures."

"Which realms do you suspect?" Xue Yuemozi remained silent in response to Xereth's question, as she had no clear guess due to the vastness of their universe. "Go and find the whereabouts of that female white demon wolf as soon as possible! If they can't find her within a year, I will destroy their realm."
"Yes, Lord Xereth." Xue Yuemozi and her subordinates immediately disappeared from that place.

A male demon looked up at Xereth and told him. "My lord, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have been hiding their true strength all this time, and the demons of those realms are too weak to fight them. I almost died in their hands some time ago, and I was lucky to escape from them."
"Hmm?" Xereth turned to him with a frown. "Does that mean they've reached the pinnacle of mortal cultivation, Mo Zhuo?"

"I think so, my lord." Mo Zhuo then said something else. "My lord, some of my subordinates discovered some unusual towers in the middle realms, but I don't have any clear information about them yet, especially since they died as soon as they entered."

"Tell me their location." Mo Zhuo informed him of the locations of several towers in the middle realms, and Xereth immediately ordered him and several demons to check each tower, so they hurried to leave that realm. "Long Jiutian, go back to the Xianjin Realm now and report to me directly if any changes occur."
"Yes, Lord."
Xereth turned to Feng Yichen. "Go to the Phoenix Realm and bring the two old phoenixes to me."

Feng Yichen nodded before flying into the sky, and she returned to her dark phoenix form before flying away from the dark realm. The other demons also left the realm after Xereth gave them some new orders.

Xereth wanted to leave the realm, but hundreds of golden swords suddenly descended from the sky and rained down on him. He snorted and stomped his feet on the ground, and hundreds of black swords shot towards them before clashing with each other, causing a huge explosion in the air.

Soon, a woman with golden hair flowing down to her waist appeared in the sky. However, her face was not visible because she was wearing a white and gold mask; a tight white and gold dress wrapped her tall body from top to bottom, showing off her perfectly curvy and seductive figure, with two enormous mounds hanging over her chest. Golden gauntlets covered her hands, golden boots covered her feet, and two large golden wings flapped behind her back.
The woman looked at Xereth with her right hand raised upwards, and a golden sword materialized in her palm, which she immediately grasped.
Xereth's expression turned serious, and a black scythe appeared in his hand as a jet-black aura enveloped his body.
*Swoosh*

The woman and Xereth quickly flew towards each other, and their two weapons immediately clashed against each other, causing a huge wave of Qi to sweep across the entire realm, turning the area below them into a mess.
Both of them were knocked back by each other's attacks, but they immediately attacked each other again, which once again resulted in a powerful explosion from the clash of their weapons.
In just a few minutes, Xereth and the woman had exchanged attacks hundreds of times, but neither of them had the upper hand against the other.

Xereth suddenly flew away from the woman. "Tian Huangjin, no matter how strong you are, you will never be able to capture me. I would rather not waste my time with you, and I will visit your realm once again after I get everything I need. At that time, I will destroy your Radiance Domain, and I will absorb you and all the members of your race."

The woman didn't say anything and swung her golden sword towards Xereth, and a golden light shot towards him. However, the demon had turned into a statue again, and her attacks shattered it into pieces.

The woman let out a sigh of disappointment after she failed to kill Xereth. She then turned her gaze towards the distance, feeling a familiar presence there. "A human, a beast, and a demon coexist together in one body. I didn't expect to find such an existence in these mortal realms, and his light element is no less powerful than my race, even though he has a demon bloodline in his body. He was lucky because that filthy demon didn't seem to know anything about his existence, or else he would have captured him. However, he will face those demons when they attack his realm, and they will be a tough test for him. If he manages to overcome this danger and further develop himself, he might succeed in ascending to my realm, and I will meet him at that time."
The woman stretched her hand forward, and a golden light shot out from it, heading towards the Xianjin Realm. She once again let out a soft sigh before disappearing from the dark realm.
"That bitch! She's been hunting me for thousands of years, but she still hasn't given up." Xereth, who had moved to another realm, grumbled to himself.

Xereth then looked in a certain direction with narrowed eyes. "My home realm should be in that direction, and I've been away from that place for a long time, so it's time for me to return. Those old folks will not be happy to see me again, but they are no longer my opponents."

Xereth immediately flew away from the realm at high speed. sentences.text: In a dark realm, dozens of demons gathered on a mountain that was intentionally flattened.
They formed several lines and were led by several powerful demons, one of whom was Long Jiutian.
They lined up around a giant demon statue with a rather terrifying appearance, and dozens of women from various races of living beings were lying under it.
"How about your tasks in the lower realm, Fa Ling?
Did you succeed in finding the ten demon seeds?" Long Jiutian asked a female demon with a completely red body covered by a little black cloth, which accentuated her voluptuous body.
Fa Ling has two behemoth-like horns on her head, two bloody red eyes, two wings that are a combination of dragon wings and demon wings, and a long black tail behind her hips.
Fa Ling turned to Long Jiutian.
"One of my subordinates has succeeded in taking over the Tian Realm, but a human kid disrupted his plans by liberating it from him.
The kid also brought many strong cultivators with him at that time.
Furthermore, he has the ability to go to the Xian Realm, so I ordered one of them to exterminate the people from that realm."
"Oh?" Long Jiutian and the other demons were shocked to hear that.
"Do they know that kid's identity?"
"No." Fa Ling answered by shaking her head.
"As for the ten demon seeds, I haven't managed to find them because there was a big change in the Diyu Realm.

All the demon rulers who cooperated with those birdmen were killed by someone, and that person also destroyed the portals connecting the two realms, which made me certain that the culprit was that human kid.
I wanted to go to Earth myself to look for that kid, but our lord asked me to wait."
"Where are your other subordinates now, Fa Ling?" A male demon with an appearance similar to Zhang Fei's lust demon lord form asked.
"I ordered them to go to the Wasteland Realm to wait for the appearance of the Abyssal Demon Heart, which I believe will appear in a few months." Fa Ling then turned to ask a question.
"What about your tasks in the Blue Water Realm, Chao Mojie?
Have you made any progress in capturing the Abyssal Leviathan Demon?"
"Not yet." Chao Mojie replied with a soft sigh.
"That Abyssal Leviathan Demon is hiding in the Shunken Empire, and its location is too deep at the bottom of the sea.
There are no water demons among us, and that beast is too powerful if we fight in the sea, so I repeatedly failed in my fights against it.
My subordinates have been controlling the demons in that region, but for some reason, they are unable to enter the ruins."
Fa Ling then asked Long Jiutian.
"What about the preparations to attack the Xianjin Realm?
Have those humans carried out the plan?"
"Haha." Long Jiutian laughed and answered confidently.
"I have long strengthened the people of the Huang Clan using my demon dragon blood, so they are strong now, and my subordinates are also assisting them from behind.
With the absence of the Nameless One and the powerful cultivators in these upper realms, I am confident that we can swiftly conquer the realm.
"I hope you're right."
*Scree*
A giant dark red bird suddenly descended from the sky towards the statue, and it quickly turned into a mature woman.
The woman has long, flowing dark red hair; her eyes were piercing dark with flickering dark red flames.
Her face was incredibly alluring.
Her waist was as lithe as a snake; she was able to mesmerize people with a single glance.
She was wearing a simple and flimsy-looking black dress, which further accentuated her perfect figure.
However, the woman's demeanor was cold and aloof, and her aura gave off a chilling yet scorching presence, radiating both the cold of deathly stillness and the heat of dark red flames.
Her dark red wings exuded both a destructive and ominous energy.
As soon as the woman touched the giant demon statue, it immediately glowed red, and all the demons present at that place right away knelt on one knee.
Shortly, the statue came to life and stretched its body as he stared at them.
"Lord Xereth!" Long Jiutian and the others immediately greeted.
Xereth simply nodded at them and pulled the woman beside him into his arms.
"Are you ready to return to your realm, Feng Yichen?
Your phoenix race is one of the obstacles for us to execute our main plans, so it's time for us to exterminate them."
"I'm ready." Feng Yichen curtly answered.
"That's good." Xereth moved Feng Yichen aside and looked at the dozens of women below him.

He raised his fingers and made them float in midair, but the next scene was extremely gruesome, especially since he absorbed everything in their bodies, including their blood, flesh, vitality, souls, and everything else.
He also absorbed their skeletons, ensuring they died with nothing left behind.
After that, Xereth turned into one of the male demons.
"Have you managed to find the whereabouts of the demon extermination sword, Mo Xieshen?"
"Please forgive me, Lord Xereth.
I have explored almost the entire universe, but I have not managed to find the whereabouts of the sword." Mo Xieshen respectfully replied.
Fa Ling then spoke to Xereth.
"My lord, one of my subordinates saw a human kid holding a black sword when he disrupted my plans in the lower realms, and the sword might be the demon extermination sword you have been looking for."
"Hmm?" Xereth pulled Fa Ling to him, placed his hands on her temples, and read her memories.
His expression changed with excitement after he saw everything.
"Hahahaha!
After several thousand years, I finally found that damn sword!
The sword in that human kid's hand is truly the demon extermination sword!"
"Do you want me to go there to look for that human kid, Lord?" Fa Ling asked.
Xereth immediately released Fa Ling.
"Go to that realm and find that human kid for me!
If he is hiding from you, you can destroy the realm to lure him out, and you must bring him and the sword to me afterward."
"Yes, Lord." Fa Ling took out her flying artifact and took her other subordinates to leave that realm.
Xereth then requested reports from the other demons, and they took turns reporting the progress of their plans.
However, some of their reports made him angry, especially since they had not succeeded in carrying out their duties.
"Mo Xieshen, I want you to accompany Chao Mojie to the Blue Water Realm right now.
I have run out of patience to capture the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, so I need you to destroy that realm and force that ancient demon out of hiding."
"Yes, Lord." Mo Xieshen and Chao Mojie did not stay there for long and took their subordinates away.
"When will we attack the Xianjin Realm, Lord?" Long Jiutian asked.
"We can't openly attack that realm because of their defense mechanism against our demon races, so you should order those foolish humans to start attacking them.

Tell them to concentrate their attacks on their defense mechanism first, and our demon armies will invade that realm once they have destroyed their defense." Long Jiutian immediately contacted the Huang Clan and ordered them to move according to Xereth's orders.
"Xue Yuemozi."
"Yes, Lord Xereth." A female demon with a jet-black body and bloody red eyes replied.
"What about the Blackthorn Abyss Realm?
Have they found that female white demon wolf?" Xue Yuemozi shook her head at Xereth.
"What exactly happened there?
How did they lose her?"
Xue Yuemozi immediately told Xereth about everything that happened in the Blackthorn Abyss Realm.
"I don't understand how Alder managed to escape from them, and he secretly took his daughter away from their realm.
Since then, their whereabouts are unknown, and I suspect that they are hiding in one of the human realms or in the realm of other living creatures."
"Which realms do you suspect?" Xue Yuemozi remained silent in response to Xereth's question, as she had no clear guess due to the vastness of their universe.
"Go and find the whereabouts of that female white demon wolf as soon as possible!
If they can't find her within a year, I will destroy their realm."
"Yes, Lord Xereth." Xue Yuemozi and her subordinates immediately disappeared from that place.
A male demon looked up at Xereth and told him.
"My lord, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have been hiding their true strength all this time, and the demons of those realms are too weak to fight them.
I almost died in their hands some time ago, and I was lucky to escape from them."
"Hmm?" Xereth turned to him with a frown.
"Does that mean they've reached the pinnacle of mortal cultivation, Mo Zhuo?"
"I think so, my lord." Mo Zhuo then said something else.
"My lord, some of my subordinates discovered some unusual towers in the middle realms, but I don't have any clear information about them yet, especially since they died as soon as they entered."

"Tell me their location." Mo Zhuo informed him of the locations of several towers in the middle realms, and Xereth immediately ordered him and several demons to check each tower, so they hurried to leave that realm.
"Long Jiutian, go back to the Xianjin Realm now and report to me directly if any changes occur."
"Yes, Lord."
Xereth turned to Feng Yichen.
"Go to the Phoenix Realm and bring the two old phoenixes to me."
Feng Yichen nodded before flying into the sky, and she returned to her dark phoenix form before flying away from the dark realm.
The other demons also left the realm after Xereth gave them some new orders.
Xereth wanted to leave the realm, but hundreds of golden swords suddenly descended from the sky and rained down on him.
He snorted and stomped his feet on the ground, and hundreds of black swords shot towards them before clashing with each other, causing a huge explosion in the air.
Soon, a woman with golden hair flowing down to her waist appeared in the sky.

However, her face was not visible because she was wearing a white and gold mask; a tight white and gold dress wrapped her tall body from top to bottom, showing off her perfectly curvy and seductive figure, with two enormous mounds hanging over her chest.
Golden gauntlets covered her hands, golden boots covered her feet, and two large golden wings flapped behind her back.
The woman looked at Xereth with her right hand raised upwards, and a golden sword materialized in her palm, which she immediately grasped.
Xereth's expression turned serious, and a black scythe appeared in his hand as a jet-black aura enveloped his body.
*Swoosh*

The woman and Xereth quickly flew towards each other, and their two weapons immediately clashed against each other, causing a huge wave of Qi to sweep across the entire realm, turning the area below them into a mess.
Both of them were knocked back by each other's attacks, but they immediately attacked each other again, which once again resulted in a powerful explosion from the clash of their weapons.
In just a few minutes, Xereth and the woman had exchanged attacks hundreds of times, but neither of them had the upper hand against the other.
Xereth suddenly flew away from the woman.
"Tian Huangjin, no matter how strong you are, you will never be able to capture me.
I would rather not waste my time with you, and I will visit your realm once again after I get everything I need.
At that time, I will destroy your Radiance Domain, and I will absorb you and all the members of your race."
The woman didn't say anything and swung her golden sword towards Xereth, and a golden light shot towards him.
However, the demon had turned into a statue again, and her attacks shattered it into pieces.
The woman let out a sigh of disappointment after she failed to kill Xereth.
She then turned her gaze towards the distance, feeling a familiar presence there.
"A human, a beast, and a demon coexist together in one body.
I didn't expect to find such an existence in these mortal realms, and his light element is no less powerful than my race, even though he has a demon bloodline in his body.
He was lucky because that filthy demon didn't seem to know anything about his existence, or else he would have captured him.
However, he will face those demons when they attack his realm, and they will be a tough test for him.
If he manages to overcome this danger and further develop himself, he might succeed in ascending to my realm, and I will meet him at that time."
The woman stretched her hand forward, and a golden light shot out from it, heading towards the Xianjin Realm.
She once again let out a soft sigh before disappearing from the dark realm.
"That bitch!
She's been hunting me for thousands of years, but she still hasn't given up." Xereth, who had moved to another realm, grumbled to himself.
Xereth then looked in a certain direction with narrowed eyes.
"My home realm should be in that direction, and I've been away from that place for a long time, so it's time for me to return.
Those old folks will not be happy to see me again, but they are no longer my opponents."
"Hahaha!

I haven't been to these three mortal realms for a long time, so I'm curious about the situation in my home realm, and I will use them to smooth out my plans." Xereth immediately flew away from the realm at high speed.
"After I take care of them, I will go to the Heavenly Moon Realm to face Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and I will absorb both of them to increase my strength."

chapters.title: Chapter 820 820: Capture The Traitors
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian had already arrived at the defense center, where Cheng Gaoji, Wang Zhemin, Tantai Lingyan, Yan Yinqing, and Feng Yao were already waiting for them.

It was not difficult for Cheng Gaoji and the others to enter the place, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not join them and waited on top of the building in an invisible state, watching the people from the Huang Clan who were getting closer.

"The Huang Clan is still holding themselves back, especially since the strongest among them are Huang Rongyun and Huang Zhiqian, with their cultivation being at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm. The cultivation of their members is below that, including the two people from the Xiong Clan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the map and used the nature awareness ability, finding several demons in the distance. "Two archduke demons with cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, huh? I didn't expect Long Jiutian's subordinates to be so powerful, and they used special artifacts to hide their demon auras, so it's no wonder that the Huang Clan is confident in taking over this defense center."
[Do you plan to take any action against them, Master?]

"Do you think I need to make a move, Mei? Have you forgotten about Huo Ling, who is by Feng Yao's side?" Instead, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked back. "That rude fire spirit is much stronger than all the cultivators in the upper realms, so they can handle these people. However, I will try to get those two demons, and I will absorb their demon essence. With their demon rank and cultivation, I am sure their demon essence is plentiful, and my demon rank will get closer to archduke rank if I absorb their demon essence."

Zhang Fei [4] and Feltia [2] suddenly appeared by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side, and they focused their gazes on the two demon archdukes, waiting for an opening to lure them elsewhere. "Let's wait for them to start fighting."
In the defense center, Wang Zhemin and his others provided an explanation to the defense chief of the realm. "Are you sure all the information is accurate, Old Wang?"

"Do you think we would have come here if the information were wrong?" Guan Chenhong turned to Feng Yao. "My parents and the Nameless One are already on their way back to this realm, and Lin Jingxia will arrive here tonight. Additionally, Tian Shuxiang and Yao Shen are also on their way here, as are several others."
Cheng Gaoji urged Guan Chenhong. "Old Guan, activate the barrier now, or it will be too late."

"Old Cheng, if I activate the barrier now, those people will immediately notice it, and they might abandon their intentions." Despite this, Guan Chenhong went to one side of the room and activated all the defense mechanisms in the realm, and he then turned on the screen in front of them, and all the images of the various areas of the realm appeared there.
"There." Yan Yinqing pointed to one of the pictures. "They are people from the Huang and Xiong clans, and they are on their way here to take over this place."

Guan Chenhong enlarged the image before speaking to them. "The Huang Clan underestimated me, especially since Huang Zhejun only sent Huang Rongyun and Huang Zhiqian, and their cultivation is only at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm."

"Senior Guan, the Huang Clan did not underestimate you, but they were overconfident with their backers." Lin Moxian asked Guan Chenhong to display the other images, and he once again pointed to one of the images. "Those two people are archduke demons, and their cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, so neither of us can fight them with our cultivation."

Guan Chenhong enlarged the image and looked at the two archduke demons with a serious expression. "What should we do to stop them? If they help the Huang and Xiong clans, they will succeed in taking over this place."

"We don't need to do anything to them, and someone will take care of them for us." Guan Chenhong looked at Feng Yao in confusion. "Trust me, that person is capable of taking care of both demons, so we just need to focus on the people from the Huang and Xiong clans. The Nameless One asked us to capture whoever intends to take over this place, and he will punish their clans later."

Guan Chenhong nodded and displayed the picture showing the location of the people from the Huang and Xiong clans. "They will be here soon, so we have to prepare now, and we will capture them as soon as they come in."
"Let's go." They rushed to the entrance and waited for their enemies there.

On top of the building, Zhang Fei's three clones were already prepared to stop the two archduke demons, but they did not move immediately and waited for the people from the two clans to fall into the trap first.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as he noticed something shooting towards him, but he didn't have an opportunity to react, and the golden light instantly entered his body. Strangely, the system didn't give any reaction to that. "What kind of thing just entered my body, Mei?"
[Master, I don't know what that thing is, but I detected it in your soul space, so you can see it there yourself.]

Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered his soul space directly, where he found the golden light floating in the middle. Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu were already on the side of the golden light. "Do you two know anything about this thing? This thing radiates purity and holiness stronger than the winged races in my home realm."
"I don't know how this thing found you, but it belonged to someone from that race, kid." Ma Kuangyu answered him.
Nalan Yushu pointed to the golden light. "Master, only winged race members have such a thing, but its owner is not ordinary and should be a high-ranking official."
"Does that mean the owner of this golden light comes from the Paradise Realm?"
"Yes!" Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu answered in unison. "Try using your heavenly fox form and touch this golden light, kid."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] transformed into his complete fox form and touched it with one of his tails. In that instant, the golden light entered his soul and spread throughout him.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's light element has been upgraded to peak stage.]
[Congratulations! The host's light element law has been upgraded to intermediate stage.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was stunned by the appearance of the two notifications, but his vision suddenly became blurry. Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu disappeared from his sight, and the golden-haired woman appeared before him. "As I thought, you are human, but you are also a heavenly fox and a lust demon."
"Who are you? Can you tell me why you decided to help me?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] inquired inquisitively, particularly since the mask obscured her face from his view.

"You will know my name in the future." Tian Huangjin then informed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I helped you because you are the most unique existence I have ever met, and you are the only one in this entire universe. A demon named Xereth has ordered his minions to attack your realm, and some of them have already invaded it. Your light element is strong and pure, but it is still not enough to fight them, so I am helping you out a little."
"Xereth!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft cry as his suspicion was correct that the demon was the mastermind behind his new problem. "Do you know where he is? Did you come from the Paradise Realm?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s second question surprised Tian Huangjin, but he couldn't see her expression. "How did you know about the Paradise Realm?"

"Didn't you see the two souls living in my soul space?" Tian Huangjin shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "They are cultivators from the Paradise Realm, and I met them by chance. I have met winged races from the three mortal realms, but none of them have your purity and holiness, so I guess you came from that realm."

Tian Huangjin nodded in understanding. "You guessed right; I came from the Paradise Realm, and I came here specifically to hunt down Xereth. Unfortunately, he managed to escape from me, but I didn't expect to meet such a unique living being like you. I don't know where he is now, but he sent his other subordinates to several other realms."
"Do you have any information about those realms?"

Tian Huangjin shared some information about Xereth and his subordinates with Zhang Xiaolong [3], which caused his expression to become serious mixed with anger. "My time is up, and I will wait for you in the Paradise Realm."

After Tian Huangjin disappeared, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, and both of them looked at him with confused expressions. "Did you meet the owner of the golden light?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at them. "I'll go out now."

When he returned to his body, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw that the people from the Huang and Xiong clans were already close to the defense center. The two archduke demons were also not far behind them, so he and the two clones prepared to stop the two demons. "Mei, I didn't expect that everything would be related to each other, and Earth was in danger because of me. Moreover, Xereth should be powerful, or else that golden-haired woman wouldn't have hunted him all the way here."

[Since Xereth didn't go to Earth, we still have a chance to save that planet and its inhabitants. Moreover, the female demon won't arrive there that quickly, so we still have plenty of time to think of the best solution for them. For now, you can focus on the two archduke demons, and you can discuss those matters with the others later.]
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "They finally arrived."

As soon as the people from the two clans entered the defense center, Zhang Fei [4] and Feltia [2] immediately moved behind the two archduke demons, opening the gate behind them. At the same time, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already used his strengthening abilities, immediately moved in front of them and kicked them into the gate.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feltia [2] caught up with the two archduke demons in the Nine Hells Darkland before closing the gate. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] informed Morgana and Alder of the matter so they could contact the people from their realms.

Inside the defense center, the people from both clans were shocked by Wang Zhemin and the others who immediately surrounded them, and they also closed the entrance. "You didn't expect this, right, Huang Rongyun and Huang Zhiqian?"
"What do you mean, Old Wang?" Huang Zhiqian asked him with feigned ignorance.
Wang Zhemin, Tantai Lingyan, Cheng Gaoji, and Guan Chenhong immediately moved to immobilize him and Huang Rongyun before sealing their cultivation.
Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, and Feng Yao immobilized the other people of the two clans, including Xiong Qinglai and Xiong Yinghao.
"What do you mean by doing this to us?" Huang Rongyun asked with a shout.

"Shut up! You don't need to shout!" Cheng Gaoji himself shouted loudly as he stepped on Huang Rongyun's head. "Do you think we don't know that you guys are here to take over this place under Long Jiutian's orders?"

Huang Rongyun and the others instantly froze after Cheng Gaoji said that, and Guan Chenhong spoke to them. "We have long suspected that your Huang Clan is colluding with the demons, but we have not been able to find any evidence. Unfortunately, you guys were too careless this time by bringing Long Jiutian here three days ago, and we already knew that he was a blood dragon demon, so you guys won't be able to deny it anymore."

"The Nameless One is on his way back to this realm, and he already knows about this matter." Huang Rongyun and the others looked at Tantai Lingyan, their bodies trembling. "All of you should already know how much he hates the demons and those who dare to collude with them, right? This time, your two clans will not be able to pretend anymore, and all of you will suffer from his wrath once he returns."
Guan Chenhong then summoned several people and ordered them to take the people from both clans to a special prison, especially since they had to wait for the Nameless One to return to sentence them.

As soon as Guan Chenhong opened the door, Zhang Fei [4] walked immediately in, surprising him. Lin Moxian directly told him. "Old Guan, he is my junior brother, and he is the one who discovered Long Jiutian's whereabouts in this realm."
"Oh?" Guan Chenhong was surprised by that.

Zhang Fei [4] ignored Guan Chenhong and opened the gate to the Phoenix Realm. "Feng Yao, we should go to your realm now because the dark phoenix is on her way there, and Xereth ordered her to destroy your realm."
"You guys wait here! I alone am enough to handle the dark phoenix." Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [4] rushed into the gate, which immediately disappeared.
After they disappeared, Guan Chenhong asked Lin Moxian. "Is he really your junior brother? How can he have similar abilities to the heavenly fox race?"

"Old Guan, you should keep your mouth shut and not mention anything about that kid's abilities to anyone." Guan Chenhong turned to Cheng Gaoji. "He really is Hun Di's disciple, and he is also my boss."
Guan Chenhong's jaw dropped, hearing Cheng Gaoji refer to Zhang Fei as his boss. After all, they lived in the same realm and had known each other for millennia, so he was familiar with his character.
"Where are the two archduke demons now?"

Lin Moxian immediately told Yan Yinqing. "Our junior brother sent the two of them to another realm, so we don't need to think about them. However, I don't know what he will do with them, especially since he decided to take them there suddenly."
"Can he face the two of them by himself? After all, their cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant, right?" Yan Yinqing asked worriedly.

Lin Moxian shook his head with a soft sigh. "I don't know if he can face them by himself, but I know that he is not a reckless person, so he should have a plan for those two. By the way, we have to be prepared to face the Huang and Xiong clans; I'm sure they will come to this place soon if their people don't come back."

"Does that mean there is a member of that fox race in the Xianjin Realm, Huan Ying?" Yu Xue asked with a frown.

"Unfortunately, you two are mistaken because I am not a heavenly fox, and I am a lust demon lord. I helped those humans because I was bored, and I needed you two to increase my strength."
"Humph!" Huan Ying snorted and turned into a shadow to attack him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] surprised him by turning into a shadow as well, and the two continued to chase each other in the shadows.

Meanwhile, Yu Xue pointed his index finger in the air, and a cloud of blood quickly formed in the sky. He tried to lock onto Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s movements, but his eyes and senses couldn't follow him. "Tch! Blood Rain!"
