paragraphs: *Splurt*
Yu Xue looked down as an invisible sword pierced his chest from behind, causing his technique to fail. He looked back, but he didn't see anyone behind him.

The demon extermination sword quickly absorbed Yu Xue's demon essence. Feltia [2], standing behind him, used the devouring art, the demon-absorbing technique, and the life-force absorption technique on him at the same time.
After all, Yu Xue was much stronger than Feltia [2] in demon rank and cultivation, so he had to move quickly to weaken him.
"Gahhh!" Yu Xue screamed in pain, but the blood on his chest and back moved towards Feltia [2] to attack him.
Since Yu Xue couldn't see Feltia [2] in his invisible state, he could easily dodge his attack and press the demon extermination sword deeper.

Feltia [2] channeled her light element into Yu Xue's body, which inflicted excruciating pain on him as the light element was the nemesis of demons. Moreover, his light element had previously reached the peak rank, and his light elemental law reached the intermediate stage, making it even more potent.

"Argh! Fuck! Where did this light element come from!?" Yu Xue panicked due to the pain and the rapid depletion of his demon essence, soul power, and life force, which forced him to kneel on the ground. He grabbed the blade of the demon extermination sword and tried to push it back out of his body.
Feltia [2] swirled his sword, causing another extreme pain for Yu Xue. He then took out the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle and chained his hands, sealing his cultivation.

Despite the sealing of his cultivation, Yu Xue was still able to utilize his demon abilities, particularly as they had no connection to his cultivation. His blood spread out and began to cover them, but Feltia [2] moved faster by pulling the demon extermination sword out before jumping away.
[You gained 5,000,000 demon essences from Yu Xue.]
[You gained 5,000,000 Qi from Yu Xue.]
Since his cultivation was not completely stable, Feltia [2] transferred some of Yu Xue's Qi to his Qi storage, or it would be dangerous for him if he broke through to the 2-Star Heaven Realm.
Soon, Yu Xue's blood formed a blood ball, covering him. He tried to release the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle, but his attempt failed, and the shackle continued to absorb his Qi.
Feltia [2] immediately chased after Huan Ying, who was still chasing Zhang Xiaolong [3]. The two of them attacked the demon, forcing him out of the shadows with a shocked expression.

Huan Ying was truly shocked because Feltia [2] and Zhang Xiaolong [3] were completely similar in their appearance, cultivation, and aura. After all, there is no clone technique that can produce such perfect clones, and they usually only have a fraction of the original's power.
Huan Ying was even more shocked when Zhang Fei came out of the training space. 'Which one of them is the real one?'
Huan Ying glanced at Yu Xue's location, his expression growing more serious as he realized his friend's predicament.
"Where are you looking at?" Huan Ying was startled, but Zhang Fei immediately slashed his light sword Qi at his chest.
"Gahhh!" Huan Ying groaned in pain and flew backward, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feltia [2] surrounded him from behind, and both of them slashed the swords in their hands at his back. "Gahhh!"

Huan Ying wanted to escape into the shadow, but Zhang Fei and his two clones used the shadow emperor technique to overcome his shadow abilities, and they then used the shadow binding technique to bind him.

Huan Ying was once again shocked to learn that lust demons like them could overcome his abilities in shadows. The moment he thought that, three shadow blades appeared beneath him and pierced three parts of his body directly. "Gahh!"

Zhang Fei and Zhang Xiaolong [3] moved to both sides of Huang Yin with light Qi swords in their hands, and Feltia [2] moved in front of the demon with the demon extermination sword wrapped in light Qi.
Zhang Fei and Zhang Xiaolong [3] chopped off both of Huan Ying's arms, and Feltia [2] slashed both of his legs, causing black blood to spray around.
"Argh!" Huan Ying fell to the ground and groaned in pain.

Feltia [2] immediately stabbed the demon extermination sword into Huan Ying's chest, nailing him to the ground. However, he avoided his heart, especially since he had no intention of killing the demon.

Zhang Fei and Zhang Xiaolong [3] landed on either side of Huan Ying, and Feltia [2] crouched on top of him. They immediately crippled his cultivation before using their three absorption techniques so they wouldn't absorb his Qi.
"Argh!" They were absorbing Huan Ying's demon essence, soul power, and life force, rapidly weakening him. "Argh! You will feel my lord's wrath if you kill me!"

Naturally, Zhang Fei and his two clones would not stop their actions in absorbing them. Instead, they accelerated their absorption. "Xereth is indeed a great demon, but I am not afraid of him, and I will kill him one day in the future to avenge my two spirit girls."
For some time, Huan Ying continued to let out screams of pain, but he eventually died after Zhang Fei and his two clones absorbed everything, drying up his body.
[You gained 25,000,000 demon essences from Huan Ying.]
"I got so much demon essence from this guy!" Zhang Fei exclaimed with satisfaction. "How much more demon essence do I need now, Mei?"
[Cultivation]
> 1 Star Heaven Realm [Qi: 3,000,000/10,000,000]
[Demon Rank]
- Duke Rank [Female Essence: 119,100,000/180,000,000]
[Beast Rank]
"About sixty million, huh?" Zhang Fei and his two clones then moved to Yu Xue's location and landed in front of him. Wasting no time, they immediately destroyed the blood ball that covered him.
*Boom*
"Gahh!" Yu Xue bounced and rolled backward, but Zhang Fei immediately used the shadow binding to bind him.
Zhang Fei and his two clones surrounded Yu Xue and crippled his cultivation, terrifying him. "Your friend is dead; it's your turn now."
"No! Don't kill me!"

Zhang Fei and his two clones naturally wouldn't listen to Yu Xue's pleas, and they directly absorbed his demon essence, soul power, and life force. In the end, he suffered the same fate as Huan Ying, and his body dried up.
[You gained 20,000,000 demon essences from Yu Xue.]
"Phew!" Zhang Fei exhaled with a sense of relief. "Having my speed and clones is the best thing in my life, or else I won't be able to kill these two demons."

After that, Zhang Fei returned to the training space, especially since Hong Yao was still in the process of transforming into a beast. Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to the Xianjin Realm, and Feltia [2] returned to the Phoenix Realm before soaking in the icy lake again.
"What about the two demons, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian inquired immediately after Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared in front of them.
Yan Yinqing, on the other hand, grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulders and checked his body. "Junior Brother, did you sustain any injuries in the fight with them?"

"Hehe! You act like a caring wife, Senior Sister." Yan Yinqing was stunned for a moment before withdrawing both hands from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The two demons are dead, but Long Jiutian will probably notice their deaths. However, we don't need to worry too much about the demon because Feng Xueying is in this realm, and she will stop him if he wants to go on a rampage here."
"How did you manage to kill those two demons, kid?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] tilted his head to Wang Zhemin. "Naturally, I didn't fight them alone, and I was helped by several people. If I fought those two alone, I would be the one to die by their hands."
Wang Zhemin wore a doubtful look after listening to that, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was previously able to suppress his granddaughter, Wang Yourou, with such a low cultivation.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled at Wang Zhemin's expression. "Is your aunt close to this realm, Senior Brother?"
"My aunt will arrive soon." Lin Moxian then asked him. "Can you infiltrate the Huang Clan?"
"I can, but I won't." Zhang Xiaolong [3] informed Lin Moxian about some things through telepathy. "I will return to the inn now to continue stabilizing my foundation."
When he arrived at the inn, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found Wang Yourou had just arrived there. He immediately teased her. "Did you come here to look for me on purpose, Senior Sister?"
"Can we talk together in your room?" Wang Yourou asked with a slight blush on her cheeks, amusing Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly and teased her again. "Senior Sister, you are a woman, and I am a man. Aren't you afraid that having me in the same room will tarnish your reputation?"
"Humph!" Wang Yourou snorted and walked into the inn. "Let's go!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head, followed Wang Yourou into the inn, and led her directly to his room. "So, what do you want from me, Senior Sister?"
"I... I want you to use your technique from back then on me again." Wang Yourou replied with a bashful expression.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised at her request. "Why do you want me to use that?"

"You! It's all because of you, so you have to take responsibility!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] burst into laughter at Wang Yourou's response. "Don't laugh at me! I can no longer experience 'that' after you used your technique on me four days ago!"
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed louder, embarrassing and angering Wang Yourou. "I didn't expect that you often do 'that' by yourself, Senior Sister."

"Don't make fun of me!" Wang Yourou shouted in frustration. She actually didn't want to see Zhang Xiaolong [3] because she was embarrassed, but she felt like she had no other choice but to see him. "Help me now!"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Wang Yourou's hand and brought her to sit at the foot of the bed. "Before I helped you, I was curious about your relationship with Xi Hongyan, so I wanted to know about the relationship between you two. Did you two often satisfy each other in the past? How did you two do it?"
"My past relationship with Xi Hongyan is none of your business!" Wang Yourou withdrew her hand from his grasp.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed to the door. "If you don't want to tell me, then I won't help you, and you can go back to your clan."
Wang Yourou stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a fierce gaze, as she was embarrassed to tell all that to a man like him.

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "I've already told you that I like women like you and Xi Hongyan. In fact, I have two pairs of women like you two by my side, and I enjoy watching their actions of pleasing each other. However, every female lover has their habits, so I'm curious about you and Xi Hongyan."
Wang Yourou furrowed her brows. "Do you really not mind your women doing such things with each other?"

"Why should I object to that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] touched Wang Yourou's forehead and shared his memories of the four women, who were Yan Lu'er, Xi Zihua, Luo Yu, and Gu Yan. Naturally, those memories were from his dual cultivation with the four women.

Wang Yourou innocently took Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s bait by watching his memories, and her face turned as ripe as a red tomato as soon as she saw their activities. Even so, she kept watching them because she was curious about his activities with the four women. She could see the four women pleasuring each other while he dual cultivated with them, and their expressions were downright lewd because of the pleasure.

Wang Yourou had often pleasured each other with Xi Hongyan in the past, but she was sure that their expressions at that time were not as lewd as the four women in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s memories, and the four of them were truly like women intoxicated by sexual pleasure.

Before long, Wang Yourou opened her eyes and stole a glance at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s trousers, but she hurriedly averted her gaze. "Hongyan and I have never done anything like them, and we used to do it at a slow tempo."
"Oh." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked. "Are you interested in experiencing the same as my four women, Senior Sister?"
"Huh?" Wang Yourou stared at him with wide eyes. "No! We don't know each other, so I won't do such a thing with you, and I only need your technique to help me!"

"Lie down and make yourself as relaxed as possible so you can enjoy the effects more." Wang Yourou hurriedly lay down on the bed and covered her mouth with both hands, especially since she had moaned so loudly when Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his technique on her a few days ago, and she did not want to experience the same thing again. "Are you ready, Senior Sister?"

Wang Yourou nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately touched her feet and used the enhanced demon touch on her. In that instant, her eyes rolled back, her body arched upwards, and a muffled groan escaped her lips.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see Wang Yourou's lower body drenched in her sticky pleasure liquid, which also soaked the bed. He used the enhanced demon touch on her once again, causing her body to contract endlessly and her liquid to continue to wet below. 'This woman! Is she not afraid that I will do something to her in this kind of situation?'
[I thought you didn't like Wang Yourou, Master.]

paragraphs: "What happened to you?" Lin Jingxia asked her nephew.
Lin Moxian was aware of her aunt's question, but she decided to pretend not to know. "What do you mean by that, Aunt?"
"Forget it." Lin Jingxia put away her flying artifact immediately so as not to attract people's attention. "Bring me to the kid."
"Yes."

A while later, Lin Moxian had already brought Lin Jingxia to the room he shared with Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he was surprised to find Wang Yourou sleeping on one of the beds. 'What is she doing here?'
Lin Jingxia paid no attention to Wang Yourou and walked in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Her nose twitched at the familiar smell of his body. "I can smell thousands of types of herbs from him."
"Do you believe me now, Aunt?" Lin Moxian questioned his aunt as he stood by her side.

Lin Jingxia nodded and extended her hand to Lin Moxian, who immediately handed her a superior-grade healing pill. She closely observed the pill, trying to discern the herbs used to concoct it. "I couldn't recognize some of the ingredients."

"Eh?" Lin Moxian was taken aback by this, as Lin Jingxia, despite being the most skilled female alchemist in their universe, was unable to identify some of the ingredients in the pill. "Does that mean my junior brother uses special ingredients?"
"Yes." Lin Jingxia returned the pill to Lin Moxian. "He is stabilizing his unstable foundation."

"He previously broke through from the 7-Star Earth Realm to the 1-Star Heaven Realm." Lin Jingxia tilted her head to Lin Moxian with raised eyebrows. "He is different from us, and he is a dual cultivator. He has many people by his side, so he pushed himself to the extreme for them."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. She then took a pill, pulled his chin down, and forced him to swallow it.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] already knew of Lin Jingxia and Lin Moxian's arrival, but he was too busy stabilizing his foundation. Moreover, he knew they wouldn't hurt him, so he continued his actions. 'Mei, check the ingredients of the pill.'

[I've checked the ingredients, and there's no poison in it, so you can swallow it, Master.] Even if the pill contained poison, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confident that his poison immunity would save him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly dissolved the pill and spread it all over his body. The pill not only warmed his body from the inside, but it also made his foundation more stable than before. 'What a magnificent pill! Just one pill, but my foundation is gradually stabilizing on its own. Since I already know the ingredients, I will try concocting the pill later. That way, I don't have to wait long to stabilize my cultivation, and I can cultivate without worrying about my foundation.'

After his body absorbed all of the pill, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes and stood up. Lin Jingxia's beauty and demeanor momentarily stunned him, but he hurriedly cupped his hand. "Thank you for your help, Senior. Thanks to your pill, my foundation is almost completely stabilized."
"En." Lin Jingxia then asked. "What kind of pills did you give my nephew?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback by her question. "I gave him the five basic pills, Senior."
Lin Jingxia's expression showed that she did not believe him. "Don't lie to me."
[Master, this woman noticed that Lin Moxian used a disguise technique to hide the effects of your two pills.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed wryly in his heart before taking out the two pills, and he showed them to Lin Jingxia directly, making Lin Moxian feel guilty toward the two of them. "These two are the Beauty Restoring Pill and the Youthful Retaining Pill."

Lin Jingxia was shocked after hearing the names of the two pills, especially since she and Tian Shuxiang had tried concocting such pills. Unfortunately, they were continuously faced with failure, yet Zhang Xiaolong [3] had such pills in his possession. She then turned to her nephew. "Cancel your disguise."
"Yes." Lin Jingxia gasped in shock as soon as she saw Lin Moxian's true face. She groped his face with an incredulous look, making him awkward. "Aunt."
Lin Jingxia hurriedly pulled both hands back and took the two pills from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hands. "Where did you get their recipe? How did you concoct them?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally wouldn't tell Lin Jingxia that he bought the two pills from the system shop, but he did tell her about the ingredients in them, which actually made her even more curious about them. "Senior, I got their recipe and some of the ingredients in the Star Tower, so it's natural that you don't know about them."
"The Star Tower?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and explained to Lin Jingxia about it and the other towers. "When are you going to the tower again?"
"Once my cultivation is completely stable." Lin Jingxia immediately took out the same pill as before and gave it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'She can't wait to go to the tower, huh?'

"Swallow the Nine Revolutions Pill, and your cultivation will be fully stabilized." Lin Jingxia wanted to return the two pills to him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to give them to her. He also gave her the five basic pills. "Thank you."

"No need for thanks, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat back on the bed and swallowed the pill. A few minutes later, his foundation had completely stabilized, and it was more solid than before. 'Tch! If I had known she had this kind of pill, I wouldn't have rushed to kill those two demons, and I could have broken through to the 2-Star Heaven Realm straight away.' "Senior, I will take you to the Star Tower with us, but we must settle the matters in this realm first, especially since the Nameless One and the others are still away."
"All right." Lin Jingxia agreed. "I'll go to my room."
After Lin Jingxia left, Lin Moxian released a soft sigh and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "Sorry, my aunt noticed my disguise."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "It's a trivial matter, so you don't need to apologize. Moreover, your aunt gave me two pills with extraordinary effects, and my foundation is stable now."
"What is she doing here?" Lin Moxian pointed at Wang Yourou.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched his head and told him about Wang Yourou's request, making him facepalm. "She's too tired, so she'll probably sleep for a long time."
"Let her sleep then." Lin Moxian then lay down on his bed, but he suddenly received a voice transmission from Wang Zhemin. "The Huan and Xiong clans are preparing their men."

"Both demons are dead, and Long Jiutian hasn't returned to this realm yet, so I'm sure they won't make a move soon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] lay down on his bed and hugged Wang Yourou, making Lin Moxian laugh in amusement at the sight. "This woman is quite funny and amusing, but her arrogance is too high."

"Haha." Lin Moxian laughed at. "It's not a big deal for you, right? You have dozens of women, so I'm sure you can tame her. If you get her, then her Wang Clan will become your subordinate, which will benefit you."

"Let's see in the future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the map to monitor the people from the two clans, and he also sent the Demon's Eye Orb to the Huang Clan to investigate the clan deeper because his intuition told him that there was something unusual within the clan.

In the main hall of the Xiong Clan, the clan leaders were gathered together with several leaders from other clans. An old man with long black hair, Huang Zhejun, sat on the head seat, rubbing his lengthy beard. He was the ancestor of the clan, Huang Zhejun, accompanied by an old woman, who was his wife.

On the right side, several people from his Xiong Clan sat side by side with serious expressions, and they were led by their ancestor, Xiong Yehui. On the left side, Huang Jiguang sat side by side with his brothers and sisters and their respective partners.
However, there were several other people on the side of the Huang Clan members, and the writing on their robes showed that they were people from the Lei Clan, led by Lei Xuanfeng.
"Brother-in-law, do you think they were caught by Guan Chenhong?" Lei Xuanfeng asked Huang Zhejun.

"That's most likely the case." Huang Zhejun then told them. "For the past three days, Wang Zhemin has been going back and forth several times between the Wang Clan and the defense center. Unfortunately, my men couldn't check inside because Guan Chenhong would know right away, and the place is covered by an anti-spying formation, so I don't have accurate information about their activities. Since my people and Xiong Minglei's people haven't returned from there, I suspect that Old Guan captured and locked them up in that place."

Xiong Yehui's expression turned ugly after hearing that, and he immediately asked a few questions. "Have you contacted those two people, Brother Huang? Why didn't they save our people? Didn't Long Jiutian send them specifically to help us?"

"Some time after our people entered that place, Long Jiutian contacted me and told me that his two men were dead; otherwise, Old Guan would not have been able to capture them." Huang Zhejun's answer shocked both Xiong Yehui and Lei Xuanfeng. "He is on his way to our realm now, and he asked us to be prepared. Once he arrives in two days, we will attack and take over the place, especially since that place is our main key to taking over this realm."

"Husband, I have a bad feeling about this matter." Lei Xuanfeng and Xiong Yehui turned to Huang Zhejun's wife, Lei Huiyin. "We had been planning everything carefully for the past few months, but the situation suddenly changed today. I suspect that something has happened in this realm without our knowledge, which has a direct impact on our plans."
"What do you think really happened, sister?" Lei Xuanfeng asked.
Lei Huyin shook her head. "I can't confirm that, but it might have something to do with Hun Di's three disciples, especially since this incident happened after they arrived in our realm."

"If you didn't mention those three, I wouldn't have thought of that possibility." Xiong Yehui replied with a serious expression. "A few days ago, Hun Di's two male disciples met Jian Wufeng, and the young one managed to suppress Wang Yourou, even though his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Heaven Realm."

"Being able to suppress Wang Yourou with such a low cultivation does not make sense, so I agree with my sister that those three brats have something to do with today's incident." Lei Xuanfeng then asked them. "Do you think they killed those two people?"

Huang Zhejun immediately answered him. "Lin Moxian and his junior sister appeared in the defense center, but his junior brother had not joined them previously. I originally thought that brat got rid of those two people, but I thought it was too ridiculous, especially since it was impossible for a cultivator at the 1-Star Heaven Realm to fight two cultivators at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, and they could kill him like an ant."

"Father." Huang Zhejun looked at his son, Huang Jiguang. "Since that kid could suppress Wang Yourou with his low cultivation, I think Hun Di gave him a special artifact. If my guess is correct, he might be the one who eliminated the two of them. They lived in the Golden Crane Inn, and I think we should move to capture them first, or they will thwart our next plan."
"Brother-in-law, I agree with my nephew; we must capture them to secure our plan." Lei Xuanfeng spoke.
Xiong Yehui also agreed with the two. "We should move now before the situation gets worse, or we will suffer if our plans fail miserably."

Huang Zhejun also felt that it was the best option they had right now, but Lei Huiyin seemed doubtful about the success of their plan to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others. "Husband, we should not move ourselves, and you can order others to try to capture them."
"All right." Huang Zhejun immediately contacted someone, as did Lei Xuanfeng and Xiong Yehui. "Let's wait for their report."
At the Phoenix Palace, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [4] stood above the main gate, awaiting the arrival of the dark phoenix. "How long do you think it will take for her to arrive in this realm?"

"According to that woman's information, Feng Yichen will arrive here this morning at the earliest." Zhang Fei [4] then asked her. "Are you sure you can handle her by yourself? I know you have Huo Ling, but that woman is stronger than expected."

Feng Yao turned to him with a smile. "You've always been curious about me, right? I'll show you a little bit of my abilities when I face Feng Yichen, so you should watch me carefully, and you'll understand the difference between us."

"Don't worry, I will watch your fight with Feng Yichen later from close range." Zhang Fei [4] let out a soft sigh. "Once we resolve the issue in the upper realms, I need your help to secure Earth. Fa Ling is too strong, so I can't fight with her there, or our fight will affect those earthlings."
"Sure."

sentences.text: "What happened to you?" Lin Jingxia asked her nephew.
Lin Moxian was aware of her aunt's question, but she decided to pretend not to know.
"What do you mean by that, Aunt?"
"Forget it." Lin Jingxia put away her flying artifact immediately so as not to attract people's attention.
"Bring me to the kid."
"Yes."

A while later, Lin Moxian had already brought Lin Jingxia to the room he shared with Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he was surprised to find Wang Yourou sleeping on one of the beds. 'What is she doing here?'
Lin Jingxia paid no attention to Wang Yourou and walked in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Her nose twitched at the familiar smell of his body.
"I can smell thousands of types of herbs from him."
"Do you believe me now, Aunt?" Lin Moxian questioned his aunt as he stood by her side.
Lin Jingxia nodded and extended her hand to Lin Moxian, who immediately handed her a superior-grade healing pill.
She closely observed the pill, trying to discern the herbs used to concoct it.
"I couldn't recognize some of the ingredients."
"Eh?" Lin Moxian was taken aback by this, as Lin Jingxia, despite being the most skilled female alchemist in their universe, was unable to identify some of the ingredients in the pill.
"Does that mean my junior brother uses special ingredients?"
"Yes." Lin Jingxia returned the pill to Lin Moxian.
"He is stabilizing his unstable foundation."
"He previously broke through from the 7-Star Earth Realm to the 1-Star Heaven Realm." Lin Jingxia tilted her head to Lin Moxian with raised eyebrows.
"He is different from us, and he is a dual cultivator.
He has many people by his side, so he pushed himself to the extreme for them."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again.
She then took a pill, pulled his chin down, and forced him to swallow it.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] already knew of Lin Jingxia and Lin Moxian's arrival, but he was too busy stabilizing his foundation.
Moreover, he knew they wouldn't hurt him, so he continued his actions. 'Mei, check the ingredients of the pill.'

[I've checked the ingredients, and there's no poison in it, so you can swallow it, Master.] Even if the pill contained poison, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confident that his poison immunity would save him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly dissolved the pill and spread it all over his body.
The pill not only warmed his body from the inside, but it also made his foundation more stable than before. 'What a magnificent pill!
Just one pill, but my foundation is gradually stabilizing on its own.
Since I already know the ingredients, I will try concocting the pill later.
That way, I don't have to wait long to stabilize my cultivation, and I can cultivate without worrying about my foundation.'
After his body absorbed all of the pill, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes and stood up.
Lin Jingxia's beauty and demeanor momentarily stunned him, but he hurriedly cupped his hand.
"Thank you for your help, Senior.
Thanks to your pill, my foundation is almost completely stabilized."
"En." Lin Jingxia then asked.
"What kind of pills did you give my nephew?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback by her question.
"I gave him the five basic pills, Senior."
Lin Jingxia's expression showed that she did not believe him.
"Don't lie to me."
[Master, this woman noticed that Lin Moxian used a disguise technique to hide the effects of your two pills.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed wryly in his heart before taking out the two pills, and he showed them to Lin Jingxia directly, making Lin Moxian feel guilty toward the two of them.
"These two are the Beauty Restoring Pill and the Youthful Retaining Pill."
Lin Jingxia was shocked after hearing the names of the two pills, especially since she and Tian Shuxiang had tried concocting such pills.
Unfortunately, they were continuously faced with failure, yet Zhang Xiaolong [3] had such pills in his possession.
She then turned to her nephew.
"Cancel your disguise."
"Yes." Lin Jingxia gasped in shock as soon as she saw Lin Moxian's true face.
She groped his face with an incredulous look, making him awkward.
"Aunt."
Lin Jingxia hurriedly pulled both hands back and took the two pills from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hands.
"Where did you get their recipe?
How did you concoct them?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally wouldn't tell Lin Jingxia that he bought the two pills from the system shop, but he did tell her about the ingredients in them, which actually made her even more curious about them.
"Senior, I got their recipe and some of the ingredients in the Star Tower, so it's natural that you don't know about them."
"The Star Tower?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and explained to Lin Jingxia about it and the other towers.
"When are you going to the tower again?"
"Once my cultivation is completely stable." Lin Jingxia immediately took out the same pill as before and gave it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'She can't wait to go to the tower, huh?'
"Swallow the Nine Revolutions Pill, and your cultivation will be fully stabilized." Lin Jingxia wanted to return the two pills to him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to give them to her.
He also gave her the five basic pills.
"Thank you."
"No need for thanks, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat back on the bed and swallowed the pill.
A few minutes later, his foundation had completely stabilized, and it was more solid than before. 'Tch!

If I had known she had this kind of pill, I wouldn't have rushed to kill those two demons, and I could have broken through to the 2-Star Heaven Realm straight away.' "Senior, I will take you to the Star Tower with us, but we must settle the matters in this realm first, especially since the Nameless One and the others are still away."
"All right." Lin Jingxia agreed.
"I'll go to my room."
After Lin Jingxia left, Lin Moxian released a soft sigh and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.
"Sorry, my aunt noticed my disguise."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed.
"It's a trivial matter, so you don't need to apologize.
Moreover, your aunt gave me two pills with extraordinary effects, and my foundation is stable now."
"What is she doing here?" Lin Moxian pointed at Wang Yourou.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched his head and told him about Wang Yourou's request, making him facepalm.
"She's too tired, so she'll probably sleep for a long time."
"Let her sleep then." Lin Moxian then lay down on his bed, but he suddenly received a voice transmission from Wang Zhemin.
"The Huan and Xiong clans are preparing their men."

"Both demons are dead, and Long Jiutian hasn't returned to this realm yet, so I'm sure they won't make a move soon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] lay down on his bed and hugged Wang Yourou, making Lin Moxian laugh in amusement at the sight.
"This woman is quite funny and amusing, but her arrogance is too high."
"Haha." Lin Moxian laughed at.
"It's not a big deal for you, right?
You have dozens of women, so I'm sure you can tame her.
If you get her, then her Wang Clan will become your subordinate, which will benefit you."

"Let's see in the future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the map to monitor the people from the two clans, and he also sent the Demon's Eye Orb to the Huang Clan to investigate the clan deeper because his intuition told him that there was something unusual within the clan.
In the main hall of the Xiong Clan, the clan leaders were gathered together with several leaders from other clans.
An old man with long black hair, Huang Zhejun, sat on the head seat, rubbing his lengthy beard.
He was the ancestor of the clan, Huang Zhejun, accompanied by an old woman, who was his wife.
On the right side, several people from his Xiong Clan sat side by side with serious expressions, and they were led by their ancestor, Xiong Yehui.
On the left side, Huang Jiguang sat side by side with his brothers and sisters and their respective partners.
However, there were several other people on the side of the Huang Clan members, and the writing on their robes showed that they were people from the Lei Clan, led by Lei Xuanfeng.
"Brother-in-law, do you think they were caught by Guan Chenhong?" Lei Xuanfeng asked Huang Zhejun.
"That's most likely the case." Huang Zhejun then told them.
"For the past three days, Wang Zhemin has been going back and forth several times between the Wang Clan and the defense center.

Unfortunately, my men couldn't check inside because Guan Chenhong would know right away, and the place is covered by an anti-spying formation, so I don't have accurate information about their activities.
Since my people and Xiong Minglei's people haven't returned from there, I suspect that Old Guan captured and locked them up in that place."
Xiong Yehui's expression turned ugly after hearing that, and he immediately asked a few questions.
"Have you contacted those two people, Brother Huang?
Why didn't they save our people?
Didn't Long Jiutian send them specifically to help us?"

"Some time after our people entered that place, Long Jiutian contacted me and told me that his two men were dead; otherwise, Old Guan would not have been able to capture them." Huang Zhejun's answer shocked both Xiong Yehui and Lei Xuanfeng.
"He is on his way to our realm now, and he asked us to be prepared.
Once he arrives in two days, we will attack and take over the place, especially since that place is our main key to taking over this realm."
"Husband, I have a bad feeling about this matter." Lei Xuanfeng and Xiong Yehui turned to Huang Zhejun's wife, Lei Huiyin.
"We had been planning everything carefully for the past few months, but the situation suddenly changed today.
I suspect that something has happened in this realm without our knowledge, which has a direct impact on our plans."
"What do you think really happened, sister?" Lei Xuanfeng asked.
Lei Huyin shook her head.
"I can't confirm that, but it might have something to do with Hun Di's three disciples, especially since this incident happened after they arrived in our realm."
"If you didn't mention those three, I wouldn't have thought of that possibility." Xiong Yehui replied with a serious expression.
"A few days ago, Hun Di's two male disciples met Jian Wufeng, and the young one managed to suppress Wang Yourou, even though his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Heaven Realm."

"Being able to suppress Wang Yourou with such a low cultivation does not make sense, so I agree with my sister that those three brats have something to do with today's incident." Lei Xuanfeng then asked them.
"Do you think they killed those two people?"
Huang Zhejun immediately answered him.
"Lin Moxian and his junior sister appeared in the defense center, but his junior brother had not joined them previously.

I originally thought that brat got rid of those two people, but I thought it was too ridiculous, especially since it was impossible for a cultivator at the 1-Star Heaven Realm to fight two cultivators at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, and they could kill him like an ant."
"Father." Huang Zhejun looked at his son, Huang Jiguang.
"Since that kid could suppress Wang Yourou with his low cultivation, I think Hun Di gave him a special artifact.
If my guess is correct, he might be the one who eliminated the two of them.
They lived in the Golden Crane Inn, and I think we should move to capture them first, or they will thwart our next plan."
"Brother-in-law, I agree with my nephew; we must capture them to secure our plan." Lei Xuanfeng spoke.
Xiong Yehui also agreed with the two.
"We should move now before the situation gets worse, or we will suffer if our plans fail miserably."
Huang Zhejun also felt that it was the best option they had right now, but Lei Huiyin seemed doubtful about the success of their plan to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others.
"Husband, we should not move ourselves, and you can order others to try to capture them."
"All right." Huang Zhejun immediately contacted someone, as did Lei Xuanfeng and Xiong Yehui.
"Let's wait for their report."
At the Phoenix Palace, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [4] stood above the main gate, awaiting the arrival of the dark phoenix.
"How long do you think it will take for her to arrive in this realm?"
"According to that woman's information, Feng Yichen will arrive here this morning at the earliest." Zhang Fei [4] then asked her.
"Are you sure you can handle her by yourself?
I know you have Huo Ling, but that woman is stronger than expected."
Feng Yao turned to him with a smile.
"You've always been curious about me, right?
I'll show you a little bit of my abilities when I face Feng Yichen, so you should watch me carefully, and you'll understand the difference between us."
"Don't worry, I will watch your fight with Feng Yichen later from close range." Zhang Fei [4] let out a soft sigh.
"Once we resolve the issue in the upper realms, I need your help to secure Earth.
Fa Ling is too strong, so I can't fight with her there, or our fight will affect those earthlings."
"Sure."

paragraphs: In the Huang Clan, the Demon's Eye Orb followed Huang Zheyun and Lei Huiyin to the underground chamber beneath their clan, where a black demon statue stood at the end.
"Are you sure you want to activate this statue, Husband?"

Huang Zheyun answered his wife with a shake of his head. "Back then, Lord Jiutian told me to activate this statue if the situation is not in our favor, but I will not rush to activate it, and I will wait for news on whether our people have successfully captured the three individuals. If they fail to carry out their duties, Guan Chenhong will definitely contact those old folks, and the situation will become unfavorable for us. If they make a move on us, I will activate this statue directly."
"I think that is the best choice." Lei Huiyin then walked away. "You can prepare to activate this statue, and I will go to prepare other things."
"All right."

Inside the inn room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat by the window as he looked towards the location of the Huang Clan. "The black statue is the same one that Xereth used to appear in the dark realm. If that is true, that demon will appear in this realm once Huang Zhejun activates it, and no one in this realm will be able to fight him; even the defense mechanisms available here will not work against him."
"Is he that strong, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian approached him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Tian Huangjin is a cultivator of the Paradise Realm, and Xereth can match her; not even the Nameless One can face him with his current strength. Even if he joins hands with your aunt and the others, they still won't be able to stop him, so the casualties will be innumerable if he appears here."
"Do you have a solution for this problem?"

"Feng Yao should be able to stop Xereth, but she is waiting for the arrival of the dark phoenix now." Lin Moxian had no doubts, having witnessed Huo Ling's actions during their assistance to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the Nine Hells Realm. "We still don't have clear information about that demon's strength and abilities, so it's too risky if we let Huang Zheyun activate that statue, and we have to think of something to buy time."

"What if we let them arrest us?" Lin Moxian expressed his idea. "They already guessed that we told Senior Guan about them, and they might lower their guard if we were in their hands. That way, Huang Zheyun won't activate the statue, and we can think of a way to destroy it."
"Do you have anything for that?"

"Yes." Lin Moxian took out four puppets and showed them to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Once we implant our hair and blood into these humanoid dolls, they will immediately transform into us. We can use a thread of our soul to control them from afar, and they will never realize that they are dolls unless they have puppet masters by their side."
"Let's use them then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] contacted Tantai Lingyan and Yan Yinqing, asking them to go to his room.

After Tantai Lingyan and Yan Yinqing arrived, Lin Moxian immediately explained the plan to the two women, and they straight away agreed with it. They then implanted their hair and blood in the four humanoid dolls, which immediately changed to look exactly like them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3], Lin Moxian, and Yan Yinqing could easily implant a thread of their souls into the dolls because they were soul cultivators. However, Tantai Lingyan was not a soul cultivator like them, so she had difficulty doing that.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed her hand and guided her to do that, but Tantai Lingyan was a little uncomfortable because she was rubbing her hand. She was a mature woman and experienced cultivator, and she was aware of his intentions from the moment he gave his Yang Qi to her.
Noticing that, Yan Yinqin smiled mischievously and pushed Tantai Lingyan forward, causing her to fall into Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s embrace.
Tantai Lingyan wanted to get away from him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged her instead. "Let me go."

"Hehe!" Yan Yinqing chuckled. "Don't be shy, Mom. My junior brother has clearly shown his interest in you by giving you his Yang Qi, and you are a free woman because my father died a long time ago. Therefore, it doesn't matter if you have a relationship with him, and my four grandparents will definitely support you."

Tantai Lingyan was embarrassed that her daughter said such a thing in front of the two men, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately lifted her chin and looked her in the eye. "Even though you already have a daughter as big as my senior sister, I was attracted to you the moment we met. Even though you are a widow, I'm not concerned about that, and I want to have you as my wife. I will never force you to accept me, and I will try hard to convince you that I am sincere to you."

Tantai Lingyan directly pushed Zhang Xiaolong [3] backward with a little force, and she hurriedly left the room with an embarrassed face. After all, he was much younger than her, and he was her daughter's junior brother.

"Hahaha!" Yang Yinqing laughed out loud, realizing her mother's bashful expression as she ran away. She then spoke to Lin Moxian. "Hey, senior brother! You should learn a lot from our junior brother in wooing women, or you will be single for the rest of your life if you keep failing to win Xi Hongyan's feelings."

Lin Moxian's lips twitched, and he countered her directly. "Don't talk nonsense about me, Junior Sister. Look at you, you're almost as old as me, but you have never had a lover yourself, especially since you were too tomboyish. If you continue acting like this, you'll be a spinster for the rest of your life!"

Instead, Yan Yinqing smiled faintly and grabbed Lin Moxian's collar. "How about we get married, Senior Brother? However, we will get married if you fail to conquer Xi Hongyan and no man is willing to marry me, so we will not live in loneliness for the rest of our lives."
Lin Moxian was stunned by Yan Yinqing's words, especially since he had never had such thoughts toward her, and he had always regarded her as his junior sister.
"Just kidding." Yan Yinqing immediately let go of Lin Moxian's collar. "I would rather live alone for the rest of my life than marry an old and obsessive man like you."
Black lines appeared on Lin Moxian's forehead, but he was familiar with Yan Yinqing's mischievous and playful character, so he immediately ignored her words. "Tch! I won't care about you anymore."
"Hehe." Yan Yinqing giggled to herself.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was amused by their antics, but he then pulled Yan Yinqing into his embrace and whispered to her. "How about you become my wife too, Senior Sister?"

"Huh?" Yan Yinqing looked at him with repeated blinks, but she then leaned against his chest and twirled her index finger there. "Are you able to please me, Junior Brother? I'm a tomboy, possessive, and jealous woman, you know? If I become your wife, I will snatch you away from your other wives, and I will never share you with them forever."

"Senior sister, you can lie to others, but you can never lie to me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed at her chest. "I have dozens of women by my side, remember? Therefore, I am more expert than you, and I know that your words are different from your heart and soul. I know you are a caring woman, and you will never do such things."
"Haha." Yan Yinqing immediately broke away from him. "If you are confident in your words, you can try to get me, but you will regret choosing me as your wife."
"Let's prove it in the future, Senior Sister." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a smile.
Yan Yinqing only nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she took her and her mother's dolls to their room to prepare to face the people from the two clans.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then carried Wang Yourou before leaving the room together with Lin Moxian, and the two dolls that had transformed into them lay down on their bed to deceive the people who would come to them soon.
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3], Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan gathered on the roof of the inn.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to send Wang Yourou into the Yin-Yang Space, especially since she slept like a dead pig, which surprised Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan.
"What kind of place is behind the portal, Junior Brother?" Yan Yinqing inquired inquisitively, and Tantai Lingyan shared her curiosity.
"A prison." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer caused both women to raise their eyebrows. "That place is a special prison, and I locked up ten female cultivators who were my enemies in the past."
"Are you using them as your cultivation furnace?" Tantai Lingyan asked, but her tone was filled with detest.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it immediately. "The way I use them as my cultivation furnace is different from what you imagine. I have never touched them, and they don't experience the slightest pain in the process."
"Prove it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] first turned to Lin Moxian, who immediately contacted Lin Jingxia and informed her of their plans. After that, he brought the three of them into the Yin-Yang Space, but he had no intention of bringing them into the training space yet.
"So, this is how you absorb their powerful Qi, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian posed this question as he stood before the glass tube.

"As I explained some time ago, I cannot absorb the Yin Qi of female cultivators in the Seven Divine Realm directly, but I can absorb it from this tube." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed at the ten rooms. "Ten women slept in those rooms, and I locked their subconsciousness in dreamland. I gave them sweet dreams, and their Yin Qi would flow directly into this glass tube. By the way, the three of you definitely recognize some of them."

Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan immediately checked the rooms, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] stopped Lin Moxian because all ten female prisoners were naked. Both women were surprised when they found Shang Xishun, Shang Ziyuan, and Shi Wuxian sleeping in the three different rooms. However, they could not recognize the identities of the other seven women, especially since they were cultivators from the lower and middle realms.

"See? They aren't in the slightest pain, right?" Both women nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I would never lock up innocent women in this place, and I locked them up because they are my enemies. Currently, they are dreaming of their respective partners, so I can harvest their Yin Qi. I wake them up once in a while to eat, and I'll give them healing and recovery pills if their condition weakens. If I no longer need them, I will release them from this place, but I will erase their memories of me and everything related to me."
Tantai Lingyan then pointed to several rooms. "Why can I detect your Yang Qi in their bodies?"

"Their Yin Qi is too weak for me, so they drink my Yang Qi, just like you." Tantai Lingyan became embarrassed when Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought up that matter. "Those people have started moving, so we have to get out now."

When they arrived outside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought them into an invisible state, and they found several people from the Huang, Xiong, and Lei clans sneaking into their inn. Meanwhile, Lin Jingxia stood in midair and watched the movements of those people, but no one noticed her presence.
According to Lin Moxian, Lin Jingxia used an ancient artifact that could completely hide her presence and aura; even those defense mechanisms in the Xianjin Realm could not detect her either.
Sometime later, the people from the three clans brought the four humanoid dolls out of the inn, and they took them away to the Huang Clan.
They saw Lin Jingxia following those people. "Let's follow them."
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] refused. "You three go somewhere else first, and I will infiltrate the Huang Clan by myself."
"But—"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] interrupted Yan Yinqing straight away. "Senior Sister, my ability is not perfect. Many people and artifacts can detect us, so I can't take the three of you there. If those people notice our presence, it will be difficult for us to escape. As for me, this is my clone, and I will cancel it immediately if they notice my presence, so you don't have to worry about me."
Yan Yinqing let out a soft sigh before agreeing with him, and they immediately moved elsewhere once Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from their sight.

Up in the sky, Lin Jingxia noticed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s arrival at the Huang Clan, but she didn't have time to stop him. "His speed was marvelous, but he was careless by infiltrating this clan alone."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already inside the Huang Clan, and he found those people bringing the four humanoid dolls to Huang Zhejun, who was waiting for them in the room with the black demon statue.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't go to that place directly, but instead, he went somewhere else after using his strengthening technique. He also used the Demon Transformation II ability to disguise himself as Long Jiutian. Unlike other disguise techniques, his form and aura were completely similar to the blood dragon demon's, and he used the concealment ring to hide his cultivation.

Soon, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived in front of a room, and Lei Huiyin opened the door for him. However, she was surprised by his sudden arrival, especially since Long Jiutian was supposed to arrive in two days. "When did you arrive in the realm, Lord?"
"Just now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered the room directly. "Let's go in."

Lei Huiyin was confused by that, but she did not argue with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and went inside while closing the door. She then approached him, sat on his lap, and hugged his neck, surprising him. "Is there something bothering you, Lord?"

'Hmm? This woman is a bitch, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly muttered. "My lord was furious after hearing of the deaths of my two subordinates, so I rushed back to this realm, and we will begin our plan soon."
"Do you want me to serve you as usual, Lord?" Lei Huiyin posed a flirtatious question while shaking her lower body. "I miss your dragon dick inside me, and I want to feel it pound me again."

"I'm not in the mood to do it with you right now." Lei Huiyin responded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a disappointed expression. "Once our business in this realm is done, I will satisfy you as much as you want, so you don't need to be disappointed like this."

Huang Zhejun nodded at her.

Not long after Huang Zhejun left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] came alive again and walked towards the black demon statue, thinking about how to move or destroy it.

On Earth, Zhang Fei [5] stood alone in the sky while observing all areas of his country, but he was disappointed because he could not find the ancient places left behind by the cultivators of the past.
"Mei, I am still curious about the past calamity that happened here in the past, but I am at a loss to know the details.
If I can enter that place again, I might be able to ask the universe about it."
[Unfortunately, I don't have a solution to help you enter that place, Master.
However, I think there is someone who can help you with that, but it will be troublesome if that person knows about the place and knows a lot about those things.]
"The Nameless One, right?"
[Yes, Master.
The Nameless One has the void element, and I suspect that the space rift is connected to the void, so he might be able to help you enter that place.]
"After the business in the upper realms is finished, I will go find him and talk to him about that matter.
I hope he can really help me enter that place, and I won't be curious all the time like this." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Lillea and Janette out of the training space.
"I want the two of you to raise all the trees in this world."
"Eh?" Janette and Lillea turned to him in surprise; even Mei was also surprised by his spontaneous decision.
"Do you really want to do that?
These humans will be shocked if we do that, and it will cause huge chaos not only in this country but in other countries too."
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"The world will be in chaos if we do that, but it will not last long and will disappear on its own."
"Why do you suddenly care about this planet?" Lillea asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] looked around before answering her.
"Before, I wasn't concerned about this planet, and I only needed money from these earthlings.
However, the past calamity and the disappearance of Qi from this world continue to bother me.
If I improve the conditions of this world, the Qi will probably return to this planet by itself."
"Wouldn't that just spread more chaos on the planet?" Janette then pointed in several directions.
"Look at those foolish humans; they never stop waging war on other countries, and countless humans have died because of their stupidity and greed.
If they became cultivators, the situation on this planet would be even worse, and there would be more victims."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed upon hearing that.
"Do you think they can cultivate without knowing the method?
If I had not died and was resurrected by that little girl, I would never have known about cultivation and the like, and I would never have reached this stage.
Additionally, some of my slaves live on Earth now, and I will ask them to stop the chaos if it happens, so you don't have to worry."
Janette and Lillea eventually agreed with Zhang Fei [5]'s wish, and they began to grow all the trees that were already available in all the cities in the country, including the forests.
They also created various new trees in former mining sites and the like, and their actions caused a great commotion there.
Zhang Fei [5] asked them to ignore the earthlings and rush to other countries to do the same, and a simultaneous commotion broke out across the planet because of the sudden change.
All the wars taking place in various countries immediately stopped, especially since numerous new trees suddenly appeared on all battlefields, which hindered their movements.
Zhang Fei [5] thought of destroying all war equipment belonging to all countries on Earth at once, especially their nuclear weapons.
However, it would only cause greater panic and chaos, so he gave up his intention to do it simultaneously.
Instead, he ordered Mo Zifeng, Pang Gui, and Pang Zhen to do it in stages.
In a few hours, all areas of the Earth were filled with tall trees, except for the South Pole and the North Pole, which made the planet almost completely green.
Due to all the sudden events, all the country leaders declared a state of emergency in their respective countries, and they also ordered their people to investigate everything.
In addition, they decided to gather to discuss it, especially since the events were too mysterious for them.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei [5] sent Janette and Lillea back to the training space, and he went to the warehouse, where many cars entered the warehouse.
They delivered modern kitchen equipment, which was ordered by Huang Rong's subordinates yesterday.
[I didn't expect you to take such a decision, Master.
Why don't you take over the planet altogether?
If you unite all those countries and lead them yourself, this planet will be more peaceful.]
"Why should I bother with such trivial matters, Mei?
They are just ordinary humans, and they are of no use to me apart from their money.

I am doing this only because of my curiosity about the past calamity and the disappearance of Qi; I hope my guess is right in doing all this." Zhang Fei [5] once again looked around the entire Earth area.
"If the Qi really returns to this planet, those hidden places will probably reappear on their own, and it will be easier for me to search for information about the past calamity.
Moreover, those places probably have many hidden treasures, so I think this is the best decision."
[I hope your guess is correct, Master.]
"We can only wait for the results for now, and my slaves will inform me if the results meet my expectations." Zhang Fei [5] then went to the warehouse and took all the modern kitchen equipment.
Additionally, he gathered all the earth's items from various warehouses across several countries, aiming to increase the stock in his stores.
After completing everything, Zhang Fei [5] proceeded to the Divine Flame Realm.
Since Jiang Shen had asked many people to renovate it, his new building in the realm had been renovated, and he rushed to install the modern kitchen equipment on the first floor.

Since he couldn't wait to open his new shop and restaurant in that realm, Zhang Fei [5] summoned some of his women to help him arrange all the items on the second floor, including pills, earth items, and others.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to see Zhang Chen, who was discussing earth dishes with Wan Xueyuan.
Zhang Fei [5] told them that the restaurant was ready to open, and Zhang Chen decided to stay in the realm for a while, specifically to help Wan Xueyuan manage the new restaurant.
As for the shop, he asked Jiang Shen to take care of it, but he sent five members of the demon fox group to help him.
Zhang Fei [5] then met Feng Xishui and informed him about the problems in the Phoenix Realm.
"Do you want to return to your realm?"
"No need." Feng Xishui refused with a shake of his head.
"My princess has returned to our realm, and I believe she can handle the dark phoenix by herself."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Feng Xishui in surprise.
"You have that much confidence in Feng Yao, huh?"
"Yes." Feng Xishui nodded at him.
"Since her birth, my princess has been different from others in our race, and her strength has grown too rapidly.
I have also watched her grow up, and I have seen much of her abilities, so I have complete confidence in her."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before raising his eyebrows slightly.
"The dark phoenix has just entered the phoenix realm."
"Please let me know the results."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then went to another area to complete one of the three daily quests.
In the phoenix realm, all the phoenixes are ready to welcome the arrival of the dark phoenix, but they do not move immediately and wait for Feng Yao's orders.
However, Feng Yao still did not give them any orders; instead, she flew into the sky to confront the dark phoenix.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] entered the invisible state and watched her from a distance, but his gaze was more focused on the dark phoenix that was flying towards them so quickly.
Before long, Feng Yichen had arrived in front of Feng Yao and returned to her human form, and her beauty captured Zhang Fei [4]. 'Hmm?
She is as beautiful as the other phoenixes, and she seems to be the only one of her kind, so I want to have her by my side.'
Feng Yichen looked at Feng Yao with disdain in her eyes, especially since the phoenix princess's cultivation simply was too far below hers.

She then looked for the whereabouts of Feng Shen and Feng Xueying, but she couldn't find them, especially since one was away meeting the other mythical beast races and the other was hiding in the Xianjin Realm.
"You don't need to look for them, and I will be your opponent." Feng Yao calmly spoke.
Feng Yichen said nothing and shot her dark flames toward her, but Feng Yao casually stretched her right hand forward and stopped her flames instantly, shocking her.
Feng Yao casually played around with Feng Yichen's dark flames before absorbing them, or rather, Huo Ling absorbed them.
"I've heard of you from my ancestors, and they said you were powerful.
However, I'm disappointed that your strength is only this much, and you will never be able to defeat me with this much strength.
If you want to defeat me, you have to cultivate longer."
Feng Yichen was furious because of Feng Yao's taunting, and a black flame vortex immediately surrounded the phoenix princess.
"Burn!"
*Swoosh*
Immediately, the black flame vortex ignited, radiating heat throughout the entire realm.
However, Feng Yao shocked Feng Yichen once again by walking out of it without the slightest injury, and her appearance was clean.

"Let me show you the difference between the two of us, Little Phoenix." A woman figure wearing a headscarf and a plain white dress suddenly appeared behind Feng Yao, and the aura radiating from her directly suppressed Feng Yichen, forcing her to kneel in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 825: Feng Yao's Strength
paragraphs: *Boom*
Feng Yichen's aura suddenly exploded, broke free from Feng Yao's pressure, and charged directly towards her. However, the phoenix princess did not show any fear, and she waited for her to get closer.

As soon as Feng Yichen arrived in front of Feng Yao, she punched her right hand, covered in dark flames, forward. However, the phoenix princess blocked it with her index finger, and Huo Ling absorbed her dark flames.
Feng Yichen was momentarily shocked before jumping away from Feng Yao, and she swung both her hands crosswise, causing the crossed dark flames to shoot towards her.

"Futile." Feng Yao raised her right hand slowly with two fingers pointing at Feng Yichen. In an instant, small crimson flames shot out and collided with the crossed dark flames, which immediately disappeared because of her attack.
Feng Yichen flew sideways to avoid Feng Yao's crimson flames, but it changed trajectory after the phoenix princess moved her fingers, which hit his back directly.
"Hiss." Feng Yichen hissed in pain, flew backward, and glared at Feng Yao in shock.

Feng Yao's actions shocked all members of the Phoenix Race, especially since they had heard of the dark phoenix and the chaos it caused in the past. Moreover, her cultivation was still at the 3-Star Divine Manifestation Realm, and Feng Yichen's cultivation was far above hers.

Zhang Fei [4], who already knew a little about Feng Yao and Huo Ling, was also shocked watching her actions. He clenched his fists tightly, realizing that the phoenix princess was more terrifying than he had initially thought and that she was beyond his league, particularly considering her ease in fighting Feng Yichen.

"What do you think differentiates one cultivator from another?" Feng Yichen was shocked when Feng Yao suddenly moved in front of her, and the phoenix princess directly planted her palm on her chest, sending her flying backward.
Feng Yao disappeared once before reappearing behind the dark phoenix, and she punched Feng Yichen's back directly. "The answer is experience."
Feng Yichen hurriedly stabilized herself, but she did not immediately attack Feng Yao again, especially since her actions just now left her in deep shock.

"Did my abilities shock you that much?" Feng Yao asked with a faint mocking smile. "Your cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and you can do whatever you want in the three mortal realms. However, in front of me, you are no different from a toddler who has just learned to walk."

Zhang Fei [4] smiled bitterly as he listened to Feng Yao from inside the invisible state. After all, Feng Yichen was already that strong, but the Phoenix Princess considered her a toddler who had just learned to walk. Then what about him with his cultivation still at the 1-Heaven Realm?

Feng Yichen was shocked because Feng Yao moved behind her again, and she wanted to fly away from her. However, the phoenix princess grabbed her shoulder and injected a bit of her Qi into her body, causing her to spurt black blood from her mouth.
*Splurt*
Feng Yao threw the dark phoenix towards the ground with force, but two black wings appeared on Feng Yichen's back, and she hurriedly flew up just before she slammed into the ground.

Feng Yichen clutched her chest due to the pain from Feng Yao's attack just now. 'Impossible! Since when did the phoenix race have a cultivator as strong as her? Who exactly is she? She's not even a thousand years old, and her cultivation is so low, yet I'm helpless in front of her.'

Feng Yao moved to attack the dark phoenix again, but Feng Yichen immediately kept her distance and repeatedly attacked her. Unfortunately, none of her attacks managed to land on the phoenix princess, and Huo Ling absorbed her dark flames.
After they played cat and mouse for a while, Feng Yao stopped chasing Feng Yichen and stood a little distance in front of her, but the dark phoenix continued to wear an alert expression.

"I don't know how Xereth was able to take you to the Paradise Realm, but you've wasted your chance." Feng Yichen was shocked after Feng Yao mentioned that realm. "The normal Qi and the Divine Qi in these three mortal realms are different from the Qi in that realm, and we cannot absorb that Qi like the previous two Qi. We need a specific method to be able to absorb it, and you don't have one, so your time there ended up being wasted. Your master still hasn't succeeded in breaking through to that stage, right?"
"You look down on my master too much." Feng Yichen finally spoke. "My master has long broken through to the five celestial realms, and his cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord."

Feng Yichen's revelation shocked everyone who heard it, and they never expected that there were still other realms above the upper realms, let alone other cultivation stages above the Seven Divine Realms.

"3-Star Celestial Lord, huh? Your master's cultivation isn't bad, but he's still too weak before me." Feng Yichen frowned at Feng Yao's words. "If my guess is correct, Xereth was able to break through to that stage not through his efforts, and he found a secret inheritance, which helped his cultivation jump to that stage. Otherwise, he would have imparted the method to you, preventing your cultivation from stagnating as it is now."
Feng Yichen's silence convinced Feng Yao that her guess was right on target, and the dark phoenix secretly informed Xereth about the phoenix princess.

Since she had no chance of winning against Feng Yao, Feng Yichen decided to flee. Quickly, her body was covered by black flames, but the phoenix princess realized her intentions and acted before she disappeared by shooting a bit of her qi.
Zhang Fei [4] appeared beside Feng Yao. "Why did you let her get away?"

"Are you impatient to have the dark phoenix by your side?" Zhang Fei [4] laughed awkwardly in response to Feng Yao. "I believe Feng Yichen will return to Xereth's side, and I have implanted something in her body, which will react as soon as they meet."
"Do you intend to use her to attack Xereth?"

Feng Yao nodded at him. "The Nameless One, my parents, and the other cultivators have been hunting Xereth for a long time because his actions destroyed many realms. However, he managed to escape to the Paradise Realm, and they have not been able to find him since. Now that he's returned, we must get rid of him as soon as possible, or he will become a stumbling block in the future."

"I will not let Xereth fall into their hands." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [4], who immediately summoned the demon extermination sword. "I have promised the two spirits in my sword to let them kill him, especially since he was the one who killed them and their families. With his last strength, their father forged this sword specifically to kill him, and he used their souls to strengthen it."

"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "You have heard for yourself that Xereth's cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord, so you are not his opponent with your current cultivation and abilities. For now, we should wait for Feng Yichen to arrive by his side, and if my plan for him succeeds, I will tell you about their location."
"Tell me about the Five Celestial Realms."

Feng Yao actually didn't want to tell Zhang Fei [4] about it, but he had heard it from Feng Yichen before. "The Five Celestial Realms are Celestial Lord, Celestial King, Celestial Emperor, Celestial Venerable, and Celestial God, which are divided into 1 Sun to 3 Sun. I won't explain too much to you about them, and you can understand them after you reach that stage."

"I haven't even broken through to the Seven Divine Realms, so I'm not interested in them yet, and I just want to know the names of the stages." Zhang Fei [4] then asked Feng Yao. "Do you want to return to the Xianjin Realm now?"

"You must have started moving, right?" Zhang Fei [4] immediately told Feng Yao about his actions in infiltrating the Huang Clan. "Since you've already made your move, I'll stay here just in case Xereth comes here. Moreover, Feng Xueying is in that realm now, and she's more than enough to help you fight Long Jiutian."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "In that case, I will go to the Nine Hells Darkland first, and I will return after settling my business."

After Zhang Fei [4] left, Feng Yao ordered the members of the Phoenix Race to return to their respective places. However, they urged her to tell them about the Paradise Realm and the Five Celestial Realms, but she only told them the outline.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory pack.]

[Master, you still haven't unlocked the rewards from your marriage to Zhou Shenxin. Moreover, you still have other quests in the Nine Stars Realm besides getting the lightning elemental seed and clearing the second floor of the Star Tower.]

Zhang Fei [5] naturally remembered the third quest in that realm, especially since it asked him to marry a member of the fourth royal family. However, he had no intention of marrying Bai Tian'er, and Bai Shushi was still not willing to be his wife. "Open the reward, Mei."
[You obtained the Celestial Spring Pool x1.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] did not expect to get a pool from the system. "Show the description, Mei."

[Celestial Spring Pool: A pool infused with yin and yang essence, created by an ancient formation. It serves as a place for dual cultivation, harmonizing the partners' Yin and Yang Qi, increasing their cultivation speed.]
"Yin and yang essence, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Let my real body install it inside the Cloud Mansion, and I'll go meet Yumei at the Alchemy Union."

Soon, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Alchemy Union headquarters, and Shang Yumei informed him about the alchemists' activities in the past week. She also gave him several types of pills concocted by them. "Currently, Nangfeng Yunxi is their leader, and Luo Xuejia takes care of the rest of the guards. However, the alchemists have been careless, and their alchemy skills have not met our expectations. According to them, Huoyun Zhiyan and those two people usually concoct high-rank pills, so you must get them and bring them back here as soon as possible."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] contacted Hong Xinxin in the Azure Sky Realm, asking her about Huoyun Zhiyan. "Their leader will arrive in that realm tonight, and Xinxin will capture him directly. Thereafter, I will bring the two of them back here, and he will go to the Heaven Blossom Realm to capture Xiu Hanyu."
"That's good." Shang Yumei then asked him. "What is the current situation in the Xianjin Realm? Is that realm still safe now?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "My third clone is in the Huang Clan now, and Long Jiutian will arrive the day after tomorrow, so that realm is still safe now. Moreover, Feng Xueying and Ling Jingxia are there now, and they can stop that demon. However, I'm worried about the black demon statue in that clan's underground, especially since Xereth will appear there as soon as Huang Zhejun activates it. His cultivation has already reached 3-Sun Celestial King, and no one can fight him, except for Feng Yao."

"3-Sun Celestial King?" Zhang Fei [5] told Shang Yumei about the Five Celestial Realms directly, which shocked her. "I didn't expect that the cultivation stages were so long with another five stages after the Seven Divine Realms."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate to the Divine Flame Realm. "I will go to the Blacksmith Union again, and you can inform me of any changes in this realm."
"All right."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored hundreds of bottles containing Lei Huiyin, Qin Liangyu, and Huang Bingyun's Yin Qi after they became exhausted. If they were in normal condition, he would not have been able to do anything to them. That's why he deliberately used his hormone manipulation to weaken them, and he took out their souls directly.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after seeing their souls, especially the black dragon symbol within them. "Long Jiutian deliberately marked them, huh? If my guess is right, he also marked Huang Zhejun. That demon will notice if I plant my soul mark or demon slave mark in their souls, so I have to use other methods against them."
After thinking about it, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to imprison the three women's subconscious, and he used his memory manipulation to add a few things into their memories.

Then, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map to search for Huang Zhejun's whereabouts, but he couldn't find him anywhere. He looked for him elsewhere and found him in the Lei Clan together with his son, Huang Jiguang. He rushed to the dungeon to check on the black demon statue, especially since he previously couldn't do anything to it using his humanoid doll.

Upon arriving there, Zhang Xiaolong [3] examined the statue carefully before trying to lift it, but it couldn't be moved because it was stuck to the ground. Based on Mei's examination, there was something inside the statue, and its owner would immediately know if he forced it to move, so he gave up and left the Huang Clan.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already gathered with Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan. Lin Jingxia, who was also with them, immediately questioned him. "How can you disguise yourself as a demon? Even your aura is completely similar to that of a demon."

"Because I am a demon." The three women were shocked by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s confession, but not Lin Moxian, who had known about it for a long time. "Basically, I was a human, and I turned into a demon without my will."

To make it easier to explain, Zhang Xiaolong [3] shared some of his memories with them, especially about his memories when he died and his awakening into a demon. However, the three women's faces turned red, especially since his awakening occurred when he had sex with Ru Xue.
"Have you known about this issue for a long time? Why did you never tell me about this?" Lin Jingxia questioned her nephew.

Lin Moxian nodded at her. "My junior brother's identity as a demon is no longer a secret, and everyone who knows him already knows it, including my master. Moreover, he never does evil things to the innocent, and he only does evil things to his enemies. He even helps us to deal with that demon, so his demon identity is not a big deal, right?"
"En." Lin Jingxia and the two women gave a light nod.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them about the black demon statue, which made their expressions become serious. "For now, I haven't found a solution to move the statue, so I will continue to infiltrate the Huang Clan until Long Jiutian arrives."

"I think I know someone who might be able to move the statue." Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others turned to Lin Jingxia, who immediately contacted the person she was referring to. "Sigh! He is still on his way to the Wasteland Realm, so he won't be able to arrive in this realm in a short time."
"Who is the person you are referring to, Aunt?"
"Gong Ren."
Lin Moxian turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How about you bring my aunt to that realm? After that, you two can catch up with the Nameless One and the others so they can return to this realm faster."
"We can do that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Lin Jingxia first. "How fast is your flying artifact compared to Empress Feng's, Senior?"
"The person who made our flying artifacts used the same materials, so their speeds are comparable."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate to the Wasteland Realm. "Let's go there, Senior."
