As soon as Feng Yichen arrived in front of Feng Yao, she punched her right hand, covered in dark flames, forward.
However, the phoenix princess blocked it with her index finger, and Huo Ling absorbed her dark flames.
Feng Yichen was momentarily shocked before jumping away from Feng Yao, and she swung both her hands crosswise, causing the crossed dark flames to shoot towards her.
"Futile." Feng Yao raised her right hand slowly with two fingers pointing at Feng Yichen.
In an instant, small crimson flames shot out and collided with the crossed dark flames, which immediately disappeared because of her attack.
Feng Yichen flew sideways to avoid Feng Yao's crimson flames, but it changed trajectory after the phoenix princess moved her fingers, which hit his back directly.
"Hiss." Feng Yichen hissed in pain, flew backward, and glared at Feng Yao in shock.
Feng Yao's actions shocked all members of the Phoenix Race, especially since they had heard of the dark phoenix and the chaos it caused in the past.
Moreover, her cultivation was still at the 3-Star Divine Manifestation Realm, and Feng Yichen's cultivation was far above hers.
Zhang Fei [4], who already knew a little about Feng Yao and Huo Ling, was also shocked watching her actions.

He clenched his fists tightly, realizing that the phoenix princess was more terrifying than he had initially thought and that she was beyond his league, particularly considering her ease in fighting Feng Yichen.

"What do you think differentiates one cultivator from another?" Feng Yichen was shocked when Feng Yao suddenly moved in front of her, and the phoenix princess directly planted her palm on her chest, sending her flying backward.
Feng Yao disappeared once before reappearing behind the dark phoenix, and she punched Feng Yichen's back directly.
"The answer is experience."
Feng Yichen hurriedly stabilized herself, but she did not immediately attack Feng Yao again, especially since her actions just now left her in deep shock.
"Did my abilities shock you that much?" Feng Yao asked with a faint mocking smile.
"Your cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and you can do whatever you want in the three mortal realms.
However, in front of me, you are no different from a toddler who has just learned to walk."
Zhang Fei [4] smiled bitterly as he listened to Feng Yao from inside the invisible state.
After all, Feng Yichen was already that strong, but the Phoenix Princess considered her a toddler who had just learned to walk.
Then what about him with his cultivation still at the 1-Heaven Realm?
Feng Yichen was shocked because Feng Yao moved behind her again, and she wanted to fly away from her.
However, the phoenix princess grabbed her shoulder and injected a bit of her Qi into her body, causing her to spurt black blood from her mouth.
*Splurt*
Feng Yao threw the dark phoenix towards the ground with force, but two black wings appeared on Feng Yichen's back, and she hurriedly flew up just before she slammed into the ground.
Feng Yichen clutched her chest due to the pain from Feng Yao's attack just now. 'Impossible!
Since when did the phoenix race have a cultivator as strong as her?
Who exactly is she?
She's not even a thousand years old, and her cultivation is so low, yet I'm helpless in front of her.'
Feng Yao moved to attack the dark phoenix again, but Feng Yichen immediately kept her distance and repeatedly attacked her.
Unfortunately, none of her attacks managed to land on the phoenix princess, and Huo Ling absorbed her dark flames.
After they played cat and mouse for a while, Feng Yao stopped chasing Feng Yichen and stood a little distance in front of her, but the dark phoenix continued to wear an alert expression.
"I don't know how Xereth was able to take you to the Paradise Realm, but you've wasted your chance." Feng Yichen was shocked after Feng Yao mentioned that realm.
"The normal Qi and the Divine Qi in these three mortal realms are different from the Qi in that realm, and we cannot absorb that Qi like the previous two Qi.
We need a specific method to be able to absorb it, and you don't have one, so your time there ended up being wasted.
Your master still hasn't succeeded in breaking through to that stage, right?"
"You look down on my master too much." Feng Yichen finally spoke.
"My master has long broken through to the five celestial realms, and his cultivation has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord."

Feng Yichen's revelation shocked everyone who heard it, and they never expected that there were still other realms above the upper realms, let alone other cultivation stages above the Seven Divine Realms.
"3-Star Celestial Lord, huh?
Your master's cultivation isn't bad, but he's still too weak before me." Feng Yichen frowned at Feng Yao's words.
"If my guess is correct, Xereth was able to break through to that stage not through his efforts, and he found a secret inheritance, which helped his cultivation jump to that stage.
Otherwise, he would have imparted the method to you, preventing your cultivation from stagnating as it is now."
Feng Yichen's silence convinced Feng Yao that her guess was right on target, and the dark phoenix secretly informed Xereth about the phoenix princess.
Since she had no chance of winning against Feng Yao, Feng Yichen decided to flee.
Quickly, her body was covered by black flames, but the phoenix princess realized her intentions and acted before she disappeared by shooting a bit of her qi.
Zhang Fei [4] appeared beside Feng Yao.
"Why did you let her get away?"
"Are you impatient to have the dark phoenix by your side?" Zhang Fei [4] laughed awkwardly in response to Feng Yao.
"I believe Feng Yichen will return to Xereth's side, and I have implanted something in her body, which will react as soon as they meet."
"Do you intend to use her to attack Xereth?"
Feng Yao nodded at him.
"The Nameless One, my parents, and the other cultivators have been hunting Xereth for a long time because his actions destroyed many realms.
However, he managed to escape to the Paradise Realm, and they have not been able to find him since.
Now that he's returned, we must get rid of him as soon as possible, or he will become a stumbling block in the future."
"I will not let Xereth fall into their hands." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [4], who immediately summoned the demon extermination sword.
"I have promised the two spirits in my sword to let them kill him, especially since he was the one who killed them and their families.
With his last strength, their father forged this sword specifically to kill him, and he used their souls to strengthen it."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding.
"You have heard for yourself that Xereth's cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord, so you are not his opponent with your current cultivation and abilities.
For now, we should wait for Feng Yichen to arrive by his side, and if my plan for him succeeds, I will tell you about their location."
"Tell me about the Five Celestial Realms."
Feng Yao actually didn't want to tell Zhang Fei [4] about it, but he had heard it from Feng Yichen before.
"The Five Celestial Realms are Celestial Lord, Celestial King, Celestial Emperor, Celestial Venerable, and Celestial God, which are divided into 1 Sun to 3 Sun.
I won't explain too much to you about them, and you can understand them after you reach that stage."
"I haven't even broken through to the Seven Divine Realms, so I'm not interested in them yet, and I just want to know the names of the stages." Zhang Fei [4] then asked Feng Yao.
"Do you want to return to the Xianjin Realm now?"
"You must have started moving, right?" Zhang Fei [4] immediately told Feng Yao about his actions in infiltrating the Huang Clan.
"Since you've already made your move, I'll stay here just in case Xereth comes here.
Moreover, Feng Xueying is in that realm now, and she's more than enough to help you fight Long Jiutian."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her.
"In that case, I will go to the Nine Hells Darkland first, and I will return after settling my business."
After Zhang Fei [4] left, Feng Yao ordered the members of the Phoenix Race to return to their respective places.
However, they urged her to tell them about the Paradise Realm and the Five Celestial Realms, but she only told them the outline.

[Master, you still haven't unlocked the rewards from your marriage to Zhou Shenxin.
Moreover, you still have other quests in the Nine Stars Realm besides getting the lightning elemental seed and clearing the second floor of the Star Tower.]
Zhang Fei [5] naturally remembered the third quest in that realm, especially since it asked him to marry a member of the fourth royal family.
However, he had no intention of marrying Bai Tian'er, and Bai Shushi was still not willing to be his wife.
"Open the reward, Mei."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] did not expect to get a pool from the system.
"Show the description, Mei."
[Celestial Spring Pool: A pool infused with yin and yang essence, created by an ancient formation.
It serves as a place for dual cultivation, harmonizing the partners' Yin and Yang Qi, increasing their cultivation speed.]
"Yin and yang essence, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly.
"Let my real body install it inside the Cloud Mansion, and I'll go meet Yumei at the Alchemy Union."
Soon, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Alchemy Union headquarters, and Shang Yumei informed him about the alchemists' activities in the past week.
She also gave him several types of pills concocted by them.
"Currently, Nangfeng Yunxi is their leader, and Luo Xuejia takes care of the rest of the guards.
However, the alchemists have been careless, and their alchemy skills have not met our expectations.
According to them, Huoyun Zhiyan and those two people usually concoct high-rank pills, so you must get them and bring them back here as soon as possible."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] contacted Hong Xinxin in the Azure Sky Realm, asking her about Huoyun Zhiyan.
"Their leader will arrive in that realm tonight, and Xinxin will capture him directly.
Thereafter, I will bring the two of them back here, and he will go to the Heaven Blossom Realm to capture Xiu Hanyu."
"That's good." Shang Yumei then asked him.
"What is the current situation in the Xianjin Realm?
Is that realm still safe now?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"My third clone is in the Huang Clan now, and Long Jiutian will arrive the day after tomorrow, so that realm is still safe now.
Moreover, Feng Xueying and Ling Jingxia are there now, and they can stop that demon.
However, I'm worried about the black demon statue in that clan's underground, especially since Xereth will appear there as soon as Huang Zhejun activates it.
His cultivation has already reached 3-Sun Celestial King, and no one can fight him, except for Feng Yao."
"3-Sun Celestial King?" Zhang Fei [5] told Shang Yumei about the Five Celestial Realms directly, which shocked her.
"I didn't expect that the cultivation stages were so long with another five stages after the Seven Divine Realms."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate to the Divine Flame Realm.
"I will go to the Blacksmith Union again, and you can inform me of any changes in this realm."
"All right."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored hundreds of bottles containing Lei Huiyin, Qin Liangyu, and Huang Bingyun's Yin Qi after they became exhausted.
If they were in normal condition, he would not have been able to do anything to them.
That's why he deliberately used his hormone manipulation to weaken them, and he took out their souls directly.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after seeing their souls, especially the black dragon symbol within them.
"Long Jiutian deliberately marked them, huh?
If my guess is right, he also marked Huang Zhejun.
That demon will notice if I plant my soul mark or demon slave mark in their souls, so I have to use other methods against them."
After thinking about it, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to imprison the three women's subconscious, and he used his memory manipulation to add a few things into their memories.
Then, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map to search for Huang Zhejun's whereabouts, but he couldn't find him anywhere.
He looked for him elsewhere and found him in the Lei Clan together with his son, Huang Jiguang.
He rushed to the dungeon to check on the black demon statue, especially since he previously couldn't do anything to it using his humanoid doll.
Upon arriving there, Zhang Xiaolong [3] examined the statue carefully before trying to lift it, but it couldn't be moved because it was stuck to the ground.
Based on Mei's examination, there was something inside the statue, and its owner would immediately know if he forced it to move, so he gave up and left the Huang Clan.
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already gathered with Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan.
Lin Jingxia, who was also with them, immediately questioned him.
"How can you disguise yourself as a demon?
Even your aura is completely similar to that of a demon."
"Because I am a demon." The three women were shocked by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s confession, but not Lin Moxian, who had known about it for a long time.
"Basically, I was a human, and I turned into a demon without my will."
To make it easier to explain, Zhang Xiaolong [3] shared some of his memories with them, especially about his memories when he died and his awakening into a demon.
However, the three women's faces turned red, especially since his awakening occurred when he had sex with Ru Xue.
"Have you known about this issue for a long time?
Why did you never tell me about this?" Lin Jingxia questioned her nephew.
Lin Moxian nodded at her.
"My junior brother's identity as a demon is no longer a secret, and everyone who knows him already knows it, including my master.
Moreover, he never does evil things to the innocent, and he only does evil things to his enemies.
He even helps us to deal with that demon, so his demon identity is not a big deal, right?"
"En." Lin Jingxia and the two women gave a light nod.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them about the black demon statue, which made their expressions become serious.
"For now, I haven't found a solution to move the statue, so I will continue to infiltrate the Huang Clan until Long Jiutian arrives."
"I think I know someone who might be able to move the statue." Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others turned to Lin Jingxia, who immediately contacted the person she was referring to.
"Sigh!
He is still on his way to the Wasteland Realm, so he won't be able to arrive in this realm in a short time."
"Who is the person you are referring to, Aunt?"
"Gong Ren."
Lin Moxian turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How about you bring my aunt to that realm?
After that, you two can catch up with the Nameless One and the others so they can return to this realm faster."
"We can do that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Lin Jingxia first.
"How fast is your flying artifact compared to Empress Feng's, Senior?"
"The person who made our flying artifacts used the same materials, so their speeds are comparable."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate to the Wasteland Realm.
"Let's go there, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 826: His Wives Concerns
paragraphs: "Are you also a Heavenly Fox?" Lin Jingxia questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3] as they exited the gate. "Only that fox race has this ability."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to her. "It's weird, isn't it? I am a human, a demon, and a beast."
"You are indeed weird." Lin Jingxia then followed his gaze. "Do you have anything to do on that island?"

"Tianguo, the divine black dog, lives on that island." Lin Jingxia could immediately guess Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s intention. "Back then, I wasn't sure if I was strong enough to fight him, but I had fought and defeated several cultivators who were much stronger than him. Therefore, it's time for me to face him, but I'll do it after we get rid of Xereth and his subordinates."
Lin Jingxia immediately took out her flying artifact, took Zhang Xiaolong [3] on board it, and flew it out of the Wasteland Realm at full speed.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly sensed a killing intent lock onto him, and he instantly realized that its owner was Tianguo. He deliberately declared war on the black dog by responding with his own killing intent. 'Wait for me; I will tame you after my affairs are settled.'
[Master, Wang Yourou is awake.]

"Oh, crap! I forgot about that woman." Lin Jingxia looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion, but the appearance of the portal leading to the Yin-Yang Space surprised her. She was even more surprised when Wang Yourou walked out with an angry expression, especially since she was in a strange place when she opened her eyes. "Hey! I didn't do anything to you, okay? You were sleeping like a dead pig before, and some people intended to kidnap us, so I hid you in my private place."
"Humph." Wang Yourou snorted in response. "Who are the ten women at that place? What did you do to them? Did you use them as your cultivation furnace?"
"Are you really using women as cultivation furnaces?" Lin Jingxia's tone was filled with anger.
"Huh?" Wang Yourou turned to Lin Jingxia. "Huh? How can you be here with this lecherous man, Senior Lin?"
*Slap*
"Ahh!" Wang Yourou yelped and fiercely glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why did you slap my butt?"
"Do you need to ask that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with narrowed eyes, causing Wang Yourou's neck to shrink. "I refused to get close to you, but you came to me yourself and asked me to—"
"Stop!" With an embarrassed look, Wang Yourou covered Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s mouth. "I'm sorry, okay? I said that because you imprisoned those ten women in that strange place."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled Wang Yourou's hand down directly. "They are my enemies, so I imprisoned them there. I used them as cultivation furnaces, but I never touched them directly. You just saw them, so you should already know that my methods don't cause them any pain."
"Is what he said true?" Lin Jingxia questioned Wang Yourou.

"Yes, Senior." Wang Yourou promptly clarified. "Unlike the women used by those evil dual cultivation sects back then, those ten women are in completely healthy condition, with no wounds on their bodies. They are like people sleeping with sweet dreams, and their Yin Qi flows into a special place by itself."
Lin Jingxia looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. "How do you harvest their Yin Qi without harming them?"

"I used my technique to give them sweet dreams, and I used modern technology to absorb their Yin Qi. This way, I don't need to do anything to them, and I can harvest their Yin Qi nonstop." Lin Jingxia wanted to interrupt, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly continued. "I often wake them up and feed them, and I also use pills to nourish their bodies. In fact, there were four other women, but I let them go because their Yin Qi was no longer useful to me, and I replaced them with Shang Ziyuan and three other women."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding. "As long as you don't use cruel methods to harvest their Yin Qi, I'll turn a blind eye to it."
"So, where are we going now?"
"We'll catch up with the Nameless One and the others." Lin Jingxia answered Wang Yourou before speaking to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "While we wait to meet them, you can show me your alchemy skills."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out an alchemy furnace, but he did not use the Heaven Creation Furnace. He then took out several ingredients. "I will concoct the rank 4 Soul Mending Pill, which will be useful for soul repair, particularly in cases of soul injury."

Lin Jingxia had never heard of the Soul Mending Pill, but she didn't say anything and let Zhang Xiaolong [3] perform his alchemy first. Wang Yourou was surprised that he was an alchemist, but she didn't bother him either and sat silently.

In one of the rooms in the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei was busy installing the Celestial Spring Pool, and three little girls were watching him impatiently. Ru Xue and the others were curious about the origin of the pool, but they knew that he wouldn't tell them, so they didn't ask him anything.
Up until now, Zhang Lin was the only one of Zhang Fei's wives who already knew about the existence of the system. However, he still had not told her about Mei's existence.
The Celestial Spring Pool itself is more similar to a jacuzzi, but its size is much larger than the normal one, and it can accommodate 20 to 30 people at a time.

After he finished installing it, Zhang Fei immediately activated the ancient formation on one side. Quickly, hot water filled the pool, and they could feel the powerful Yin and Yang Qi from within the water. "If you guys can't wait to try it, you don't need to wait for me and can try it directly, and I will check Huang Rong first."

After Zhang Fei left, all of them hurriedly took off their clothes and entered the pool directly. They tried absorbing the Yin Qi within it, and the results surprised them, especially since it was purer and denser than the normal one.
"How could the Yin Qi in this poll be like this, Big Sis?" Liu Hua asked her big sister.
Liu Qingyu went to the corner with the ancient formation. "Apparently, this formation is not ordinary, and it makes the Yin Qi inside here like this."

"Isn't this mixture good?" Yun Xinyue asked as she washed her face with the water. "By absorbing the Yin Qi in this poll and combining it with our avatars' continued cultivation in that room, our cultivation will increase faster than before."

Zhou Shenxin immediately warned them. "Our husband said that this pool is used for dual cultivation, so normally we have to absorb this Yin Qi when dual cultivating with him. If we cultivate in this pool without him, you guys have to adjust according to your strength, especially since this Yin Qi is too strong for the few of us."

"Shenxin is right; all of you should avoid absorbing too much Yin Qi from this pool when cultivating yourselves." Xian Xianqin then turned to the three little girls. "You three must always remember our words, okay? Your physique and cultivation are still not comparable to ours, so you guys can't stay in this pool for too long."
"Yes, Big Sis Xianqin." Xu Ling'er, Wu Lianzhi, and Tasha answered in unison.
Tang Ziyu then asked Lillea and Janette. "Did our husband really do that on Earth?"

"Yes." Janette answered Tang Ziyu. "My mother and I are confused by his sudden decision, especially since he has never shown any concern for Earth before. Because of our actions, Earth is currently experiencing a significant commotion, and Earthlings are likely to place blame on each other."

"I don't think so." Zhong Yan said with a shake of his head. Since you and Lillea did that in all countries at once, they won't blame each other. However, your actions will change the future of Earth; whether it will work out well or not, we will see the results in the future."
"Do you think Fei'er has any special plans for Earth?" Qing Yi asked them.

Ru Xue immediately replied. "Fei'er doesn't have any plans for Earth yet, but he keeps thinking about the past calamity. If my guess is right, he wants Qi to fill Earth again to lure those ancient ruins out on their own. Since cultivators once inhabited Earth in the past, he believes there are still many ruins left there."

"I think the same as you, Big Sis Xue." Zhang Lin then pointed at Zhang Yue. "The existence of the ancient ruins on Earth has been proven by my big sis; she accidentally discovered the ice phoenix forest, and she got her bloodline there. Since that place exists, there is a big possibility of the existence of other ruins. If we can find them, we might find many interesting things in them."

All of them agreed with Zhang Lin, but Shen Xueyi then said to them. "The ice phoenix deliberately hid her resting place, so I'm sure the past cultivators on Earth did the same. If that's true, our husband will never be able to find them by himself, especially since such a thing will choose certain people."
"Shall we go to Earth to look for them?" Chu Qing asked.
"We can't do that, Qing'er." Chu Qing turned to Chu Ying. "Our husband wants to take us to the Star Tower soon, so we should focus on that for now."
"Besides, our husband continues to fight alone out there, so we have to focus on more important things first." Zhao Ziqing added.

"Phew." Boitata suddenly let out a heavy sigh as she leaned against the poolside. "In the Sky Jade Realm, I could always help our husband fight his enemies, but I couldn't do anything after we moved to the Nine Stars Realm. We've been in that realm for seven and a half months, but he's been dealing with all the problems outside by himself, and we haven't helped him at all, which frustrates me."

Boitata's words cast a shadow over everyone, prompting Hu Yue to speak. "Not to mention, our husband has already started to face so many powerful cultivators in the upper realms, and we are powerless to help him. It hasn't been long since he defeated the Shang Clan, but the Heavenly Fox Race has already started to chase him again, and he now has to face even more powerful demons."
"What can we do to improve ourselves?" Shen Yu asked in a weak tone.

All of them released heavy sighs as they didn't have a quick solution to increase their strength. After all, they weren't Zhang Fei, who had them as his partners. They only had him as their partner, so it was impossible for them to match him.

"Why are you all gloomy?" They turned to Chu Xing, who walked in with Wei Luan, Han Yuanzhi, Angela, and several other women. Chu Qing promptly explained the situation to her second sister and the others. "Isn't that easy? You guys just need to lock my brother-in-law in a room, and you can dual cultivate with him every day. As long as you all do it with him nonstop, your cultivation will also increase rapidly."

Han Yuznahi laughed upon hearing that. "Xing'er, you've never dual cultivated with Zhang Fei, so you don't know his prowess in bed. Even if we all work together, we're still overwhelmed to deal with him, so we can't do it nonstop. If you don't believe me, you can engage in dual cultivation with him, allowing you to personally witness his prowess in this area."

Chu Xing was stunned upon hearing that, but she had often watched her mother and two sisters dual cultivate with Zhang Fei, so she had some ideas about her progress in bed. However, watching them was certainly different from doing it herself, especially since he would be pounding on her like he was pounding on them, making her feel that she could withstand it.

Wei Luan shook her head and patted Chu Xing on the back. "You've been in love with him for a long time now, right? You didn't want to be with him because you prioritized avenging your father's death, but now that Shang Huaqiang is dead, you can pursue your feelings. Therefore, you don't need to delay it any longer, and you can go see him now."
"Come with me." Chu Xing grabbed Wei Luan's hand and led her away directly.
"Wait! I don't want to go there!" Wei Luan shouted as she tried to pull her hand away, but Chu Xing held it tightly and pulled her faster. "Xing'er! Let me go!"
"It seems your second daughter will be joining us soon, Qingyu." Angela said this as she entered the pool.

Liu Qingyu sighed heavily as she massaged her forehead. Before Zhang Fei appeared, she was a loyal woman with one husband, but she had an affair with him after he appeared. Not to mention, her first and third daughters had become his wives, and her second daughter would soon become one of them. "Our husband is truly a bad egg; he has complicated our relationship."
"Hahaha." Upon hearing that, they burst into laughter.

As soon as they entered Zhang Fei's room, Wei Luan immediately covered her eyes because he and the seven women were naked, but she was a little too late because she had already seen his dick. Her face turned as red as a ripe tomato, but she peeked a little through her fingers. 'Ugh! He's such a pervert!'

"Why are you two here, Qing`er?" Zhang Fei asked as he lifted Huang Rong, who had already turned into a beast cultivator, or to be precise, the Flame-Spirit Deer. Just like Hong Yao, she had a cultivation after the process was completed, and her cultivation is at the 1-Star Elementary Realm.
Chu Xing pulled Wei Luan to Zhang Fei's side and whispered to him. 'Luan'er and I want to do it with you, brother-in-law.'
"No! I don't want to do it, Xing!" Wei Luan denied and attempted to flee, but Chu Xing hugged her and held her back from leaving.
Zhang Fei said immediately. "Xing, I know you have feelings for me, so I want to do it with you. However, Luan'er doesn't have feelings for me, so you don't need to force her and let her go now."

"You're wrong, brother-in-law." Chu Xing grabbed Wei Luan's head and faced her toward Zhang Fei. "Luan'er repeatedly asked me about you, especially after she swallowed your Yang Qi continually. She once admitted to me that she already liked you, but she was hesitant because Aunt Yi Na was one of your women."
*Puff*
Smoke seemed to come out of Wei Luan's head after Chu Xing said that, making her face red and hot.
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Nevertheless, I don't want you to force Luan'er, and I will wait for her to confess her feelings to me herself."
"All right then." Wei Luan immediately ran away as soon as Chu Xing let go of her. "Are you really going to turn them into beasts?"
"Zhang Fei never forced us, and we decided it ourselves." Yang Lu'er immediately climbed into the capsule. "Start now, Fei."

Zhang Fei asked Mei to run the capsule as he laid Huang Rong on the bed. He then took Chu Xing to another room, especially since he didn't want to embarrass her by doing it in front of so many women for her first time.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei carried Chu Xing to the bed and sat her down there. "Are you sure you're ready to be my wife?"
"Yes." Chu Xing replied with a determined nod. "I've been thinking about my feelings for a long time, and I'm sure that I like you, so I want to be your wife."

[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
The three notifications appeared at the same time as Zhang Xiaolong [3] completed his alchemy.
Although he had successfully refined rank 4 pills before, he used the Heaven Creation Furnace to concoct them, which could shorten the concoction time by 50%.
Therefore, it took him longer to refine the rank 4 Soul Mending Pills, but the results were no different, especially since he had successfully concocted five superior grade pills.
When Zhang Xiaolong [3] took the five pills from the furnace, Wang Yourou was so shocked that her jaw fell.
Unlike her, Lin Jingxia nodded in satisfaction after she saw the results with her own eyes.
"Did Feng Yao teach you a lot about alchemy?"
"Not really, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied by shaking his head.
"In fact, Feng Yao only taught me a little, and I learned about alchemy from one of my wives.
However, she is her disciple, so it's no different for me learning from her."
Hearing that, Lin Jingxia put on a curious look about his wife's identity, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately summoned Zhang Lingxue out of the training space.

Additionally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] also summoned Chu Ying and Chu Qing out because he wanted to know Lin Jingxia's opinion about the Chu Sisters, especially since both of them were still relatively new in alchemy.
Lin Jingxia was not surprised by the beauty of the three women, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had given her both pills.
Meanwhile, Wang Yourou was shocked and amazed by their beauty; she also felt jealous of it. 'Where did he get these three beauties?
How can they be this beautiful?
What's the secret of their beauty?'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly introduced them to Lin Jingxia.
"The one with red hair is Zhang Lingxue, and the other two are sisters, Chu Ying and Chu Qing."
"Senior." Zhang Lingxue, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing respectfully greeted Lin Jingxia.
Lin Jingxia nodded slightly as she observed the three women.
"Have you succeeded in concocting the rank 5 pill, Lingxue?"
"Yes, Senior." Zhang Lingxue then took out a pill and gave it to Lin Jingxia.
"Big Sis Yao taught me how to concoct this rank 5 Everlasting Qi Pill a long time ago, and I succeeded in concocting it a while ago."
"You and your husband are both talented in alchemy, but this pill is a bit imperfect, which reduces its effect by about 10%." Lin Jingxia told Zhang Lingxue the method to perfect it.
"You can try it now."
"Yes, Senior." Zhang Lingxue immediately sat down; she took out all the ingredients and the furnace.
Lin Jingxia then looked at Chu Ying and Chu Qing, making both women tense.
"Two master rank alchemists, huh?
How long have you two studied alchemy?"
"Four and a half months, Senior." The Chu sisters' answer surprised Lin Jingxia.
"At first, we learned alchemy from our husband and Big Sis Lingxue, and Big Sis Yao guided us after she returned from the tower."
"I see." Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding before taking out some herbs and handing them to the Chu sisters.
Besides, she shared a pill recipe with them.
"The Jade Essence Pill is a rank 2 pill, and I want the two of you to concoct it here so I can properly assess your abilities in alchemy."
The Chu sisters nodded to Lin Jingxia and sat there, but they did not immediately take out their furnaces.
Instead, they studied the pill recipe using the Divine Alchemy Method because they would rather not disappoint the alchemy goddess, so they wanted to refine the pill in one try.
Lin Jingxia nodded her head repeatedly as she was satisfied with the Chu sisters' patience and seriousness.
At a glance, she could understand their abilities in alchemy, and she was sure that they would fail to concoct the pill if they concocted it directly.
"Do you still want to concoct another pill?" Lin Jingxia asked as Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out some other ingredients.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.
"I want to concoct a rank 4 Ethereal Bliss Pill, but the pill is only useful for dual cultivators like me."
"I see." Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding.
Since she had already seen Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s abilities before, she didn't pay any attention to him, and she focused more on the three women.
'Tch!
They 're too busy with their own business!' Wang Yourou grumbled as she continued to stare jealously at Zhang Lingxue, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing.
Since his third clone was away with Lin Jingxia, Zhang Fei [4] went straight to the Xianjin Realm after finishing his business with the Blacksmith Union.
His fifth clone remains in the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the latest daily quests, and he will return to the phoenix realm to improve his fire elemental law afterwards.
After he met Lin Moxian and the two women, Zhang Fei [4] disguised himself as Long Jiutian once again and went to the Huang Clan.
He found Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang in front of the room.
"Why are you two here?"
"Where have you been, Lord?" Huang Zhejun asked.
"Do I need to report my affairs to you?" Zhang Fei [4] released his killing intent to scare them, and both of them trembled because of it.
"Why are you two here?
Are you looking for your wives?"
"Yes... yes... we are looking for them, Lord." Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang answered stutteringly.
"Wait here." Zhang Fei [4] immediately entered the room to free Lei Huiyin and Qin Liangyu's subconscious.
Afterwards, he asked them to return to their husbands, and he began to harvest Huang Bingyun's Yin Qi.

In their room, Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang immediately interrogated Lei Huiyin and Qin Liangyu, but they didn't remember anything because they were affected by Zhang Fei [4]'s hormone manipulation, and they only remembered having sex with him for so long.
Unfortunately, both men didn't notice the strange looks their wives were giving them, especially since he had already added a little memory to their memories.
"Are you impatient to arrive at your home realm?" Zhang Fei [1] questioned Balena, who was standing by herself at the front of the Pandora Odyssey.
Balena turned and nodded at him.
"I miss my home realm and parents so much, so I can't wait to arrive there."

"We will arrive at your home realm in a week, but there are many powerful demons heading to the Blue Water Realm." Zhang Fei [1] informed Balena about the demons based on the information Tian Huangjin had provided.
"Their demon rank is at the Emperor Rank, and their cultivation is at the Divine Ascension Realm, so they are truly powerful.
I don't know what Xereth's goal is in subduing the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, but I will not let the beast fall into their hands."
Balena became anxious after hearing that.
"Do you think they enslaved all the residents of my realm, including my family?"
"That's possible, but I can't say for sure, and we'll have to wait until we get there." Zhang Fei [1] embraced Balena.
"If your parents still haven't forgotten you, I'll help you save them if they really fall into the hands of the demons, so you don't have to worry about them.
However, I won't save them if they have forgotten you, let alone consider you dead."
Balena nodded slightly.
"Thank you, Fei."
"You are my woman, so you don't need to thank me." Zhang Fei [1] then opened the portal and summoned his fifteen partners out of the training space.
Since Zhang Fei [1] had already informed them of his departure, Huan Ya and the others were not surprised to see them in outer space.
"Did you call us out to dual cultivate with us, Fei?" Luo Yu asked while hugging his arm.
Gu Yan hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s other arm.
"Naturally, he will dual cultivate with us, especially since he's been gone for so long."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled at that and squeezed their buttocks.
"We need another week to arrive at the Blue Water Realm, but I can't enter the training space right now.
Therefore, I summoned you all out, and we will dual cultivate for the next week."
"Let's go then; we missed you too." Luo Yu and Gu Yan pulled Zhang Fei [1] away to the bedroom area, followed by Xia Qianqian and a few other women.
"Fei!
Why don't you bring my big sis here?" Zhang Fei [1] turned to Yan Luan'er directly.
"She's been thinking things over for quite some time, and she's already willing to be your partner, so you should bring her here and dual cultivate with him first."
Xi Zihua also spoke to him.
"Luan'er is right, Fei.
Sister Zixiu has already decided to be your partner."
"Is Yan Zixiu willing to be my partner now?"
"Yes." Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua nodded at him.
Zhang Fei [1] summoned Yan Zixiu out of the training space and asked her directly about her decision, which she confirmed immediately.
"Yes, I am willing to be your partner."
"In that case, I will dual cultivate with you first, Zixiu." Yan Zixiu gave Zhang Fei [1] a light nod.
Upon arriving at the bedroom area, they ran into Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu, who had just come out of their room.
The two female foxes were surprised by the presence of the fifteen women, but they were jealous of their beauty, especially since they had long swallowed the two pills.
"Why haven't you taken them as your women yet, brother?" Yue Qingya asked him.
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at her.
"Their cultivation is at the Seven Divine Realms, so I have to wait to break through to that stage before I can take them.
Anyways, you guys don't need to think about them, and I will focus on helping all of you, especially those of you who haven't broken through to the Earth Realm."
Ning Xiang and the others were excited when they heard that, and they hurriedly entered one of the rooms in that place.
However, they had to wait for Zhang Fei [1] to dual cultivate with Yan Zixiu first, especially since she was the only one among them who had not yet become his partner.
Zhang Fei [1] didn't waste much time and used his enhanced demon touch on Yan Zixiu, and the two of them quickly started their dual cultivation.
Since Yan Zixiu had not had sex with a man for too long, especially after her partner died at the hands of demons, she felt awkward and overwhelmed to serve Zhang Fei [1]'s extremely high lust.
After a week of traveling, Huoyun Zhiyan finally arrived at the Azure Sky Realm, and he rushed to find Sun Jianming at their shop.
However, he looked confused when he entered it, especially since there was nothing there.
"Jianming!" Soon, Sun Jianming came down from the second floor to meet him, but Huoyun Zhiyan frowned when he detected that his cultivation was sealed.
"What happened to you?
Where are our items for sale?
Why is this place completely empty?"
"You don't need to be confused by that." Huoyun Zhiyan was shocked to hear a woman's voice from behind, but Hong Xinxin immediately restricted his movements before sealing his cultivation.
"You targeted the wrong person, and my husband has taken over your organization now."
"Who... who is your husband, senior?" Huoyun Zhiyan asked nervously and haltingly.
"Zhang Fei." Huoyun Zhiyan froze in place as his body trembled.
"If you didn't look for trouble with him, you guys would never have had this day."
"Senior...
"You don't need to say anything because my husband won't change his mind." Hong Xinxin immediately contacted Zhang Fei through one of his clones.
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] had arrived inside the building, shocking Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming.
Wasting no time, he weakened the two men using his demon-absorbing technique, and he planted his demon slave mark into their souls afterward, which horrified them.

"Xinxin, you can go to the Blossom Heaven Realm to capture Xiu Hanyu now, and I will bring these two men back to the Alchemy Union." After Zhang Fei [5] took Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming away, Hong Xinxin hurriedly left the realm and went to the next realm.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei [5] threw Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming to the floor as soon as they arrived at the Alchemy Union Headquarters.
He then sat in the head seat and looked at the two.
"Remember well, you two are my slaves now, so you must obey my orders; otherwise, I will make you two suffer."
"What do you want them to do, husband?" Shang Yumei asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] took out a piece of paper and wrote down the ingredients of Lin Jingxia's Nine Revolutions Pill.
"Yumei, I want these two men to concoct this pill as much as possible, and I want you to supervise them so that they don't slack off.
If the ingredients are lacking, you can contact me directly, and I will buy them in the Xianjin Realm."
"What kind of pill is this?"
"Senior Lin Jingixa gave it to me, and my foundation immediately stabilized after I swallowed two pills." Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming were shocked to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5]'s mouth.

"Therefore, I want them to concoct as much of this pill as possible so I don't need to waste my time stabilizing my foundation, and I can break through faster without worrying about my foundation being shaken and destroyed."
"I see." Shang Yumei then took the two men away with her.
"Husband, you can take care of your other business, and I will take care of all the matters here."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the Nine Hells Darkland, especially since the three quests were still unfinished.

chapters.title: Chapter 829: Lin Jingxia's Disciples
paragraphs: After he collected more of Huang Bingyun's Yin Qi, Zhang Fei [4] stored those bottles into his inventory. He intended to give them to the people around him, whose cultivation had reached the Seven Divine Realms.

Zhang Fei [4] first used the Demon's Eye Orb to check on Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang, and he heard them talking about Long Jiutian, who would arrive tonight. The demon hadn't told them about their next plan, so he couldn't learn more.

Zhang Fei [4] was sure they would make their move soon, especially after Long Jiutian's arrival. However, he wasn't too worried about it because Feng Xueying was in that realm, and she was definitely stronger than the demon. He informed the ice phoenix about it before freeing Huang Bingyun's subconscious, and he didn't forget to activate the traps he had prepared within the clan.
After that, Zhang Fei [4] left the Huang clan to return to the phoenix realm, especially since he wanted to increase his fire elemental law to the half-perfection stage as soon as possible.

Shortly after he left, Huang Bingyun opened her eyes, but she felt her body was too weak, and the Yin Qi in her body was too thin. She quickly swallowed recovery pills before getting dressed, and she went to see Lei Huiyin and Qin Liangyu afterward.

Several hours later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already concocted the rank 4 Ethereal Bliss Pill and taken them from the furnace, but Wang Yourou immediately asked him. "What is the function of the pill?"

"This pill is similar to an aphrodisiac." Wang Yourou and Lin Jingxia immediately frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why are you two looking at me like that? This pill does work like an aphrodisiac, but it doesn't affect our lust. Instead, it will affect our Yang and Yin Qi, and its effect will make the flow of Qi smoother and lighter, so our partner won't have any trouble absorbing our Qi.
Lin Jingxia stretched out her hand. "Let me try one."

"You cannot swallow this pill, Senior." Lin Jingxia raised an eyebrow, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to explain to her. "Even though this pill doesn't affect our lust directly, you will still feel something unusual in your body due to the changes in your Qi flow, and you won't be able to reverse the effects without the help of a man. That's why I said that this pill is specifically for dual cultivators like me, and my partners will get the beneficial effects if I swallow it."
"I see." Lin Jingxia withdrew her hand and watched Zhang Lingxue, who had just taken out the pill she concocted. "Now that the pills are perfect, their effects won't diminish like before."
Zhang Lingxue nodded to her. "Thank you for your guidance, Senior."
"Are you willing to become my disciple, Lingxue?"

"Yes! I am willing to be your disciple, Senior." Zhang Lingxue spontaneously accepted her offer, especially since Lin Jingxia was the best female alchemist in the universe. She immediately knelt down and kowtowed three times to her. "Master."
Lin Jingxia took out a special plaque and gave it to Zhang Lingxue. "From now on, you are my disciple, and you will also be part of my Lin Clan."
After receiving the plaque, Zhang Lingxue was overjoyed, but then she asked a question. "What about my husband, Master?"

"I will pass all my alchemy knowledge to you, and he can learn everything from you later." Lin Jingxia then gave Zhang Lingxue a thick book. "For now, I want you to read this book, and I have written a lot of my experiences in alchemy in it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed bitterly in his heart when Lin Jingxia explored at him, but he could already guess her reason for not wanting to take him as her disciple, which was because he was a dual cultivator.

Zhang Lingxue looked at her husband with an apologetic look, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her with a smile. Although he was disappointed, he didn't think much about it, especially since he was still able to learn all of Lin Jingxia's alchemy knowledge from his wife.

After she cleaned up the remaining alchemy ingredients and furnace, Zhang Lingxue read the book Lin Jingxia gave her. From the first page, she found many intriguing things in it, most of which were new to her.

A while later, Chu Ying and Chu Qing had finished concocting the Rank 2 Jade Essence Pill, but they could only concoct intermediate-grade pills, which made them disappointed. Despite this, Lin Jingxia still decided to accept them as her disciple, which overjoyed them.
Lin Jingxia then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you mind if I take your three wives back to the Void Heaven Realm?"

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the three women expressed surprise. "Senior, I am happy that you want to teach them alchemy, but they will lag behind their sisters in cultivation if they stay with you in that realm."

"Isn't that a trivial matter for you?" Lin Jingxia shook her head in response. "You just need to go to my realm, and you can use your beast's ability to go back and forth there to dual cultivate with them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh before answering her. "You are not wrong about that, Senior. However, our secluded place is different from your realm, and it is also our training ground. If you don't believe me, you can try chasing one of them using only raw speed, and I guarantee you won't be able to catch them."
Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou turned to the three women, but they seemed doubtful about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s words, especially since their cultivation was too low.
"Go on, try to catch them."

As soon as Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou wanted to catch them, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters immediately disappeared. The two women tried to catch them by circling on the flying artifact, but the raw speed of the three women was too quick for them, mainly because of their adaptation to eight and sixteen times heavier gravity.
After they played cat and mouse for quite some time, the two women decided to give up because it was impossible for them to catch Zhang Lingxue, Chu Ying, and Chu Xing.
*Thud*

Wang Yourou fell onto her buttocks, catching her breath, her gaze fixed on the three smiling women. She suddenly remembered her first meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she was also unable to catch him at that time.

Lin Jingxia was still relaxed, even though she had also chased three women for so long. The speed of the three women was simply astonishing in her eyes, especially since her cultivation was already at the Divine Ascension Realm, but she failed to catch them. "How do you all train your speed to surpass mine?"

"Senior, their previous speed wasn't their maximum speed yet, especially since this place is too small." Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock. "If the two of you race with them in a wide area, you guys won't be able to see their figures. As for the way we train our speed, we use extremely heavy weights to do it."
"Extremely heavy weights?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out a metal hammer and showed it to them. "This hammer looks small, but it is much heavier than you can imagine."

"Give it to me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave it to Lin Jingxia straight away, but the alchemy goddess's face turned red as soon as the hammer was in her hand. She even exerted her cultivation, but the weight still overwhelmed her.
"Is the hammer really that heavy, Senior?" Wang Yourou asked.

"Don't even think about trying to lift it, or you'll break your wrist." Lin Jingxia immediately returned the hammer to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who threw it several times in the air with ease. "How heavy is that hammer actually?"

"A blacksmith acquaintance of mine forged this hammer with a special metal, and its weight is 5000 pounds (2.27 t)." Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the hammer to Zhang Lingxue, who caught it and casually swung it.

Zhang Lingxue then gave the hammer to the Chu Sisters, and they could also easily swing it. After all, the weight of the hammer was nothing compared to the gravity they had faced before, and it also tempered their physiques, even though their physiques were still not as strong as their husband's.

"You guys are really crazy!" Wang Yourou exclaimed as she massaged her forehead. Even cultivators of Lin Jingxia's caliber had difficulty lifting the hammer, yet the three women, despite their low cultivation, could swing it so easily.
Lin Jingxia nodded in agreement with Wang Yourou; she would never have believed that the three women could lift such a heavy hammer if she had not witnessed it with her own eyes.

"Haha." Zhang Lingxue softly laughed. "Master and senior sister, we didn't start practicing with this heavy hammer. Instead, we began with a lighter one and gradually increased the weight until reaching this level."

Chu Ying then added. "At first, we were overwhelmed by it, and we couldn't stand up because of it. However, we didn't give up, and we continued our practice. Time passed, and our hard work paid off as we adapted to such a heavy weight."
"Why are you all pushing yourselves that hard?" Wang Yourou asked them.

Chu Qing pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Our husband always said that life is better than death, and he also said that running away is not an act of cowardice, but it is a delayed victory. Therefore, he forced himself to hone his speed to be able to escape from danger, and we are his wives, so we decided to follow in his footsteps."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] saved the hammer. "We lack strong backers, so we must reconsider fighting those who are more powerful than us. Moreover, life is too beautiful to sacrifice, and if the situation in front of me becomes too dangerous, I use my speed to escape.

"Actually, you are not wrong to think that way." Lin Jingxia uttered as she nodded. "However, your actions contradict your words, such as your action of destroying the Shang Clan before. Shang Huaqiang is not as strong as me or Tian Shuxiang, but he and his clan are much stronger than you, yet you choose to deal with them. Fortunately, you have help from the Hong Clan and the other clans, or else you will never win against them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled upon hearing that, especially since Lin Jingxia didn't know the real situation. It was true that the Hong Clan and the other clans helped him, but he could still defeat Shang Huaqiang by himself. "Senior, family is everything to me, and that guy caused several of my family members to suffer. Therefore, I had no choice but to fight him, and as a result, he is dead now."
"Master, our husband went against Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan because of us." Lin Jingxia looked at the Chu Sisters. "He caused our father to die, so our husband fought him to avenge us."

"Master, Shang Huaqiang caused my brother to become a demon, and my family would have lost him if not for our husband, who found and brought him back to us." Lin Jingxia was surprised by Zhang Lingxue's confession. "Many things happened in our home realm hundreds of years ago, and many lives were lost because of events initiated by that guy. Less than a year ago, he attacked our realm again, but our husband and Big Sis Yao managed to stop his plans with several casualties."

Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding. "We have long heard that Shang Huaxiang is targeting the lower realms, but we did not stop him because he did not go there himself, and he only sent the younger generation of his Shang Clan. However, I did not expect that the realm was your home realm, and it would not have happened if we were stricter with the rules."

"Everything has happened and cannot be repeated, so we don't need to discuss that anymore." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Lin Jingxia. "Can you estimate our distance to the Nameless One and the others, Senior?"

Lin Jingxia took out a small device and turned it on, which immediately displayed a hologram map. Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily surprised to see that, but the Xianjin Realm was indeed the most advanced in the entire universe.
Lin Jingxia then pointed to the two dots that appeared on the hologram map. "Based on our distance and speed, we will meet them in three days, and you can take us back to the Xianjin Realm directly."
"Then, what about the situation there? What if those demons suddenly appear?" Wang Yourou joined the conversation.

"Long Jiutian will return to that realm tonight, but I'm not worried about him, especially since Feng Xueying is already on standby there to deal with him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] paused for a moment before continuing. "However, the black demon statue in the Huang Clan's underground is a big deal, and great chaos will occur there if Huang Zhejun activates it, especially since Xereth will immediately appear there. Therefore, we must get rid of the statue as soon as possible, and the situation will be in our control if it disappears. Can you speed up this flying artifact, Senior?"

Lin Jingxia shook her head at him. "This is already the maximum speed of my flying artifact, so we have no other choice but to wait three days. By the way, tell Senior Xueying to lure Long Jiutian out of the Xianjin Realm, and if possible, ask her to stop the Huang Clan."
"I'll contact her right now."

Quickly, the sun had set in the outside world. Inside the Cloud Mansion, Zhou Ling, Ren Xia, Qiu Mei, and Fang Chen had transformed into beasts.
Zhou Ling chose the windpiercer crane beast, Ren Xia chose the spirit snake turtle, Qiu Mei chose the firemane lion, and Fang Chen chose the azure feather falcon.
"Are the four of you satisfied now?" Zhang Fei asked them.
The four women nodded and answered in unison. "Yes!"

"You guys are already beast cultivators now, but your cultivation is still at rock bottom, so I will help you for the next few days." Zhang Fei passed the Flawless Yin-Yang Art to them, just like with Yang Lu'er, Huang Rong, and Hong Yao. Although they were not members of his main harem, they were still his women, so he gave them the best. "Let's start."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was sitting together with Lin Moxian, Cheng Gaojie, Wang Zhemin, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan not far from the Huang Clan.
Before long, they saw Long Jiutian walking into the Huang Clan disguised as a human. Wang Zhemin immediately contacted Guan Chenhong to prepare the realm's defense mechanism against the clan.
Feng Xueying, who was previously hiding in another area, suddenly appeared by their side.
"Can you move that statue, Old Phoenix?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her.

Feng Xueying shook her head. "I checked the statue after you told me about it, but Xereth used something on it, and he will detect my actions if I do something to it. Therefore, we must wait for Gong Ren, who may have the best solution to remove it without the demon noticing."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In that case, I hope you can help paralyze the demon and the Huang clan, preventing them from activating the statue."

"All right." Feng Xueying then informed them. "Feng Shen and the ancestors of the other mythical beasts are on their way to this realm, and the two ancestors of the golden fox will arrive tomorrow in case Xereth suddenly turns around and goes here."

I am willing to be your disciple, Senior." Zhang Lingxue spontaneously accepted her offer, especially since Lin Jingxia was the best female alchemist in the universe.
She immediately knelt down and kowtowed three times to her.
"Master."
Lin Jingxia took out a special plaque and gave it to Zhang Lingxue.
"From now on, you are my disciple, and you will also be part of my Lin Clan."
After receiving the plaque, Zhang Lingxue was overjoyed, but then she asked a question.
"What about my husband, Master?"
"I will pass all my alchemy knowledge to you, and he can learn everything from you later." Lin Jingxia then gave Zhang Lingxue a thick book.
"For now, I want you to read this book, and I have written a lot of my experiences in alchemy in it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed bitterly in his heart when Lin Jingxia explored at him, but he could already guess her reason for not wanting to take him as her disciple, which was because he was a dual cultivator.
Zhang Lingxue looked at her husband with an apologetic look, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her with a smile.
Although he was disappointed, he didn't think much about it, especially since he was still able to learn all of Lin Jingxia's alchemy knowledge from his wife.
After she cleaned up the remaining alchemy ingredients and furnace, Zhang Lingxue read the book Lin Jingxia gave her.
From the first page, she found many intriguing things in it, most of which were new to her.
A while later, Chu Ying and Chu Qing had finished concocting the Rank 2 Jade Essence Pill, but they could only concoct intermediate-grade pills, which made them disappointed.
Despite this, Lin Jingxia still decided to accept them as her disciple, which overjoyed them.
Lin Jingxia then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Do you mind if I take your three wives back to the Void Heaven Realm?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the three women expressed surprise.
"Senior, I am happy that you want to teach them alchemy, but they will lag behind their sisters in cultivation if they stay with you in that realm."
"Isn't that a trivial matter for you?" Lin Jingxia shook her head in response.
"You just need to go to my realm, and you can use your beast's ability to go back and forth there to dual cultivate with them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh before answering her.
"You are not wrong about that, Senior.
However, our secluded place is different from your realm, and it is also our training ground.
If you don't believe me, you can try chasing one of them using only raw speed, and I guarantee you won't be able to catch them."
Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou turned to the three women, but they seemed doubtful about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s words, especially since their cultivation was too low.
"Go on, try to catch them."
As soon as Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou wanted to catch them, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters immediately disappeared.

The two women tried to catch them by circling on the flying artifact, but the raw speed of the three women was too quick for them, mainly because of their adaptation to eight and sixteen times heavier gravity.
After they played cat and mouse for quite some time, the two women decided to give up because it was impossible for them to catch Zhang Lingxue, Chu Ying, and Chu Xing.
*Thud*
Wang Yourou fell onto her buttocks, catching her breath, her gaze fixed on the three smiling women.
She suddenly remembered her first meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she was also unable to catch him at that time.
Lin Jingxia was still relaxed, even though she had also chased three women for so long.
The speed of the three women was simply astonishing in her eyes, especially since her cultivation was already at the Divine Ascension Realm, but she failed to catch them.
"How do you all train your speed to surpass mine?"
"Senior, their previous speed wasn't their maximum speed yet, especially since this place is too small." Lin Jingxia and Wang Yourou looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock.
"If the two of you race with them in a wide area, you guys won't be able to see their figures.
As for the way we train our speed, we use extremely heavy weights to do it."
"Extremely heavy weights?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out a metal hammer and showed it to them.
"This hammer looks small, but it is much heavier than you can imagine."
"Give it to me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave it to Lin Jingxia straight away, but the alchemy goddess's face turned red as soon as the hammer was in her hand.
She even exerted her cultivation, but the weight still overwhelmed her.
"Is the hammer really that heavy, Senior?" Wang Yourou asked.
"Don't even think about trying to lift it, or you'll break your wrist." Lin Jingxia immediately returned the hammer to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who threw it several times in the air with ease.
"How heavy is that hammer actually?"

"A blacksmith acquaintance of mine forged this hammer with a special metal, and its weight is 5000 pounds (2.27 t)." Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the hammer to Zhang Lingxue, who caught it and casually swung it.
Zhang Lingxue then gave the hammer to the Chu Sisters, and they could also easily swing it.

After all, the weight of the hammer was nothing compared to the gravity they had faced before, and it also tempered their physiques, even though their physiques were still not as strong as their husband's.
"You guys are really crazy!" Wang Yourou exclaimed as she massaged her forehead.
Even cultivators of Lin Jingxia's caliber had difficulty lifting the hammer, yet the three women, despite their low cultivation, could swing it so easily.
Lin Jingxia nodded in agreement with Wang Yourou; she would never have believed that the three women could lift such a heavy hammer if she had not witnessed it with her own eyes.
"Haha." Zhang Lingxue softly laughed.
"Master and senior sister, we didn't start practicing with this heavy hammer.
Instead, we began with a lighter one and gradually increased the weight until reaching this level."
Chu Ying then added.
"At first, we were overwhelmed by it, and we couldn't stand up because of it.
However, we didn't give up, and we continued our practice.
Time passed, and our hard work paid off as we adapted to such a heavy weight."
"Why are you all pushing yourselves that hard?" Wang Yourou asked them.
Chu Qing pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Our husband always said that life is better than death, and he also said that running away is not an act of cowardice, but it is a delayed victory.
Therefore, he forced himself to hone his speed to be able to escape from danger, and we are his wives, so we decided to follow in his footsteps."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] saved the hammer.
"We lack strong backers, so we must reconsider fighting those who are more powerful than us.
Moreover, life is too beautiful to sacrifice, and if the situation in front of me becomes too dangerous, I use my speed to escape.
"Actually, you are not wrong to think that way." Lin Jingxia uttered as she nodded.
"However, your actions contradict your words, such as your action of destroying the Shang Clan before.
Shang Huaqiang is not as strong as me or Tian Shuxiang, but he and his clan are much stronger than you, yet you choose to deal with them.
Fortunately, you have help from the Hong Clan and the other clans, or else you will never win against them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled upon hearing that, especially since Lin Jingxia didn't know the real situation.
It was true that the Hong Clan and the other clans helped him, but he could still defeat Shang Huaqiang by himself.
"Senior, family is everything to me, and that guy caused several of my family members to suffer.
Therefore, I had no choice but to fight him, and as a result, he is dead now."
"Master, our husband went against Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan because of us." Lin Jingxia looked at the Chu Sisters.
"He caused our father to die, so our husband fought him to avenge us."

"Master, Shang Huaqiang caused my brother to become a demon, and my family would have lost him if not for our husband, who found and brought him back to us." Lin Jingxia was surprised by Zhang Lingxue's confession.
"Many things happened in our home realm hundreds of years ago, and many lives were lost because of events initiated by that guy.
Less than a year ago, he attacked our realm again, but our husband and Big Sis Yao managed to stop his plans with several casualties."
Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding.
"We have long heard that Shang Huaxiang is targeting the lower realms, but we did not stop him because he did not go there himself, and he only sent the younger generation of his Shang Clan.
However, I did not expect that the realm was your home realm, and it would not have happened if we were stricter with the rules."
"Everything has happened and cannot be repeated, so we don't need to discuss that anymore." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Lin Jingxia.
"Can you estimate our distance to the Nameless One and the others, Senior?"
Lin Jingxia took out a small device and turned it on, which immediately displayed a hologram map.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily surprised to see that, but the Xianjin Realm was indeed the most advanced in the entire universe.
Lin Jingxia then pointed to the two dots that appeared on the hologram map.
"Based on our distance and speed, we will meet them in three days, and you can take us back to the Xianjin Realm directly."
"Then, what about the situation there?
What if those demons suddenly appear?" Wang Yourou joined the conversation.

"Long Jiutian will return to that realm tonight, but I'm not worried about him, especially since Feng Xueying is already on standby there to deal with him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] paused for a moment before continuing.
"However, the black demon statue in the Huang Clan's underground is a big deal, and great chaos will occur there if Huang Zhejun activates it, especially since Xereth will immediately appear there.
Therefore, we must get rid of the statue as soon as possible, and the situation will be in our control if it disappears.
Can you speed up this flying artifact, Senior?"
Lin Jingxia shook her head at him.
"This is already the maximum speed of my flying artifact, so we have no other choice but to wait three days.
By the way, tell Senior Xueying to lure Long Jiutian out of the Xianjin Realm, and if possible, ask her to stop the Huang Clan."
"I'll contact her right now."
