Quickly, the sun had set in the outside world.
Inside the Cloud Mansion, Zhou Ling, Ren Xia, Qiu Mei, and Fang Chen had transformed into beasts.
Zhou Ling chose the windpiercer crane beast, Ren Xia chose the spirit snake turtle, Qiu Mei chose the firemane lion, and Fang Chen chose the azure feather falcon.
"Are the four of you satisfied now?" Zhang Fei asked them.
The four women nodded and answered in unison.
"Yes!"

"You guys are already beast cultivators now, but your cultivation is still at rock bottom, so I will help you for the next few days." Zhang Fei passed the Flawless Yin-Yang Art to them, just like with Yang Lu'er, Huang Rong, and Hong Yao.
Although they were not members of his main harem, they were still his women, so he gave them the best.
"Let's start."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was sitting together with Lin Moxian, Cheng Gaojie, Wang Zhemin, Yan Yinqing, and Tantai Lingyan not far from the Huang Clan.
Before long, they saw Long Jiutian walking into the Huang Clan disguised as a human.
Wang Zhemin immediately contacted Guan Chenhong to prepare the realm's defense mechanism against the clan.
Feng Xueying, who was previously hiding in another area, suddenly appeared by their side.
"Can you move that statue, Old Phoenix?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her.
Feng Xueying shook her head.
"I checked the statue after you told me about it, but Xereth used something on it, and he will detect my actions if I do something to it.
Therefore, we must wait for Gong Ren, who may have the best solution to remove it without the demon noticing."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I hope you can help paralyze the demon and the Huang clan, preventing them from activating the statue."
"All right." Feng Xueying then informed them.

"Feng Shen and the ancestors of the other mythical beasts are on their way to this realm, and the two ancestors of the golden fox will arrive tomorrow in case Xereth suddenly turns around and goes here."

chapters.title: Chapter 830: Tian Shuixiang
paragraphs: *Bam*
Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang slammed into the wall, fell to the floor, and vomited a mouthful of blood from their mouths. "Cough... Cough..."
"Idiot!" Long Jiutian furiously shouted. "I told you that I would arrive today, but you foolishly gave way for that impostor to infiltrate this clan."

"Cough." Huang Zhejun rubbed his chest and explained. "Lord, that person's aura is identical to yours, so we didn't realize that he was an impostor. However, he didn't do anything in this clan, and he had already left long ago."

Long Jiutian went straight to Huang Zhejun, grabbed his head, and read his memories. However, he didn't find out much from his memories, especially since the Huang ancestor didn't communicate much with Zhang Fei's clone, and they only exchanged a few words a few times.
Long Jiutian found out about the four humanoid dolls in Huang Zhejun's memories, but he was disappointed because the Yan Jinqing and Tantai Lingyan dolls were taken away by Zhang Fei's clone.

Long Jiutian rushed to the dungeon, followed by Huang Zhejun, Huang Jiguang, and the three women. Upon arrival, he checked out the Zhang Fei and Lin Moxian dolls, but he realized that both of them were dolls and destroyed them instantly.

Huang Zhejun, Huang Jiguang, and the three women were shocked to see that. Before they could speak, Long Jiutian knocked them backward until they slammed into the dungeon wall. "Find those damn people now."

After they wiped the blood on their mouths, Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang hurriedly left their clan's dungeon. The Huang ancestor contacted Xiong Yehui and Lei Xuanfeng to help them search for Zhang Fei, Lin Moxian, and the two women.

Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu shrank as soon as Long Jiutian turned towards them with a fierce gaze. However, a snow-white bird suddenly darted into the dungeon and attacked the demon, knocking him several steps back.

"This Qi! Didn't my lord send Feng Yichen to the phoenix realm? How can that ice phoenix be in this realm?" Long Jiutian rushed out of the dungeon before jumping to the highest place in the Huang Clan, looking for Feng Xueying's whereabouts.
Long Jiutian noticed numerous traces of ice Qi, intentionally left by Feng Xueying, in the darkness of the night sky. Without realizing that it was a trap, he immediately rushed after her.
After those people left, Zhang Fei [5] walked into the Huang Clan together with Lin Moxian in an invisible state, and they went into the dungeon to retrieve the fragments of the two dolls.

Zhang Fei [5] canceled his abilities as soon as they arrived there. Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu were surprised by their appearance, but they did not show any excessive reaction, especially since he had added some things to their memories.
Zhang Fei [5] then took out a black pill and gave it to Lei Huiyin. "You know what to do with this pill, right?"
"Yes, Master." Lei Huiyin replied with a nod. "I'll prepare this pill now; my husband and others won't notice once they take it."
After Lei Huiyin and the two women left the dungeon, Lin Moxian asked Zhang Fei [5]. "What have you done to make them loyal to you?"

"I added some things to their memories." Lin Moxian raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5]. "It's one of my demon abilities, but I rarely use it, including against my enemies. I only changed the memories of a few of them, and most of them are men, so they are completely loyal to me."
"Does that mean you will bring three women to your side?"

Zhang Fei [5] answered with a nod. "You have seen my special prison, and the cultivation of three of the ten women there is still in the ten mortal realms. Therefore, I will replace them with Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu. That way, the tube will produce more Yin Qi faster, and I don't have to worry about breaking through by relying on your aunt's Nine Revolutions Pill to stabilize my foundation."

"I see." Lin Moxian then warned him. "Junior brother, the Nine Revolutions Pill can indeed stabilize our foundation, but you can't always rely on it. The ingredients are scarce, and the time to concoct it is quite long. My aunt once told me that it took her a month to concoct one pill, and she has never managed to concoct more than one pill because of the complexity."

"Senior brother, I have three cultivators with the wood element, remember? In fact, I already have the herb seeds to concoct the pill, and they have already helped me grow them, so I don't need to worry about the herbs." Lin Moxian could only shake his head hearing that because Zhang Fei [5] was a cheater with them by his side. "As for the time to concoct it, I don't dare to say exactly how much time I need to concoct it. I haven't tried concocting it yet, and I will try concocting it first after the situation in this realm calms down."

Lin Moxian let out a soft sigh and patted his shoulder. "If you can refine the pill faster and with more quantity than my aunt, then your breakthrough will be unstoppable, and you can break through whenever you want. By the way, let's leave this clan now, or Huang Zhejun will be aware of our actions."
"Let's go! I want to see Feng Xueying's fight with Long Jiutian." Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Lin Moxian out of the clan.

"Hmm?" Long Jiutian frowned as he reached the last trace of ice Qi, which was already outside the Xianjin Realm. Feng Xueling was standing with her back to him, both hands behind her hips. "How did you get to this realm?"
Feng Xueying turned to him with a bone-piercing cold gaze. "Do you think all phoenixes live in the phoenix realm?"

"I've been in this realm for a long time, and I've never felt your presence here before." Long Jiutian replied confidently, but Feng Xueying's aura suddenly disappeared, even though she was still standing in front of him. "I didn't expect you to suppress your aura so deeply that I couldn't sense it. Since you are here, I will capture you and hand you over to my lord."

Feng Xueying said nothing and stretched her right hand forward. In an instant, a few snow-white birds flew towards Long Jiutian, but the demon immediately countered it with several blackish red balls.

Feng Xueying's snow-white birds immediately disappeared after colliding with Long Jiutian's blackish red balls, and those balls instantly shot towards the ice phoenix. She kept calm and blew out a cold breath at them, freezing them.

Long Jiutian, who was previously happy after destroying those snow-white birds, immediately became tense. He was previously confident that he could defeat Feng Xueying with his abilities, but she froze his blackish red balls instead.
"Your blood and darkness can corrupt many things, but none of them can corrupt my ice." Feng Xueying once again summoned her snow-white birds and shot them toward Long Jiutian.
Unlike before, Long Jiutian could not destroy Feng Xueying's attack, and the snow-white birds flew around him, creating a vortex of ice around him.
*Swoosh*

A blackish red vortex instantly emerged from Long Jiutian's body to counter Feng Xueying's attack, but it immediately froze, making him panic. He immediately flew out of the ice encirclement and shot a few other blackish red balls toward the ice phoenix.
"Futile." Feng Xueying waved her hand, freezing those balls again. Soon, a few ice arrows appeared behind her, and they shot straight toward Long Jiutian.

Long Jiutian intended to counter those arrows by creating a blackish red shield in front of him, but their trajectory changed and circled behind him. However, another shield appeared behind the demon, but it immediately froze after they stuck it.

"Fuck!" Long Jiutian cursed and floated away from Feng Xueying. 'I've heard that the ice of the ice phoenix is indeed freezing, but it shouldn't be able to freeze darkness, yet she managed to do it repeatedly.'

"Thinking in battle, huh?" Long Jiutian immediately turned back with a black sword in his hand and attacked Feng Xueying, but the ice phoenix turned into an ice statue before shattering. "You can't even tell the difference between illusion and reality."

Long Jiutian turned to Feng Xueying, who had already returned to her original position. He intended to inform Xereth of the ice phoenix's whereabouts and abilities, but a snow-white fog quickly enveloped him, causing his body to gradually freeze.
'Shit!' Long Jiutian tried to fight it with his darkness and blood, but it backfired on him, especially since he froze even faster. A large block of ice encased the demon in a matter of seconds.
Zhang Fei [5] and Lin Moxian immediately appeared behind Long Jiutian, checking his condition. "Did you find anything inside his body, Old Phoenix?"

"No." Feng Xueying shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "However, I'm sure Xereth has planted something into this demon's body, so I froze him instead of killing him. Otherwise, the demon would instantly become aware of his death, posing a significant risk to us, particularly since the others have not yet returned to this realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I'm glad you didn't kill this demon, and I will use him to increase my demon rank and cultivation later."

Feng Xueying let out a soft sigh. "I understand your desire to become strong, but you take shortcuts too often. It will have a bad impact on you one day, so you should think more carefully about using shortcuts."

"I understand your concerns, and I thank you for that." Zhang Fei [5] said sincerely. "Unfortunately, I have no choice but to use shortcuts, especially since the enemies blocking my path are getting stronger and stronger. Thus, I have to increase my strength as quickly as possible, or I will always be dependent on all of you."

Feng Xueying immediately scolded him. "You're too stupid, kid. What's wrong with having to depend on other people? Do you think it's worse than using shortcuts? No matter how strong you become in the future, you won't be able to do everything by relying on yourself, and you will still need other people's help to overcome some things beyond your control."

"Old Phoenix, have you ever been betrayed by people you trust?" Zhang Fei's [5] question surprised Feng Xueying and Lin Moxian. "I'm not saying that you and the others will betray me one day, but my blood brother and ex-lover betrayed me long before I became a cultivator. In fact, I was able to reach this stage thanks to the help of many people, and I am aware that I will always need the help of others, but I would rather not continue relying on anyone. I am aware that using shortcuts will have a negative impact on me, but I am willing to bear the risk as long as I can be strong to protect myself and the people around me, especially all my wives and our families."

"I'm just reminding you as a senior, and you can decide everything for yourself." After she said that, Feng Xueying immediately disappeared from their sight. She originally wanted to take care of the people from the Huang, Xiong, and Lei clans, but she changed her mind and let Zhang Fei [5] and the others sort them out themselves.
"What happened to them?"
"I killed them with my hands."
"Does your family know about that?"

"I told them myself." Zhang Fei [5] then clenched his right fist and continued with full resolution. "I hate betrayal the most, whether they are my enemies or family members; I will kill anyone who dares to betray me, and I will make them suffer before they die."
Lin Moxian didn't say anything, patted Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulder, and flew into the realm again.

Zhang Fei [5] originally wanted to send the frozen Long Jiutian into one of his spaces, but he changed his mind and sent him to the Nine Hells Darkland instead. This way, the demon wouldn't harm his family if he suddenly managed to break free from Feng Xueying's ice.
Zhang Fei [5] then monitored Huang Zhejun and the others through the system map, but they would never have expected that Tantai Lingyan and the others were hiding in Cheng Gaoji's shop.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly saw a flying artifact similar to Lin Jingxia's approaching that realm, and he could immediately guess that its owner was the alchemy god, Tian Shuixiang.
[Master, you have to be careful of that person.]
'What do you mean by that, Mei? Why should I be careful of him?'
[I'll show you.]
Name: Shang Xiuluo (Tian Shuixiang)
Gender: Male
Race: Asura Demon
Rank: Emperor
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements: Fire + Blood
Core: Peak-Rank Fire Core, Peak-Rank Blood Core
Physique: Demon God
Special Physique: Infernal Flame Demon
Special Bloodline: Infernal Flame Demon
Abilities: blood slaughter qi, asura battle will, asura war form, slaughter sword intent, slaughtering domain, asura rebirth, and so on.
Partner: Ye Zhiye (Eternal Night Demon Queen)
Likes: Lin Jingxia, Feng Jiu, Feng Yao, Huli Xianniang, Nu Shen, Fu Xin, and so on.
Dislikes: Lin Clan, The Nameless One, Phoenix Race, and so on.
'Asura demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] frowned and muttered inwardly. 'Did he use something to hide his demon identity?'

[Master, he didn't use an artifact to hide his demon identity, and another demon seemed to help him become human by using a special ability similar to your body modification ability, or else his demon aura had already spread around.]
'What kind of demon has the ability to change other people's bodies?'
[The system has no information about demons with such abilities apart from incubi and succubi, master.]
'I see.'
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] was already in front of Lin Moxian. "Senior brother, what do you know about Tian Shuxiang?"
"What do you mean by your question, Junior Brother?" Zhang Fei [5] carefully explained to Lin Moxian. "Are you sure that Senior Tian is a demon?"
"I'm a demon, remember? I don't know which demon helped him hide his demon identity; I'm certain that he's a demon."

Lin Moxian nodded. "Honestly, I've never heard anything strange about Senior Tian, and he's actually a nice guy. Unlike my aunt, he often helps people in our realm, and the residents like him very much, so I find it difficult to believe that he's a demon."

"Well, not all demons are evil, right?" Zhang Fei [5] said with a smile. "I don't know the reason he disguised himself as a human, but his demon identity is truly extraordinary. Moreover, his true name is Shang Xiuluo, and his true cultivation is not at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm but 5-Moon."
Lin Moxian looked at him in shock. "How do you know so much about Senior Tian?"

"Sorry, but I can't tell you that, Senior Brother." Zhang Fei [5] then looked outside because Tian Shuxiang had already arrived in front of the residence. "For now, let's just pretend that we don't know about his true identity, but I will try something to investigate his purpose for disguising himself as a human."

Lin Moxian nodded at him. "I don't know how you know all that, but I hope you will never become enemies with Senior Tian. Otherwise, you will face too many powerful cultivators, including the Nameless One, and my Lin Clan might also become your enemy."
"Does that mean you will also be my enemy, Senior Brother?"
"I can't answer that now." Lin Moxian replied with a shake of her head. "You are my junior brother, but the Lin Clan is my family, and such a situation will put me in a dilemma."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Let's meet that person."

"I added some things to their memories." Lin Moxian raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5].
"It's one of my demon abilities, but I rarely use it, including against my enemies.
I only changed the memories of a few of them, and most of them are men, so they are completely loyal to me."
"Does that mean you will bring three women to your side?"
Zhang Fei [5] answered with a nod.
"You have seen my special prison, and the cultivation of three of the ten women there is still in the ten mortal realms.
Therefore, I will replace them with Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu.
That way, the tube will produce more Yin Qi faster, and I don't have to worry about breaking through by relying on your aunt's Nine Revolutions Pill to stabilize my foundation."
"I see." Lin Moxian then warned him.
"Junior brother, the Nine Revolutions Pill can indeed stabilize our foundation, but you can't always rely on it.
The ingredients are scarce, and the time to concoct it is quite long.
My aunt once told me that it took her a month to concoct one pill, and she has never managed to concoct more than one pill because of the complexity."
"Senior brother, I have three cultivators with the wood element, remember?

In fact, I already have the herb seeds to concoct the pill, and they have already helped me grow them, so I don't need to worry about the herbs." Lin Moxian could only shake his head hearing that because Zhang Fei [5] was a cheater with them by his side.
"As for the time to concoct it, I don't dare to say exactly how much time I need to concoct it.
I haven't tried concocting it yet, and I will try concocting it first after the situation in this realm calms down."
Lin Moxian let out a soft sigh and patted his shoulder.
"If you can refine the pill faster and with more quantity than my aunt, then your breakthrough will be unstoppable, and you can break through whenever you want.
By the way, let's leave this clan now, or Huang Zhejun will be aware of our actions."
"Let's go!
I want to see Feng Xueying's fight with Long Jiutian." Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Lin Moxian out of the clan.
"Hmm?" Long Jiutian frowned as he reached the last trace of ice Qi, which was already outside the Xianjin Realm.
Feng Xueling was standing with her back to him, both hands behind her hips.
"How did you get to this realm?"
Feng Xueying turned to him with a bone-piercing cold gaze.
"Do you think all phoenixes live in the phoenix realm?"

"I've been in this realm for a long time, and I've never felt your presence here before." Long Jiutian replied confidently, but Feng Xueying's aura suddenly disappeared, even though she was still standing in front of him.
"I didn't expect you to suppress your aura so deeply that I couldn't sense it.
Since you are here, I will capture you and hand you over to my lord."
Feng Xueying said nothing and stretched her right hand forward.
In an instant, a few snow-white birds flew towards Long Jiutian, but the demon immediately countered it with several blackish red balls.
Feng Xueying's snow-white birds immediately disappeared after colliding with Long Jiutian's blackish red balls, and those balls instantly shot towards the ice phoenix.
She kept calm and blew out a cold breath at them, freezing them.
Long Jiutian, who was previously happy after destroying those snow-white birds, immediately became tense.
He was previously confident that he could defeat Feng Xueying with his abilities, but she froze his blackish red balls instead.
"Your blood and darkness can corrupt many things, but none of them can corrupt my ice." Feng Xueying once again summoned her snow-white birds and shot them toward Long Jiutian.
Unlike before, Long Jiutian could not destroy Feng Xueying's attack, and the snow-white birds flew around him, creating a vortex of ice around him.
*Swoosh*
A blackish red vortex instantly emerged from Long Jiutian's body to counter Feng Xueying's attack, but it immediately froze, making him panic.
He immediately flew out of the ice encirclement and shot a few other blackish red balls toward the ice phoenix.
"Futile." Feng Xueying waved her hand, freezing those balls again.
Soon, a few ice arrows appeared behind her, and they shot straight toward Long Jiutian.
Long Jiutian intended to counter those arrows by creating a blackish red shield in front of him, but their trajectory changed and circled behind him.
However, another shield appeared behind the demon, but it immediately froze after they stuck it.

"Fuck!" Long Jiutian cursed and floated away from Feng Xueying. 'I've heard that the ice of the ice phoenix is indeed freezing, but it shouldn't be able to freeze darkness, yet she managed to do it repeatedly.'
"Thinking in battle, huh?" Long Jiutian immediately turned back with a black sword in his hand and attacked Feng Xueying, but the ice phoenix turned into an ice statue before shattering.
"You can't even tell the difference between illusion and reality."
Long Jiutian turned to Feng Xueying, who had already returned to her original position.
He intended to inform Xereth of the ice phoenix's whereabouts and abilities, but a snow-white fog quickly enveloped him, causing his body to gradually freeze.
'Shit!' Long Jiutian tried to fight it with his darkness and blood, but it backfired on him, especially since he froze even faster.
A large block of ice encased the demon in a matter of seconds.
Zhang Fei [5] and Lin Moxian immediately appeared behind Long Jiutian, checking his condition.
"Did you find anything inside his body, Old Phoenix?"
"No." Feng Xueying shook her head at Zhang Fei [5].
"However, I'm sure Xereth has planted something into this demon's body, so I froze him instead of killing him.
Otherwise, the demon would instantly become aware of his death, posing a significant risk to us, particularly since the others have not yet returned to this realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"I'm glad you didn't kill this demon, and I will use him to increase my demon rank and cultivation later."
Feng Xueying let out a soft sigh.
"I understand your desire to become strong, but you take shortcuts too often.
It will have a bad impact on you one day, so you should think more carefully about using shortcuts."
"I understand your concerns, and I thank you for that." Zhang Fei [5] said sincerely.
"Unfortunately, I have no choice but to use shortcuts, especially since the enemies blocking my path are getting stronger and stronger.
Thus, I have to increase my strength as quickly as possible, or I will always be dependent on all of you."
Feng Xueying immediately scolded him.
"You're too stupid, kid.
What's wrong with having to depend on other people?
Do you think it's worse than using shortcuts?
No matter how strong you become in the future, you won't be able to do everything by relying on yourself, and you will still need other people's help to overcome some things beyond your control."
"Old Phoenix, have you ever been betrayed by people you trust?" Zhang Fei's [5] question surprised Feng Xueying and Lin Moxian.
"I'm not saying that you and the others will betray me one day, but my blood brother and ex-lover betrayed me long before I became a cultivator.
In fact, I was able to reach this stage thanks to the help of many people, and I am aware that I will always need the help of others, but I would rather not continue relying on anyone.

I am aware that using shortcuts will have a negative impact on me, but I am willing to bear the risk as long as I can be strong to protect myself and the people around me, especially all my wives and our families."
"I'm just reminding you as a senior, and you can decide everything for yourself." After she said that, Feng Xueying immediately disappeared from their sight.
She originally wanted to take care of the people from the Huang, Xiong, and Lei clans, but she changed her mind and let Zhang Fei [5] and the others sort them out themselves.
"What happened to them?"
"I killed them with my hands."
"Does your family know about that?"
"I told them myself." Zhang Fei [5] then clenched his right fist and continued with full resolution.
"I hate betrayal the most, whether they are my enemies or family members; I will kill anyone who dares to betray me, and I will make them suffer before they die."
Lin Moxian didn't say anything, patted Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulder, and flew into the realm again.
Zhang Fei [5] originally wanted to send the frozen Long Jiutian into one of his spaces, but he changed his mind and sent him to the Nine Hells Darkland instead.
This way, the demon wouldn't harm his family if he suddenly managed to break free from Feng Xueying's ice.
Zhang Fei [5] then monitored Huang Zhejun and the others through the system map, but they would never have expected that Tantai Lingyan and the others were hiding in Cheng Gaoji's shop.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly saw a flying artifact similar to Lin Jingxia's approaching that realm, and he could immediately guess that its owner was the alchemy god, Tian Shuixiang.
[Master, you have to be careful of that person.]
'What do you mean by that, Mei?
Why should I be careful of him?'
[I'll show you.]
Name: Shang Xiuluo (Tian Shuixiang)
Gender: Male
Race: Asura Demon
Rank: Emperor
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements: Fire + Blood
Core: Peak-Rank Fire Core, Peak-Rank Blood Core
Physique: Demon God
Special Physique: Infernal Flame Demon
Special Bloodline: Infernal Flame Demon
Abilities: blood slaughter qi, asura battle will, asura war form, slaughter sword intent, slaughtering domain, asura rebirth, and so on.
Partner: Ye Zhiye (Eternal Night Demon Queen)
Likes: Lin Jingxia, Feng Jiu, Feng Yao, Huli Xianniang, Nu Shen, Fu Xin, and so on.
Dislikes: Lin Clan, The Nameless One, Phoenix Race, and so on.
'Asura demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] frowned and muttered inwardly. 'Did he use something to hide his demon identity?'

[Master, he didn't use an artifact to hide his demon identity, and another demon seemed to help him become human by using a special ability similar to your body modification ability, or else his demon aura had already spread around.]
'What kind of demon has the ability to change other people's bodies?'
[The system has no information about demons with such abilities apart from incubi and succubi, master.]
'I see.'
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] was already in front of Lin Moxian.
"Senior brother, what do you know about Tian Shuxiang?"
"What do you mean by your question, Junior Brother?" Zhang Fei [5] carefully explained to Lin Moxian.
"Are you sure that Senior Tian is a demon?"
"I'm a demon, remember?
I don't know which demon helped him hide his demon identity; I'm certain that he's a demon."
Lin Moxian nodded.
"Honestly, I've never heard anything strange about Senior Tian, and he's actually a nice guy.
Unlike my aunt, he often helps people in our realm, and the residents like him very much, so I find it difficult to believe that he's a demon."
"Well, not all demons are evil, right?" Zhang Fei [5] said with a smile.
"I don't know the reason he disguised himself as a human, but his demon identity is truly extraordinary.
Moreover, his true name is Shang Xiuluo, and his true cultivation is not at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm but 5-Moon."
Lin Moxian looked at him in shock.
"How do you know so much about Senior Tian?"
"Sorry, but I can't tell you that, Senior Brother." Zhang Fei [5] then looked outside because Tian Shuxiang had already arrived in front of the residence.
"For now, let's just pretend that we don't know about his true identity, but I will try something to investigate his purpose for disguising himself as a human."
Lin Moxian nodded at him.
"I don't know how you know all that, but I hope you will never become enemies with Senior Tian.
Otherwise, you will face too many powerful cultivators, including the Nameless One, and my Lin Clan might also become your enemy."
"Does that mean you will also be my enemy, Senior Brother?"
"I can't answer that now." Lin Moxian replied with a shake of her head.
"You are my junior brother, but the Lin Clan is my family, and such a situation will put me in a dilemma."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"Let's meet that person."

chapters.title: Chapter 831: Ye Zhiye
paragraphs: "What happened, Father? Why did you suddenly stop?" Huang Jiguang asked his father.
Huang Zhejun was still seriously listening to the report from one of his subordinates. "One of our people said that Tian Shuixiang is in this realm now, and he is visiting Cheng Gaoji."
"Isn't that natural?" Huang Jiguang asked in confusion. "Everyone knows that Tian Shuxiang has a close relationship with Cheng Gaoji, and Lin Jingxia chose Gong Ren as her partner in some matters."
Huang Zhejun nodded to his son, but he felt that Tian Shuxiang's arrival was too sudden, and the alchemy god's sudden arrival made him uneasy.

Huang Zhejun tried then to contact Long Jiutian to inform him of the arrival of the alchemy god, but unfortunately, Feng Xueying had already frozen him, and Zhang Fei [5] had transferred him to the Nine Hells Darkland. 'Where is he? Why can't I contact him?'
"This is serious, Brother Huang." Xiong Yehui said as he landed in front of the two men, followed by his wife, Duan Menghua.
Lei Xuanfeng also landed there before speaking. "Tian Shuxiang has just arrived in this realm, so we cannot act rashly with his presence here."
"Have you contacted Lord Jiutian?" Duan Menghua asked.

Huang Zhejun explained to them directly about Long Jiutian's situation, making them all frown. "Let's stop our search for now, and we will continue looking for them once Tian Shuxiang leaves this realm."
After that, Huang Zhejun and his son returned to the Huang Clan, as did Lei Xuanfeng, who returned to the Lei Clan.

The two people from the Xiong Clan did not return to their clan directly, but they tried to go to the business area to find out the reason for Tian Shuxiang's sudden arrival in their realm. "Do you think there is something we're not aware of, wife?"

"Yes." Duan Menghua nodded at Xiong Yehui. "Lord Jiutian couldn't have disappeared just like that, and I feel that Tian Shuxiang's sudden arrival has something to do with his plans to take over this realm. In my opinion, we should be more passive for the next few days, or he will become suspicious of us."

Xiong Yehui nodded as he thought about several things. "What do you think if we leave this realm for now? I feel that the situation has become unfavorable for us, and I think we should go to your realm to avoid unexpected events. Moreover, Long Jiutian's whereabouts are unknown, so this is a good opportunity for us to escape."

"Do you think we can escape from Long Jiutian with his black dragon mark in our souls?" Duan Menghua asked with doubt. "If he finds out we escaped from this realm, he will definitely hunt us down wherever we go, and he will destroy our two clans."
Xiong Yehui released a heavy sigh. "I know it's too risky, but it could buy us time to find a way to remove his mark from our souls."

"The only one who can help us is Hun Di, but he is not in this realm right now, and we don't know when he will return." Duan Menghua then touched her chest. "My ability in the soul cultivation path is second only to him, but I have repeatedly failed to remove the mark. Moreover, Long Jiutian has already done something to our two grandsons, and they are completely loyal to him now, especially Qinglai."

"They are in Guan Chenhong's hands now, and there is no way we can free them now. Moreover, Old Guan will not kill them immediately, so we should leave first, and we will save them after the situation changes again." Duan Menghua frowned at Xiong Yehui. "I'm worried about them myself, and I don't want them to die either, but our clan will be destroyed if we don't escape now."

Duan Menghua fell into contemplation for a long time before deciding. "All right, I agree with you; we should leave this realm tonight, and we will take the others with us. As for Qinglai and Yinghao, we will rescue them once the situation in this realm is calmer."
"Let's go back to our clan now, and we will leave this realm as soon as possible." The two immediately rushed back to the Xiong Clan.

At Cheng Gaoji's residence, he and the others had already welcomed Tian Shuxiang, and they sat together in the living room. Despite his old age, the alchemy god appeared surprisingly youthful, resembling a man in his early forties.
Tian Shuxiang's demeanor was extremely calm, and his appearance was that of a gentle literati, making the people sitting with him feel comfortable to be around him.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei [5] could still feel Tian Shuxiang's asura demon aura, which made him quite wary of him. However, he did not say anything and casually sat by Lin Moxian's side, and he used his natural awareness ability to confirm the alchemy god's demon identity, which proved to be true that he was a demon. 'In the novels on Earth, Asura Demons are always described as war demons, and they are maniac fighters with high bloodlust. Yet, this guy can act so calmly, and his demeanor does not show the slightest bit of his bloodlust.'
"Where is your aunt, Moxian?" Tian Shuxiang inquired, casting a sidelong glance at Zhang Fei [5].

'This kid should be a demon, but I can't sense his demon aura. Could it be that he's using the same method I use to hide it?' Zhang Fei [5] slightly raised an eyebrow as a notification appeared in his mind, warning him that the alchemy god was trying to probe him. The system's action of stopping him shocked Tian Shuxiang, and he hurriedly stopped his action. 'This kid is not an ordinary one, and there is something special in his body.'

"Senior Tian, my aunt is catching up with the Nameless One and the others, and they will probably arrive in this realm in three days." Lin Moxian's answer confused Tian Shuxiang. "My aunt is catching up with them with someone, and he can bring them back faster."

"Hmm?" Tian Shuxiang raised an eyebrow as she looked at the people in front of her, but they didn't show anything on their expressions, especially since Zhang Fei [5] had already told them not to mention anything about his clones in front of the alchemist god. "Who is that man? How is he going to bring them back here in three days if they are still in the middle realms now?"

"Senior Tian, you know about the race that can switch realms easily, right?" Tian Shuxiang was once again shocked after realizing the identity of the person Lin Moxian was referring to. "He comes from that race, but he would rather not be directly involved with us, and he is willing to help us only because of his good relationship with my aunt."

Tian Shuixiang was not suspicious of that because he was familiar with Lin Jingxia, and he knew quite a lot about her acquaintances, one of whom was a person from the Heavenly Fox Race. "If that person is with your aunt, it's not difficult for them to arrive in this realm in three days."

"Yes." Lin Moxian put her arm around Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulder. "Senior Tian, Zhang Fei is my junior brother, and my master accepted him as his disciple five months ago. Moreover, he is an alchemist, and my aunt has personally witnessed his skill in alchemy."

"His body reeked with the smell of many herbs, so I knew from the beginning that he was an alchemist. However, I didn't expect that Hun Di would take a disciple as young as him, and his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Heaven Realm." Tian Shuxiang then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "What rank is your alchemist at now?"
"A king rank, Senior." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer surprised Tian Shuxiang. "I have a good master in alchemy, and I was able to reach this rank so early because of her guidance."
"Who is your master?"
"Feng Yao."

"Little Yao's talent in alchemy is indeed extraordinary, so you are lucky to be able to have her as your master." Zhang Fei [5] responded to Tian Shuxiang with a faint smile. "Despite her young age, Jingxia and I have always believed that her abilities would surpass ours one day. Unfortunately, her interest in alchemy was not as deep as her interest in other things. She even chose to go to the lower realms to protect a small realm, which perplexed us."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately said. "The small realm is my home realm, and I met Feng Yao there. Since then, I learned a lot about alchemy from her, but she forbade me from addressing her as my master."

"I see." Tian Shuxiang then asked Wang Zhemin. "What are your plans now? Previously, I saw people from the Huang, Xiong, and Lei clans moving around the city. They seemed to be looking for something or someone."

Instead, Whang Zhemin pointed his finger at Lin Moxian, Zhang Fei [5], Tantai Lingyan, and Yan Yinqing. "Those people are looking for their whereabouts, especially since they previously kidnapped them."
"They kidnapped my four humanoid dolls, Senior Tian." Lin Moxian told him.
Tian Shuxiang nodded in understanding and stood up. "In that case, I will go to the Golden Crane Inn and wait for the others to arrive, and we will move against the three clans after that."

After Tian Shuxiang left, Cheng Gaoji immediately spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Kid, you should bring Duan Zhao and the others back to your realm first, especially since the situation in this realm will be chaotic soon."

"All right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately met Duan Zhao and his three male disciples in the back room. After he confirmed that Tian Shuxiang was not monitoring him, he sent the four of them back to the Nine Stars Realm.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to go to the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the quests, but he dropped his intention because of Tian Shuxiang's presence. Instead, his other two clones, who were cultivating in the phoenix realm, went there. They brought all the demons from the training space to that realm for training.

Since it was still midnight, Zhang Fei [5] and the others chose to go to their respective rooms to rest and cultivate. Meanwhile, Wang Zhemin and Cheng Gaoji went to the realm's defense center to meet Guan Chenhong, preparing their next move against the three clans.

In the Xiong Clan, Xiong Minglei and the other clan members were shocked by Xiong Yehui and Duan Menghua's sudden decision. Moreover, Xiong Qinglai and Xiong Yinghai were in Guan Chenhong's hands, yet they decided to abandon them.

Xiong Yehui spoke straight away. "I understand how you all feel, but we have no choice but to leave this realm for now. If we continue to stay in this realm, then our clan will most likely be destroyed, and we will die. Since Long Jiutian disappeared without a trace, this is our chance to leave. After the situation is normal, we will return to this realm again, and we will save them."
"All right, we don't have much time, so you guys pack your personal belongings now." Duan Menghua urged them.

Despite their unwillingness, Xiong Minglei and the others hurriedly followed Xiong Yehui and Duan Menghua's decision. After they were all ready, they secretly left the Xianjin Realm, and they also sealed their clans.

Guan Chenhong and Wang Zhemin were naturally aware of their actions, but they did not stop the people from the Xiong Clan because they knew exactly their destination. However, they still used something to track their whereabouts, so even if they went to a far realm, they could still detect them.
Tian Shuxiang had arrived at the inn and went straight to his room. Not long after, a fiery, red-haired woman came out of his body.

Ye Zhiye has an alluringly beautiful face that exudes the bewitching seductiveness. Her crescent brows and phoenix eyes released a boundless bewitching allure. A single small glance from her would penetrate a man's soul and topple his will. Her exquisite lips were pink and dewy.

Ye Zhiye had a slender build, with half of her jet-black hair spilled over her shoulders, and the rest hung all the way down to her waist. She dressed in soft, black leather clothing that tightly wrapped around her body. Every outline her clothes drew on her body was perfect to the point of being stifling. Her bottom and bosom were round and swelled, her waist as delicate as a willow.
Ye Zhiye sat on Tian Shuxiang's lap and hugged his neck. "Are you thinking about that child, Xiuluo?"

"Yes." Tian Shuxiang nodded at her. "Zhiye, I believe that kid is a demon like us, but something inside his body stops me from examining him. If my guess is right, he should already know that I am a demon, but he dares not say anything about my true identity because of his low cultivation."

"How about I help you investigate him?" Ye Zhiye asked. "I don't know what's inside his body, but I'm sure he won't be able to resist my abilities, and I can get more detailed information about him easily."

Tian Shuxiang thought about it first. "You can investigate him, but you have to be careful about the thing in his body. I'm afraid it has something to do with people from that realm, and you'll be in big trouble if my guess is right."
"Haha." Ye Zhiye giggled and disappeared in the darkness instantly.
Tian Shuxiang then sat by the window and looked at Cheng Gaoji's residence. "Could it be that the kid is a runaway too, like Zhiye and me?"
A while later, Ye Zhiye had already arrived at Zhang Fei [5]'s room, filling the room with pitch darkness.
Zhang Fei [5] naturally noticed Ye Zhiye's presence, but he pretended not to notice her presence and continued to suck Qi from the air. 'Scan her, Mei.'
Name: Ye Zhiye
Gender: Female
Race: Eternal Night Demon
Rank: Empress
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements: Darkness
Core: Peak-Rank Darkness Core
Physique: Night Demon
Special Physique: None
Special Bloodline: None
Abilities: endless night domain, moonless night, eternal night clones, eternal night enhancement, night cataclysm, dream invasion, nightmare manipulation, and so on.
Partner: Shang Xiuluo (Tian Shuixiang)
Like: Shang Xiuluo (Tian Shuixiang)
Dislike: All men of all races
'Eternal night demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] felt Ye Zhiye touch his forehead, but the system immediately reacted as soon as she used one of her abilities on him.

Ye Zhiye was shocked that her ability was useless against Zhang Fei [5], and she decided to use her other ability, but her attempt failed once again due to the system's intervention. 'How could this happen? Why can't I do anything about him?'
'Phew! Luckily, I have the system, or this woman would control me.' Taking advantage of Ye Zhiye's darkness, Zhang Fei [5] secretly used the darkness corruption, gradually weakening her.

Ye Zhiye immediately realized this and countered it by using her endless night domain, which suppressed Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness corruption. However, she looked at him in confusion because there was no movement of Qi in his body. 'Is it this kid's ability that weakened me just now? How can he use it without using his Qi?'
Just as Ye Zhiye was thinking that, Zhang Fei [5]'s pink gas spread out from his body and merged with her darkness, making the female demon unconsciously inhale it.

Ye Zhiye's lust ignited spontaneously, causing a pink heart symbol to appear in both of her eyes. Without thinking twice, she escaped from Zhang Fei [5]'s room and rushed back to Tian Shuxiang, especially since her lust continued to strengthen.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened his eyes. "I didn't want to find trouble with you, but you wanted to do such a thing to me, so you can feel the consequences."

Moreover, Old Guan will not kill them immediately, so we should leave first, and we will save them after the situation changes again." Duan Menghua frowned at Xiong Yehui.
"I'm worried about them myself, and I don't want them to die either, but our clan will be destroyed if we don't escape now."
Duan Menghua fell into contemplation for a long time before deciding.
"All right, I agree with you; we should leave this realm tonight, and we will take the others with us.
As for Qinglai and Yinghao, we will rescue them once the situation in this realm is calmer."
"Let's go back to our clan now, and we will leave this realm as soon as possible." The two immediately rushed back to the Xiong Clan.
At Cheng Gaoji's residence, he and the others had already welcomed Tian Shuxiang, and they sat together in the living room.
Despite his old age, the alchemy god appeared surprisingly youthful, resembling a man in his early forties.
Tian Shuxiang's demeanor was extremely calm, and his appearance was that of a gentle literati, making the people sitting with him feel comfortable to be around him.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei [5] could still feel Tian Shuxiang's asura demon aura, which made him quite wary of him.

However, he did not say anything and casually sat by Lin Moxian's side, and he used his natural awareness ability to confirm the alchemy god's demon identity, which proved to be true that he was a demon. 'In the novels on Earth, Asura Demons are always described as war demons, and they are maniac fighters with high bloodlust.
Yet, this guy can act so calmly, and his demeanor does not show the slightest bit of his bloodlust.'
"Where is your aunt, Moxian?" Tian Shuxiang inquired, casting a sidelong glance at Zhang Fei [5].
'This kid should be a demon, but I can't sense his demon aura.

Could it be that he's using the same method I use to hide it?' Zhang Fei [5] slightly raised an eyebrow as a notification appeared in his mind, warning him that the alchemy god was trying to probe him.
The system's action of stopping him shocked Tian Shuxiang, and he hurriedly stopped his action. 'This kid is not an ordinary one, and there is something special in his body.'
"Senior Tian, my aunt is catching up with the Nameless One and the others, and they will probably arrive in this realm in three days." Lin Moxian's answer confused Tian Shuxiang.
"My aunt is catching up with them with someone, and he can bring them back faster."

"Hmm?" Tian Shuxiang raised an eyebrow as she looked at the people in front of her, but they didn't show anything on their expressions, especially since Zhang Fei [5] had already told them not to mention anything about his clones in front of the alchemist god.
"Who is that man?
How is he going to bring them back here in three days if they are still in the middle realms now?"
"Senior Tian, you know about the race that can switch realms easily, right?" Tian Shuxiang was once again shocked after realizing the identity of the person Lin Moxian was referring to.
"He comes from that race, but he would rather not be directly involved with us, and he is willing to help us only because of his good relationship with my aunt."
Tian Shuixiang was not suspicious of that because he was familiar with Lin Jingxia, and he knew quite a lot about her acquaintances, one of whom was a person from the Heavenly Fox Race.
"If that person is with your aunt, it's not difficult for them to arrive in this realm in three days."
"Yes." Lin Moxian put her arm around Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulder.
"Senior Tian, Zhang Fei is my junior brother, and my master accepted him as his disciple five months ago.
Moreover, he is an alchemist, and my aunt has personally witnessed his skill in alchemy."
"His body reeked with the smell of many herbs, so I knew from the beginning that he was an alchemist.
However, I didn't expect that Hun Di would take a disciple as young as him, and his cultivation was still at the 1-Star Heaven Realm." Tian Shuxiang then asked Zhang Fei [5].
"What rank is your alchemist at now?"
"A king rank, Senior." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer surprised Tian Shuxiang.
"I have a good master in alchemy, and I was able to reach this rank so early because of her guidance."
"Who is your master?"
"Feng Yao."
"Little Yao's talent in alchemy is indeed extraordinary, so you are lucky to be able to have her as your master." Zhang Fei [5] responded to Tian Shuxiang with a faint smile.
"Despite her young age, Jingxia and I have always believed that her abilities would surpass ours one day.
Unfortunately, her interest in alchemy was not as deep as her interest in other things.
She even chose to go to the lower realms to protect a small realm, which perplexed us."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately said.
"The small realm is my home realm, and I met Feng Yao there.
Since then, I learned a lot about alchemy from her, but she forbade me from addressing her as my master."
"I see." Tian Shuxiang then asked Wang Zhemin.
"What are your plans now?
Previously, I saw people from the Huang, Xiong, and Lei clans moving around the city.
They seemed to be looking for something or someone."
Instead, Whang Zhemin pointed his finger at Lin Moxian, Zhang Fei [5], Tantai Lingyan, and Yan Yinqing.
"Those people are looking for their whereabouts, especially since they previously kidnapped them."
"They kidnapped my four humanoid dolls, Senior Tian." Lin Moxian told him.
Tian Shuxiang nodded in understanding and stood up.
"In that case, I will go to the Golden Crane Inn and wait for the others to arrive, and we will move against the three clans after that."
After Tian Shuxiang left, Cheng Gaoji immediately spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"Kid, you should bring Duan Zhao and the others back to your realm first, especially since the situation in this realm will be chaotic soon."
"All right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately met Duan Zhao and his three male disciples in the back room.
After he confirmed that Tian Shuxiang was not monitoring him, he sent the four of them back to the Nine Stars Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] wanted to go to the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the quests, but he dropped his intention because of Tian Shuxiang's presence.
Instead, his other two clones, who were cultivating in the phoenix realm, went there.
They brought all the demons from the training space to that realm for training.
Since it was still midnight, Zhang Fei [5] and the others chose to go to their respective rooms to rest and cultivate.
Meanwhile, Wang Zhemin and Cheng Gaoji went to the realm's defense center to meet Guan Chenhong, preparing their next move against the three clans.
In the Xiong Clan, Xiong Minglei and the other clan members were shocked by Xiong Yehui and Duan Menghua's sudden decision.
Moreover, Xiong Qinglai and Xiong Yinghai were in Guan Chenhong's hands, yet they decided to abandon them.
Xiong Yehui spoke straight away.
"I understand how you all feel, but we have no choice but to leave this realm for now.
If we continue to stay in this realm, then our clan will most likely be destroyed, and we will die.
Since Long Jiutian disappeared without a trace, this is our chance to leave.
After the situation is normal, we will return to this realm again, and we will save them."
"All right, we don't have much time, so you guys pack your personal belongings now." Duan Menghua urged them.
Despite their unwillingness, Xiong Minglei and the others hurriedly followed Xiong Yehui and Duan Menghua's decision.
After they were all ready, they secretly left the Xianjin Realm, and they also sealed their clans.
Guan Chenhong and Wang Zhemin were naturally aware of their actions, but they did not stop the people from the Xiong Clan because they knew exactly their destination.
However, they still used something to track their whereabouts, so even if they went to a far realm, they could still detect them.
Tian Shuxiang had arrived at the inn and went straight to his room.
Not long after, a fiery, red-haired woman came out of his body.
Ye Zhiye has an alluringly beautiful face that exudes the bewitching seductiveness.
Her crescent brows and phoenix eyes released a boundless bewitching allure.
A single small glance from her would penetrate a man's soul and topple his will.
Her exquisite lips were pink and dewy.
Ye Zhiye had a slender build, with half of her jet-black hair spilled over her shoulders, and the rest hung all the way down to her waist.
She dressed in soft, black leather clothing that tightly wrapped around her body.
Every outline her clothes drew on her body was perfect to the point of being stifling.
Her bottom and bosom were round and swelled, her waist as delicate as a willow.
Ye Zhiye sat on Tian Shuxiang's lap and hugged his neck.
"Are you thinking about that child, Xiuluo?"
"Yes." Tian Shuxiang nodded at her.
"Zhiye, I believe that kid is a demon like us, but something inside his body stops me from examining him.
If my guess is right, he should already know that I am a demon, but he dares not say anything about my true identity because of his low cultivation."
"How about I help you investigate him?" Ye Zhiye asked.
"I don't know what's inside his body, but I'm sure he won't be able to resist my abilities, and I can get more detailed information about him easily."
Tian Shuxiang thought about it first.
"You can investigate him, but you have to be careful about the thing in his body.
I'm afraid it has something to do with people from that realm, and you'll be in big trouble if my guess is right."
"Haha." Ye Zhiye giggled and disappeared in the darkness instantly.
Tian Shuxiang then sat by the window and looked at Cheng Gaoji's residence.
"Could it be that the kid is a runaway too, like Zhiye and me?"
A while later, Ye Zhiye had already arrived at Zhang Fei [5]'s room, filling the room with pitch darkness.
Zhang Fei [5] naturally noticed Ye Zhiye's presence, but he pretended not to notice her presence and continued to suck Qi from the air. 'Scan her, Mei.'

'Eternal night demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] felt Ye Zhiye touch his forehead, but the system immediately reacted as soon as she used one of her abilities on him.

Ye Zhiye was shocked that her ability was useless against Zhang Fei [5], and she decided to use her other ability, but her attempt failed once again due to the system's intervention. 'How could this happen?
Why can't I do anything about him?'
'Phew!
Luckily, I have the system, or this woman would control me.' Taking advantage of Ye Zhiye's darkness, Zhang Fei [5] secretly used the darkness corruption, gradually weakening her.
Ye Zhiye immediately realized this and countered it by using her endless night domain, which suppressed Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness corruption.
However, she looked at him in confusion because there was no movement of Qi in his body. 'Is it this kid's ability that weakened me just now?
How can he use it without using his Qi?'
Just as Ye Zhiye was thinking that, Zhang Fei [5]'s pink gas spread out from his body and merged with her darkness, making the female demon unconsciously inhale it.
Ye Zhiye's lust ignited spontaneously, causing a pink heart symbol to appear in both of her eyes.
Without thinking twice, she escaped from Zhang Fei [5]'s room and rushed back to Tian Shuxiang, especially since her lust continued to strengthen.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened his eyes.
"I didn't want to find trouble with you, but you wanted to do such a thing to me, so you can feel the consequences."

"Help... me... Xiuluo... I can't control my lust any longer."
Tian Shuxiang hurriedly took out a pill and forced Ye Zhiye to swallow it. He immediately helped her to absorb the pill, but her lust did not subside and flared up even more.
"Xiuluo... fuck me... I'm going crazy."
Tian Shuxiang let out a heavy sigh, took off their clothes, and started having sex with Ye Zhiye. The female demon quickly fell into sexual pleasure, and her moans echoed in the room.

Unlike Ye Zhiye, Tian Shuxian's mind was filled with questions about her condition, and he was one hundred percent sure that it was caused by Zhang Fei [5]. 'What exactly did that kid do to her? Why is she being this lustful?'

On the roof of the inn, Zhang Fei [5] sat alone in an invisible state, watching Tian Shuxian and Ye Zhiye having sex. 'Heh! No matter how long you satisfy her lust, her lust will be insatiable before I withdraw my hormone manipulation from her.'

Zhang Fei [5] then moved to the Huang Clan, observing Lei Huiyin and Qin Liangyu, who gave his pills to their husbands, Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang. 'Now my plan for this clan is in place, and I will execute it soon. The Xiong clan has already fled from this realm, so only the Lei clan remains.'
[Do you plan to take any action regarding the Lei Clan now, Master?]
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. 'I will let the Nameless One and the others take care of the Lei Clan once they return.'
[In that case, why don't you go subdue Tianguo now, Master? Additionally, Fa Ling's subordinates who used to trouble the Tian and Xian Realms are there, so you can get rid of them all at once.]
'Leave them alone for now, and I will go to the Wasteland Realm after the affairs in this realm are resolved.' After that, Zhang Fei [5] returned to Cheng Gaoji's residence to cultivate again.
"What happened to you, Husband?" Lei Huiyin asked, pretending to be panicked.
Huang Zhejun shook his head at her. "I'm probably exhausted thinking about the change in situation, so I'll rest now."

Lei Huiyin smiled faintly as she saw her husband lying on their bed, but she then left him in their room and went to see Qin Liangyu, who had just finished giving the pill to her husband, Huang Jiguang. After that, the two of them, together with Huang Bingyun, began to carry out Zhang Fei [5]'s orders.

After several days of travel, Xereth finally arrived at the Abyssal Realm, but he found it covered by a powerful barrier. He squinted his eyes and pressed his hand against the barrier, but it didn't show the slightest tremor after he attacked it. "Since when did this realm have such a powerful barrier? Moreover, this barrier is quite strange because it can absorb attacks from cultivators at my level, and it should be impossible because the highest cultivation in the upper realms is only at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
*Swoosh*

Xereth turned to Feng Yichen, who had just arrived and returned to her human form. He wanted to ask the female dark phoenix something, but before he could, a small fire phoenix suddenly shot out of her body and attacked him.
Xereth wanted to destroy the small fire phoenix, but it dodged his attack and entered his body directly.
"Shit!" Feng Yao's phoenix flames instantly enveloped Xereth's body and burned him, causing him to groan in pain. "Argh! Fuck! Yichen! Help me!"
Feng Yichen herself was shocked to see that, and she hurriedly tried to help Xereth. However, Feng Yao's phoenix flame spread to her body and burned her body as well. "Argh!"
"Damn it!" Xereth immediately abandoned his current body, which right away turned into a black demon statue and burned to ashes.

On the other hand, Feng Yichen returned to her dark phoenix form and used her dark flames to fight Feng Yao's phoenix flames. Unfortunately, her efforts were futile, and the phoenix flames continued to burn her, forcing her to go to the nearest realm.
The demons from the Abyssal Realm, who watched them from behind the barrier, cheered with joy, seeing Xereth and Feng Yichen in so much pain.
Right behind the barrier, a male demon with a calm appearance was standing in the air while looking out. Behind him, five demons—three men and two women—stood with satisfied smiles on their faces.
"Emperor, we are lucky that the mysterious person gave us this barrier, or else Xereth would have destroyed our realm." One of the female demons spoke with a relieved tone.

The demon emperor nodded in agreement. "Xereth has disappeared for so long, so I didn't expect that he would suddenly reappear on the surface. Moreover, his and that woman's cultivation is much higher than ours, and we will not be able to defeat them. Fortunately, Morgana warned us about his return, and I immediately activated this barrier to ward them off, or else we would have perished by now."
"Speaking of Morgana, it's been several hundred years since she returned to our realm, and I missed her so much." Another female demon spoke to them.

"Hahaha." The demon emperor laughed upon hearing that. "Morgana has found her husband, and she decided to leave with him to help him recover his memories. Perhaps her husband's memories have not yet returned, which is why she has not come back to our realm. By the way, we succeeded in repelling Xereth this time, but I'm sure he will come back here again. We must remain vigilant, with the five of you taking turns to monitor this barrier in case he devises a plan to destroy it."
"Yes, Emperor."

Meanwhile, Feng Yichen had arrived in a realm with her body on fire, and she went straight to the ocean in that realm before diving to the bottom. Unfortunately, Feng Yao's phoenix flames are different from her black flames or other phoenix flames, and the seawater cannot extinguish them.
Instead, Feng Yao's phoenix flames caused the surface of the sea to evaporate, causing panic in the realm.

Xereth was already in another realm with an angry expression; he was really furious because Feng Yao's phoenix flames injured him, even though the injury was not serious because he sacrificed his statue.

"That female phoenix must be from the Heavenly Realm; otherwise, her phoenix flames wouldn't be able to harm me, and it forced me to sacrifice one of my statues. Since she protects the phoenix realm, I can't go there to capture those two old phoenixes." Xereth pondered his options before departing the realm. "In that case, I will go to the Heavenly Moon Realm now, and I will capture those two old heavenly foxes. If I absorb them, I can gain their power and abilities. That way, that bitch Tian Huangjin won't be able to hunt me anymore, and I will raze the Radiance Domain to the ground."
In the Phoenix Realm, Feng Yao landed at the edge of the sea of fire, and Zhang Fei [4] hurriedly came out to meet her. "Has Feng Yichen met Xereth?"

"Yes." Feng Yao then touched his chest and injected a bit of her phoenix fire into his body. "Feng Yichen is in a realm not far from the Abyssal Realm right now, and she won't be able to leave that realm anytime soon. You can chase her to that realm whenever you want, and my phoenix flame will lead you to her. Unfortunately, my calculations about Xereth were wrong, mainly because his body is not his original body, and his body is made from the same statue as in the Huang Clan's basement. Since he abandoned it, I can't track his location."

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "Since Xereth failed to attack the Abyssal Realm, I believe his next destination will be the Heavenly Moon Realm, and he will definitely target Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing."

"Are you going to warn those two old foxes about Xereth?" Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow slightly in response to Feng Yao. "You need their hearts to evolve into the ten-tails, remember? If they die by his hands, you will never be able to evolve, and the ten-tailed fox will never be reborn in this universe. If the ten-tailed fox disappears forever, you will never be able to reach the peak of cultivation, and this universe will never be at peace."

Zhang Fei [4] released a soft sigh, and a gate appeared quite far from their location. However, Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu soon arrived at their side, especially since his first clone deliberately sent them there.
"What can I do for you, Master?" Tian Jianxia asked him.

Zhang Fei [4] told the two female foxes about the situation, and he had one of them open the gate leading to the Heavenly Moon Realm, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing would notice his aura if he did it. "Feng Yao, you can tell those two old foxes about Xereth."

"All right." As soon as Tian Jianxia opened the gate to the Heavenly Moon Realm, Feng Yao immediately sent a small fire phoenix into the realm, and the female fox closed it again right away. "They will receive my message soon, and one of them might come here, so you should leave now."

Zhang Fei [4] immediately sent Zhang Yue back to the training space, especially since his Yang Qi was too strong in her body. After that, he and Feltia [2] took the two female foxes to the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the three quests and met the female demons, who were deliberately left in that realm to train.
Shortly after they left, a gate appeared in another area of the phoenix realm, and Tian Baixing immediately appeared in front of Feng Yao.

Tian Baixing was a little furious at Feng Yao, especially since she still remembered the story of the four foxes who were once tasked to hunt Zhang Fei in the Sky Jade Realm. They said that the phoenix princess was the one who stopped and drove them out of the realm.
Since the situation was dire, Tian Baixing chose to forget about the matter for now. "Is the news you gave true, Phoenix Princess?"
"If you want to die, you can ignore my words." Feng Yao indifferently replied to her.
Tian Baixing asked her again. "How strong is the current Xereth?"

"Even if all the powerful cultivators in the upper realms join forces to attack Xereth, you will all die in his hands." Tian Baixing doubted Feng Yao's words, but the phoenix princess immediately did something she had never imagined before, and she forced the female fox to kneel before her. "Heh! Yours and Tian Baitian's cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but you two are still ants in my eyes. I can kill that demon myself, but I'm not interested in dealing with such trivial matters. Therefore, I deliberately sent that message to the two of you, and you guys can find a way to deal with him yourselves."

"Hah... Hah..." Tian Baixing gasped heavily as she looked at Feng Yao in shock. Never had she imagined that the phoenix princess was actually much stronger than all the cultivators in the upper realms combined. "Hah... Who exactly are you? How can you be this strong even though your cultivation is only at the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm?"
"A mere heavenly fox like you is not worthy of knowing my identity." Feng Yao replied condescendingly to her. "Go back to your realm now."
Tian Baixing did not ask further, opened the gate to her realm, and disappeared into it.
Huo Ling emerged from Feng Yao's body immediately and inquired. "Are you leaving this realm soon, Master?"

"Yes." Feng Yao replied with a light nod. "After I make sure that Xereth can't mess around in the three mortal realms, we will go to the Paradise Realm directly, and we will wait for Zhang Fei there."

Huo Ling was annoyed that Feng Yao kept thinking about Zhang Fei, and she always unconditionally helped him. "Are you sure you can leave that brat alone? Even if Xereth can't mess around here, he will probably still face many powerful enemies soon, including Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "I've told you many times not to underestimate Zhang Fei, but you never listen to my words. He is indeed weak, but he can cover up his weaknesses with his cunningness, speed, and some other things. Therefore, I don't need to worry about him, and he will succeed in going there. Moreover, I have to meet someone there, especially since she will play an important role for his future."
"The young miss of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Luo Yunxiao."

"That's right." Feng Yao nodded at Huo Ling. "Their strength and status are like heaven and earth now, but Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei are childhood friends, making her the right choice to help him once he goes there. However, her situation doesn't seem good, so I want to meet her first, and I will prepare her for him."
"Master, your feelings for Zhang Fei have blinded your eyes; you have even thought of such far-reaching plans for his sake." After she said that, Huo Ling immediately entered Feng Yao's body again.
Tian Baitian's expression looked serious as he listened to Tian Baixing's story about Feng Yu, but he found it difficult to believe that the phoenix princess could suppress his sister like that.

Tian Baixing immediately shared her memories of when she faced Feng Yao earlier, which shocked Tian Baitian. "Since she deliberately warned us like that, I believe Xereth's strength should be slightly lower or equal to hers."
"Yes." Tian Baitian asked her. "Did you ask Feng Yao about the fox who opened the gate for her?"

"I'm sure it's Tian Jianxia, but I can't find her there." Tian Baitian frowned in response. "I've asked her brother to track her whereabouts, and he will contact me directly once he finds her. For now, we must focus on Xereth, and we must evacuate our younger generations to another realm, or our race will be wiped out if he succeeds in breaking through our barrier."

"You're right." Tian Baitian then looked up into the sky before shooting something there, and a thick light barrier quickly enveloped their entire realm. He then declared an emergency to all members of their race, and he ordered them to face the worst. "Let's prepare to face the demon."

However, the naked Chu Xing immediately approached him and pulled him into her room, making him smile in amusement. "Are you looking forward to dual cultivating with me again, sister-in-law?"
