"Argh!
Fuck!
Yichen!
Help me!"
Feng Yichen herself was shocked to see that, and she hurriedly tried to help Xereth.
However, Feng Yao's phoenix flame spread to her body and burned her body as well.
"Argh!"
"Damn it!" Xereth immediately abandoned his current body, which right away turned into a black demon statue and burned to ashes.
On the other hand, Feng Yichen returned to her dark phoenix form and used her dark flames to fight Feng Yao's phoenix flames.
Unfortunately, her efforts were futile, and the phoenix flames continued to burn her, forcing her to go to the nearest realm.
The demons from the Abyssal Realm, who watched them from behind the barrier, cheered with joy, seeing Xereth and Feng Yichen in so much pain.
Right behind the barrier, a male demon with a calm appearance was standing in the air while looking out.
Behind him, five demons—three men and two women—stood with satisfied smiles on their faces.
"Emperor, we are lucky that the mysterious person gave us this barrier, or else Xereth would have destroyed our realm." One of the female demons spoke with a relieved tone.
The demon emperor nodded in agreement.
"Xereth has disappeared for so long, so I didn't expect that he would suddenly reappear on the surface.
Moreover, his and that woman's cultivation is much higher than ours, and we will not be able to defeat them.
Fortunately, Morgana warned us about his return, and I immediately activated this barrier to ward them off, or else we would have perished by now."
"Speaking of Morgana, it's been several hundred years since she returned to our realm, and I missed her so much." Another female demon spoke to them.
"Hahaha." The demon emperor laughed upon hearing that.
"Morgana has found her husband, and she decided to leave with him to help him recover his memories.
Perhaps her husband's memories have not yet returned, which is why she has not come back to our realm.
By the way, we succeeded in repelling Xereth this time, but I'm sure he will come back here again.
We must remain vigilant, with the five of you taking turns to monitor this barrier in case he devises a plan to destroy it."
"Yes, Emperor."
Meanwhile, Feng Yichen had arrived in a realm with her body on fire, and she went straight to the ocean in that realm before diving to the bottom.
Unfortunately, Feng Yao's phoenix flames are different from her black flames or other phoenix flames, and the seawater cannot extinguish them.
Instead, Feng Yao's phoenix flames caused the surface of the sea to evaporate, causing panic in the realm.

Xereth was already in another realm with an angry expression; he was really furious because Feng Yao's phoenix flames injured him, even though the injury was not serious because he sacrificed his statue.
"That female phoenix must be from the Heavenly Realm; otherwise, her phoenix flames wouldn't be able to harm me, and it forced me to sacrifice one of my statues.
Since she protects the phoenix realm, I can't go there to capture those two old phoenixes." Xereth pondered his options before departing the realm.
"In that case, I will go to the Heavenly Moon Realm now, and I will capture those two old heavenly foxes.
If I absorb them, I can gain their power and abilities.
That way, that bitch Tian Huangjin won't be able to hunt me anymore, and I will raze the Radiance Domain to the ground."
In the Phoenix Realm, Feng Yao landed at the edge of the sea of fire, and Zhang Fei [4] hurriedly came out to meet her.
"Has Feng Yichen met Xereth?"
"Yes." Feng Yao then touched his chest and injected a bit of her phoenix fire into his body.
"Feng Yichen is in a realm not far from the Abyssal Realm right now, and she won't be able to leave that realm anytime soon.
You can chase her to that realm whenever you want, and my phoenix flame will lead you to her.
Unfortunately, my calculations about Xereth were wrong, mainly because his body is not his original body, and his body is made from the same statue as in the Huang Clan's basement.
Since he abandoned it, I can't track his location."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding.
"Since Xereth failed to attack the Abyssal Realm, I believe his next destination will be the Heavenly Moon Realm, and he will definitely target Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing."
"Are you going to warn those two old foxes about Xereth?" Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow slightly in response to Feng Yao.
"You need their hearts to evolve into the ten-tails, remember?
If they die by his hands, you will never be able to evolve, and the ten-tailed fox will never be reborn in this universe.
If the ten-tailed fox disappears forever, you will never be able to reach the peak of cultivation, and this universe will never be at peace."
Zhang Fei [4] released a soft sigh, and a gate appeared quite far from their location.
However, Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu soon arrived at their side, especially since his first clone deliberately sent them there.
"What can I do for you, Master?" Tian Jianxia asked him.

Zhang Fei [4] told the two female foxes about the situation, and he had one of them open the gate leading to the Heavenly Moon Realm, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing would notice his aura if he did it.
"Feng Yao, you can tell those two old foxes about Xereth."
"All right." As soon as Tian Jianxia opened the gate to the Heavenly Moon Realm, Feng Yao immediately sent a small fire phoenix into the realm, and the female fox closed it again right away.
"They will receive my message soon, and one of them might come here, so you should leave now."
Zhang Fei [4] immediately sent Zhang Yue back to the training space, especially since his Yang Qi was too strong in her body.
After that, he and Feltia [2] took the two female foxes to the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the three quests and met the female demons, who were deliberately left in that realm to train.
Shortly after they left, a gate appeared in another area of the phoenix realm, and Tian Baixing immediately appeared in front of Feng Yao.
Tian Baixing was a little furious at Feng Yao, especially since she still remembered the story of the four foxes who were once tasked to hunt Zhang Fei in the Sky Jade Realm.
They said that the phoenix princess was the one who stopped and drove them out of the realm.
Since the situation was dire, Tian Baixing chose to forget about the matter for now.
"Is the news you gave true, Phoenix Princess?"
"If you want to die, you can ignore my words." Feng Yao indifferently replied to her.
Tian Baixing asked her again.
"How strong is the current Xereth?"

"Even if all the powerful cultivators in the upper realms join forces to attack Xereth, you will all die in his hands." Tian Baixing doubted Feng Yao's words, but the phoenix princess immediately did something she had never imagined before, and she forced the female fox to kneel before her.
"Heh!
Yours and Tian Baitian's cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but you two are still ants in my eyes.
I can kill that demon myself, but I'm not interested in dealing with such trivial matters.
Therefore, I deliberately sent that message to the two of you, and you guys can find a way to deal with him yourselves."
"Hah...
Hah..." Tian Baixing gasped heavily as she looked at Feng Yao in shock.
Never had she imagined that the phoenix princess was actually much stronger than all the cultivators in the upper realms combined.
"Hah...
Who exactly are you?
How can you be this strong even though your cultivation is only at the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm?"
"A mere heavenly fox like you is not worthy of knowing my identity." Feng Yao replied condescendingly to her.
"Go back to your realm now."
Tian Baixing did not ask further, opened the gate to her realm, and disappeared into it.
Huo Ling emerged from Feng Yao's body immediately and inquired.
"Are you leaving this realm soon, Master?"
"Yes." Feng Yao replied with a light nod.
"After I make sure that Xereth can't mess around in the three mortal realms, we will go to the Paradise Realm directly, and we will wait for Zhang Fei there."
Huo Ling was annoyed that Feng Yao kept thinking about Zhang Fei, and she always unconditionally helped him.
"Are you sure you can leave that brat alone?
Even if Xereth can't mess around here, he will probably still face many powerful enemies soon, including Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled.
"I've told you many times not to underestimate Zhang Fei, but you never listen to my words.
He is indeed weak, but he can cover up his weaknesses with his cunningness, speed, and some other things.
Therefore, I don't need to worry about him, and he will succeed in going there.
Moreover, I have to meet someone there, especially since she will play an important role for his future."
"The young miss of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Luo Yunxiao."
"That's right." Feng Yao nodded at Huo Ling.
"Their strength and status are like heaven and earth now, but Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei are childhood friends, making her the right choice to help him once he goes there.
However, her situation doesn't seem good, so I want to meet her first, and I will prepare her for him."
"Master, your feelings for Zhang Fei have blinded your eyes; you have even thought of such far-reaching plans for his sake." After she said that, Huo Ling immediately entered Feng Yao's body again.
Tian Baitian's expression looked serious as he listened to Tian Baixing's story about Feng Yu, but he found it difficult to believe that the phoenix princess could suppress his sister like that.
Tian Baixing immediately shared her memories of when she faced Feng Yao earlier, which shocked Tian Baitian.
"Since she deliberately warned us like that, I believe Xereth's strength should be slightly lower or equal to hers."
"Yes." Tian Baitian asked her.
"Did you ask Feng Yao about the fox who opened the gate for her?"
"I'm sure it's Tian Jianxia, but I can't find her there." Tian Baitian frowned in response.
"I've asked her brother to track her whereabouts, and he will contact me directly once he finds her.
For now, we must focus on Xereth, and we must evacuate our younger generations to another realm, or our race will be wiped out if he succeeds in breaking through our barrier."
"You're right." Tian Baitian then looked up into the sky before shooting something there, and a thick light barrier quickly enveloped their entire realm.
He then declared an emergency to all members of their race, and he ordered them to face the worst.
"Let's prepare to face the demon."

After he helped Huang Rong and the others to improve their cultivation for four days in the training space, Zhang Fei decided to let the seven women rest.
However, the naked Chu Xing immediately approached him and pulled him into her room, making him smile in amusement.
"Are you looking forward to dual cultivating with me again, sister-in-law?"
"We just did it once, and you were busy with them afterward, so I wanted to do it with you again." Chu Xing shamelessly admitted it.
"However, we won't do that now, and I want you to teach me the Lotus Ascension Art first so I can form my Yin Lotus."
"Oh!
That's right!
I forgot you haven't learned that technique yet." Zhang Fei immediately imparted the Lotus Ascension Art to Chu Xing before pulling her onto the bed.
"We will do it by dual cultivating at once, so your cultivation and soul cultivation will increase in harmony."
After Chu Xing agreed, Zhang Fei used his enhanced demon touch on her and connected their genitals directly.
The two of them then released their souls, and he first guided her to learn the Lotus Ascension Art so she would have no trouble forming her Yin Lotus.

chapters.title: Chapter 833: Three Days Later
paragraphs: Chu Xing opened her eyes and looked at the black lotus inside her soul with joy, but it was still in the bud phase. Unlike hers, all the white lotuses inside Zhang Fei's souls already have ten petals under them.
"What are you thinking about?" Zhang Fei asked Chu Xing.
"Them." Chu Xing pointed to all the white lotuses. "How can I bloom my lotus buds?"

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei rubbed Chu Xing's cheeks. "Isn't that easy? You just need to dual soul cultivate with me, and the lotus bud in your soul will bloom by itself. The first will bloom five petals, which is the foundation of the Lotus Ascension Art. At this stage, the circulation of our Yin and Yang Qi will be smoother and faster than before, and our lotuses will strengthen our souls. In the second stage, the number of petals will increase by five, and it helps us better understand the essence of Yin and Yang. Our lotuses will bloom at their peak stage, and they will have 64 petals. At that stage, we will be able to understand the Dao of the Yin Yang, and we may be able to do things beyond reason if we can reach that stage."
"The Dao of Yin Yang?"

Zhang Fei explained to her directly. "The Dao of Yin Yang is the principle of balance between opposites—creation and destruction, light and dark, life and death, male and female. Yin Yang is the basis of all things, be it our existence, the flow that forms this universe, or the source of cultivation; the Dao is the pinnacle of all things, including dual cultivation."

"Oh." Chu Xing then spoke. "In that case, I want to dual soul cultivate with you until my lotus bud blooms with five petals, and I won't be left behind by my sisters and the others, especially since their lotus buds already have five petals."
"Let's continue then."
"Yeah.
Huli Zhishen and Huli Jinhu finally arrived at the Xianjin Realm, especially since their home realm was quite close to it, and the two golden foxes had the ability to accelerate their speed.

Feng Xueying welcomed the arrival of the two, but she clearly did not like Huli Zhishen and was cold to him. However, her attitude was a little softer when talking to Huli Jinhu, especially since both of them were female beasts.
"What is the situation in this realm, Xueying?" Huli Jinhu inquired.

Feng Xueying informed them directly. "I've killed the blood dragon demon, so this realm is safe for now. However, we must remain vigilant, particularly given the potential for Xereth's unexpected appearance in this realm. Based on information from Feng Yao, his strength is much stronger than the combined strength of all of us."
"Are you serious about that? How could Xereth have such high strength?" Huli Zhishen asked in disbelief.
Feng Xueying responded with a shrug. "If you don't believe me, you can fight Xereth if he really comes to this realm."
'Tch! This ice phoenix bitch!' Huli Zhishen clicked his tongue.
"Could it be that the realm beyond the upper realms really exists? Could it be that Xereth discovered the place before us?" Huli Jinhu wondered to herself.

"In fact, that realm really exists, and its entrance is in the middle realms." Huli Zhishen and Huli Jinhu looked at Feng Xueying in shock, and the ice phoenix told them about the tower. "If I recall correctly, your descendant, Huli Xianniang, went to one of the towers along with Feng Jiu and the others."

Huli Jinhu nodded at her. "Xianniang did go with them to the middle realms, but she didn't tell us that the tower was the entrance to that place. Even if she had told us about it, we couldn't have left our realm for so long. However, we should try to go to one of those towers after our business with Xereth is finished, and our cultivation might be able to advance if we go to that realm."
"Let's talk about that later." Thereafter, Feng Xueying took the two ancestors of the golden fox race to his hiding place in the Xianjin Realm, waiting for the Nameless One and the others to return.
Three days later, a flying artifact entered the Xianjin Realm, and they went straight to the Jian Clan. As soon as they arrived there, Jian Wufeng immediately welcomed them.
The first to descend from the flying artifact was a middle-aged man with shoulder-length purple hair and wearing a purple robe. The man was none other than the Poison God, You Shen.

Behind You Shen, a young woman walks gracefully, and her face is a little prettier than Wang Yourou's. However, her build is smaller and slimmer, and she wears a purple shirt combined with a purple skirt, revealing a pair of white and smooth legs. She had a pair of demonic-looking eyes that flashed mysteriously as she blinked.
Three men and a woman leisurely descended behind them, one of whom was the effeminate man that Zhang Fei had met in the Red Sun Realm, Du Yuanjia.
"Wufeng!" You Xinglan called out with her soft voice as she approached Jian Wufeng before hugging him. "I miss you."
"I miss you too, Xinglan." Jian Wufeng then looked at You Shen. "Uncle Shen, I—"
You Shen immediately interrupted. "Kid, my daughter is crazy about you, and you two will get married soon."
"Haha." Jian Wufeng laughed awkwardly. "Father-in-law, welcome to my clan."
You Shen nodded, satisfied with that. "Have they returned to this realm yet?"

"Not yet." Jian Wufeng replied with a shake of his head. "According to the information I have, they should have arrived today. However, they still haven't arrived, so we can only wait for them for now."
You Shen nodded in understanding. "Let's wait for them to arrive then."
"Wufeng, where is that kid?" Jian Wufeng turned to Du Yuanjia, who had asked the question. "You know, Hun Di's newest disciple, he and Lin Moxian should be in this realm, right?"
"Oh, that's right." You Shen just remembered about it. "Is Old Hun's newest disciple really in this realm?"

Jian Wufeng nodded at them. "Zhang Fei is indeed in this realm, and he has been staying here for about two weeks. I haven't seen him for ten days, but he should be staying at Cheng Gaoji's residence with the others."

Hearing that, Du Yuanjia immediately flew toward Cheng Gaoji's residence, confusing You Xinglan and his fellow disciple. "Why is that sissy in such a hurry to go meet that kid? What's so great about that kid?"

"Xinglan, you are too busy with your cultivation and new poisons, so you haven't heard of that kid's actions in recent times." You Xinglan turned to her father directly. "The Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm was destroyed, and that kid did it. He didn't do it alone; the Hong Clan and the other clans helped him to face them. However, I heard that all the plans came from him, and he also arranged everything so they could kill the two clan ancestors."
"Oh." You Xinglan responded flatly as she was not interested in that, and she pulled Jian Wufeng into his clan. "Let's go in; I want to talk a lot with you, especially about our marriage."
"Come in, father-in-law." Jian Wufeng directly led them to enter his clan."
Meanwhile, Du Yuanjia had arrived at Cheng Gaoji's residence, but he couldn't find Zhang Fei there, and he only discovered Lin Moxian, who was chatting with Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan.
"You have finally arrived, Yuanjia."
Du Yuanjia nodded at Lin Moxian. "Where is your junior brother? My master is in the Jian Clan now, and I want to invite that kid to meet him."

"Hey, Yuanjia, don't tell me that you are interested in my junior brother." Du Yuanjia looked at Yan Yinqing. "My junior brother is not an effeminate man like you, and he is a normal man with many wives."

Du Yuanjia shrugged his shoulders. "I am not interested in your junior brother, but I am interested in his knowledge of poison. I have already told my master about him, and he wants to meet him. Therefore, I came here as soon as I heard he was here, but he seems to be away now."

"My junior brother still has other matters to attend to, so he is not here now, but he will be back soon." Lin Moxian then pointed to an empty seat. "We haven't seen each other for a while, so join us for a chat."
"I can't do that because my master is waiting for me, but we will talk again after the danger has passed." Du Yuanjia left them straight after.
After he left, Yan Yinqing asked Lin Moxian. "Where did our junior brother meet him? Why does he seem so eager to meet him again?"

"They met in the Red Sun Realm." Lin Moxian then told Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan about Zhang Fei's meeting with Du Yuanjia. "By the way, the two ancestors of the golden fox race arrived three days ago, and several other mythical beasts will arrive soon. Moreover, the Nameless One and the others will also return soon, so we have to prepare to move against the Huang and Lei Clans."
"All right."

In the Huang Clan, Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang were in bad shape, especially after they swallowed Zhang Fei's pills three days ago. They were sitting together with Lei Xuanfeng, discussing the arrival of You Shen and also the disappearance of the Xiong Clan.
*Bam*

"That bastard Xiong Yehui! He intentionally brought his Xiong Clan members to leave this realm, and he didn't tell us about it in advance." Lei Xuanfeng then asked. "What should we do now? They have betrayed us, and Lord Jiutian still hasn't appeared until now. If we let the situation continue like this, both of our clans will be destroyed in their hands."

Huang Zhejun forced his weak body to stand up. "I actually didn't want to do this, but we have no other choice now, so I will activate the black statue in my clan now. For backup, activate the one in your clan, and they won't be able to stop Lord Xereth from taking over this realm."
"All right, I will return to my clan now."
After Lei Xuanfeng left, Huang Zhejun rushed to the dungeon with his wife. However, as soon as they arrived there, Lei Huiyin immediately attacked him from behind.
"Gah!" Huang Zhejun staggered forward before falling and rolling on the ground. He then glanced at Lei Huiyin and asked a furious question. "What do you mean by this? Why did you attack me?"
"Long Jiutian is dead, and I have poisoned you." Lei Huiyin immediately attacked her husband again, but Huang Zhejun suddenly threw an artifact at her, which instantly trapped her. "Crap!"
Huang Zhejun struggled to his feet and staggered over to his wife. "What actually happened to you? Why did you suddenly betray me?"
"Humph!" Lei Huiyin contacted her daughter and daughter-in-law. "You can lock me up with this artifact, but your plan to summon Xereth will not work, and you will all die soon."

Huang Zhejun was perplexed by Lei Huiyin's sudden change, especially since her attitude was still normal before. He immediately ignored his wife and approached the black demon statue, but several tree branches suddenly came out of the wall and attacked him.

"Shit! Gah!" The tree branches pushed Huang Zhejun away from the black demon statue before wrapping it up. A few other tree branches appeared from the other side of the wall, and they immediately tied his hands and feet, pinning him to the wall.

Huang Zhejun struggled to free himself, but Huang Bingyun and Qin Liangyu suddenly ran into the dungeon. They attacked him head-on, further weakening his body, which was already debilitated by poison.
Qin Liangyu freed her mother-in-law from the artifact, but she threw it at her father-in-law, and it immediately imprisoned him. Lei Huiyin then moved and sealed her husband's cultivation.

"Hahaha!" Huang Zhejun suddenly laughed. "We had prepared everything long ago, but I didn't anticipate that the betrayal of the three of you would destroy everything. Fortunately, I didn't tell all of our plans to the three of you, and Lord Xereth's arrival in this realm would be inevitable."
"What do you mean by that?" Lei Huiyin asked with a frown.
Huang Zhejun grinned widely. "Since the three of you dare to betray us, you guys will die together with those people."
Lei Huiyin did not ask her husband anything further and contacted Zhang Fei directly. "What about Jiguang?"
"I've captured and detained him in the room." Qin Liangyu answered her. "I hope our master will appear soon, or the situation will change again if Xereth comes to this realm."
"Yeah."

At the inn, Tian Shuxiang looked confused about Ye Zhiye's condition; he had tried to quench her lust for three whole days. Unfortunately, her lust did not subside at all, and she became even more lustful.

Tian Shuxiang eventually decided to knock Ye Zhiye unconscious, and he rushed to Cheng Gaoji's residence to see Zhang Fei. However, he had not returned, so the alchemist god decided to wait for him there without explaining anything to Lin Moxian and the two women, confusing the three of them.

After they practiced alchemy with Lin Jingxia for three days, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters back to the training space, especially since the mental strength of the three women was not enough to withstand the presence of so many powerful cultivators at once.
Lin Jingxia, Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Wang Yourou immediately moved to Feng Jiu's flying artifact before the alchemist goddess kept hers.

Everyone's eyes fell on Zhang Xiaolong [3], including the Nameless One. However, Huli Xianniang and several other mythical beasts gave him unusual looks, and they recognized that he was a beast like them, mainly because of his faint beast aura.
Zhang Xialong [3] naturally noticed the gazes of the mythical beasts, but he ignored them and walked straight to Hun Di. "Master, I have come to pick you all up."

"Yes." Hun Di responded with a satisfied nod before patting Zhang Xiaolong's shoulder. "I was not wrong in choosing you as my disciple. In just five months, your soul level has risen from the initial stage to the perfection stage of the earthly soul level. Even I, as your master, cannot do such a thing."

Hun Di's words left the Nameless One and the others beyond shocked. Even though most of them weren't soul cultivators, they knew that breaking through one stage was already difficult, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] broke through three stages in just five months.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched the back of his head. "Master, many people helped me, and I was lucky enough to find something extraordinary in an unknown realm, which helped me break through to this stage."
"Regardless, your progress is amazing, and I will teach you something new after we finish our business with Xereth." Hun Di then asked. "What is the current situation in the Xianjin Realm?"
Instead of Zhang Xiaolong [3], Lin Jingxia explained to Hun Di and the others about the situation in the Xianjin Realm, which relieved them. "We don't have much time, so we should go there now."
"How are we going to the Xianjin Realm?" The Azure Dragon, Long Xiang, asked.
Lin Jinxia pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "This kid will take us there right now."

Long Xiang and the other mythical beasts glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] as soon as he opened the gate to the Xianjin Realm. He actually didn't want to expose his identity in front of them, but he had no other choice since Feng Yao had no intention of stepping in to deal with Xereth, so he was forced to do so to bring them back to the realm. "Let's go in."

However, we should try to go to one of those towers after our business with Xereth is finished, and our cultivation might be able to advance if we go to that realm."
"Let's talk about that later." Thereafter, Feng Xueying took the two ancestors of the golden fox race to his hiding place in the Xianjin Realm, waiting for the Nameless One and the others to return.
Three days later, a flying artifact entered the Xianjin Realm, and they went straight to the Jian Clan.
As soon as they arrived there, Jian Wufeng immediately welcomed them.
The first to descend from the flying artifact was a middle-aged man with shoulder-length purple hair and wearing a purple robe.
The man was none other than the Poison God, You Shen.
Behind You Shen, a young woman walks gracefully, and her face is a little prettier than Wang Yourou's.
However, her build is smaller and slimmer, and she wears a purple shirt combined with a purple skirt, revealing a pair of white and smooth legs.
She had a pair of demonic-looking eyes that flashed mysteriously as she blinked.
Three men and a woman leisurely descended behind them, one of whom was the effeminate man that Zhang Fei had met in the Red Sun Realm, Du Yuanjia.
"Wufeng!" You Xinglan called out with her soft voice as she approached Jian Wufeng before hugging him.
"I miss you."
"I miss you too, Xinglan." Jian Wufeng then looked at You Shen.
"Uncle Shen, I—"
You Shen immediately interrupted.
"Kid, my daughter is crazy about you, and you two will get married soon."
"Haha." Jian Wufeng laughed awkwardly.
"Father-in-law, welcome to my clan."
You Shen nodded, satisfied with that.
"Have they returned to this realm yet?"
"Not yet." Jian Wufeng replied with a shake of his head.
"According to the information I have, they should have arrived today.
However, they still haven't arrived, so we can only wait for them for now."
You Shen nodded in understanding.
"Let's wait for them to arrive then."
"Wufeng, where is that kid?" Jian Wufeng turned to Du Yuanjia, who had asked the question.
"You know, Hun Di's newest disciple, he and Lin Moxian should be in this realm, right?"
"Oh, that's right." You Shen just remembered about it.
"Is Old Hun's newest disciple really in this realm?"
Jian Wufeng nodded at them.
"Zhang Fei is indeed in this realm, and he has been staying here for about two weeks.
I haven't seen him for ten days, but he should be staying at Cheng Gaoji's residence with the others."
Hearing that, Du Yuanjia immediately flew toward Cheng Gaoji's residence, confusing You Xinglan and his fellow disciple.
"Why is that sissy in such a hurry to go meet that kid?
What's so great about that kid?"
"Xinglan, you are too busy with your cultivation and new poisons, so you haven't heard of that kid's actions in recent times." You Xinglan turned to her father directly.
"The Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm was destroyed, and that kid did it.
He didn't do it alone; the Hong Clan and the other clans helped him to face them.
However, I heard that all the plans came from him, and he also arranged everything so they could kill the two clan ancestors."
"Oh." You Xinglan responded flatly as she was not interested in that, and she pulled Jian Wufeng into his clan.
"Let's go in; I want to talk a lot with you, especially about our marriage."
"Come in, father-in-law." Jian Wufeng directly led them to enter his clan."
Meanwhile, Du Yuanjia had arrived at Cheng Gaoji's residence, but he couldn't find Zhang Fei there, and he only discovered Lin Moxian, who was chatting with Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan.
"You have finally arrived, Yuanjia."
Du Yuanjia nodded at Lin Moxian.
"Where is your junior brother?
My master is in the Jian Clan now, and I want to invite that kid to meet him."
"Hey, Yuanjia, don't tell me that you are interested in my junior brother." Du Yuanjia looked at Yan Yinqing.
"My junior brother is not an effeminate man like you, and he is a normal man with many wives."
Du Yuanjia shrugged his shoulders.
"I am not interested in your junior brother, but I am interested in his knowledge of poison.
I have already told my master about him, and he wants to meet him.
Therefore, I came here as soon as I heard he was here, but he seems to be away now."
"My junior brother still has other matters to attend to, so he is not here now, but he will be back soon." Lin Moxian then pointed to an empty seat.
"We haven't seen each other for a while, so join us for a chat."
"I can't do that because my master is waiting for me, but we will talk again after the danger has passed." Du Yuanjia left them straight after.
After he left, Yan Yinqing asked Lin Moxian.
"Where did our junior brother meet him?
Why does he seem so eager to meet him again?"
"They met in the Red Sun Realm." Lin Moxian then told Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan about Zhang Fei's meeting with Du Yuanjia.
"By the way, the two ancestors of the golden fox race arrived three days ago, and several other mythical beasts will arrive soon.
Moreover, the Nameless One and the others will also return soon, so we have to prepare to move against the Huang and Lei Clans."
"All right."
In the Huang Clan, Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang were in bad shape, especially after they swallowed Zhang Fei's pills three days ago.
They were sitting together with Lei Xuanfeng, discussing the arrival of You Shen and also the disappearance of the Xiong Clan.
*Bam*
"That bastard Xiong Yehui!
He intentionally brought his Xiong Clan members to leave this realm, and he didn't tell us about it in advance." Lei Xuanfeng then asked.
"What should we do now?
They have betrayed us, and Lord Jiutian still hasn't appeared until now.
If we let the situation continue like this, both of our clans will be destroyed in their hands."
Huang Zhejun forced his weak body to stand up.
"I actually didn't want to do this, but we have no other choice now, so I will activate the black statue in my clan now.
For backup, activate the one in your clan, and they won't be able to stop Lord Xereth from taking over this realm."
"All right, I will return to my clan now."
After Lei Xuanfeng left, Huang Zhejun rushed to the dungeon with his wife.
However, as soon as they arrived there, Lei Huiyin immediately attacked him from behind.
"Gah!" Huang Zhejun staggered forward before falling and rolling on the ground.
He then glanced at Lei Huiyin and asked a furious question.
"What do you mean by this?
Why did you attack me?"
"Long Jiutian is dead, and I have poisoned you." Lei Huiyin immediately attacked her husband again, but Huang Zhejun suddenly threw an artifact at her, which instantly trapped her.
"Crap!"
Huang Zhejun struggled to his feet and staggered over to his wife.
"What actually happened to you?
Why did you suddenly betray me?"
"Humph!" Lei Huiyin contacted her daughter and daughter-in-law.
"You can lock me up with this artifact, but your plan to summon Xereth will not work, and you will all die soon."
Huang Zhejun was perplexed by Lei Huiyin's sudden change, especially since her attitude was still normal before.
He immediately ignored his wife and approached the black demon statue, but several tree branches suddenly came out of the wall and attacked him.
"Shit!
Gah!" The tree branches pushed Huang Zhejun away from the black demon statue before wrapping it up.
A few other tree branches appeared from the other side of the wall, and they immediately tied his hands and feet, pinning him to the wall.
Huang Zhejun struggled to free himself, but Huang Bingyun and Qin Liangyu suddenly ran into the dungeon.
They attacked him head-on, further weakening his body, which was already debilitated by poison.
Qin Liangyu freed her mother-in-law from the artifact, but she threw it at her father-in-law, and it immediately imprisoned him.
Lei Huiyin then moved and sealed her husband's cultivation.
"Hahaha!" Huang Zhejun suddenly laughed.
"We had prepared everything long ago, but I didn't anticipate that the betrayal of the three of you would destroy everything.
Fortunately, I didn't tell all of our plans to the three of you, and Lord Xereth's arrival in this realm would be inevitable."
"What do you mean by that?" Lei Huiyin asked with a frown.
Huang Zhejun grinned widely.
"Since the three of you dare to betray us, you guys will die together with those people."
Lei Huiyin did not ask her husband anything further and contacted Zhang Fei directly.
"What about Jiguang?"
"I've captured and detained him in the room." Qin Liangyu answered her.
"I hope our master will appear soon, or the situation will change again if Xereth comes to this realm."
"Yeah."
At the inn, Tian Shuxiang looked confused about Ye Zhiye's condition; he had tried to quench her lust for three whole days.
Unfortunately, her lust did not subside at all, and she became even more lustful.
Tian Shuxiang eventually decided to knock Ye Zhiye unconscious, and he rushed to Cheng Gaoji's residence to see Zhang Fei.
However, he had not returned, so the alchemist god decided to wait for him there without explaining anything to Lin Moxian and the two women, confusing the three of them.

After they practiced alchemy with Lin Jingxia for three days, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters back to the training space, especially since the mental strength of the three women was not enough to withstand the presence of so many powerful cultivators at once.
Lin Jingxia, Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Wang Yourou immediately moved to Feng Jiu's flying artifact before the alchemist goddess kept hers.
Everyone's eyes fell on Zhang Xiaolong [3], including the Nameless One.
However, Huli Xianniang and several other mythical beasts gave him unusual looks, and they recognized that he was a beast like them, mainly because of his faint beast aura.
Zhang Xialong [3] naturally noticed the gazes of the mythical beasts, but he ignored them and walked straight to Hun Di.
"Master, I have come to pick you all up."
"Yes." Hun Di responded with a satisfied nod before patting Zhang Xiaolong's shoulder.
"I was not wrong in choosing you as my disciple.
In just five months, your soul level has risen from the initial stage to the perfection stage of the earthly soul level.
Even I, as your master, cannot do such a thing."
Hun Di's words left the Nameless One and the others beyond shocked.
Even though most of them weren't soul cultivators, they knew that breaking through one stage was already difficult, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] broke through three stages in just five months.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched the back of his head.
"Master, many people helped me, and I was lucky enough to find something extraordinary in an unknown realm, which helped me break through to this stage."
"Regardless, your progress is amazing, and I will teach you something new after we finish our business with Xereth." Hun Di then asked.
"What is the current situation in the Xianjin Realm?"
Instead of Zhang Xiaolong [3], Lin Jingxia explained to Hun Di and the others about the situation in the Xianjin Realm, which relieved them.
"We don't have much time, so we should go there now."
"How are we going to the Xianjin Realm?" The Azure Dragon, Long Xiang, asked.
Lin Jinxia pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"This kid will take us there right now."
Long Xiang and the other mythical beasts glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] as soon as he opened the gate to the Xianjin Realm.

He actually didn't want to expose his identity in front of them, but he had no other choice since Feng Yao had no intention of stepping in to deal with Xereth, so he was forced to do so to bring them back to the realm.
"Let's go in."

chapters.title: Chapter 834: Nameless One's True Identity
paragraphs: As soon as the Nameless One and the others came out of the gate, Tian Shuxiang, Feng Xueying, Huli Zhizhen, Huli Jinhu, and You Shen appeared in front of them.
Before any of them could speak, the Nameless One had already moved them to a large room. He also asked Guan Chenhong, Wang Zhemin, and a few others to meet him immediately.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt a little jealous of the Nameless One. 'His void element sure is interesting. Scan him and his beast, Mei.'
[Wait a second, Master.]

'Zhe Wuming is his real name, huh? I didn't expect him to have four other elements besides the void element, and one of them is metal.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised by Xue Bao's status. 'Tch! Even his pet has the void element! However, his soul-related abilities make him a more suitable disciple of Master Hun.'
Suddenly, someone tugged at the corner of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s sleeve, so he turned back and looked at Shang Yaolin, who was looking at him with a questioning expression.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh and pulled Shang Yaolin with him, but young cultivators like Tie Xuan and the others followed them, especially since all of them were curious about his true identity. So far, only Murong Mengying, Qiao Liangren, Shang Yingyue, and Wu Xueming know his true identity.

The mythical beasts, such as Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Huli Xianniang, Zhu Hong, Wang Wugui, Nu Shen, and Fu Xin, were also curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity, especially after he used the gate, which was a special ability of the Heavenly Fox Race. However, they restrained themselves from meeting him, especially since Zhe Wuming's expression was so serious.
Unlike them, Feng Jiu repeatedly glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a smile on her face, making Feng Tian smile helplessly, knowing his wife's thoughts.

Before long, Guan Chenhong, Wang Zhemin, and a few others had arrived at that place. Zhe Wuming immediately led the discussion to determine their next steps to anticipate attacks from Xereth and his subordinates.

On the other side of the area, Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Shang Yaolin and the others about his true identity, but he didn't tell them about his current realm or the identities of those closest to him in detail.
"So, you're 20 years old now?" Shang Yaolin was disappointed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] lied to her to such an extent.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly spoke to her. "I know I lied to you about my real identity, but I had no other choice because I wanted to destroy Shang Huaqiang, which has been achieved now. However, I did not lie to you about my feelings for you, and I like you."

"Is that so? Do you think I can trust you again after you lied to me once?" Shang Yaolin's voice sounded bitter when she asked that. "My feelings were sincere to you, but you lied to me to achieve your ambition of destroying Shang Huaqiang."
Shang Yingyue wanted to talk to Shang Yaolin, but Wu Xueming stopped her and asked her to let Zhang Xiaolong [3] settle things between them by himself.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed Shang Yaolin by the shoulders. "I'm not asking you to trust me, and I'm asking you to give me a chance to prove my feelings for you."
Shang Yaolin swatted away Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand directly. "For now, I would rather not see or talk to you, and I want to calm myself down first."
Shang Yaolin ran to an area not far from them. She sat there, hugged her legs, and buried her face in her knees. Within seconds, they could hear the sound of her sobbing.
Shang Yingyue let out a soft sigh and caught up with Shang Yaolin, and she sat by her junior sister's side, hugging her silently.
"Are you going to let Yaolin be sad like that?" Miao Mio asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Let her vent her sadness first, and I will talk to her again later." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked them. "So how was your adventure in the Sun Tower? Did you all get many good things there?"
"Hahaha!" Tie Xuan laughed and patted his shoulder. "Since we went with Senior Hun Di and the others, we managed to reach the fifth floor, and we all got many valuable things there."
"In fact, we were about to continue to the sixth floor, but those two old people suddenly came to see us and conveyed your message." Lai Minhua added.

Murong Mengying suddenly took out a piece of parchment and showed it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I found the parchment in a pile of corpses on the second floor, and I thought it was a fragment of a map. Unfortunately, I didn't find any other pieces on the third to fifth floors, so I don't know what kind of map this is."
"Let me see it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] took it from Murong Mengying's hand before taking out his own, and the two parchments instantly fused by themselves, triggering a notification in his mind.
[Ding]
[Obtained 2/6 map fragments of the Temple of Forgotten Flames.]
"Eh?" Murong Mengying and the others were shocked to see that. "Did you get your piece at the Star Tower?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] got his map fragment from the system quest, but he couldn't possibly tell them about it. "You're right, I got mine from the first floor of the Star Tower. However, these two map fragments haven't shown anything clear yet, so they're still useless to us now, and we have to find some other fragments."
"I see." Murong Mengying nodded understandingly. "You can keep my fragment, but you must take me to the map's indicated location in the future."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled Murong Mengying into his embrace and gave her a kiss, stunning those young generation cultivators. "You are my woman, so I will take you to that place."
Murong Mengying gently pushed Zhang Xiaolong [3] back. "You are too narcissistic! I have never agreed to be your woman, so don't talk carelessly about that."
'She's a liar!' Tie Xuan and the others screamed in their hearts, especially since Murong Mengying was clearly enjoying her kiss with Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and grabbed Murong Mengying's cheek. "Have you forgotten that our souls have merged into one? You can lie to others, but you can't lie to me, especially since I can see everything from your soul."
"Humph." Murong Mengying snorted softly and turned her face to the side, glaring at Miao Miao and the others, who were laughing at her.

"Do you know that person?" Tie Xuan suddenly asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] while pointing at the middle-aged man in Zhe Wuming's group. "He is Ji Changlan, the leader of the Blacksmith Union. If you need forging materials, you can go see him with my Tie Clan plaque, and he will help you provide them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Ji Changlan directly. "I've heard about him when I participated in the blacksmith competition, and I came here with Senior Brother Moxian specifically to meet him. However, we accidentally discovered the relationship between the Xiong Clan and Long Jiutian, so we investigated them further, and we found out that the Huang Clan was the main culprit. Huang Zhejun was the first to have a relationship with that demon, and he even gave the three women in his family to him."
"Did Huang Zhejun really do something that crazy?" Huo Qiubing asked in shock.

"Do I need to lie about that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] had never liked Huo Qiubing because his name had always been red on the map until now. "Huang Zhejun sent people to kidnap me and Senior Sister Moxian, and we learned about the relationship between the three women and Long Jiutian because of it. We also found a black demon statue in the basement of his clan, and Xereth can come to this realm at any time through that statue."
"Do you think Xereth appeared in this realm?" Hao Weizen asked.

"Destruction." Zhang Xiaolong's [3] answer made their expressions turn serious, especially since they had heard Feng Jiu and the others' conversation on the flying artifact a few days ago. "Even if the Nameless One and the others join forces, they won't be able to defeat Xereth, and the only way to delay the danger is to get rid of that statue. Unfortunately, there's another statue in the Lei Clan, so they must act quickly."
Qiao Liangren then spoke. "If Xereth's power is really that high, I'm sure he's been to that place before."

"You are right, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "Xereth has indeed been there before, and he brought his subordinates there. His cultivation had already broken through to the stage after the Seven Divine Realms, but his subordinates' cultivation was still at the Divine Ascension Realm."
"What is the name of that cultivation stage?"

"The Five Celestial Realms: each stage has three minor stages, 1 Sun to 3 Sun." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained the five stages to them as Feng Yao had previously described. "Since you already know about my relationship with the people in the Star Tower, you don't need to be surprised if I know them, especially since they told me about them."
They all nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Wu Xueming spoke to him. "After matters in this realm are settled, Yingyue and I want to meet our daughter."

"Lianzhi always misses you two too, so I will take you to meet him later." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at Tian Shuixiang, who was walking towards them. 'Haha! He must be aware that I did that to Ye Zhiye.'
"Can you give me the antidote?" Tian Shuixiang asked without beating around the bush.

"Senior, I don't have the antidote." Tian Shuixiang frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "If you want to cure her, you have to take me to see her. It's not poison; it's the effect of my defensive ability, so only I can dispel it."

"We will go to the Huang and Lei clans now, and I will take you to see her later." After saying that, Tian Shuixiang immediately left them and returned to the other senior cultivators' side, at which point Zhe Wuming took them all and disappeared from that place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate. "Since the Nameless One and the others will take care of them, we don't need to interfere in this matter, and you guys can go to the inn to rest first."

All of them immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since they had barely rested at the Sun Tower for months. Therefore, they wanted to rest their bodies and minds, and they hurriedly left the place through the gate.
Shang Yingyue brought her junior sister with her and her husband, but Shang Yaolin still didn't want to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
After they exited the gate, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Murong Mengying, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, and Shang Yaolin to Cheng Gaoji's residence.
"Yo! Long time no see, Yingyue and Liangren." Lin Moxian immediately greeted the two juniors.

On the other hand, Yan Yinqing immediately approached Shang Yingyue and hugged her arm. She looked at Shang Yaolin, who was still sad, and took the two of them away directly to an empty room. Wu Xueming immediately followed them, but he went to another room.
"I didn't expect to meet you here, first brother." Qiao Liangren immediately sat down in front of Lin Moxian.
Lin Moxian pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I brought our junior brother to this realm to see Ji Changlan, but we found a serious problem here instead."

"I see." Qiao Liangren nodded in understanding. "I don't know what will happen next, but our master and the others should be able to handle this matter, and I hope there won't be any major chaos here."
"I hope so."
"Senior brothers, I'll go take care of something first." Without waiting for their reply, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from their sight.
Lin Moxian could only shake his head at that. "Your eyes are sharp, Liangren. If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have such a junior brother, and all his actions really amaze me."
"Not really." Qiao Liangren replied by shaking his head. "If Yaolin hadn't brought him to the Wasteland Realm, I would never have met him, and he would never have become our junior brother."
After that, Qiao Liangren and Lin Moxian talked about many other things, most of which were about Zhang Xiaolong [3].

When they arrived at the Huang Clan, Zhe Wuming, Feng Jiu, and several others found the clan members sleeping in various places. They immediately went to the dungeon to check the black demon statue, where they found Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang tied to the wall in an unconscious state. However, they could not find Lei Huiyin, Qin Liangyu, and Huang Bingyun anywhere, especially since Zhang Fei's other clone had already taken them away to the Yin-Yang Space.
"Check this statue and find a way to move it as soon as possible." Gong Ren immediately followed Zhe Wuming's orders. "Where did those three women go? Why aren't they anywhere in this clan?"
"Perhaps there is a secret place in this clan, so we will search for it now." Feng Tian and several others spread out to check the entire area of the Huang Clan.
"What are your plans for these two people?" Feng Jiu pointed to Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang.
Zhe Wuming immediately approached the two men, but Xue Bao right away spoke to him. "Master, I haven't enjoyed human souls for a long time; let me eat the souls of these two men."

"We don't yet have information about Xereth's true plans for our realm, and we still have to find the other clans who have submitted to him, so we still need them alive." Zhe Wuming then turned to Feng Jiu. "Is Zhang Fei a member of the Heavenly Fox Race?"

"Not really." Feng Jiu replied with a shake of her head. "Zhang Fei is indeed a Heavenly Fox, but he is not part of them. In fact, they are hunting him for a reason, but my daughter didn't tell me the details."
Zhe Wuming nodded slightly. "Feng Jiu, I want to talk to that kid, so please bring him to see me later."
"All right."
Meanwhile, Long Qiang and the others had already arrived in front of the Lei Clan, but the clan was covered by a powerful barrier. "Are any of you able to break this barrier?"

"Let me try it." Xia Tian said as he took out a needle-like artifact, but the size was as big as a man's arm. "Hehe! I found this golden piercing needle in a distant realm, and it should be able to break this barrier."
*Boom*
As Xia Tian expected, the barrier exploded as soon as he stuck the needle there. "Let's enter and capture them."
