So far, only Murong Mengying, Qiao Liangren, Shang Yingyue, and Wu Xueming know his true identity.

The mythical beasts, such as Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Huli Xianniang, Zhu Hong, Wang Wugui, Nu Shen, and Fu Xin, were also curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity, especially after he used the gate, which was a special ability of the Heavenly Fox Race.
However, they restrained themselves from meeting him, especially since Zhe Wuming's expression was so serious.
Unlike them, Feng Jiu repeatedly glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a smile on her face, making Feng Tian smile helplessly, knowing his wife's thoughts.
Before long, Guan Chenhong, Wang Zhemin, and a few others had arrived at that place.
Zhe Wuming immediately led the discussion to determine their next steps to anticipate attacks from Xereth and his subordinates.

On the other side of the area, Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Shang Yaolin and the others about his true identity, but he didn't tell them about his current realm or the identities of those closest to him in detail.
"So, you're 20 years old now?" Shang Yaolin was disappointed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] lied to her to such an extent.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly spoke to her.
"I know I lied to you about my real identity, but I had no other choice because I wanted to destroy Shang Huaqiang, which has been achieved now.
However, I did not lie to you about my feelings for you, and I like you."
"Is that so?
Do you think I can trust you again after you lied to me once?" Shang Yaolin's voice sounded bitter when she asked that.
"My feelings were sincere to you, but you lied to me to achieve your ambition of destroying Shang Huaqiang."
Shang Yingyue wanted to talk to Shang Yaolin, but Wu Xueming stopped her and asked her to let Zhang Xiaolong [3] settle things between them by himself.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed Shang Yaolin by the shoulders.
"I'm not asking you to trust me, and I'm asking you to give me a chance to prove my feelings for you."
Shang Yaolin swatted away Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand directly.
"For now, I would rather not see or talk to you, and I want to calm myself down first."
Shang Yaolin ran to an area not far from them.
She sat there, hugged her legs, and buried her face in her knees.
Within seconds, they could hear the sound of her sobbing.
Shang Yingyue let out a soft sigh and caught up with Shang Yaolin, and she sat by her junior sister's side, hugging her silently.
"Are you going to let Yaolin be sad like that?" Miao Mio asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Let her vent her sadness first, and I will talk to her again later." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked them.
"So how was your adventure in the Sun Tower?
Did you all get many good things there?"
"Hahaha!" Tie Xuan laughed and patted his shoulder.
"Since we went with Senior Hun Di and the others, we managed to reach the fifth floor, and we all got many valuable things there."
"In fact, we were about to continue to the sixth floor, but those two old people suddenly came to see us and conveyed your message." Lai Minhua added.
Murong Mengying suddenly took out a piece of parchment and showed it to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I found the parchment in a pile of corpses on the second floor, and I thought it was a fragment of a map.
Unfortunately, I didn't find any other pieces on the third to fifth floors, so I don't know what kind of map this is."
"Let me see it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] took it from Murong Mengying's hand before taking out his own, and the two parchments instantly fused by themselves, triggering a notification in his mind.
[Ding]
[Obtained 2/6 map fragments of the Temple of Forgotten Flames.]
"Eh?" Murong Mengying and the others were shocked to see that.
"Did you get your piece at the Star Tower?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] got his map fragment from the system quest, but he couldn't possibly tell them about it.
"You're right, I got mine from the first floor of the Star Tower.
However, these two map fragments haven't shown anything clear yet, so they're still useless to us now, and we have to find some other fragments."
"I see." Murong Mengying nodded understandingly.
"You can keep my fragment, but you must take me to the map's indicated location in the future."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled Murong Mengying into his embrace and gave her a kiss, stunning those young generation cultivators.
"You are my woman, so I will take you to that place."
Murong Mengying gently pushed Zhang Xiaolong [3] back.
"You are too narcissistic!
I have never agreed to be your woman, so don't talk carelessly about that."
'She's a liar!' Tie Xuan and the others screamed in their hearts, especially since Murong Mengying was clearly enjoying her kiss with Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and grabbed Murong Mengying's cheek.
"Have you forgotten that our souls have merged into one?
You can lie to others, but you can't lie to me, especially since I can see everything from your soul."
"Humph." Murong Mengying snorted softly and turned her face to the side, glaring at Miao Miao and the others, who were laughing at her.
"Do you know that person?" Tie Xuan suddenly asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] while pointing at the middle-aged man in Zhe Wuming's group.
"He is Ji Changlan, the leader of the Blacksmith Union.
If you need forging materials, you can go see him with my Tie Clan plaque, and he will help you provide them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Ji Changlan directly.
"I've heard about him when I participated in the blacksmith competition, and I came here with Senior Brother Moxian specifically to meet him.
However, we accidentally discovered the relationship between the Xiong Clan and Long Jiutian, so we investigated them further, and we found out that the Huang Clan was the main culprit.
Huang Zhejun was the first to have a relationship with that demon, and he even gave the three women in his family to him."
"Did Huang Zhejun really do something that crazy?" Huo Qiubing asked in shock.
"Do I need to lie about that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] had never liked Huo Qiubing because his name had always been red on the map until now.
"Huang Zhejun sent people to kidnap me and Senior Sister Moxian, and we learned about the relationship between the three women and Long Jiutian because of it.
We also found a black demon statue in the basement of his clan, and Xereth can come to this realm at any time through that statue."
"Do you think Xereth appeared in this realm?" Hao Weizen asked.
"Destruction." Zhang Xiaolong's [3] answer made their expressions turn serious, especially since they had heard Feng Jiu and the others' conversation on the flying artifact a few days ago.
"Even if the Nameless One and the others join forces, they won't be able to defeat Xereth, and the only way to delay the danger is to get rid of that statue.
Unfortunately, there's another statue in the Lei Clan, so they must act quickly."
Qiao Liangren then spoke.
"If Xereth's power is really that high, I'm sure he's been to that place before."
"You are right, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod.
"Xereth has indeed been there before, and he brought his subordinates there.
His cultivation had already broken through to the stage after the Seven Divine Realms, but his subordinates' cultivation was still at the Divine Ascension Realm."
"What is the name of that cultivation stage?"
"The Five Celestial Realms: each stage has three minor stages, 1 Sun to 3 Sun." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained the five stages to them as Feng Yao had previously described.
"Since you already know about my relationship with the people in the Star Tower, you don't need to be surprised if I know them, especially since they told me about them."
They all nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Wu Xueming spoke to him.
"After matters in this realm are settled, Yingyue and I want to meet our daughter."
"Lianzhi always misses you two too, so I will take you to meet him later." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at Tian Shuixiang, who was walking towards them. 'Haha!
He must be aware that I did that to Ye Zhiye.'
"Can you give me the antidote?" Tian Shuixiang asked without beating around the bush.
"Senior, I don't have the antidote." Tian Shuixiang frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"If you want to cure her, you have to take me to see her.
It's not poison; it's the effect of my defensive ability, so only I can dispel it."

"We will go to the Huang and Lei clans now, and I will take you to see her later." After saying that, Tian Shuixiang immediately left them and returned to the other senior cultivators' side, at which point Zhe Wuming took them all and disappeared from that place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the gate.
"Since the Nameless One and the others will take care of them, we don't need to interfere in this matter, and you guys can go to the inn to rest first."
All of them immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since they had barely rested at the Sun Tower for months.
Therefore, they wanted to rest their bodies and minds, and they hurriedly left the place through the gate.
Shang Yingyue brought her junior sister with her and her husband, but Shang Yaolin still didn't want to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
After they exited the gate, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Murong Mengying, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, and Shang Yaolin to Cheng Gaoji's residence.
"Yo!
Long time no see, Yingyue and Liangren." Lin Moxian immediately greeted the two juniors.
On the other hand, Yan Yinqing immediately approached Shang Yingyue and hugged her arm.
She looked at Shang Yaolin, who was still sad, and took the two of them away directly to an empty room.
Wu Xueming immediately followed them, but he went to another room.
"I didn't expect to meet you here, first brother." Qiao Liangren immediately sat down in front of Lin Moxian.
Lin Moxian pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I brought our junior brother to this realm to see Ji Changlan, but we found a serious problem here instead."
"I see." Qiao Liangren nodded in understanding.
"I don't know what will happen next, but our master and the others should be able to handle this matter, and I hope there won't be any major chaos here."
"I hope so."
"Senior brothers, I'll go take care of something first." Without waiting for their reply, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from their sight.
Lin Moxian could only shake his head at that.
"Your eyes are sharp, Liangren.
If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have such a junior brother, and all his actions really amaze me."
"Not really." Qiao Liangren replied by shaking his head.
"If Yaolin hadn't brought him to the Wasteland Realm, I would never have met him, and he would never have become our junior brother."
After that, Qiao Liangren and Lin Moxian talked about many other things, most of which were about Zhang Xiaolong [3].
When they arrived at the Huang Clan, Zhe Wuming, Feng Jiu, and several others found the clan members sleeping in various places.
They immediately went to the dungeon to check the black demon statue, where they found Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang tied to the wall in an unconscious state.
However, they could not find Lei Huiyin, Qin Liangyu, and Huang Bingyun anywhere, especially since Zhang Fei's other clone had already taken them away to the Yin-Yang Space.
"Check this statue and find a way to move it as soon as possible." Gong Ren immediately followed Zhe Wuming's orders.
"Where did those three women go?
Why aren't they anywhere in this clan?"
"Perhaps there is a secret place in this clan, so we will search for it now." Feng Tian and several others spread out to check the entire area of the Huang Clan.
"What are your plans for these two people?" Feng Jiu pointed to Huang Zhejun and Huang Jiguang.
Zhe Wuming immediately approached the two men, but Xue Bao right away spoke to him.
"Master, I haven't enjoyed human souls for a long time; let me eat the souls of these two men."

"We don't yet have information about Xereth's true plans for our realm, and we still have to find the other clans who have submitted to him, so we still need them alive." Zhe Wuming then turned to Feng Jiu.
"Is Zhang Fei a member of the Heavenly Fox Race?"
"Not really." Feng Jiu replied with a shake of her head.
"Zhang Fei is indeed a Heavenly Fox, but he is not part of them.
In fact, they are hunting him for a reason, but my daughter didn't tell me the details."
Zhe Wuming nodded slightly.
"Feng Jiu, I want to talk to that kid, so please bring him to see me later."
"All right."
Meanwhile, Long Qiang and the others had already arrived in front of the Lei Clan, but the clan was covered by a powerful barrier.
"Are any of you able to break this barrier?"
"Let me try it." Xia Tian said as he took out a needle-like artifact, but the size was as big as a man's arm.
"Hehe!
I found this golden piercing needle in a distant realm, and it should be able to break this barrier."
*Boom*
As Xia Tian expected, the barrier exploded as soon as he stuck the needle there.
"Let's enter and capture them."

chapters.title: Chapter 835 835: Talk With Xia Tian
paragraphs: Xia Tian and the others charged into the Lei Clan, but they could not find Lei Xuanfeng and the main members of the clan, and they only discovered the black demon statue that was already half-activated. In the same room, they find traces of a teleportation portal.
"Shit! We're late." Long Qiang cursed irritably.
Zhu Hong and the other mythical beasts were also furious about their failure to capture Lei Xuanfeng, preventing them from seeking information about Xereth's other plans.
"Hey! Check this statue." Cheng Gaoji and Ji Changlan approached Xia Tian, who was standing in front of the black demon statue. "Can you do something about this statue, Old Cheng?"

Cheng Gaoji examined every side of the statue before giving his answer. "Even though my abilities are not as good as Gong Ren's, I can still do something to get rid of this statue. However, I can't do it right away, and I need to prepare some materials for that."
"What materials do you need, Old Cheng?" Cheng Gaoji told Ji Changlan about all the materials he needed. "My shop should have all those materials; I will go over there to get them."
After Ji Changlan left, Cheng Gaoji and Xia Tian examined the black statue again, looking for an easier method to remove it from their realm.

Meanwhile, the mythical beasts were waiting in the front room. Dai Hubai then asked the others. "Do you guys think Zhang Fei is a Heavenly Fox? How can he disguise his beast aura so neatly? If we weren't mythical beasts, we wouldn't be able to recognize his identity."
"Why are you asking something so obvious, Old Dai?" Long Qiang responded with a shake of his head. "In this universe, only the Heavenly Fox Race has the ability to create the gate."

Wang Wugui nodded in agreement with the azure dragon. "Fortunately, he is a member of that fox race, or we would have arrived in this realm too late. Even the Nameless One, who possesses the void element, could not have brought us back here this early."
"Hey! You look down on my future husband too much, Old Tortoise!" Huli Xianniang protested angrily.
"Didn't I speak the truth?" Wang Wugui responded with a shrug of his shoulders. "If the Nameless One could have brought us back here, we would have arrived here a week ago."
"You—"

"Stop it, Xianniang." Zhu Hong, the vermilion bird, interceded for them. "I know you love the Nameless One, but Wang Wugui is stating the fact, so don't be angry. Rather than thinking about that, I'm more curious about Zhang Fei's reason for helping the humans, and I feel that he has an ulterior motive."

"I agree with you, Hong." Nu Shen, the Nian beast, said it with a nod. "We all know Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are too arrogant and hate humans. Thus, they will never allow their race members to help humans, so I also feel that Zhang Fei has a certain motive for helping us."
"Could it be that Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are plotting with Xereth?"
"What a foolish question!" Zhu Hong and others shouted at Fu Xin, the mythical deer beast. "If those two old foxes conspire with that demon, then the sky will definitely fall!"
Fu Xin pouted her lips in response. "Then, what do they mean by sending Zhang Fei to help the humans?"

Although the mythical beasts were talking outside, their voices reached Cheng Gaoji's and Xia Tian's ears, causing the two old men to laugh to themselves, especially since they already knew that Zhang Fei was not part of the Heavenly Fox Race.
Huli Zhizhen and Huli Jinhu suddenly appeared at that place. Huli Xianniang and the others immediately greeted the two, especially since they were seniors to them.
"Did you guys manage to find the way to that place in the Sun Tower?"

"No." Huli Xianniang explained to Huli Zhizhen and Huli Jinhu about the situation in the Sun Tower, and the other mythical beasts supported her words. "Ancestors, Zhang Fei should know the key to going to that place, especially since he had a good relationship with those people. If it weren't for him, we would never know that the upper realms were facing great danger. He asked someone on duty at the Star Tower to contact those two elders, and they were the ones who informed us about Xereth."
"That kid should be a Heavenly Fox, right, wife?" Huli Zhizhen asked his wife.

Huli Jinhu nodded at him. "Zhang Fei is indeed a Heavenly Fox, and she was the one who asked Feng Shen to meet us. In fact, he came to our realm together with Old Shen, and I met him at that time. However, you didn't notice his presence, especially since he was in an invisible state."

"Hmm?" Huli Zhizhen frowned in response. "Could it be that Zhang Fei is the son of Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing? As far as I can remember, only both of them have such an ability in their race, so I guessed that way."
"That's impossible." Huli Jinhu immediately denied it. "All of Tian Baitian's and Tian Baixing's descendants are old, and they have no more children after them."

Huli Xianniang immediately spoke to them. "Ancestors, instead of guessing about Zhang Fei's identity, why don't we go see him directly? If we talk to him, we will know more clearly about his identity and motives."
"Let's first resolve this issue, and once everything is in order, we'll meet Zhang Fei for a conversation." Huli Jinhu then walked away from the place, followed by Huang Zhizhen.

"Hey, Zhang Fei is quite interesting and talented." Huli Xianniang, Zhu Hong, and Fu Xin immediately turned to Nu Shen with raised eyebrows. "He's only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Heaven Realm. Moreover, he's Hun Di's youngest disciple, and he managed to reach the perfection stage of the earthly soul level so quickly. Additionally, I'm sure he is also a body cultivator like me, and his body cultivation level has probably already reached the third stage. Compared with him, the younger generations of our races are nothing."
"Don't tell me that you like Zhang Fei?" Huli Xianniang suspiciously asked. Zhu Hong and Fu Xin also felt suspicious of Nu Shen.
Unlike them, the three male mythical beasts, especially the azure dragon, Long Qiang, looked serious. 'Tch! If that brat dares to approach Nu Shen, I will eat him and the people around him alive.'

"What are you saying, Xianniang? Don't you already know the rules of my race?" Nu Shen immediately denied it. "We, Nian beasts, cannot carelessly establish relationships with any living creatures. Our soulmates are predetermined by several things, and we will perish if we violate them. As for me, I don't like my life being ruled by unknown things, but I'm also afraid of violating them, so I prefer to live in solitude."
Huli Xianniang then walked away. "Since the Lei clan members have fled, I will go to my future husband's place."
"Shameless!" Nu Shen, Fu Xin, and Zhu Hong exclaimed simultaneously. "The Nameless One rejected Xianniang tens of thousands of times, but she insisted on getting him."
Thereafter, the three female mythical beasts left the Lei Clan, followed by Long Qiang and the two male mythical beasts.

Following their departure, Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared at that place. He deliberately followed the mythical beasts because he got ominous feelings from some of them, and their names were also red on the map. 'Have you saved their data, Mei?'
[I have, Master. However, I don't understand why they are hostile towards you, especially since you have never met each other before.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself was also confused about it, but he had an idea in mind. 'They have already recognized my identity as a Heavenly Fox, and their hatred for me is probably because of that, which means they have old issues with those foxes.'
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to meet Cheng Gaoji and Xia Tian in the inner room. "Old Cheng, can you estimate the Lei Clan's destination from the teleportation portal residue?"

"I don't need to bother doing that because Lei Xuanfeng bought the teleportation device from me, and I set the coordinates, so I know his destination." Cheng Gaoji then took out a device and gave it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You can activate it, and it will take you to him."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to check the device, but Xia Tian suddenly stood up and faced him. "Do you like my little daughter, kid?"

"Senior Xia, I wouldn't have tied our souls together if I didn't like Mengying, right?" Xia Tian wasn't surprised to hear that from Zhang Xiaolong [3] because Murong Mengying had already told him about their soul bond. "Mengying is an attractive woman, but she is also a lonely woman, and I can remove that loneliness from her heart."

"You're right, kid. Behind her cheerfulness, my little daughter actually feels deep loneliness. Even though I've brought her to explore this universe many times, the loneliness in her heart still hasn't disappeared." Xia Tian grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulders. "Mengying is not my biological daughter, but I already consider her as one, and she is my everything. I know she likes you, but she still can't accept her feelings. I hope you can convince her to accept her feelings for you, and you must help her overcome the loneliness in her heart."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Don't worry, Senior Xia. I will definitely convince Mengying to accept her feelings, and I will make sure her life will not be lonely anymore."
"I leave Mengying to you, kid."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked him. "Have you heard of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Senior Xia?"
Xia Tian turned to Cheng Gaoji, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told him that he was a member of his group. "Who told you about that realm?"

"I met someone in the Star Tower, and he told me about that realm." Xia Tian was slightly taken aback by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer. "In fact, I am looking for a suitable realm to live in in the upper realms, and I am considering several realms, including the Sovereign Heaven Realm. I am thinking of going to that realm to check if the situation there is suitable for me and my family, and I will bring them there after I have confirmed everything."

"In fact, not many people know about that realm, including the Nameless One." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Xia Tian's answer. "As you already know, I am a wandering cultivator, and I have been to countless mysterious places. I discovered that realm by accident, and that realm is another world separate from this universe. However, it is difficult to enter that realm, and it took me ten years to be able to enter that realm."
"Why is that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.

Xia Tian explained it to him directly. "Based on the history I read in their library, the Sovereign Heaven Realm is the oldest realm in the upper realms, and it is directly connected to the Paradise Realm in the past. However, I did not find any records of how the realm was separated from that place, and I also could not discover any records of the appearance of the boundaries separating that place from the upper realms."
"So, in the past, the Paradise Realm and the Upper Realms were connected to each other, huh?"

Xia Tian nodded to him. "The two were connected in the past, but the emergence of the boundaries separated them. The records didn't mention the Paradise Realm; instead, they referred to another realm beyond the upper realms, which included cultivation stages following the Seven Divine Realms. I learned the name of that place, the Paradise Realm, from my little daughter, who said she heard it from you."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Mengying once told me that you always believed there was another world after the upper realms, but I didn't expect that you knew about it from the Sovereign Heaven Realm. So, what makes it difficult for us to enter that realm?"

"Before you enter that realm, you have to go through a series of difficult tests. Even with my knowledge and experience exploring this universe, I have difficulty completing some of them." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression turned serious after Xia Tian said that. "The first test is to test our aptitude in cultivation, and you will be expelled immediately if you fail to pass it. Even if your cultivation is at the Divine Ascension Realm, you may not be able to pass the first test. If you have high aptitude in cultivation, you will be able to pass it easily, but vice versa."
"Aptitude test, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. "What's the second test?"
Xia Tian explained directly. "The second test is the Sovereign Gate, where you will undergo three tests: the mind and heart test, the body test, and the soul test."

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought. "Let me guess, they are using illusions to test our minds and hearts. They will probably use pressure or gravity to test our bodies, and they will probably use soul attacks to test our souls."

"Hahaha." Xia Tian laughed and patted him on the shoulder. "All your guesses are correct, kid. I'm sure you won't have any trouble passing the soul test, especially since you are a soul cultivator, and Old Hun praised your talent for the skies. During the mind and heart test, they will use powerful illusions on you, and you will fail if your mind and heart are filled with filth. In the worst-case scenario, they will destroy both, resulting in your death during the test."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath after hearing that. He was confident that he could pass the mind and heart test because he had the illusion negation ability, but all his women, family, and friends did not have it.
Xia Tian then continued. "In the body test, they will suppress you with their aura, and you will also be challenged by five times heavier gravity."
"Oh? Is it possible for them to increase gravity?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in surprise.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not worried about it, especially since he had already perfectly adapted to sixteen times gravity. Most of the people by his side had also been adapted to that level, and the rest had already been adapted to eight times gravity, so it wasn't a difficult thing for them.

"Yes." Xia Tian continued with his explanation. "In fact, the gravity in the Sovereign Heaven Realm is already five times heavier than the gravity in this realm or other realms, and it took me some time to adapt to it. There are some cultivators in that realm who have the ability to control gravity, and they can increase the gravity there several times heavier."
"Have they ever used their abilities to increase the gravity there?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in a curious manner.

"Yes." Xia Tian nodded and explained. "They have a special training ground and prison where they can adjust gravity as they wish. If I recall correctly, they increased the gravity in both places to ten times heavier, which is very difficult even for the residents of the realm itself."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly, especially since ten times heavier gravity was mere child's play for the current him. "Then what about the other tests?"

"The second test is a competency test, where you are given a special technique. You must successfully learn the technique within a certain period of time, and you will fail the test if you fail to learn it after the time is up. If you fail, the technique will automatically disappear from your memories, so you will not be able to remember anything." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised to hear that people in that realm had such an ability. "The third test is the battle test, and it has ten levels of difficulty. At each level, the number of your opponents will increase, and their strength will also increase by one minor level, which is quite difficult for many people."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly. "So they deliberately designed those quests to thwart people who want to enter their realm, huh?"
- To Be Continued

Rather than thinking about that, I'm more curious about Zhang Fei's reason for helping the humans, and I feel that he has an ulterior motive."
"I agree with you, Hong." Nu Shen, the Nian beast, said it with a nod.
"We all know Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are too arrogant and hate humans.
Thus, they will never allow their race members to help humans, so I also feel that Zhang Fei has a certain motive for helping us."
"Could it be that Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are plotting with Xereth?"
"What a foolish question!" Zhu Hong and others shouted at Fu Xin, the mythical deer beast.
"If those two old foxes conspire with that demon, then the sky will definitely fall!"
Fu Xin pouted her lips in response.
"Then, what do they mean by sending Zhang Fei to help the humans?"

Although the mythical beasts were talking outside, their voices reached Cheng Gaoji's and Xia Tian's ears, causing the two old men to laugh to themselves, especially since they already knew that Zhang Fei was not part of the Heavenly Fox Race.
Huli Zhizhen and Huli Jinhu suddenly appeared at that place.
Huli Xianniang and the others immediately greeted the two, especially since they were seniors to them.
"Did you guys manage to find the way to that place in the Sun Tower?"
"No." Huli Xianniang explained to Huli Zhizhen and Huli Jinhu about the situation in the Sun Tower, and the other mythical beasts supported her words.
"Ancestors, Zhang Fei should know the key to going to that place, especially since he had a good relationship with those people.
If it weren't for him, we would never know that the upper realms were facing great danger.
He asked someone on duty at the Star Tower to contact those two elders, and they were the ones who informed us about Xereth."
"That kid should be a Heavenly Fox, right, wife?" Huli Zhizhen asked his wife.
Huli Jinhu nodded at him.
"Zhang Fei is indeed a Heavenly Fox, and she was the one who asked Feng Shen to meet us.
In fact, he came to our realm together with Old Shen, and I met him at that time.
However, you didn't notice his presence, especially since he was in an invisible state."
"Hmm?" Huli Zhizhen frowned in response.
"Could it be that Zhang Fei is the son of Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing?
As far as I can remember, only both of them have such an ability in their race, so I guessed that way."
"That's impossible." Huli Jinhu immediately denied it.
"All of Tian Baitian's and Tian Baixing's descendants are old, and they have no more children after them."
Huli Xianniang immediately spoke to them.
"Ancestors, instead of guessing about Zhang Fei's identity, why don't we go see him directly?
If we talk to him, we will know more clearly about his identity and motives."
"Let's first resolve this issue, and once everything is in order, we'll meet Zhang Fei for a conversation." Huli Jinhu then walked away from the place, followed by Huang Zhizhen.
"Hey, Zhang Fei is quite interesting and talented." Huli Xianniang, Zhu Hong, and Fu Xin immediately turned to Nu Shen with raised eyebrows.
"He's only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Heaven Realm.
Moreover, he's Hun Di's youngest disciple, and he managed to reach the perfection stage of the earthly soul level so quickly.
Additionally, I'm sure he is also a body cultivator like me, and his body cultivation level has probably already reached the third stage.
Compared with him, the younger generations of our races are nothing."
"Don't tell me that you like Zhang Fei?" Huli Xianniang suspiciously asked.
Zhu Hong and Fu Xin also felt suspicious of Nu Shen.
Unlike them, the three male mythical beasts, especially the azure dragon, Long Qiang, looked serious. 'Tch!
If that brat dares to approach Nu Shen, I will eat him and the people around him alive.'
"What are you saying, Xianniang?
Don't you already know the rules of my race?" Nu Shen immediately denied it.
"We, Nian beasts, cannot carelessly establish relationships with any living creatures.
Our soulmates are predetermined by several things, and we will perish if we violate them.
As for me, I don't like my life being ruled by unknown things, but I'm also afraid of violating them, so I prefer to live in solitude."
Huli Xianniang then walked away.
"Since the Lei clan members have fled, I will go to my future husband's place."
"Shameless!" Nu Shen, Fu Xin, and Zhu Hong exclaimed simultaneously.
"The Nameless One rejected Xianniang tens of thousands of times, but she insisted on getting him."
Thereafter, the three female mythical beasts left the Lei Clan, followed by Long Qiang and the two male mythical beasts.
Following their departure, Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared at that place.
He deliberately followed the mythical beasts because he got ominous feelings from some of them, and their names were also red on the map. 'Have you saved their data, Mei?'
[I have, Master.
However, I don't understand why they are hostile towards you, especially since you have never met each other before.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself was also confused about it, but he had an idea in mind. 'They have already recognized my identity as a Heavenly Fox, and their hatred for me is probably because of that, which means they have old issues with those foxes.'
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to meet Cheng Gaoji and Xia Tian in the inner room.
"Old Cheng, can you estimate the Lei Clan's destination from the teleportation portal residue?"

"I don't need to bother doing that because Lei Xuanfeng bought the teleportation device from me, and I set the coordinates, so I know his destination." Cheng Gaoji then took out a device and gave it to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"You can activate it, and it will take you to him."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to check the device, but Xia Tian suddenly stood up and faced him.
"Do you like my little daughter, kid?"

"Senior Xia, I wouldn't have tied our souls together if I didn't like Mengying, right?" Xia Tian wasn't surprised to hear that from Zhang Xiaolong [3] because Murong Mengying had already told him about their soul bond.
"Mengying is an attractive woman, but she is also a lonely woman, and I can remove that loneliness from her heart."
"You're right, kid.
Behind her cheerfulness, my little daughter actually feels deep loneliness.
Even though I've brought her to explore this universe many times, the loneliness in her heart still hasn't disappeared." Xia Tian grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulders.
"Mengying is not my biological daughter, but I already consider her as one, and she is my everything.
I know she likes you, but she still can't accept her feelings.
I hope you can convince her to accept her feelings for you, and you must help her overcome the loneliness in her heart."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"Don't worry, Senior Xia.
I will definitely convince Mengying to accept her feelings, and I will make sure her life will not be lonely anymore."
"I leave Mengying to you, kid."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked him.
"Have you heard of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Senior Xia?"
Xia Tian turned to Cheng Gaoji, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told him that he was a member of his group.
"Who told you about that realm?"
"I met someone in the Star Tower, and he told me about that realm." Xia Tian was slightly taken aback by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer.
"In fact, I am looking for a suitable realm to live in in the upper realms, and I am considering several realms, including the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
I am thinking of going to that realm to check if the situation there is suitable for me and my family, and I will bring them there after I have confirmed everything."
"In fact, not many people know about that realm, including the Nameless One." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Xia Tian's answer.
"As you already know, I am a wandering cultivator, and I have been to countless mysterious places.
I discovered that realm by accident, and that realm is another world separate from this universe.
However, it is difficult to enter that realm, and it took me ten years to be able to enter that realm."
"Why is that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.
Xia Tian explained it to him directly.
"Based on the history I read in their library, the Sovereign Heaven Realm is the oldest realm in the upper realms, and it is directly connected to the Paradise Realm in the past.

However, I did not find any records of how the realm was separated from that place, and I also could not discover any records of the appearance of the boundaries separating that place from the upper realms."
"So, in the past, the Paradise Realm and the Upper Realms were connected to each other, huh?"
Xia Tian nodded to him.
"The two were connected in the past, but the emergence of the boundaries separated them.
The records didn't mention the Paradise Realm; instead, they referred to another realm beyond the upper realms, which included cultivation stages following the Seven Divine Realms.
I learned the name of that place, the Paradise Realm, from my little daughter, who said she heard it from you."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"Mengying once told me that you always believed there was another world after the upper realms, but I didn't expect that you knew about it from the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
So, what makes it difficult for us to enter that realm?"
"Before you enter that realm, you have to go through a series of difficult tests.
Even with my knowledge and experience exploring this universe, I have difficulty completing some of them." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression turned serious after Xia Tian said that.
"The first test is to test our aptitude in cultivation, and you will be expelled immediately if you fail to pass it.
Even if your cultivation is at the Divine Ascension Realm, you may not be able to pass the first test.
If you have high aptitude in cultivation, you will be able to pass it easily, but vice versa."
"Aptitude test, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself.
"What's the second test?"
Xia Tian explained directly.
"The second test is the Sovereign Gate, where you will undergo three tests: the mind and heart test, the body test, and the soul test."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought.
"Let me guess, they are using illusions to test our minds and hearts.
They will probably use pressure or gravity to test our bodies, and they will probably use soul attacks to test our souls."
"Hahaha." Xia Tian laughed and patted him on the shoulder.
"All your guesses are correct, kid.
I'm sure you won't have any trouble passing the soul test, especially since you are a soul cultivator, and Old Hun praised your talent for the skies.
During the mind and heart test, they will use powerful illusions on you, and you will fail if your mind and heart are filled with filth.
In the worst-case scenario, they will destroy both, resulting in your death during the test."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath after hearing that.
He was confident that he could pass the mind and heart test because he had the illusion negation ability, but all his women, family, and friends did not have it.
Xia Tian then continued.
"In the body test, they will suppress you with their aura, and you will also be challenged by five times heavier gravity."
"Oh?
Is it possible for them to increase gravity?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in surprise.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not worried about it, especially since he had already perfectly adapted to sixteen times gravity.
Most of the people by his side had also been adapted to that level, and the rest had already been adapted to eight times gravity, so it wasn't a difficult thing for them.
"Yes." Xia Tian continued with his explanation.
"In fact, the gravity in the Sovereign Heaven Realm is already five times heavier than the gravity in this realm or other realms, and it took me some time to adapt to it.
There are some cultivators in that realm who have the ability to control gravity, and they can increase the gravity there several times heavier."
"Have they ever used their abilities to increase the gravity there?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in a curious manner.
"Yes." Xia Tian nodded and explained.
"They have a special training ground and prison where they can adjust gravity as they wish.
If I recall correctly, they increased the gravity in both places to ten times heavier, which is very difficult even for the residents of the realm itself."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly, especially since ten times heavier gravity was mere child's play for the current him.
"Then what about the other tests?"
"The second test is a competency test, where you are given a special technique.
You must successfully learn the technique within a certain period of time, and you will fail the test if you fail to learn it after the time is up.

If you fail, the technique will automatically disappear from your memories, so you will not be able to remember anything." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised to hear that people in that realm had such an ability.
"The third test is the battle test, and it has ten levels of difficulty.
At each level, the number of your opponents will increase, and their strength will also increase by one minor level, which is quite difficult for many people."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly.
"So they deliberately designed those quests to thwart people who want to enter their realm, huh?"
- To Be Continued

chapters.title: Chapter 836 836: Release Three Prisoners
paragraphs: "The people of the Sovereign Heaven Realm are not interested in accepting outsiders, and they have their own ancient civilization. Therefore, they deliberately set such difficult tests to prevent outsiders from entering their realm, especially since the presence of outsiders can bring about changes in their realm that have lasted for hundreds of thousands or perhaps millions of years." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Xia Tian, who immediately continued. "The fourth test is the karmic test, and you will face a series of lightning tribulations depending on your karma. The fifth test is the loyalty and righteousness test; you will face random challenges in this test, so you have to undergo it yourself to find out. The final test is the Dao test, which I find difficult to explain, but I'm sure you're already familiar with it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a moment. "The Dao is the fundamental laws of existence and the path of cultivation. It is the truth that governs the universe; cultivators seek to comprehend and master it to achieve transcendence and immortality."

"Yes." Xia Tian then released a soft sigh before speaking again. "Can we really attain transcendence? Does immortality really exist? According to the information I learned in that realm, none of the residents of that realm managed to achieve either, and their lifespan was at most a million years."

"A million years?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised that there were living creatures that could live that long in the upper realms. However, he remembered that both ancestors of the phoenix race and both ancestors of the golden fox race had lived for more than five hundred thousand years.

"That's right." Xia Tian nodded at him. "In fact, there are some tombs in that realm, and they are tombs for cultivators who have reached that lifespan in the past. Even though they had reached that age, they had never managed to transcend the Seven Divine Realms, and they died because their lifespan ended."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded his head repeatedly. "To be able to surpass the Seven Divine Realms, we need the Celestial Qi. Unfortunately, it does not exist in the three mortal realms because it is blocked by the boundaries, so we will never be able to surpass those stages. The Celestial Qi only exists in the Paradise Realm, and cultivators need a special method to transform the Divine Qi in our bodies into the Celestial Qi before we can absorb it. If we succeed in doing that, our cultivation will break through to the Five Celestial Realms, or else we will be stuck in the Seven Divine Realms until our lifespan ends."
"The Celestial Qi and the Five Celestial Realms, huh?" Xia Tian murmured.

"The Five Celestial Realms are Celestial Lord, Celestial King, Celestial Emperor, Celestial Venerable, and Celestial God, with three minor levels from 1 Sun to 3 Sun." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked him. "Do people in the Sovereign Heaven Realm not know about those towers?"

Xia Tian shook his head in response. "They have isolated their realms from the outside world for a long time, so they don't know anything about those towers. In fact, I wouldn't know about them if you didn't tell Mengying about them, or else I wouldn't have bothered myself to check and study the boundaries, right? If I'm not mistaken, those towers appeared in the middle realms around or thousands of years ago."

'Let me out, kid.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned Ma Kuangyu's soul out of his soul space, shocking Xia Tian. "I have been to the three mortal realms many times in the past, but I have never met a cultivator interested in the many mysterious things in this universe, kid."
Xia Tian smiled bitterly, listening to Ma Kuangyu call him a kid. He cupped his hands at him. "Are you a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, Senior?"

"I did come from that realm, and I met this kid at the Star Tower." Ma Kuangyu continued, revealing more information. "Hundreds of thousands of years ago, the people of my realm created those towers, originally using them as prisons. However, many changes have occurred in my realm, and we have experienced a talent crisis in the past few thousand years, so they decided to send those towers here. They needed fresher talents, but the lower realms were too weak, and the minds of cultivators in the upper realms were already polluted by many negative things, so the middle realms were the best choice."
"How could your realm experience a talent crisis, Old Ma?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.

Ma Kuangyu shook his head. "Several thousand years ago, a strange phenomenon occurred in my realm, and the situation there has changed since then. Many new talents have emerged there, such as your little lover, Luo Yunxiao. However, since the phenomenon appeared, their numbers have drastically decreased and continued to decline over time. As a result, they decided to send the towers here as a testing ground for talents from the middle realms. Unfortunately, there has never been a cultivator from the middle realms who succeeded in ascending to the top of the towers, so the situation in my realm still hasn't changed until now."
"What about this kid, Senior? Does he have the ability to reach the top of the tower?" Xia Tian asked as he patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.

"Hahaha." Ma Kuangyu laughed loudly before answering. "I've lived in his soul space for almost half a year now, and I've witnessed many of his actions, including his actions against cultivators with cultivation far above his. I can say that he is the only cultivator with a high chance of reaching the top of the tower, but he can't do it anytime soon. After all, each floor has a minimum requirement, and he won't be able to challenge it if he doesn't meet the requirements yet. As long as you are on his side, he will definitely help you to go to my home realm."
Xia Tian nodded in understanding. "I actually never liked relying on other people, but it looks like I have to rely on you to go to that realm, kid."

"Why do you have to say that, Senior Xia?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled as he posed the question. "Even though you are not Mengying's biological father, the relationship between the two of you is deeper than blood. I will help you reach that realm, but it will take a long time. After all, the main requirement to be able to go there is to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm first, and that stage is still far beyond my reach."

Xia Tian let out a soft sigh. "I had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm a thousand years ago, but my cultivation still shows no signs of breaking through to the 2 Moon. Therefore, I will start focusing on my cultivation instead of my wanderings, or I will never be able to reach the 5 Moon."

"Why don't you get married, Senior Xia?" Xia Tian frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Mengying once told me that you have no interest in getting married, and you are more interested in the mysteries hidden in this universe."
Xia Tian shrugged in response. "Women are the most troublesome creatures! Those mysteries are more interesting than them, and I don't have to deal with their pointless nagging."

"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed upon hearing Xia Tian's answer. "Senior Xia, many women are indeed troublesome, but many of them are lovable, like Mengying and my wives. They sometimes grumble meaninglessly, but their presence makes my life more meaningful. They always help me become strong, and I don't want to stop strengthening myself for their future. You may think that way now, but you will definitely change your mind once you find the right woman for you, and you will understand the feeling of having someone who means a lot to you by your side."

Xia Tian shook his head hearing that. "You are no different from my little daughter; she always forces me to look for a wife. Unfortunately, I really am not interested in such a life, and I prefer to enjoy a free, unfettered life. In any case, it would be best if you left now, and I'll assist Old Cheng in examining this statue."
"All right." After Ma Kuangyu returned to his soul space, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the place, but he ran into Ji Changlan, who had just returned.

Ji Changlan spoke directly to him. "Kid, I've heard about you from Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi, and I wanted to talk to you about blacksmithing. Unfortunately, we're facing a serious problem right now, so we'll talk after everything is settled."

"All right, I will meet you at your shop after everything is over, Senior Ji." Ji Changlan hurriedly met the two old men in the statue room. Zhang Xiaolong [3], on the other hand, decided to enter the Yin-Yang Space.

Once inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] released Wang Xiaoyi, Shen Shixi, and Shen Xiwu. He replaced them with Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu. This way, all ten of his prisoners were female cultivators with cultivation in the Seven Divine Realms, allowing him to gather Yin Qi faster.
[What will you do about Wang Xiaoyi, Shen Shixi, and Shen Xiwu, Master? Are you going to send them to the training space like Xing Mei and Chu Youqian?]

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] crouched down beside the three women. "Back then, I imprisoned them here because there was no other choice to speed up my cultivation, but their Yin Qi was too weak compared to Xing Mei and Chu Youqian. I thought of erasing their memories of me, and I would send them back to the Sky Jade Realm so they could return to their lives."

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his memory manipulation on the three women to erase all their memories of him and all the time they spent as his prisoners, and he added a few new memories to their memories. After he was done with that, he sent the three women back to the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Wang Xiaoyi to the Eastern Chu Clan, and he handed her over to her family.
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s decision shocked Chu Liuxiang, Chu Chongzi, and Yao Chi. He explained to them several things, including Wang Xiaoyi's situation while she was in his custody.
Chu Liuxiang had long forgotten Wang Xiaoyi, and he was unwilling to accept her back. Unlike them, Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi are willing to accept her, especially since she is their mother.

After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Shen Shixi and Shen Xiwu to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and he asked Sheng Yang to take care of the two women. He then looked for Hong Xuan and Ying Sha, but he could not find the two women there.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had long desired the two women, and he gave them his Yang Qi, but the two women were adamant about not wanting to be his partners. Since their Yin Qi was too weak for the current him, he decided to forget about them.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then went to Lin Mengmeng's room, but another disciple told him that she had left three months ago. The disciple handed him the letter left by her, and he hurriedly read it.
[I know you have gone to the upper realms, so I decided to leave the lower realms, and I will wait for you at the Evergreen Spirit Haven.]

"The Evergreen Spirit Haven, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. "Back then, I told her that the realm would be my first destination when I went to the Upper Realm, but I went to the Red Sun Realm because of Xinxin. Since she has returned to her home realm, I will go see her there soon. However, I have to wait for the situation in the Xianjin Realm to calm down first, and I will leave after my shop there opens."

After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to the Xianjin Realm and went to Cheng Gaoji's residence directly. He wanted to talk to Shang Yaolin, but Shang Yingyue told him that she didn't want to see him yet, so he dropped his intentions and returned to his room to cultivate.

After the three quests were completed, Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] returned to the Phoenix Realm to continue their training. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood before the frozen Long Jiutian, thinking about how to absorb his demon power and cultivate without alerting Xereth.

"Master." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Tian Jianxia. "My brother has been calling me for the past three days, and he's been asking about my whereabouts. Our ancestors seemed to realize that I was the one who opened the gate, and they asked him to look for me."
Zhang Fei [5] frowned as he thought about it. "They shouldn't have arrived at the middle realms yet, right?"
"Not yet, Master."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In that case, you can tell your brother about this realm, and I'll take care of them once they arrive here."
"Eh?" Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu were surprised. "Do you really want to fight them all at once, Master?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Xereth is on his way to the Heavenly Moon Realm now, and the situation there will be very chaotic with his arrival. Therefore, I'm sure Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing won't have time to bother about me, so I'll deal with them as soon as possible."
"Are you going to kill my brother, Master?" Tian Jianxia asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "Contact him now, and you will know the result after they arrive in this realm."

Tian Jianxia sighed softly and contacted her brother directly. Before long, she had received an answer from her brother, and she informed Zhang Fei [5] directly. "They will go to this realm once they arrive in the middle realms."
"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then checked the demons who were training in the realm before sitting down cross-legged. "Let's start dual soul cultivating."
"Yes, Master." Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu immediately sat down in front of Zhang Fei [5], and they quickly started dual soul cultivating.

When night fell, two people came to Cheng Gaoji's residence, and they immediately knocked on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s rooms. He was not surprised by Tian Shuixiang's arrival, but he was confused by Feng Jiu's arrival.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately went to see them. "Why did you come to see me, Empress Feng? Does it have something to do with Feng Yao?"
"Hehe." Feng Jiu giggled. "I did want to talk to you about my daughter, but I can't do it now because the Nameless One wants to see you, and he asked me to bring you to him."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself wanted to talk to Zhe Wuming, so he had no objections to that. "I'll go see him, but I have to help Senior Tian heal his lover first."
"Huh?" Feng Jiu turned to Tian Shuixiang in surprise. "Since when did you have a lover?"
"Long ago." Tian Shuixiang then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Let's go now, and you can meet the Nameless One afterward."

Before long, they had arrived at Tian Shuixiang's room, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately pulled his pink gas out of Ye Zhiye's body, causing her to calm down. "I'll see you again after I talk to the Nameless One."
"All right." Tian Shuixiang nodded.

Feng Jiu, filled with curiosity, led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Nameless One's place and inquired. "Since when did you know the two of them? Did you have problems with them? I never knew that Tian Shuixiang already had a lover, so I was surprised to see her."
- To Be Continued -

'Let me out, kid.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] summoned Ma Kuangyu's soul out of his soul space, shocking Xia Tian.
"I have been to the three mortal realms many times in the past, but I have never met a cultivator interested in the many mysterious things in this universe, kid."
Xia Tian smiled bitterly, listening to Ma Kuangyu call him a kid.
He cupped his hands at him.
"Are you a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, Senior?"
"I did come from that realm, and I met this kid at the Star Tower." Ma Kuangyu continued, revealing more information.
"Hundreds of thousands of years ago, the people of my realm created those towers, originally using them as prisons.
However, many changes have occurred in my realm, and we have experienced a talent crisis in the past few thousand years, so they decided to send those towers here.

They needed fresher talents, but the lower realms were too weak, and the minds of cultivators in the upper realms were already polluted by many negative things, so the middle realms were the best choice."
"How could your realm experience a talent crisis, Old Ma?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.
Ma Kuangyu shook his head.
"Several thousand years ago, a strange phenomenon occurred in my realm, and the situation there has changed since then.
Many new talents have emerged there, such as your little lover, Luo Yunxiao.
However, since the phenomenon appeared, their numbers have drastically decreased and continued to decline over time.
As a result, they decided to send the towers here as a testing ground for talents from the middle realms.
Unfortunately, there has never been a cultivator from the middle realms who succeeded in ascending to the top of the towers, so the situation in my realm still hasn't changed until now."
"What about this kid, Senior?
Does he have the ability to reach the top of the tower?" Xia Tian asked as he patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.
"Hahaha." Ma Kuangyu laughed loudly before answering.
"I've lived in his soul space for almost half a year now, and I've witnessed many of his actions, including his actions against cultivators with cultivation far above his.
I can say that he is the only cultivator with a high chance of reaching the top of the tower, but he can't do it anytime soon.
After all, each floor has a minimum requirement, and he won't be able to challenge it if he doesn't meet the requirements yet.
As long as you are on his side, he will definitely help you to go to my home realm."
Xia Tian nodded in understanding.
"I actually never liked relying on other people, but it looks like I have to rely on you to go to that realm, kid."
"Why do you have to say that, Senior Xia?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled as he posed the question.
"Even though you are not Mengying's biological father, the relationship between the two of you is deeper than blood.
I will help you reach that realm, but it will take a long time.
After all, the main requirement to be able to go there is to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm first, and that stage is still far beyond my reach."
Xia Tian let out a soft sigh.
"I had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm a thousand years ago, but my cultivation still shows no signs of breaking through to the 2 Moon.
Therefore, I will start focusing on my cultivation instead of my wanderings, or I will never be able to reach the 5 Moon."
"Why don't you get married, Senior Xia?" Xia Tian frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Mengying once told me that you have no interest in getting married, and you are more interested in the mysteries hidden in this universe."
Xia Tian shrugged in response.
"Women are the most troublesome creatures!
Those mysteries are more interesting than them, and I don't have to deal with their pointless nagging."
"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed upon hearing Xia Tian's answer.
"Senior Xia, many women are indeed troublesome, but many of them are lovable, like Mengying and my wives.
They sometimes grumble meaninglessly, but their presence makes my life more meaningful.
They always help me become strong, and I don't want to stop strengthening myself for their future.
You may think that way now, but you will definitely change your mind once you find the right woman for you, and you will understand the feeling of having someone who means a lot to you by your side."
Xia Tian shook his head hearing that.
"You are no different from my little daughter; she always forces me to look for a wife.
Unfortunately, I really am not interested in such a life, and I prefer to enjoy a free, unfettered life.
In any case, it would be best if you left now, and I'll assist Old Cheng in examining this statue."
"All right." After Ma Kuangyu returned to his soul space, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the place, but he ran into Ji Changlan, who had just returned.
Ji Changlan spoke directly to him.
"Kid, I've heard about you from Yuan Kong and Li Yanzhi, and I wanted to talk to you about blacksmithing.
Unfortunately, we're facing a serious problem right now, so we'll talk after everything is settled."
"All right, I will meet you at your shop after everything is over, Senior Ji." Ji Changlan hurriedly met the two old men in the statue room.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], on the other hand, decided to enter the Yin-Yang Space.
Once inside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] released Wang Xiaoyi, Shen Shixi, and Shen Xiwu.
He replaced them with Lei Huiyin, Huang Bingyun, and Qin Liangyu.
This way, all ten of his prisoners were female cultivators with cultivation in the Seven Divine Realms, allowing him to gather Yin Qi faster.
[What will you do about Wang Xiaoyi, Shen Shixi, and Shen Xiwu, Master?
Are you going to send them to the training space like Xing Mei and Chu Youqian?]
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] crouched down beside the three women.
"Back then, I imprisoned them here because there was no other choice to speed up my cultivation, but their Yin Qi was too weak compared to Xing Mei and Chu Youqian.
I thought of erasing their memories of me, and I would send them back to the Sky Jade Realm so they could return to their lives."

Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his memory manipulation on the three women to erase all their memories of him and all the time they spent as his prisoners, and he added a few new memories to their memories.
After he was done with that, he sent the three women back to the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Wang Xiaoyi to the Eastern Chu Clan, and he handed her over to her family.
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s decision shocked Chu Liuxiang, Chu Chongzi, and Yao Chi.
He explained to them several things, including Wang Xiaoyi's situation while she was in his custody.
Chu Liuxiang had long forgotten Wang Xiaoyi, and he was unwilling to accept her back.
Unlike them, Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi are willing to accept her, especially since she is their mother.
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Shen Shixi and Shen Xiwu to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and he asked Sheng Yang to take care of the two women.
He then looked for Hong Xuan and Ying Sha, but he could not find the two women there.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had long desired the two women, and he gave them his Yang Qi, but the two women were adamant about not wanting to be his partners.
Since their Yin Qi was too weak for the current him, he decided to forget about them.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then went to Lin Mengmeng's room, but another disciple told him that she had left three months ago.
The disciple handed him the letter left by her, and he hurriedly read it.
[I know you have gone to the upper realms, so I decided to leave the lower realms, and I will wait for you at the Evergreen Spirit Haven.]
"The Evergreen Spirit Haven, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself.
"Back then, I told her that the realm would be my first destination when I went to the Upper Realm, but I went to the Red Sun Realm because of Xinxin.
Since she has returned to her home realm, I will go see her there soon.
However, I have to wait for the situation in the Xianjin Realm to calm down first, and I will leave after my shop there opens."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to the Xianjin Realm and went to Cheng Gaoji's residence directly.
He wanted to talk to Shang Yaolin, but Shang Yingyue told him that she didn't want to see him yet, so he dropped his intentions and returned to his room to cultivate.
