[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
After the three quests were completed, Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] returned to the Phoenix Realm to continue their training.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood before the frozen Long Jiutian, thinking about how to absorb his demon power and cultivate without alerting Xereth.
"Master." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Tian Jianxia.
"My brother has been calling me for the past three days, and he's been asking about my whereabouts.
Our ancestors seemed to realize that I was the one who opened the gate, and they asked him to look for me."
Zhang Fei [5] frowned as he thought about it.
"They shouldn't have arrived at the middle realms yet, right?"
"Not yet, Master."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"In that case, you can tell your brother about this realm, and I'll take care of them once they arrive here."
"Eh?" Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu were surprised.
"Do you really want to fight them all at once, Master?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"Xereth is on his way to the Heavenly Moon Realm now, and the situation there will be very chaotic with his arrival.
Therefore, I'm sure Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing won't have time to bother about me, so I'll deal with them as soon as possible."
"Are you going to kill my brother, Master?" Tian Jianxia asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged.
"Contact him now, and you will know the result after they arrive in this realm."
Tian Jianxia sighed softly and contacted her brother directly.
Before long, she had received an answer from her brother, and she informed Zhang Fei [5] directly.
"They will go to this realm once they arrive in the middle realms."
"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then checked the demons who were training in the realm before sitting down cross-legged.
"Let's start dual soul cultivating."
"Yes, Master." Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu immediately sat down in front of Zhang Fei [5], and they quickly started dual soul cultivating.
When night fell, two people came to Cheng Gaoji's residence, and they immediately knocked on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s rooms.
He was not surprised by Tian Shuixiang's arrival, but he was confused by Feng Jiu's arrival.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately went to see them.
"Why did you come to see me, Empress Feng?
Does it have something to do with Feng Yao?"
"Hehe." Feng Jiu giggled.
"I did want to talk to you about my daughter, but I can't do it now because the Nameless One wants to see you, and he asked me to bring you to him."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself wanted to talk to Zhe Wuming, so he had no objections to that.
"I'll go see him, but I have to help Senior Tian heal his lover first."
"Huh?" Feng Jiu turned to Tian Shuixiang in surprise.
"Since when did you have a lover?"
"Long ago." Tian Shuixiang then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Let's go now, and you can meet the Nameless One afterward."
Before long, they had arrived at Tian Shuixiang's room, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately pulled his pink gas out of Ye Zhiye's body, causing her to calm down.
"I'll see you again after I talk to the Nameless One."
"All right." Tian Shuixiang nodded.
Feng Jiu, filled with curiosity, led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Nameless One's place and inquired.
"Since when did you know the two of them?
Did you have problems with them?
I never knew that Tian Shuixiang already had a lover, so I was surprised to see her."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 837: Meet Zhe Wuming
paragraphs: "To be honest, I've never met either of them, but that woman came to me three days ago while I was engaged in my cultivation. Unfortunately for her, I always used something to protect myself while I was focused on my cultivation, and she was affected by my protection." Based on Ye Zhiye's previous expression, Feng Jiu could immediately guess that she was affected by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s lust demon ability, especially since Feng Yao had already told her about his identity. "Usually, I would never let go of people who wanted to do such a thing to me, but those two are different. If we were enemies, you guys would definitely attack me at the same time. I am confident that I can avoid all of you, but it would only be a hassle for me."

"You are right." Feng Jiu nodded in response. "If you become an enemy of Tian Shuixiang, you will become an enemy of all cultivators in the upper realms. He is the alchemical god, after all, and we have benefited immensely from his pills. I dare say, though, that my phoenix race will never turn against you, and we will always stand behind you to support you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at her, startled. "Did you decide this because of Feng Yao?"

"Yes." Feng Jiu immediately admitted it. "Everything about Yao'er has been amazing from the moment she was born. I have long noticed something different about my daughter, and everything she has done since she was born has convinced me that she is a reincarnator. She asked me to fully support you, and I chose to follow her wishes."
"Do you really believe that reincarnation is real?"
"Yao'er is not the only reincarnator I have ever met, and I know many others, including Huli Xianniang."
"Eh?" Feng Jiu's statement took Zhang Xiaolong [3] by surprise. "Huli Xianniang, the matriarch of the golden fox clan, right?"

Feng Jiu gave him a nod. "I learned that Huli Xianniang was a reincarnator when her memories from her previous life returned; we were together doing something at that time. Since that day, I've been convinced that reincarnation is real, and Yao'er is one of them."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Who are the identities of the other reincarnators that you know?"

Feng Jiu immediately told Zhang Xiaolong [3] a few names, surprising him. "There are many more, but I can't tell you all of them. Among the names I just mentioned, you should be wary of Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Zhu Sanniang, and Feng Shen."

"Feng Shen?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow, as he finally understood why the system assigned him the quest to defeat the fire phoenix ancestor. "I already knew from the start that Long Qiang and Dai Hubai were hostile to me, but why Old Feng, and who is Zhu Sanniang?"

"Zhu Sanniang is Zhu Hong's cousin, and she has a deep-seated grudge with the Heavenly Fox Race. I don't know what really happened between them, especially since she never revealed the truth. Long Qiang and Dai Hubai are no different from her; both of them hate that race very much, especially Tian Baitian." Feng Jiu then sighed softly before continuing. "Feng Shen is good on the outside but bad on the inside, but he has never shown his evil side, especially since Feng Xueying kept him in check. Therefore, you must always be wary of him and never trust him, or you will regret it yourself."

"All right, I will definitely be wary of him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used his demon eyes to check Feng Jiu's soul, but the results surprised him. 'Before, I only knew that Xu Ling'er and Jiang Yinghua had such bright souls, but this woman's soul was as bright as theirs; even Feng Yao's soul is inferior to them.'
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feng Jiu arrived at Zhe Wuming's private residence, but a void wall immediately enveloped the residence as soon as they entered.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned as a powerful pressure pressed down from above him, but he realized that the owner was not Zhe Wuming, and the owner was his beast contract, Xue Bao.

Xue Bao, who was lying on Zhe Wuming's shoulders, grinned at his expression. However, he was shocked as soon as Ma Kuangyu helped Zhang Xiaolong [3] dispel his pressure and knocked him backwards. "Gah!"
Zhe Wuming didn't show any reaction seeing that, but he was shocked in his heart. Feng Jiu, on the other hand, laughed softly at Xue Bao's angry expression after being knocked away by Ma Kuangyu.
'Thank you, Old Ma.'
'Don't mind it.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked towards Zhe Wuming and asked. "Why did you call me here, Senior?"

"I'm curious about you." Zhe Wuming tried then to check on Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the system immediately repelled his sense, leaving him shocked. "I didn't expect there was something in your body, and it was powerful enough to repel my senses."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] casually smiled. "If I didn't have something, I wouldn't be able to stand before you now, especially with my low cultivation."
"Hey, brat! You—" Xue Bao shut his mouth immediately when Zhe Wuming gave him a side glance. 'Tch! Why does my master have to bother with a brat like him?'
Zhe Wuming then spoke. "Thank you for your information and help, or else we would have been late in returning here, and they might have already taken over this realm."

"Unfortunately, you can't relax about this matter yet, especially since there are still several other clans who choose to be loyal to Xereth outside of the Huang and Lei Clans." Watching their questioning expression, Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at them. "I've tried to find out information about them, but I haven't gotten any information about which clans are involved in this matter. You should send people to check all the clans in this realm now, or it will be too late if one of them activates the black statue in their clan."

Zhe Wuming did not take the information from Zhang Xiaolong [3] lightly; he immediately ordered Guan Chenhong and the others to check all the clans in the realm, both major and minor ones. "Are Lei Huiyin and those two women in your hands?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it straight away. "I exposed this matter, and I need their Yin Qi for my cultivation. Therefore, I have imprisoned them in a special place, and I will milk their Yin Qi."
Zhe Wuming frowned upon hearing that, especially since such a method was identical to the actions of demons, and he had never liked demons.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle and showed it to Zhe Wuming. "I used this artifact to milk their Yin Qi, so they didn't suffer the slightest bit."
"Oh?" Zhe Wuming, Feng Jiu, and Xue Bao were surprised by that.

Feng Jiu immediately took the shackle from Zhang Xiaolong [3], wearing it on both her hands and feet. Instantly, her cultivation was sealed, and it subtly absorbed her Yin Qi. "This artifact is truly interesting, and I don't feel the slightest pain."
Xue Bao floated in front of Feng Jiu, observing the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle. "This thing keeps absorbing your Yin Qi, Jiujiu. If the situation continues like this, you will die from Qi depletion."

"Naturally, I will not let my prisoners die so easily, or my efforts in capturing them will be in vain." The three of them turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and looked at the two pills in his hands. "These two are superior-grade qi recovery pills and superior-grade body nourishment pills, so their body condition and qi will never decline, and the shackle will continue to absorb their Yin Qi."
"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled. "My daughter told me about your alchemy skills, but I didn't expect that you could concoct superior-grade pills with your level still at grandmaster rank alchemist."

"I must correct you, Empress Feng. I am no longer a grandmaster rank alchemist, but I am a king rank alchemist now, and I will become an emperor rank alchemist soon." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s reply stunned Feng Jiu, Zhe Wuming, and Xue Bao. He just smiled and removed the shackles from the Phoenix Empress. "If the three of you are curious about my pills, you can visit my shop in this realm that I will open after the matter with Xereth is over, and you will definitely like their effects."
Feng Jiu nodded in response. "Yao'er already told me about some of your pills, and I can't wait to try them."
"Here, you can swallow them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave Feng Jiu a bottle of his basic pills. "They are basic pills, but they are not the usual ones, and their effects are much more potent."
"Hey, Kid! You gave your pills to Jiujiu, but you didn't give them to me and my master." Xue Bao immediately shouted at him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a slight shrug. "I don't know either of you, and you've tried to pressure me before. On the contrary, Feng Yao has helped me a lot, and Empress Feng is her mother, so I have a reason to give my pills to her."
"You—"
"That's enough, Bao'er." Zhe Wuming stopped his contract beast. "I'll wait for your shop to open, and I'll definitely visit it in person."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "By the way, do you know anything about the space rift, senior?"
"I do." Zhe Wuming answered with a nod.
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes were sparkling. "Can you send me into the space rift?"

"Are you crazy?" Xue Bao asked in a high pitch. "The pressure in the space rift is too strong, and you don't have the void element. If you force your way in there, the pressure will immediately crush your body."

Zhe Wuming spoke straight away. "Bao'er is right, Zhang Fei. As long as you don't have the void element, you will never be able to enter the space rift. Moreover, there is nothing in there, so your desire to go there will only be in vain."

"Senior, I can't explain my purpose for going there to you, but I have to go back there to confirm something. In fact, I was once trapped in the space rift, and I wouldn't be standing here today if I couldn't withstand the pressure." Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao obviously didn't believe Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since they were familiar with the situation inside the space rift, forcing him to explain the situation when the teleportation device that Shang Huaqiang had installed back then exploded. "If you two can really send me there, I hope you can help me with that."

Since Zhe Wuming and Xiao Bao were still doubtful, Feng Jiu decided to help Zhang Xiaolong [3] in persuading them. "Guys, my daughter witnessed the incident herself, and this kid was indeed sucked into the portal along with several other cultivators. He was the first to return thanks to his abilities as a heavenly fox, and he managed to bring some of them back. In fact, the young girl that I freed from the woman in the Blossom Heaven Realm was one of them, so you two don't need to doubt him anymore and help him enter that place."
"Master, he—"
"Let's do it, Bao'er." Zhe Wuming took a dagger and slashed through the air, leaving a long cut there. He then covered Zhang Xiaolong [3] and brought him into the gap, followed by Xue Bao.

Feng Jiu wanted to follow them, but she gave up on her intention because she did not know how strong the pressure was in the void, but she knew that it was different from the pressure in outer space. In a matter of seconds, the gap disappears by itself.
Upon arrival, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his self-created technique, and a light female figure quickly appeared behind him, illuminating the area around them.

Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao were truly surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions. They knew that elements could be materialized into certain forms, but their forms could never be as perfect as the light female figure, which was completely identical to Jiang Yinghua.
"What are you really looking for in here?" Xue Bao asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] as he looked at the surrounding area, but there was nothing there but pitch-black darkness.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was at a loss to explain it, especially since he discovered the gate due to the call from the will of the universe. 'Are you able to track the location of the gate, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, the system cannot detect anything inside the space rift, Master. Moreover, this place is simply as big as the universe, so we can't possibly search for it without the will of the universe's guidance.]
Xue Bao wanted to ask Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, but Zhe Wuming immediately covered his mouth and forbade his contract beast from disturbing him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes before spreading his presence and aura as far as possible, confusing Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao. 'What is he really looking for? Why is he so eager to find it?'
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes and released a disappointed sigh. "Apparently, the event at that time was just a mere coincidence, and I couldn't find it again."

"What exactly—" Zhe Wuming did not continue his words, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly disappeared from their sight. He and Xue Bao immediately tried to track his whereabouts, but the space rift was simply too vast, preventing them from finding him.

However, Zhe Wuming and Xiao Bao suddenly received a voice transmission from Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he informed them that he was fine. He did not tell them his location, and he asked them to return first.
"Master, what actually happened? How could that kid disappear for no reason?" Xue Bao asked in confusion.

Zhe Wuming shook his head at Xue Bao. "I can't be certain, but I think something inside this rift summoned this kid to that place. Whatever that thing is, it is what he encountered when he was trapped in this place back then, and he asked for our help to enter this place specifically to look for it again."
"Do you think that kid will be okay?"

"Yes." Zhe Wuming slashed the air again. "Since that kid was trapped here once, and he managed to get out safely, I'm sure he'll be fine. For now, we have to go back to taking care of those clans, or we have to face a fight we won't be able to win."

Zhe Wuming immediately brought Xue Bao out of the space rift, and he also explained to Feng Jiu about the situation, but the Phoenix Empress was not worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the slightest. After that, the three of them left the place and checked all the clans in the Xianjin Realm.

Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already standing in front of the towering gate that he had encountered when he was first trapped in the space rift, and his expression was one of pure joy after seeing it. 'Apparently, the will of the universe also wants to meet me, and it brought me here on purpose, Mei.'
[I think so, Master. Open the gate then, and you can meet the will of the universe again.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately pushed the gate open before entering. However, he didn't go straight to the last room, but he observed every statue of the various races that stood in the first room.

As soon as he approached the two demon statues in the room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt a sudden reaction within his body, which originated from the demon seed within his body. He immediately transformed into his lust demon lord form, and two shadowy figures appeared above the two statues, one male and one female, staring at him.
[One of the ten demon seeds, huh?]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] inhaled deeply and inquired. "May I know who you two are?"

'Before, I only knew that Xu Ling'er and Jiang Yinghua had such bright souls, but this woman's soul was as bright as theirs; even Feng Yao's soul is inferior to them.'
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feng Jiu arrived at Zhe Wuming's private residence, but a void wall immediately enveloped the residence as soon as they entered.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned as a powerful pressure pressed down from above him, but he realized that the owner was not Zhe Wuming, and the owner was his beast contract, Xue Bao.
Xue Bao, who was lying on Zhe Wuming's shoulders, grinned at his expression.
However, he was shocked as soon as Ma Kuangyu helped Zhang Xiaolong [3] dispel his pressure and knocked him backwards.
"Gah!"
Zhe Wuming didn't show any reaction seeing that, but he was shocked in his heart.
Feng Jiu, on the other hand, laughed softly at Xue Bao's angry expression after being knocked away by Ma Kuangyu.
'Thank you, Old Ma.'
'Don't mind it.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked towards Zhe Wuming and asked.
"Why did you call me here, Senior?"
"I'm curious about you." Zhe Wuming tried then to check on Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the system immediately repelled his sense, leaving him shocked.
"I didn't expect there was something in your body, and it was powerful enough to repel my senses."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] casually smiled.
"If I didn't have something, I wouldn't be able to stand before you now, especially with my low cultivation."
"Hey, brat!
You—" Xue Bao shut his mouth immediately when Zhe Wuming gave him a side glance. 'Tch!
Why does my master have to bother with a brat like him?'
Zhe Wuming then spoke.
"Thank you for your information and help, or else we would have been late in returning here, and they might have already taken over this realm."

"Unfortunately, you can't relax about this matter yet, especially since there are still several other clans who choose to be loyal to Xereth outside of the Huang and Lei Clans." Watching their questioning expression, Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at them.
"I've tried to find out information about them, but I haven't gotten any information about which clans are involved in this matter.
You should send people to check all the clans in this realm now, or it will be too late if one of them activates the black statue in their clan."
Zhe Wuming did not take the information from Zhang Xiaolong [3] lightly; he immediately ordered Guan Chenhong and the others to check all the clans in the realm, both major and minor ones.
"Are Lei Huiyin and those two women in your hands?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it straight away.
"I exposed this matter, and I need their Yin Qi for my cultivation.
Therefore, I have imprisoned them in a special place, and I will milk their Yin Qi."
Zhe Wuming frowned upon hearing that, especially since such a method was identical to the actions of demons, and he had never liked demons.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle and showed it to Zhe Wuming.
"I used this artifact to milk their Yin Qi, so they didn't suffer the slightest bit."
"Oh?" Zhe Wuming, Feng Jiu, and Xue Bao were surprised by that.
Feng Jiu immediately took the shackle from Zhang Xiaolong [3], wearing it on both her hands and feet.
Instantly, her cultivation was sealed, and it subtly absorbed her Yin Qi.
"This artifact is truly interesting, and I don't feel the slightest pain."
Xue Bao floated in front of Feng Jiu, observing the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle.
"This thing keeps absorbing your Yin Qi, Jiujiu.
If the situation continues like this, you will die from Qi depletion."
"Naturally, I will not let my prisoners die so easily, or my efforts in capturing them will be in vain." The three of them turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and looked at the two pills in his hands.
"These two are superior-grade qi recovery pills and superior-grade body nourishment pills, so their body condition and qi will never decline, and the shackle will continue to absorb their Yin Qi."
"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled.
"My daughter told me about your alchemy skills, but I didn't expect that you could concoct superior-grade pills with your level still at grandmaster rank alchemist."
"I must correct you, Empress Feng.

I am no longer a grandmaster rank alchemist, but I am a king rank alchemist now, and I will become an emperor rank alchemist soon." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s reply stunned Feng Jiu, Zhe Wuming, and Xue Bao.
He just smiled and removed the shackles from the Phoenix Empress.
"If the three of you are curious about my pills, you can visit my shop in this realm that I will open after the matter with Xereth is over, and you will definitely like their effects."
Feng Jiu nodded in response.
"Yao'er already told me about some of your pills, and I can't wait to try them."
"Here, you can swallow them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave Feng Jiu a bottle of his basic pills.
"They are basic pills, but they are not the usual ones, and their effects are much more potent."
"Hey, Kid!
You gave your pills to Jiujiu, but you didn't give them to me and my master." Xue Bao immediately shouted at him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a slight shrug.
"I don't know either of you, and you've tried to pressure me before.
On the contrary, Feng Yao has helped me a lot, and Empress Feng is her mother, so I have a reason to give my pills to her."
"You—"
"That's enough, Bao'er." Zhe Wuming stopped his contract beast.
"I'll wait for your shop to open, and I'll definitely visit it in person."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"By the way, do you know anything about the space rift, senior?"
"I do." Zhe Wuming answered with a nod.
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes were sparkling.
"Can you send me into the space rift?"
"Are you crazy?" Xue Bao asked in a high pitch.
"The pressure in the space rift is too strong, and you don't have the void element.
If you force your way in there, the pressure will immediately crush your body."
Zhe Wuming spoke straight away.
"Bao'er is right, Zhang Fei.
As long as you don't have the void element, you will never be able to enter the space rift.
Moreover, there is nothing in there, so your desire to go there will only be in vain."
"Senior, I can't explain my purpose for going there to you, but I have to go back there to confirm something.

In fact, I was once trapped in the space rift, and I wouldn't be standing here today if I couldn't withstand the pressure." Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao obviously didn't believe Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since they were familiar with the situation inside the space rift, forcing him to explain the situation when the teleportation device that Shang Huaqiang had installed back then exploded.
"If you two can really send me there, I hope you can help me with that."
Since Zhe Wuming and Xiao Bao were still doubtful, Feng Jiu decided to help Zhang Xiaolong [3] in persuading them.
"Guys, my daughter witnessed the incident herself, and this kid was indeed sucked into the portal along with several other cultivators.
He was the first to return thanks to his abilities as a heavenly fox, and he managed to bring some of them back.
In fact, the young girl that I freed from the woman in the Blossom Heaven Realm was one of them, so you two don't need to doubt him anymore and help him enter that place."
"Master, he—"
"Let's do it, Bao'er." Zhe Wuming took a dagger and slashed through the air, leaving a long cut there.
He then covered Zhang Xiaolong [3] and brought him into the gap, followed by Xue Bao.
Feng Jiu wanted to follow them, but she gave up on her intention because she did not know how strong the pressure was in the void, but she knew that it was different from the pressure in outer space.
In a matter of seconds, the gap disappears by itself.
Upon arrival, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his self-created technique, and a light female figure quickly appeared behind him, illuminating the area around them.
Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao were truly surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions.
They knew that elements could be materialized into certain forms, but their forms could never be as perfect as the light female figure, which was completely identical to Jiang Yinghua.
"What are you really looking for in here?" Xue Bao asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] as he looked at the surrounding area, but there was nothing there but pitch-black darkness.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was at a loss to explain it, especially since he discovered the gate due to the call from the will of the universe. 'Are you able to track the location of the gate, Mei?'
[Unfortunately, the system cannot detect anything inside the space rift, Master.
Moreover, this place is simply as big as the universe, so we can't possibly search for it without the will of the universe's guidance.]
Xue Bao wanted to ask Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, but Zhe Wuming immediately covered his mouth and forbade his contract beast from disturbing him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes before spreading his presence and aura as far as possible, confusing Zhe Wuming and Xue Bao. 'What is he really looking for?
Why is he so eager to find it?'
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes and released a disappointed sigh.
"Apparently, the event at that time was just a mere coincidence, and I couldn't find it again."
"What exactly—" Zhe Wuming did not continue his words, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly disappeared from their sight.
He and Xue Bao immediately tried to track his whereabouts, but the space rift was simply too vast, preventing them from finding him.
However, Zhe Wuming and Xiao Bao suddenly received a voice transmission from Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he informed them that he was fine.
He did not tell them his location, and he asked them to return first.
"Master, what actually happened?
How could that kid disappear for no reason?" Xue Bao asked in confusion.
Zhe Wuming shook his head at Xue Bao.
"I can't be certain, but I think something inside this rift summoned this kid to that place.
Whatever that thing is, it is what he encountered when he was trapped in this place back then, and he asked for our help to enter this place specifically to look for it again."
"Do you think that kid will be okay?"
"Yes." Zhe Wuming slashed the air again.
"Since that kid was trapped here once, and he managed to get out safely, I'm sure he'll be fine.
For now, we have to go back to taking care of those clans, or we have to face a fight we won't be able to win."
Zhe Wuming immediately brought Xue Bao out of the space rift, and he also explained to Feng Jiu about the situation, but the Phoenix Empress was not worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the slightest.
After that, the three of them left the place and checked all the clans in the Xianjin Realm.

Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already standing in front of the towering gate that he had encountered when he was first trapped in the space rift, and his expression was one of pure joy after seeing it. 'Apparently, the will of the universe also wants to meet me, and it brought me here on purpose, Mei.'
[I think so, Master.
Open the gate then, and you can meet the will of the universe again.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately pushed the gate open before entering.
However, he didn't go straight to the last room, but he observed every statue of the various races that stood in the first room.
As soon as he approached the two demon statues in the room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt a sudden reaction within his body, which originated from the demon seed within his body.
He immediately transformed into his lust demon lord form, and two shadowy figures appeared above the two statues, one male and one female, staring at him.
[One of the ten demon seeds, huh?]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] inhaled deeply and inquired.
"May I know who you two are?"

chapters.title: Chapter 838: Some Truth
paragraphs: [Young demon, we don't have the authority to tell you anything, so you can go to the room where our demon race statues are.] The male demon figure answered Zhang Xiaolong [3].
The female demon figure informed him as well. [Young demon, the ten demon seeds are the core of our demon race, and you can meet our first emperor to learn more about them.]
"In that case, I will go to that room right now, two seniors."
The two demons looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] as he walked away. They exchanged glances and nodded to each other before disappearing from the room again.

Just like before, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found the statue of the ten-tailed fox in the middle of the next room, with statues of mythical beasts from all races standing around. However, he noticed something different about their position, and he discovered two statues that were not there before.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] jumped onto the head of the statue of the ten-tailed fox, and he looked to the left side of the room, where he found a statue of a completely black beast with bloodshot eyes above that area. Under the statue, statues of mythical beasts that are synonymous with evil, such as Qiongqi, Taowu, Taotie, Hundun, and various others, are lined up neatly.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to the right area, where he found a statue of a completely white beast with golden eyes above it. Under the statue, statues of mythical beasts that are synonymous with righteousness, such as the five-clawed golden dragon, the phoenix, the azure dragon, the black tortoise, the vermilion bird, the white tiger, the qilin, and so on, are lined up neatly.

"Why did this place change from before? What exactly happened between the beasts in the past?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] repeatedly looked at both sides. "Their positions indicated that they were involved in a war between evil and righteous in the past, and the ten-tailed fox seemed to be their pacifier. If that was true, the old fox's origins were not as simple as Grandpa Oliver and the others told me, and he should have come from a more distant era."

{You are right, Zhang Fei.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately turned to the woman, who was the manifestation of the will of the universe. {The ten-tailed fox actually came from a more distant era, and its strength was almost on par with the two primordial beasts.}

"Are you kidding me?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in a high pitch. "How could the old fox's strength be almost on par with the two primordial beasts? Wasn't he born as a result of the collective hope and power of all the fox races? The two primordial beasts were the first to be born, and their strength was too strong, so it was impossible for his strength to be close to theirs, right?"

{I'm not joking with you.} The woman replied with a shake of her head. {In the past, the ten-tailed fox's strength was almost on par with the two primordial beasts, but it wasn't easy for him to reach that stage. I won't explain the details to you, and you will know everything in the future, but first, you must find every fragment of his soul. Once you find all of them and merge with them, you will understand his true origin and the purpose of his birth.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at the woman, but the will of the universe did not intend to say anything. "At least, you can tell me about the two primordial beasts, right? What kind of beasts are these two exactly?"

{The light beast was born from Yang, and I named it the Primordial Genesis Beast. This black beast was born from Yin, and I named it the Primordial Nihility Beast. The Yin and Yang are the essence of this universe and all living things in it, and they should balance each other out. However, they are actually trying to dominate each other, leading to chaos in this universe.}
"The origin and the nothingness, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself.

The woman then continued. {As the name suggests, all of the Primordial Nihility Beast's abilities are related to destruction and nothingness. In contrast, all of the Primordial Genesis Beast's abilities are related to creation and birth. The two beasts were born with opposite characters, which caused a clash between the two in the past. After the birth of the two primordial beasts, the evil and righteous beasts were also born in this universe, but they were divided into two camps. Since then, the war between evil and righteousness continued for a long time, but the birth of the ten-tailed fox is what stopped the war. However, the war never truly ends, and as long as they are still alive, there is a possibility that it will happen again one day in the future.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] inhaled deeply before posing a question. "So, to completely end the war, the two primordial beasts must die, right?"

{Yes.} The woman answered with a nod. {However, it's important to keep in mind that if their leader dies, the pack will descend into chaos, and if no one maintains control, they will become even more wild and violent. The two primordial beasts have always controlled those beasts, preventing their war from spreading across the universe. If they didn't do that, this universe would have been destroyed long ago. The only living creature that has the ability to put their war to an end is you, especially since you are the heir of the ten-tailed fox.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] never liked all the talk about him being the successor of the ten-tailed fox and such, and he just wanted to enjoy a safe and peaceful life with his loved ones. "Why me? Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing also have the potential to become the next ten-tailed fox, right? We can say that each of them is half him, and they are much stronger than me, so they are more worthy of carrying out the task, right?"

{Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing do have a chance to become the successors of the ten-tailed fox, but they will never be able to surpass him, and they will never be able to stop the war.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at the woman. {They only have the instincts of beasts, so they lack humanity, and they don't have your evil side.}
"Do you really think I'm evil?"
{Yes, you are evil. Fortunately, you still retain your humanity, or you would become pure evil.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned deeper. "How can I be pure evil? I'm just a lust demon, and there are many demons that are more evil than me."

{Here.} The woman pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest. {The cursed demon heart will not choose you if you lack evil within you, and it will enhance your evil side. It is a source of overwhelming power and an inescapable curse, constantly corrupting its host with darkness. It once belonged to an ancient demon race that refused to perish. It is filled with eternal vengeance, twisting the nature of whoever possesses it.}

Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] clutched his chest and felt his heart throb. He had never wanted the cursed demon heart, and it had invaded his body as soon as he received the quest reward. Moreover, the demon heart had swallowed his heart, so it was now his heart, and he could not possibly get rid of it. "Am I really going to become pure evil?"
{If you lose your humanity, you will become pure evil. Therefore, you must not lose your humanity, or you will become a threat to this universe and all its inhabitants}
"I know." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then jumped down from the ten-tailed fox statue and walked to the second room, where the statues of the demons were located.
The woman followed behind Zhang Xiaolong [3] while watching him with a serious expression, and she felt helpless about his cursed demon heart.
Arriving at the second room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately approached the statue in the middle and stood in front of it. The demon seed in his body immediately reacted, making his heart beat faster.

Soon, a male figure similar to the figure from the statue appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and looked at him with his bloodshot eyes. [I have been waiting for a long time for the person who will inherit my demon seeds, but unfortunately, you only inherited one out of ten, so you will never be able to utilize their full power.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to the woman, who immediately nodded at him. He then opened the portal to the training space, and nine demons walked out of it at the same time.
Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Ursula, Yan Zhixiu, Angela, Eve, and Fyr immediately stood behind Zhang Xiaolong [3].

The demon nodded in understanding after he observed the nine female demons. [The ten demon seeds should belong to one person, but I didn't expect that they would choose ten different demons as their new masters. However, the nine of them are your women, and the bond between you is quite strong. As long as they are by your side, you will be able to maximize their strength, and you will be unrivaled among the demons. However, I can feel other powers within you, and one of them is the power of light, which makes me feel strange.]
"Senior, you are the first demon born in this universe, right?"
[Yes.]
"Since you are the first demon, you should be a Primordial Demon, and you should have almighty power, right?" The demon nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How could you die with such great power?"

The demon turned to the woman before answering Zhang Xiaolong [3]. [In the past, my strength was indeed the highest among the demons, but there were still other living creatures with much greater strength than me. One of them attacked my demon races, and I died in its hands.]
"It?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] understood it immediately. "Don't tell me that you and your demon race died at the hands of the Primordial Nihility Beast."

[The Primordial Nihility Beast attacked us and destroyed my demon races.] The demon then looked at the seven statues on the side of the room. [They were my seven loyal followers, and they fought with all their might to stop the beast. Unfortunately, the beast's power was insurmountable at the time, resulting in their death as it swallowed them. The beast absorbed their power, and it also absorbed my power after swallowing me.]
"Please forgive me; I didn't mean to bring up those bad memories." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely spoke.

[It's fine; we're long dead.] Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confused because of that, but the demon quickly clarified his doubts. [Before the beast swallowed me, I had already separated the ten demon seeds from my body, and I sent them to distant realms randomly.]
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked again. "Are there other demon ranks after the emperor rank, Senior?"
[The lesser-to-emperor ranks are mortal demon ranks; there are seven other demon ranks after that, which we call the seven transcendent demon ranks.]
"What are the names of the seven demon ranks, Senior?"

[Demon Monarch, Demon Overlord, Demon Venerable, Demon Saint, Half-Step Demon God, Demon God, Primordial Demon.] The demon let out a soft sigh before continuing. [Unfortunately, your current world is too weak, and you will never be able to reach that stage. If you want to reach that stage, you must go to the next world. Even if you succeed in going to the next world, you still need some things to become a demon monarch, and the demon essence you need will be even greater.
"What else do I need besides the demon essence?"

The demon touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and shared something with him. [When you arrive in the next world, you can look for them there. However, their numbers are too rare, so you might have a challenging time finding them. My time is up, and I will disappear soon.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Thank you for all the information you provided, Senior."

The demon nodded and touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest. [Young demon, you are a special existence in this vast universe. I believe you will surpass me and become a greater demon. If you succeed in surpassing me, I hope you are willing to unite all the demon races and lead them into a better life. However, you have to be careful because the Primordial Nihility Beast will target you, and it will devour you to gain your power.]

"Thank you for your advice, Senior." After the demon disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent the female demons back to the training space; his other clones immediately brought them back to the Nine Hells Darkland. He then glanced at the woman and posed a question. "Were you the one who created the boundaries between the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm?"

The woman nodded at him. {I did create the boundaries, and I did that for the survival of the three mortal realms. As you already know, there are several ancient mythical beasts living behind the boundaries, and I used the boundaries to imprison them there.}
"Are they planning to attack the three mortal realms? Are they doing that because of the ten demon seeds?"

{That's right.} The woman answered with a nod. {The two primordial beasts continue to exist today, with the Primordial Nihility Beast persistently striving to destroy this universe. The ten devil seeds contain the power of the primordial demon, and the beast will become stronger if it obtains them. Therefore, it sent those ancient mythical beasts to look for them, and I was forced to create the boundaries, which cut off the connection between the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded with a serious expression, but he suddenly remembered something. "What about the Ancient Devouring Demon Beast and the Abyssal Leviathan Demon? How could both of them be in the Nine Stars Realm and the Blue Water Realm?"

{I didn't seal the Ancient Devouring Demon Beast in the Nine Stars Realm, and a demon from the Paradise Realm brought the beast to that realm.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows. {The beast in that realm was the last of its kin, and the Primordial Nihility Beast was after it. Thus, the demon deliberately brought the beast to that realm and sealed it there to protect it from the Primordial Nihility Beast. As for the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, it was the demon's mount, and he purposely left it in the Blue Water Realm because he almost died at that time.}

"So, the demon who sealed the Ancient Devouring Beast in the Nine Stars Realm is dead now?" The woman nodded in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question. "By the way, you should know about the little girl who killed and resurrected me, right? Do you know about her whereabouts?"
{The little girl's existence has gone beyond this universe, and I can't track her anywhere because of it.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was completely shocked to hear that. "How could a human possibly transcend the universe? Doesn't that mean the little girl is the strongest being in the universe?"

{Zhang Fei, I know you are curious about that little girl, but you don't need to think about her for now, especially since she is beyond your and my reach. Your road ahead is still too long, so you should focus on everything in front of you, and you don't need to worry about everything that is still far ahead.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed softly as he nodded. "Hey, are there any other realms after the Paradise Realm?"
{I won't answer this question, and you'll know everything when you're ready.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not stupid, and he immediately knew that his guess was correct that there were other realms after the Paradise Realm. "I have a few last questions. What exactly happened on Earth? What kind of calamity hit Earth in the past? How did the Qi disappear from that planet?"

The only living creature that has the ability to put their war to an end is you, especially since you are the heir of the ten-tailed fox.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] never liked all the talk about him being the successor of the ten-tailed fox and such, and he just wanted to enjoy a safe and peaceful life with his loved ones.
"Why me?
Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing also have the potential to become the next ten-tailed fox, right?
We can say that each of them is half him, and they are much stronger than me, so they are more worthy of carrying out the task, right?"

{Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing do have a chance to become the successors of the ten-tailed fox, but they will never be able to surpass him, and they will never be able to stop the war.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at the woman. {They only have the instincts of beasts, so they lack humanity, and they don't have your evil side.}
"Do you really think I'm evil?"
{Yes, you are evil.
Fortunately, you still retain your humanity, or you would become pure evil.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned deeper.
"How can I be pure evil?
I'm just a lust demon, and there are many demons that are more evil than me."
{Here.} The woman pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest. {The cursed demon heart will not choose you if you lack evil within you, and it will enhance your evil side.
It is a source of overwhelming power and an inescapable curse, constantly corrupting its host with darkness.
It once belonged to an ancient demon race that refused to perish.
It is filled with eternal vengeance, twisting the nature of whoever possesses it.}
Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] clutched his chest and felt his heart throb.
He had never wanted the cursed demon heart, and it had invaded his body as soon as he received the quest reward.
Moreover, the demon heart had swallowed his heart, so it was now his heart, and he could not possibly get rid of it.
"Am I really going to become pure evil?"
{If you lose your humanity, you will become pure evil.
Therefore, you must not lose your humanity, or you will become a threat to this universe and all its inhabitants}
"I know." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then jumped down from the ten-tailed fox statue and walked to the second room, where the statues of the demons were located.
The woman followed behind Zhang Xiaolong [3] while watching him with a serious expression, and she felt helpless about his cursed demon heart.
Arriving at the second room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately approached the statue in the middle and stood in front of it.
The demon seed in his body immediately reacted, making his heart beat faster.
Soon, a male figure similar to the figure from the statue appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and looked at him with his bloodshot eyes.
[I have been waiting for a long time for the person who will inherit my demon seeds, but unfortunately, you only inherited one out of ten, so you will never be able to utilize their full power.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to the woman, who immediately nodded at him.
He then opened the portal to the training space, and nine demons walked out of it at the same time.
Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Ursula, Yan Zhixiu, Angela, Eve, and Fyr immediately stood behind Zhang Xiaolong [3].
The demon nodded in understanding after he observed the nine female demons.
[The ten demon seeds should belong to one person, but I didn't expect that they would choose ten different demons as their new masters.
However, the nine of them are your women, and the bond between you is quite strong.
As long as they are by your side, you will be able to maximize their strength, and you will be unrivaled among the demons.
However, I can feel other powers within you, and one of them is the power of light, which makes me feel strange.]
"Senior, you are the first demon born in this universe, right?"
[Yes.]
"Since you are the first demon, you should be a Primordial Demon, and you should have almighty power, right?" The demon nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How could you die with such great power?"
The demon turned to the woman before answering Zhang Xiaolong [3].
[In the past, my strength was indeed the highest among the demons, but there were still other living creatures with much greater strength than me.
One of them attacked my demon races, and I died in its hands.]
"It?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] understood it immediately.
"Don't tell me that you and your demon race died at the hands of the Primordial Nihility Beast."
[The Primordial Nihility Beast attacked us and destroyed my demon races.] The demon then looked at the seven statues on the side of the room.
[They were my seven loyal followers, and they fought with all their might to stop the beast.
Unfortunately, the beast's power was insurmountable at the time, resulting in their death as it swallowed them.
The beast absorbed their power, and it also absorbed my power after swallowing me.]
"Please forgive me; I didn't mean to bring up those bad memories." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely spoke.
[It's fine; we're long dead.] Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confused because of that, but the demon quickly clarified his doubts.
[Before the beast swallowed me, I had already separated the ten demon seeds from my body, and I sent them to distant realms randomly.]
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked again.
"Are there other demon ranks after the emperor rank, Senior?"
[The lesser-to-emperor ranks are mortal demon ranks; there are seven other demon ranks after that, which we call the seven transcendent demon ranks.]
"What are the names of the seven demon ranks, Senior?"
[Demon Monarch, Demon Overlord, Demon Venerable, Demon Saint, Half-Step Demon God, Demon God, Primordial Demon.] The demon let out a soft sigh before continuing.
[Unfortunately, your current world is too weak, and you will never be able to reach that stage.
If you want to reach that stage, you must go to the next world.
Even if you succeed in going to the next world, you still need some things to become a demon monarch, and the demon essence you need will be even greater.
"What else do I need besides the demon essence?"
The demon touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and shared something with him.
[When you arrive in the next world, you can look for them there.
However, their numbers are too rare, so you might have a challenging time finding them.
My time is up, and I will disappear soon.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"Thank you for all the information you provided, Senior."
The demon nodded and touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest.
[Young demon, you are a special existence in this vast universe.
I believe you will surpass me and become a greater demon.
If you succeed in surpassing me, I hope you are willing to unite all the demon races and lead them into a better life.
However, you have to be careful because the Primordial Nihility Beast will target you, and it will devour you to gain your power.]

"Thank you for your advice, Senior." After the demon disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent the female demons back to the training space; his other clones immediately brought them back to the Nine Hells Darkland.
He then glanced at the woman and posed a question.
"Were you the one who created the boundaries between the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm?"
The woman nodded at him. {I did create the boundaries, and I did that for the survival of the three mortal realms.
As you already know, there are several ancient mythical beasts living behind the boundaries, and I used the boundaries to imprison them there.}
"Are they planning to attack the three mortal realms?
Are they doing that because of the ten demon seeds?"
{That's right.} The woman answered with a nod. {The two primordial beasts continue to exist today, with the Primordial Nihility Beast persistently striving to destroy this universe.
The ten devil seeds contain the power of the primordial demon, and the beast will become stronger if it obtains them.
Therefore, it sent those ancient mythical beasts to look for them, and I was forced to create the boundaries, which cut off the connection between the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded with a serious expression, but he suddenly remembered something.
"What about the Ancient Devouring Demon Beast and the Abyssal Leviathan Demon?
How could both of them be in the Nine Stars Realm and the Blue Water Realm?"

{I didn't seal the Ancient Devouring Demon Beast in the Nine Stars Realm, and a demon from the Paradise Realm brought the beast to that realm.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows. {The beast in that realm was the last of its kin, and the Primordial Nihility Beast was after it.
Thus, the demon deliberately brought the beast to that realm and sealed it there to protect it from the Primordial Nihility Beast.
As for the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, it was the demon's mount, and he purposely left it in the Blue Water Realm because he almost died at that time.}
"So, the demon who sealed the Ancient Devouring Beast in the Nine Stars Realm is dead now?" The woman nodded in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question.
"By the way, you should know about the little girl who killed and resurrected me, right?
Do you know about her whereabouts?"
{The little girl's existence has gone beyond this universe, and I can't track her anywhere because of it.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was completely shocked to hear that.
"How could a human possibly transcend the universe?
Doesn't that mean the little girl is the strongest being in the universe?"
{Zhang Fei, I know you are curious about that little girl, but you don't need to think about her for now, especially since she is beyond your and my reach.
Your road ahead is still too long, so you should focus on everything in front of you, and you don't need to worry about everything that is still far ahead.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed softly as he nodded.
"Hey, are there any other realms after the Paradise Realm?"
{I won't answer this question, and you'll know everything when you're ready.}
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not stupid, and he immediately knew that his guess was correct that there were other realms after the Paradise Realm.
"I have a few last questions.
What exactly happened on Earth?
What kind of calamity hit Earth in the past?
How did the Qi disappear from that planet?"

chapters.title: Chapter 839 839: Boitata's Anger
paragraphs: {The calamity that occurred on Earth in the past was related to the desire of the four races to determine their dominance, and they were engaged in endless war.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] furrowed his brow. {The war ended after one of them used a special technique, but he absorbed all the Qi on the planet until there was nothing left; otherwise, he wouldn't be able to execute his final attack. However, his action crushed their ambition to dominate the planet due to the disappearance of the Qi, and the planet became useless to them. Unfortunately, his attack went out of control and destroyed almost half of the planet, killing millions of people from all four races.}
"Four races?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] noticed it right away. "Humans, winged races, beast races, and demons."

{Long ago, Earth was inhabited by cultivators from all four races, but those who survived the war left the planet after their war ended, leaving behind those who could not cultivate in the first place. Since then, no more cultivators were born there, and the planet gradually recovered on its own. The end of the cultivator era marked a new era on the planet, and you should already know the rest of the story from all the records in the heaven's library.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. {Ironically, the human representative who used the technique was negatively criticized and shunned by his kin for his mistake, despite their approval of his actions.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not surprised by that, especially since all living creatures, including humans, were selfish. As the saying goes, one's own faults are invisible, but the faults of others are clearly visible, and finding a scapegoat is easier than realizing one's own mistakes. "Is that man still alive now?"

{That man is still alive and living in the upper realm to this day, and you can meet him when you go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.} Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not expect that the man who caused the past calamity on earth was still alive and residing in the upper realm, which indicates his status as a powerful cultivator. {Not only did that man live there, but most of the cultivators who left earth back then also lived there. However, the rules in that realm were very strict, and they could no longer act as they pleased, like when they were still living on Earth. They will face execution, along with their families, if they dare to instigate chaos there.}
"How do I bring Qi back to earth?"

{The air pollution on Earth is significantly worse than that of the much more advanced Xianjin Realm, making it impossible for Qi to exist there again. You have made the right move by asking the two Dryads to accelerate the growth of the trees there, but the process will be too slow as long as those greedy humans and their technology still exist.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "I can wipe out the civilization there and return it to the ancient era, but Earth will decline rapidly if I do that. The second option is to move earthlings to other realms, but there is no other realm that is free from cultivators apart from the Xian and Tian Realms."

{The third option is that you can meet people in the Xianjian Realm, such as Gong Ren. If he and Cheng Gaoji work together, they can help you create something to speed up the cleaning of the air on Earth, and the Qi will return by itself once the air there is clean again.}
Clasp

Zhang Xiaolong [3] clasped both his hands together. "You're right, I can ask them for help! By the way, does Xereth have any connection to the Primordial Nihility Beast? How did he get to the Paradise Realm? Feng Yao guessed that he got an inheritance that allowed him to break through to the Five Celestial Realms, but such an inheritance shouldn't exist in the three mortal realms, and he shouldn't know the method to transform the Divine Qi into the Celestial Qi either."

{Xereth doesn't have a direct connection to the Primordial Nihility Beast, but he does have a connection to the beast below it. The primordial beast is after the demon lord seeds and some other things, and it sent Taotie with the devouring and void abilities to the three mortal realms to look for them. By chance, he met the demon, took him to the Paradise Realm, and helped him break through to the Five Celestial Realms using certain methods. After he reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord, the beast sent him back to this realm to look for them.}

"If Taotie has such abilities, he should be able to look for them himself, right?" The woman responded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a smile, making him realize something. "Since he couldn't look for them himself because you would stop him, he used Xereth, who is basically a demon cultivator from the upper realms, to search for them."

{I won't interfere in other matters, but I can't let them descend to the three mortal realms and wreak havoc there. Thus, I have to stop them, or they will wipe out the entire realm. Since I have answered all your questions, you must return to the Xianjin Realm now. If you have any other questions, you can ask Zhe Wuming to send you into the space rift, or you can look for the void elemental seed.}
"All right! Please send me out of this place." The woman waved her hand, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly disappeared from that place.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon aura.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]

The three notifications appeared as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to the Xianjin Realm, but he saw several battles taking place in several different areas. He immediately entered the invisible state, opened the map, and checked the identities of those people. "Zhe Wuming and the others managed to discover the clans involved with Xereth, huh? However, the situation is not truly safe as long as all his statues have not been destroyed, especially since he can move from one statue to another."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Huang Clan, especially since Gong Ren and Guan Chenhong were there.
"Why did you come back here, kid?" Guan Chenhong asked him.
"I want to talk to Senior Gong." Gong Ren turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly. "Senior, can you create some things to remove air pollution?"

Gong Ren nodded in response. "Creating such things is not difficult, but I have to clean up this statue first. The Nameless One and the others found the other five statues, so you have to wait for me to clean them all up."

"I'm not in a rush with that, so you can focus on this statue first, Senior." After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the Huang Clan and returned to Cheng Gaoji's residence, but he found Ye Zhiye waiting for him there. "Why did you come to me, Senior?"
"I want to talk to you alone." Ye Zhiye replied in a cold tone, especially since she was angry with him after his previous actions.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led Ye Zhiye to his room. "Follow me then."

After she was unknowingly affected by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hormone pheromone before, Ye Zhiye followed him with full vigilance. When they arrived there, she immediately sealed the room and took out a small black sword, pressing him against the wall with her sword on his neck. "Who are you really? How could you do such a thing to me?"

"If you don't put away your sword, I will use my abilities on you again." Instead, Ye Zhiye glared fiercely at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I dare to guarantee that you will never be able to stop me from using my abilities, and you will suffer more than before. Additionally, I will reveal your and Tian Shuixiang's true identities as demons to all the cultivators in this realm, and you definitely know the consequences if the Nameless One finds out."
"What nonsense are you talking about? Shuixian and I aren't demons."

"You are the Eternal Night Demon Queen, right? Tian Shuixian's real name is Shang Xiuluo, and he is the Asura demon." Ye Zhiye stiffened as she looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with trembling eyes. "Are you shocked because I know the demon race of you two? I know that the cultivation of you two has reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but I am not afraid of you two at all. If you don't want the identities of you two to be exposed to the public, you'd better get away from me now."
"Tch!" Ye Zhiye clicked her tongue and released Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How did you find out our identity and disguise?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked over to the bed as he transformed into his incubus lord form, shocking Ye Zhiye. After all, his demon aura was completely suppressed whenever he used his human form, and not many people could guess his demon identity.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat at the foot of the bed and crossed his legs over each other. "Let me guess, you two are demons from one of the demon domains in the Paradise Realm, right? You probably faced serious trouble there, and you fled to the upper realms to hide from your enemies. Since you guys didn't use any artifacts to disguise yourselves, I'm guessing that a demon with body modification abilities helped you two change your appearances."
"Heh! You're bluffing." Ye Zhiye snorted. "I don't know how you found out our identities, but you don't have any evidence to reveal our identities to them."

"Hahahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly before crossing his arms in front of his chest. "Your lover is quite unique because he has a demon god physique, and he should be quite powerful with such a physique. Besides, he also has the special physique and bloodline of the Infernal Flame Demon."
"You, how—"

"I have my own way of finding out about all that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stopped Ye Zhiye as he smiled faintly. "Do you still doubt me now? I can find out many of your secrets, so I certainly have solid evidence to use to reveal your identity. If you still doubt me, you can test my patience, and I will expose your secrets to everyone. I initially had no intention of causing trouble with either of you, as we were strangers before this interaction. However, you came to me first, and you intended to control me; thus, don't blame me if I retaliate against you in such a way."
"Tch!" Ye Zhiye, who was frustrated by that, immediately disappeared into the darkness of the night.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head to himself after Ye Zhiye left, but someone suddenly knocked on his bedroom door. He found Shang Yingyue standing outside, so he immediately opened the door for her. "Why are you here at this time of night, Senior Sister?"
"Yaolin is calmer now, so you can have a heart-to-heart conversation with her."

"Is Yaolin willing to meet me?" Shang Yingyue nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and left him directly. After that, he went to Shang Yaolin's room, finding her sitting by the window while supporting her head. "Yaolin."
Shang Yaolin did not turn around or answer Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her eyes stared at the bright stars scattered across the night sky.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked behind Shang Yaolin and grabbed her shoulders. "Yaolin, I know I was wrong for lying to you that far, and there is no reason to justify my lie, but at least try to understand my position at the time. Would you remain silent if someone caused many of your family members to suffer?"
Hearing his question, ripples appeared in Shang Yaolin's swollen eyes, but she still didn't want to say anything to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Shang Huaqiang caused my father-in-law to die; he also caused my brother-in-law and sister-in-law to turn into demons. My four wives were in utter despair after they learned of Chu Hong's death, and I felt helpless to comfort them. Seeing them cry for days made me feel disappointed and angry with myself, especially since I had promised to make them happy." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned Shang Yaolin to face him, but he immediately lowered his head. "To tell you the truth, I was angry with you because you helped him in that incident, and I wanted to take revenge on you at that time, so I immediately agreed when you wanted to take me to the Wasteland Realm."

Shang Yaolin finally looked up and stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "So, you did all that to me because you wanted to take revenge on me? You didn't want to kill me, and you wanted to make me suffer for the rest of my life."

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it without hesitation. "I originally wanted to destroy your feelings so that you could understand their suffering due to Chu Hong's death. However, I changed my mind after spending time with you, and I came to know many things, especially about the situation in the Shang Clan. I knew that you had no choice but to follow Shang Huaqiang's orders, and I started to like you after learning all that."

"I don't believe you!" Shang Yaolin shouted angrily. "If you like me, you should stop lying and tell me right then! Therefore, your feelings are just empty talk, and you only want my body to take revenge on me!"

"How could I tell you then?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a soft sigh. "You are a member of the Shang Clan, and you obey Shang Huaqiang's orders. I was weak at that time, and I was not fully aware of the Shang Clan's situation. If I had told you at that time, you would have captured me and handed me over to him."

Shang Yaolin didn't deny it because she still didn't have any feelings for Zhang Xiaolong [3] at that time, and she was pressured by Shang Huaqiang. He sent her and her brother to work in the Wasteland Realm after their failure in the Netherworld Realm, and she would hand him over to him if he told her the truth, especially since it would free her from punishment.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then crouched down in front of Shang Yaolin and held both her hands. "Yaolin, I know I wronged you, but please give me a chance, and I will prove to you that I really like you."

"Hey, bitch!" Shang Yaolin immediately looked at Boitata, who unexpectedly emerged from the beast space. "Who do you think you are? My husband has never begged anyone, let alone a woman. If he didn't like you, he wouldn't be begging you now, yet you're playing hard to get!"
"Boitata."

"Shut up!" Boitata shouted in a high voice as he pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] to his feet. "You are my husband, and I won't let this bitch treat you like this! If it weren't for you, she would never have been able to escape from Shang Huaqiang's control, so she should be grateful that you freed her from that dead person. She should also be grateful that you like her, especially since you are the cultivator with the brightest future in this universe, and you will become the strongest in the future. It's true that she is stronger than me or my sisters, but she is different from us. Unlike her, we have always accompanied you since your cultivation was at its lowest point, and we have always worked together to become strong. She doesn't deserve to be among us the way she treats you like this, and we will never accept her as our sister if you insist on wanting her as your woman. If you don't believe me, you can summon them all here to get their answers. However, I'm sure that they will agree with me, and they will never accept a woman like this bitch as part of us."
- To Be Continued -
