Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led Ye Zhiye to his room.
"Follow me then."
After she was unknowingly affected by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hormone pheromone before, Ye Zhiye followed him with full vigilance.
When they arrived there, she immediately sealed the room and took out a small black sword, pressing him against the wall with her sword on his neck.
"Who are you really?
How could you do such a thing to me?"
"If you don't put away your sword, I will use my abilities on you again." Instead, Ye Zhiye glared fiercely at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I dare to guarantee that you will never be able to stop me from using my abilities, and you will suffer more than before.
Additionally, I will reveal your and Tian Shuixiang's true identities as demons to all the cultivators in this realm, and you definitely know the consequences if the Nameless One finds out."
"What nonsense are you talking about?
Shuixian and I aren't demons."
"You are the Eternal Night Demon Queen, right?
Tian Shuixian's real name is Shang Xiuluo, and he is the Asura demon." Ye Zhiye stiffened as she looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with trembling eyes.
"Are you shocked because I know the demon race of you two?
I know that the cultivation of you two has reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but I am not afraid of you two at all.
If you don't want the identities of you two to be exposed to the public, you'd better get away from me now."
"Tch!" Ye Zhiye clicked her tongue and released Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How did you find out our identity and disguise?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked over to the bed as he transformed into his incubus lord form, shocking Ye Zhiye.
After all, his demon aura was completely suppressed whenever he used his human form, and not many people could guess his demon identity.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat at the foot of the bed and crossed his legs over each other.
"Let me guess, you two are demons from one of the demon domains in the Paradise Realm, right?
You probably faced serious trouble there, and you fled to the upper realms to hide from your enemies.
Since you guys didn't use any artifacts to disguise yourselves, I'm guessing that a demon with body modification abilities helped you two change your appearances."
"Heh!
You're bluffing." Ye Zhiye snorted.
"I don't know how you found out our identities, but you don't have any evidence to reveal our identities to them."
"Hahahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly before crossing his arms in front of his chest.
"Your lover is quite unique because he has a demon god physique, and he should be quite powerful with such a physique.
Besides, he also has the special physique and bloodline of the Infernal Flame Demon."
"You, how—"
"I have my own way of finding out about all that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stopped Ye Zhiye as he smiled faintly.
"Do you still doubt me now?
I can find out many of your secrets, so I certainly have solid evidence to use to reveal your identity.
If you still doubt me, you can test my patience, and I will expose your secrets to everyone.
I initially had no intention of causing trouble with either of you, as we were strangers before this interaction.
However, you came to me first, and you intended to control me; thus, don't blame me if I retaliate against you in such a way."
"Tch!" Ye Zhiye, who was frustrated by that, immediately disappeared into the darkness of the night.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head to himself after Ye Zhiye left, but someone suddenly knocked on his bedroom door.
He found Shang Yingyue standing outside, so he immediately opened the door for her.
"Why are you here at this time of night, Senior Sister?"
"Yaolin is calmer now, so you can have a heart-to-heart conversation with her."
"Is Yaolin willing to meet me?" Shang Yingyue nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and left him directly.
After that, he went to Shang Yaolin's room, finding her sitting by the window while supporting her head.
"Yaolin."
Shang Yaolin did not turn around or answer Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her eyes stared at the bright stars scattered across the night sky.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked behind Shang Yaolin and grabbed her shoulders.
"Yaolin, I know I was wrong for lying to you that far, and there is no reason to justify my lie, but at least try to understand my position at the time.
Would you remain silent if someone caused many of your family members to suffer?"
Hearing his question, ripples appeared in Shang Yaolin's swollen eyes, but she still didn't want to say anything to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Shang Huaqiang caused my father-in-law to die; he also caused my brother-in-law and sister-in-law to turn into demons.
My four wives were in utter despair after they learned of Chu Hong's death, and I felt helpless to comfort them.

Seeing them cry for days made me feel disappointed and angry with myself, especially since I had promised to make them happy." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned Shang Yaolin to face him, but he immediately lowered his head.

"To tell you the truth, I was angry with you because you helped him in that incident, and I wanted to take revenge on you at that time, so I immediately agreed when you wanted to take me to the Wasteland Realm."
Shang Yaolin finally looked up and stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"So, you did all that to me because you wanted to take revenge on me?
You didn't want to kill me, and you wanted to make me suffer for the rest of my life."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it without hesitation.
"I originally wanted to destroy your feelings so that you could understand their suffering due to Chu Hong's death.
However, I changed my mind after spending time with you, and I came to know many things, especially about the situation in the Shang Clan.
I knew that you had no choice but to follow Shang Huaqiang's orders, and I started to like you after learning all that."
"I don't believe you!" Shang Yaolin shouted angrily.
"If you like me, you should stop lying and tell me right then!
Therefore, your feelings are just empty talk, and you only want my body to take revenge on me!"
"How could I tell you then?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a soft sigh.
"You are a member of the Shang Clan, and you obey Shang Huaqiang's orders.
I was weak at that time, and I was not fully aware of the Shang Clan's situation.
If I had told you at that time, you would have captured me and handed me over to him."
Shang Yaolin didn't deny it because she still didn't have any feelings for Zhang Xiaolong [3] at that time, and she was pressured by Shang Huaqiang.

He sent her and her brother to work in the Wasteland Realm after their failure in the Netherworld Realm, and she would hand him over to him if he told her the truth, especially since it would free her from punishment.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then crouched down in front of Shang Yaolin and held both her hands.
"Yaolin, I know I wronged you, but please give me a chance, and I will prove to you that I really like you."
"Hey, bitch!" Shang Yaolin immediately looked at Boitata, who unexpectedly emerged from the beast space.
"Who do you think you are?
My husband has never begged anyone, let alone a woman.
If he didn't like you, he wouldn't be begging you now, yet you're playing hard to get!"
"Boitata."
"Shut up!" Boitata shouted in a high voice as he pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] to his feet.
"You are my husband, and I won't let this bitch treat you like this!
If it weren't for you, she would never have been able to escape from Shang Huaqiang's control, so she should be grateful that you freed her from that dead person.
She should also be grateful that you like her, especially since you are the cultivator with the brightest future in this universe, and you will become the strongest in the future.
It's true that she is stronger than me or my sisters, but she is different from us.
Unlike her, we have always accompanied you since your cultivation was at its lowest point, and we have always worked together to become strong.
She doesn't deserve to be among us the way she treats you like this, and we will never accept her as our sister if you insist on wanting her as your woman.
If you don't believe me, you can summon them all here to get their answers.
However, I'm sure that they will agree with me, and they will never accept a woman like this bitch as part of us."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 840 840: Meet His Big Families
paragraphs: Hearing the commotion, Lin Moxian, Qiao Liangren, Yan Yinqing, Tantai Lingyan, Shang Yingyue, and Wu Xueming rushed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s room, where they saw Boitata hugging his arm while fiercely glaring at Shang Yaolin.

Unlike Lin Moxian, the other six had never met Boitata, but they immediately understood that she was one of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s wives. The three women, Yan Yinqing, Tantai Lingyan, and Shang Yingyue, were jealous because of her beauty.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh and opened the gate to the Nine Stars Realm; he brought them all into that realm before going to their residence in the southernmost area of the human island.
"Who created all the formations in this residence and the surrounding area, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian asked.
Qiao Liangren also checked every formation. "Their grades are not high, but they are more than enough for the middle realms."
"I agree with you, Senior Brother." Shang Yingyue said with a nod.
Yan Yinqing then asked. "Isn't our junior brother a rank 4 array master? All these formations are rank 4 and 5, so he should be able to create some of them."

"Senior Sister Yan, I had not reached that rank when I transmigrated to this realm. Therefore, I asked my acquaintance, Fa Zhen, to create them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the portal to the training space and asked everyone inside to come out, especially since they had been living there for the past five months. Furthermore, the flow of time inside was two times faster than in the outside world, which is why he asked everyone to take a rest first.

Lin Moxian and the others were stunned as they came out one by one, especially since there were so many of them. Moreover, their number is dominated by women, and none of them is ugly; instead, all of them are such beauties with different characteristics and demeanors.
"Mother! Father!" Wu Lianzhi shouted as soon as she saw her parents there, and she rushed over to them. "I missed you so much!"

Wu Xueming smiled and lifted Wu Lianzhi into his arms, but Shang Yingyue sighed in her heart after she detected Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi within their daughter's body. "Your cultivation has improved a lot since we left, Lianzhi."
"Hehe." Wu Lianzhi giggled and whispered into her father's ear, surprising Wu Xueming. "If it weren't for that, I wouldn't have broken through to the soul realm, Father."
"I see." Wu Xueming nodded in understanding. "However, you shouldn't rely solely on that and must continue manual cultivation, understood?"
"I know, Father." Wu Lianzhi then pointed to Xu Ling'er and Tasha. "Father, they are always good to me, and the three of us are like sisters now."

Wu Xueming and Shang Yingyue immediately looked at the two little girls, and they could tell that Xu Ling'er was about the same age as their daughter. However, Tasha was much older than them, and they recognized that she was a wolf demon.

"Tasha is a wolf demon from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, but her father brought her to the Netherworld Realm to hide from their enemies, and Long'er met them there." Wu Xueming and Shang Yingyue nodded to Wu Lianzhi, who immediately continued. "Xu Ling'er is the daughter of Big Sis Ru Xue, one of Long'er's wives, and she will also be his wife in the future."

Hearing that, they all looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with strange gazes, especially since Xu Ling'er was only 11 years old. However, he already considered her his wife, and he even gave his Yang Qi to her. Furthermore, her mother was one of his wives, which made them feel like their relationship was a strange one.

Ru Xue, who was standing beside Zhang Xiaolong [3], immediately told them. "Seniors, my husband never thought about it before, but my daughter fell in love with him. Since his relationship was already messy, I decided to let my daughter be his wife in the future."

Although Ru Xue explained it that way, Shang Yingyue still felt that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s relationship with them was too strange. Unlike them, Shang Yaolin felt inferior and embarrassed toward them, especially because of their beauty, and many of them were hotter than her, such as Boitata.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly introduced her to them. "Ru Xue was my first woman, and she became my woman the moment I awakened my demon side. She used to be a human, but she chose to become a demon, and she made that decision for my sake."

"Which of them are your women, Junior Brother? How can they all be this beautiful?" Yan Yinqing curiously asked. Shang Yaolin, Tantai Lingyan, and Shang Yingyue were also curious about their identities.

Zhang Xialong [3] first introduced them to Zhang Chen, his family members, and his wives' families. After that, he told them about the identities of all his official women, unofficial women, servants, and clones' partners. "Only Shang Yumei, Hong Xinxin, and Murong Qianying were absent, especially since they are in three different realms now."

"Hahahaha." Yan Yinqing laughed out loud before turning to Lin Moxian and Qiao Liangren with a mischievous smile on her face. "Senior brother! Liangren! Look at our junior brother; he is much younger than us, but he has more than fifty women by his side. Meanwhile, you two are still single even after hundreds of years, so you two should learn from him in wooing women."
Qiao Liangren responded to Yan Yinqing with a relaxed smile, especially since he didn't think much about women, and his cultivation was much more important to him.

Lin Moxian, on the other hand, immediately mocked Yan Yinqing back. "Do you think you are any different from us? You have been here for over a thousand years, but you have never had a lover, so you are a great sage!"
"Humph!" Yan Yinqing snorted and shut her mouth without being able to refute, making Lin Moxian smile triumphantly.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Zhang Chen. "Grandma, I know it's still midnight, but please prepare a feast for them so they can taste the dishes from the earth."
"Leave everything to us." Zhang Chen then glanced at Shang Yaolin. "Bring her and the others with you, and we will accompany your guests."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I will take them to the Southern Ocean now."
Upon arrival, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to speak to Shang Yaolin, but all his women glared at him. Even Zhang Yue and Hu Yue, who never asked for anything, also asked him to leave them.

'Tch! They're really scary when they unite like this!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered in his heart as he moved away from them, making Mei laugh loudly in his mind. 'Stop laughing at me, or I'll kick your ass.'
[Hahaha! You can try, Master.] Mei challenged Zhang Xiaolong [3] as she continued to laugh.

"Do you still think you are important after meeting us?" Boitata asked Shang Yaolin directly, and her tone was full of disdain. "Xian Xianqin is the princess of this kingdom. Yun Xinyue is the princess of the Yun Kingdom. Meanwhile, Zhou Shenxin is the empress of the Zhou Kingdom, so our husband is the emperor. Compared to us, your only advantage is your cultivation. Sooner or later, we will reach your level, and you will no longer have any other advantages over us."

Shang Yaolin clenched both fists tightly, especially since Boitata had been continuously insulting him since the Xianjin Realm. She wanted to attack her, but she couldn't possibly fight them all. Moreover, Shou Shenxin and some of them were stronger than her, so she would be doomed if she fought them.

Liu Hua, observing her expression, spoke. "The first time we met was a little over a year ago; our husband had not yet begun his cultivation path at that time, and he began it in our residence. Since then, we have always helped each other to reach this stage, so our relationship is already deep now."

"I don't mean to belittle you or brag about ourselves in front of you, but Boitata is right. We are indeed weaker than you, but some of us have higher statuses than you." Liu Qingyu also spoke to Shang Yaolin. "At first, our husband also lied to us, especially about his identity as a lust demon. At that time, some of us had already become his women, and we were quite disappointed because of his lies. However, we realized that he was forced to lie because his cultivation was still in the Elementary Realm, and he had no backers in our home realm. In the end, we decided to forgive him and accepted everything, including his lies."

Chu Ying didn't like Shang Yaolin's attitude toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she could understand her feelings. Then, she grabbed her hand and spoke to her. "Honestly, our situations are a bit similar, but at that time, my relationship with Fei'er had not progressed as far as your relationship with him. I was disappointed in him because he did something unusual to me without my consent, and I was also disappointed that he did not reveal his demon identity from the start. However, he never did anything evil to me; he even saved my mother and aunt from an evil cultivator. Therefore, I forgave him and accepted him, and we eventually became husband and wife."

"I already liked Fei'er before I knew that he was human." Shang Yaolin cast a strange side glance at Chu Qing. "I'm not concerned about his identity, whether he is human, beast, or demon. At that time, I knew I would be happy if he were by my side, so I accepted whatever he was."

Hu Yue then told Shang Yaolin about her first meeting with Zhang Fei, which surprised her. "I don't know what came over me at that time, but I fell in love with him at first sight, and I decided to give myself to him at that moment. He promised to save me in five years, but he fulfilled our promise several years early."

"I became Fei'er's wife initially because of my bet with Qingyu, and I still didn't know him at that time because it was our first time meeting." This time, Zhang Lingxue spoke to Shang Yaolin. "However, I feel lucky to have known him and to be his wife, and I will never hesitate to do anything to help him."

"My situation is not much different from Hu Yue, and I kept thinking about our husband after our first meeting at the Blazing Volcano Mountain." Shang Yaolin turned to Shen Yu, who directly told her about their relationship. "For my sake, he joined our sect. Not only did he free me from my shackles, but he also helped us to clean up our enemies. I am now his wife, and I will do anything for him."

After that, Zhao Ziqin, Ye Lian, Jannete, Lillea, Shen Xueyi, and the other women also told Shang Yaolin about the beginning of their relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3] up to their decision to become his wife.
"I—" Shang Yaolin wanted to say something, but no words came out of her mouth.

Ru Xue sighed softly as she looked at Shang Yaolin. "I'm not saying this because I'm his wife, but I've known him for much longer than you, so I've long understood his character and feelings. He's a loving person, but he's also a vengeful person. He did lie to you, but he did it because you were his enemy. You obeyed Shang Huaqiang's orders, and your actions caused some of us to suffer, so he took revenge on you in such a way. However, he and Sister Yumei have told us about many things, which allowed us to understand your situation."

"Like Xue, I have known our husband for several years, so I also understand everything about him. After we understand your situation, we ask him to forgive you, and we want him to take you as his wife." Zhong Yan then pointed to Zhang Yue and Zhang Lin. "Among us, the two of them understand him the most, especially since they are his big sister and younger sister. Lin'er is his first love, and she loves him unconditionally. Yue'er rarely shows her feelings, but she wholeheartedly loves him."

"Sister Yaolin, I can understand your disappointment, but the situation between the two of you forced him to lie to you." Zhang Lin took Shang Yaolin's hand. "If you really like him, you should learn to understand the situation, and you can try to forgive him."

"We wanted him to accept you as his woman, but we didn't like your attitude toward him." Shang Yaolin shivered hearing Zhang Yue's icy voice and icy aura. "For us, our husband is everything, and we will do anything for him. We won't let him beg anyone, including you. If you care more about your feelings, you are not worthy to be his wife, and we will never accept you among us."
Boitata smirked as soon as Zhang Yue said that, and the other women also agreed with her. After all, they had been with Zhang Xiaolong [3] for so long, and they also had the same goal.

"Yaolin, you don't need to make a decision now, and you can think things through first." Qing Yi then turned to the others. "I think we've talked to him enough, and we don't need to force him to accept our principles. If he can forgive Fei'er and love her sincerely, we will accept him, but vice versa."
"I agree." Xian Xianqin then turned around. "Let's go back and let him think about our words first."
After that, Zhang Lin and the others immediately followed Xian Xianqin, but Shen Xueyi paused for a moment and spoke to Shang Yaolin. "I hope you will make the right decision for your future."
*Thud*
Shang Yaolin fell into the sand after they left. She then hugged her legs, buried her face between them, and started sobbing.
However, Murong Qianying suddenly landed behind her daughter. Zhang Xiaolong [3] deliberately picked her up at the Red Sun Realm and brought her there specifically to talk to Shang Yaolin.
Murong Qianying released a soft sigh, sat by Shang Yaolin's side, and hugged her.
For a moment, Shang Yaolin looked up at her mother, taken aback. She then asked her. "What should I do, Mother?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" Murong Qianying returned the question as she caressed the back of Shang Yaolin's head. "If only your father and I were strong enough to fight Shang Huaqiang back then, you would never be in this kind of situation. I know you have completely fallen in love with him, but our weakness led to this situation. You must follow your feelings, or you will make a decision that you will regret for the rest of your life."

Shang Yaolin was innocent, but she was not stupid, and she knew that she would regret it if she refused to forgive Zhang Xiaolong [3]. However, she could not possibly forgive him just like that, especially since his lies deeply disappointed her.
Shang Yaolin then laid her head on her mother's shoulder as she considered everything, and Murong Qianying just held her in her arms, letting her think.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at the Huangfu Kingdom, and he went straight to the dungeon. Helian Yueyi immediately recognized him, but she no longer remembered any communication or meeting between them.
"Zhang Fei!" Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying exclaimed in surprise. "Zhang Fei! Please free us from this place."

"Why should I free you three?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] posed this question as he stood before their prison. "Your father and brother repeatedly wanted to capture me, but I didn't expect that Huangfu Shou would already die before I could take revenge on him."
"We—"
"That's enough, Xiaoying and Xiaomei." Helian Yueyi stopped her two daughters. "Why did you come here? Do you want to take revenge on us for what my late husband did to you?"
- To Be Continued -

Since then, we have always helped each other to reach this stage, so our relationship is already deep now."
"I don't mean to belittle you or brag about ourselves in front of you, but Boitata is right.
We are indeed weaker than you, but some of us have higher statuses than you." Liu Qingyu also spoke to Shang Yaolin.
"At first, our husband also lied to us, especially about his identity as a lust demon.
At that time, some of us had already become his women, and we were quite disappointed because of his lies.
However, we realized that he was forced to lie because his cultivation was still in the Elementary Realm, and he had no backers in our home realm.
In the end, we decided to forgive him and accepted everything, including his lies."
Chu Ying didn't like Shang Yaolin's attitude toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she could understand her feelings.
Then, she grabbed her hand and spoke to her.
"Honestly, our situations are a bit similar, but at that time, my relationship with Fei'er had not progressed as far as your relationship with him.
I was disappointed in him because he did something unusual to me without my consent, and I was also disappointed that he did not reveal his demon identity from the start.
However, he never did anything evil to me; he even saved my mother and aunt from an evil cultivator.
Therefore, I forgave him and accepted him, and we eventually became husband and wife."
"I already liked Fei'er before I knew that he was human." Shang Yaolin cast a strange side glance at Chu Qing.
"I'm not concerned about his identity, whether he is human, beast, or demon.
At that time, I knew I would be happy if he were by my side, so I accepted whatever he was."
Hu Yue then told Shang Yaolin about her first meeting with Zhang Fei, which surprised her.
"I don't know what came over me at that time, but I fell in love with him at first sight, and I decided to give myself to him at that moment.
He promised to save me in five years, but he fulfilled our promise several years early."
"I became Fei'er's wife initially because of my bet with Qingyu, and I still didn't know him at that time because it was our first time meeting." This time, Zhang Lingxue spoke to Shang Yaolin.
"However, I feel lucky to have known him and to be his wife, and I will never hesitate to do anything to help him."

"My situation is not much different from Hu Yue, and I kept thinking about our husband after our first meeting at the Blazing Volcano Mountain." Shang Yaolin turned to Shen Yu, who directly told her about their relationship.
"For my sake, he joined our sect.
Not only did he free me from my shackles, but he also helped us to clean up our enemies.
I am now his wife, and I will do anything for him."

After that, Zhao Ziqin, Ye Lian, Jannete, Lillea, Shen Xueyi, and the other women also told Shang Yaolin about the beginning of their relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [3] up to their decision to become his wife.
"I—" Shang Yaolin wanted to say something, but no words came out of her mouth.
Ru Xue sighed softly as she looked at Shang Yaolin.
"I'm not saying this because I'm his wife, but I've known him for much longer than you, so I've long understood his character and feelings.
He's a loving person, but he's also a vengeful person.
He did lie to you, but he did it because you were his enemy.
You obeyed Shang Huaqiang's orders, and your actions caused some of us to suffer, so he took revenge on you in such a way.
However, he and Sister Yumei have told us about many things, which allowed us to understand your situation."
"Like Xue, I have known our husband for several years, so I also understand everything about him.
After we understand your situation, we ask him to forgive you, and we want him to take you as his wife." Zhong Yan then pointed to Zhang Yue and Zhang Lin.
"Among us, the two of them understand him the most, especially since they are his big sister and younger sister.
Lin'er is his first love, and she loves him unconditionally.
Yue'er rarely shows her feelings, but she wholeheartedly loves him."
"Sister Yaolin, I can understand your disappointment, but the situation between the two of you forced him to lie to you." Zhang Lin took Shang Yaolin's hand.
"If you really like him, you should learn to understand the situation, and you can try to forgive him."
"We wanted him to accept you as his woman, but we didn't like your attitude toward him." Shang Yaolin shivered hearing Zhang Yue's icy voice and icy aura.
"For us, our husband is everything, and we will do anything for him.
We won't let him beg anyone, including you.
If you care more about your feelings, you are not worthy to be his wife, and we will never accept you among us."
Boitata smirked as soon as Zhang Yue said that, and the other women also agreed with her.
After all, they had been with Zhang Xiaolong [3] for so long, and they also had the same goal.
"Yaolin, you don't need to make a decision now, and you can think things through first." Qing Yi then turned to the others.
"I think we've talked to him enough, and we don't need to force him to accept our principles.
If he can forgive Fei'er and love her sincerely, we will accept him, but vice versa."
"I agree." Xian Xianqin then turned around.
"Let's go back and let him think about our words first."
After that, Zhang Lin and the others immediately followed Xian Xianqin, but Shen Xueyi paused for a moment and spoke to Shang Yaolin.
"I hope you will make the right decision for your future."
*Thud*
Shang Yaolin fell into the sand after they left.
She then hugged her legs, buried her face between them, and started sobbing.
However, Murong Qianying suddenly landed behind her daughter.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] deliberately picked her up at the Red Sun Realm and brought her there specifically to talk to Shang Yaolin.
Murong Qianying released a soft sigh, sat by Shang Yaolin's side, and hugged her.
For a moment, Shang Yaolin looked up at her mother, taken aback.
She then asked her.
"What should I do, Mother?"
"Don't you already know the answer?" Murong Qianying returned the question as she caressed the back of Shang Yaolin's head.
"If only your father and I were strong enough to fight Shang Huaqiang back then, you would never be in this kind of situation.
I know you have completely fallen in love with him, but our weakness led to this situation.
You must follow your feelings, or you will make a decision that you will regret for the rest of your life."
Shang Yaolin was innocent, but she was not stupid, and she knew that she would regret it if she refused to forgive Zhang Xiaolong [3].
However, she could not possibly forgive him just like that, especially since his lies deeply disappointed her.
Shang Yaolin then laid her head on her mother's shoulder as she considered everything, and Murong Qianying just held her in her arms, letting her think.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at the Huangfu Kingdom, and he went straight to the dungeon.
Helian Yueyi immediately recognized him, but she no longer remembered any communication or meeting between them.
"Zhang Fei!" Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying exclaimed in surprise.
"Zhang Fei!
Please free us from this place."
"Why should I free you three?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] posed this question as he stood before their prison.
"Your father and brother repeatedly wanted to capture me, but I didn't expect that Huangfu Shou would already die before I could take revenge on him."
"We—"
"That's enough, Xiaoying and Xiaomei." Helian Yueyi stopped her two daughters.
"Why did you come here?
Do you want to take revenge on us for what my late husband did to you?"
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 841: Heavenly Bliss Pavilion
paragraphs: *Clang*

Zhang Xiaolong [3] broke the prison padlock, walked in, and squatted in front of the three women. "I have no interest in taking revenge on three helpless women, and I am here to free the three of you, but on one condition."
"What is your one condition?" Helian Yueyi asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] lifted Helian Yueyi's chin with a faint smile. "You must marry me."

"Shh." Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed Helian Yueyi's lips. "Your husband is dead, and I need your status in the Huangfu royal family to accomplish a task. I don't need your body, and I don't mind if you don't want to serve me as a wife. If you agree with me, I will take the three of you out of this prison, and you guys can live freely again without any pressure."
"Zhang Fei, let us replace our mother." Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying spoke simultaneously.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not answer the two women and asked Helian Yueyi again. "Have you ever considered the possibility that Li Tiannan might forcefully violate the three of you someday? Or do you prefer something like that to happen to you guys? You had everything before, but your two daughters are still virgins, and they'll suffer if something like that happens to them."

Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying shuddered as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned it. They certainly didn't want something like that to happen to them, especially since that person was their father's killer.

"What exactly do you need from my status as the Huangfu royal family? Why should I marry you?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] simply smiled at Helian Yueyi, especially since he needed her status to complete the quest from the system. "Are you really not going to force me to serve you?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "If I wanted to force you to serve me, I could do it right here, right now, and you would never be able to refuse me."
"Mother."

Helian Yueyi looked at her two daughters before making a decision. "All right, I agree to that, but you must keep your word not to force me to serve you. If you force me to serve you, I will commit suicide immediately."
'She's still threatening me like that, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] freed Helian Yueyi and his two daughters from the chains that bound them. "I am a man of my word, and I will never force you."

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already brought the three women to the residence on the small island, which belonged to Linghu Yincheng. He then gave a red wedding dress to Helian Yueyi. "This dress is the wedding dress of one of my wives, and I brought it because her body size is similar to yours. You can wear it now, and we will get married traditionally afterward."
"All right." Helian Yueyi immediately went to one of the rooms to change dresses, followed by Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei.
[Are you really not going to touch that woman, Master?]

'Don't you already know the answer, Mei?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to the question as he began to undress and put on his wedding gown. 'I will use other means to get Helian Yueyi, and she will fall for me after she forgets Huangfu Shou.'

After he wore his wedding dress, Zhang Xiaolong [3] set up a table as an altar for his wedding with Helian Yueyi. He placed several things on it, such as candles and several other objects, similar to his wedding with the three princesses.

Sometime later, Helian Yueyi came out of the room wearing the wedding dress. Even though she didn't wear any makeup, she was still quite pretty in her red wedding dress. After that, they immediately started their wedding ceremony, with Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei as their wedding witnesses.

Both notifications immediately appeared inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s mind as soon as they finished their wedding ceremony. 'As expected! Helian Yueyi is still considered the Huangfu royal family by the system! Open the reward, Mei.'
[Yes.]
[You obtained the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion.]
'Oh? A pavilion, huh?'

[Heavenly Bliss Pavilion is a sanctuary for dual cultivators; it is built upon the foundation of an ancient Moon Jade Vein. The walls, pillars, and floors of the manor are carved from Lustrous Moon Jade, a rare divine material that passively absorbs and refines both Yin and Yang qi. The manor is equipped with the Boundless Yin-Yang Array, a divine dual cultivation array, designed to achieve the perfect fusion of Yin and Yang Qi.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in satisfaction after reading the description, and he immediately spoke to Helian Yueyi. "Although I won't force you to serve me, you are still my wife, so you should forget about your desire to have a relationship with another man."

"You don't have to worry about that; I have no desire to have a relationship with any man." Helian Yueyi then embraced Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying. "My two daughters are the most important to me, and I want to live a quiet life with them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] unsealed their cultivation, and he didn't worry that they would escape from him, especially since he had long implanted his soul mark into their souls. He gave them three types of coins in huge amounts so they could buy everything they needed. "This residence actually belongs to Linghu Yincheng, but you don't need to think about that. I have already informed her about the three of you here, and no one will disturb you, including Li Tiannan."
"Thank you."
After they changed into their normal clothes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the three women.
Helian Yueyi let out a soft sigh and spoke to her two daughters. "We are free now, but we will not return to our kingdom, and we will live normal lives from now on."
"What about our big brother, Mother?" Huangfu Xiaomei asked.

Helian Yueyi shook her head. "I want to free Lian'er from that man's control, but Li Tiannan came from the upper realms, and his cultivation is extremely high. If we act rashly, he will capture and imprison us again. For now, we just need to focus on our cultivation, and we will free your brother in the future."
"Yes, Mother."
Helian Yueyi then led them to one of the rooms. "We have been locked up in prison for a long time, so we should rest now, and we will go to the Bai Clan to buy things this morning."
Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying followed their mother, but their minds were occupied by Zhang Xiaolong [3], and they looked forward to seeing him again.
When he arrived at his residence, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found Murong Qianying and Shang Yaolin already among them, and Zhang Chen looked serious talking to the two.

Meanwhile, Qing Yi, Zhang Hanzhi, Qing Tan, and several women were still busy preparing dishes to entertain their guests. Tantai Lingyan and Yan Yinqing joined them, especially since both of them were curious about Earth's dishes.
"Who were the three women before, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian posed this question as he and Qiao Liangren approached Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not surprised by Lin Moxian's question, especially since he had previously detected his senses. "They were the former empress and two princesses of the Huangfu Kingdom, and they were once my enemies. I killed the emperor and took over the kingdom, but I left some of my slaves to take care of it."
"How many slaves do you have? Doesn't that weigh on your soul?" Qiao Liangren asked.

"Senior Liangren, I didn't use my soul mark to enslave them. Instead, I used my demon ability for that, so my soul wasn't too burdened by them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told the two men about the identities of the ten men and three women slaves. "All of them have made serious mistakes, so I enslaved them. If their mistakes are not too serious, I will only lock them up in my prison, and I will release them after I no longer need them."
Qiao Liangren released a soft sigh and grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "If only I had a little of your courage, I would never be in this kind of situation."
"What do you mean by that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.

"Liangren's lover died at the hands of his enemy." Lin Moxian's answer shocked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He knew that person hated him and repeatedly sought trouble with him, but he didn't have the heart to do anything to him, especially since he was his brother. The incident happened when he went with our master to train, and that person killed his lover to make him suffer. Since then, he would rather not get close to any woman, and he was more focused on his cultivation."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Is he still alive?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded at him. "After all, he is my big brother, and I don't have the guts to take revenge on him."
"Do you want me to kill him?" Qiao Liangren was taken aback by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question. "You don't know it yet, but I killed my brother and ex-lover myself."
"Did you really do that?" Qiao Liangren asked in disbelief.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "I don't care who they are; I will kill anyone who dares to betray me. They betrayed and framed me, and they tried to do terrible things to one of my women, so I killed them."

"I see." Qiao Liangren immediately made up his mind. "Can you help me kill him? I want to kill him myself, but I can't do it. I will never be able to move on as long as he is still alive, and his death is the only relief for me."

"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with that, especially since Qiao Liangren had helped him a lot when he started out on the soul cultivation path. "One of my clones will go to the Qiao Clan now, and you will receive news of his death soon."
"Thank you."

"No need for thanks. You have helped me a lot, and we share the same master, so I will assist you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then gave Qiao Liangren the basic pills and Yang Purifying Pill. "Senior Brother Moxian has already swallowed them, so now it's your turn."
"All right, I will swallow them now." Qiao Liangren immediately searched for an empty place to swallow the pills.
Then, Lin Moxian asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What are your plans regarding Tian Shuixiang? Was the woman who came to you earlier his woman?"

"Her name is Ye Zhiye, and she is indeed Tian Shuixiang's lover. She is also a demon, to be precise, the Eternal Night Demon Queen." Lin Moxian frowned at that. "Believe me or not, but that guy is the asura demon. Although that woman didn't admit it directly, I already know that they are demons from the Paradise Realm, and their cultivation has already reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
"Are you going to reveal their identities to the public?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a shake of his head. "Senior Brother, I myself am a lust demon lord, and not all demons are evil. Moreover, you yourself said that Tian Shuixiang helped the people in your home realm a lot, so I won't reveal their identities for now. However, I will directly reveal their identities if they have malicious intentions, and Zhe Wuming and the others can take care of them."
Lin Moxian looked confused upon hearing the latter name. "Zhe Wuming? Who is that?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly as he let slip the name. "Zhe Wuming is the Nameless One's true name, and I learned it when I met him before. By the way, you better not tell anyone else about his true name, or he will lock me up using his void element."

"I can't say anything about you." Lin Moxian sighed softly. "Everyone, including our master, has known the Nameless One for a long time, but they don't know anything about his true name. Instead, you've only met him once, but you know it right away."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled upon hearing that. "The dishes are almost ready, so let's join them."

Inside their room, Tian Shuixiang looked serious as he listened to Ye Zhiye's explanation of her previous meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "No wonder that kid's ability had such an effect on you; it turns out he's a lust demon lord. However, I don't understand where he got the information about our real identities, and he even knows so much detail down to my true physique, special physique, and bloodline."

"I didn't know that myself, and I initially thought that he was bluffing on purpose. However, I changed my mind after he mentioned those three, and I immediately left him." Ye Zhiye then asked him. "What should we do about that kid? Should we kill him to cover everything up? If he leaks our identities to them, the Nameless One and the others will attack us directly, and we will have no choice but to return to the Paradise Realm if that happens."

"You underestimate that kid too much, Zhiye." Tian Shuixiang disagreed with Ye Zhiye's idea. "He came from the lower realms, and his cultivation was still in the ten mortal realms, but he was able to reach this realm so quickly. Moreover, I couldn't check on him because my senses were blocked by something inside his body, and he also had connections with people from the Paradise Realm. We don't know the identities of the people behind him, so we should face this matter with a cool head. Otherwise, the people in that realm will know of our existence here, and they will hunt us down here. I'm sure that kid won't reveal our identities, and he purposely told you all that to prevent us from interfering in his business, so we'll play along with him."
"Are you sure about that?" Ye Zhiye doubtfully asked.

Tian Shuixiang nodded at her. "By the way, I feel that kid is more dangerous than we think, so you shouldn't go see him again. After the affairs in this realm are finished, we will immediately return to the Void Heaven Realm."

"What if we go to that realm?" Tian Shuixiang raised his eyebrows at Ye Zhiye. "The Sovereign Heaven Realm! None of the cultivators in the upper realms know about that realm, so I'm sure that kid doesn't know about it either. We can hide and live more peacefully in that realm, and those people will never be able to find us."
"Let me think about it first."

"All right then." Ye Zhiye immediately pounded at Tian Shuixiang. "The effect of that kid's ability has disappeared from my body, but I still haven't had enough of having sex with you, so I want to do it again now."
Tian Shuixiang smiled at that. "As you wish, my dear."
"Master, that kid has returned to this realm before, but he then took some people to another realm." Xue Bao spoke to his master.

Zhe Wuming nodded at him. "I already know about it, but it's none of our business, so we don't need to interfere. However, I didn't expect that he could open a secret space without the void element, and I thought it was his private training ground."
"Can you infiltrate his secret space, Master?" Zhe Wuming turned to Xue Bao with a sharp glance. "Hahaha! I'm just curious about that, so don't look at me like that."
Zhe Wuming released a soft sigh. "Bao'er, don't be too curious about that kid, or we will face serious trouble if the people behind him make a move against us. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."

"If only I had a little of your courage, I would never be in this kind of situation."
"What do you mean by that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in confusion.
"Liangren's lover died at the hands of his enemy." Lin Moxian's answer shocked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"He knew that person hated him and repeatedly sought trouble with him, but he didn't have the heart to do anything to him, especially since he was his brother.
The incident happened when he went with our master to train, and that person killed his lover to make him suffer.
Since then, he would rather not get close to any woman, and he was more focused on his cultivation."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"Is he still alive?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded at him.
"After all, he is my big brother, and I don't have the guts to take revenge on him."
"Do you want me to kill him?" Qiao Liangren was taken aback by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question.
"You don't know it yet, but I killed my brother and ex-lover myself."
"Did you really do that?" Qiao Liangren asked in disbelief.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"I don't care who they are; I will kill anyone who dares to betray me.
They betrayed and framed me, and they tried to do terrible things to one of my women, so I killed them."
"I see." Qiao Liangren immediately made up his mind.
"Can you help me kill him?
I want to kill him myself, but I can't do it.
I will never be able to move on as long as he is still alive, and his death is the only relief for me."
"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with that, especially since Qiao Liangren had helped him a lot when he started out on the soul cultivation path.
"One of my clones will go to the Qiao Clan now, and you will receive news of his death soon."
"Thank you."
"No need for thanks.
You have helped me a lot, and we share the same master, so I will assist you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then gave Qiao Liangren the basic pills and Yang Purifying Pill.
"Senior Brother Moxian has already swallowed them, so now it's your turn."
"All right, I will swallow them now." Qiao Liangren immediately searched for an empty place to swallow the pills.
Then, Lin Moxian asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"What are your plans regarding Tian Shuixiang?
Was the woman who came to you earlier his woman?"
"Her name is Ye Zhiye, and she is indeed Tian Shuixiang's lover.
She is also a demon, to be precise, the Eternal Night Demon Queen." Lin Moxian frowned at that.
"Believe me or not, but that guy is the asura demon.
Although that woman didn't admit it directly, I already know that they are demons from the Paradise Realm, and their cultivation has already reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
"Are you going to reveal their identities to the public?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a shake of his head.
"Senior Brother, I myself am a lust demon lord, and not all demons are evil.
Moreover, you yourself said that Tian Shuixiang helped the people in your home realm a lot, so I won't reveal their identities for now.
However, I will directly reveal their identities if they have malicious intentions, and Zhe Wuming and the others can take care of them."
Lin Moxian looked confused upon hearing the latter name.
"Zhe Wuming?
Who is that?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly as he let slip the name.
"Zhe Wuming is the Nameless One's true name, and I learned it when I met him before.
By the way, you better not tell anyone else about his true name, or he will lock me up using his void element."
"I can't say anything about you." Lin Moxian sighed softly.
"Everyone, including our master, has known the Nameless One for a long time, but they don't know anything about his true name.
Instead, you've only met him once, but you know it right away."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled upon hearing that.
"The dishes are almost ready, so let's join them."
Inside their room, Tian Shuixiang looked serious as he listened to Ye Zhiye's explanation of her previous meeting with Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"No wonder that kid's ability had such an effect on you; it turns out he's a lust demon lord.
However, I don't understand where he got the information about our real identities, and he even knows so much detail down to my true physique, special physique, and bloodline."
"I didn't know that myself, and I initially thought that he was bluffing on purpose.
However, I changed my mind after he mentioned those three, and I immediately left him." Ye Zhiye then asked him.
"What should we do about that kid?
Should we kill him to cover everything up?
If he leaks our identities to them, the Nameless One and the others will attack us directly, and we will have no choice but to return to the Paradise Realm if that happens."
"You underestimate that kid too much, Zhiye." Tian Shuixiang disagreed with Ye Zhiye's idea.
"He came from the lower realms, and his cultivation was still in the ten mortal realms, but he was able to reach this realm so quickly.
Moreover, I couldn't check on him because my senses were blocked by something inside his body, and he also had connections with people from the Paradise Realm.
We don't know the identities of the people behind him, so we should face this matter with a cool head.
Otherwise, the people in that realm will know of our existence here, and they will hunt us down here.
I'm sure that kid won't reveal our identities, and he purposely told you all that to prevent us from interfering in his business, so we'll play along with him."
"Are you sure about that?" Ye Zhiye doubtfully asked.
Tian Shuixiang nodded at her.
"By the way, I feel that kid is more dangerous than we think, so you shouldn't go see him again.
After the affairs in this realm are finished, we will immediately return to the Void Heaven Realm."
"What if we go to that realm?" Tian Shuixiang raised his eyebrows at Ye Zhiye.
"The Sovereign Heaven Realm!
None of the cultivators in the upper realms know about that realm, so I'm sure that kid doesn't know about it either.
We can hide and live more peacefully in that realm, and those people will never be able to find us."
"Let me think about it first."
"All right then." Ye Zhiye immediately pounded at Tian Shuixiang.
"The effect of that kid's ability has disappeared from my body, but I still haven't had enough of having sex with you, so I want to do it again now."
Tian Shuixiang smiled at that.
"As you wish, my dear."
"Master, that kid has returned to this realm before, but he then took some people to another realm." Xue Bao spoke to his master.
Zhe Wuming nodded at him.
"I already know about it, but it's none of our business, so we don't need to interfere.
However, I didn't expect that he could open a secret space without the void element, and I thought it was his private training ground."
"Can you infiltrate his secret space, Master?" Zhe Wuming turned to Xue Bao with a sharp glance.
"Hahaha!
I'm just curious about that, so don't look at me like that."
Zhe Wuming released a soft sigh.
"Bao'er, don't be too curious about that kid, or we will face serious trouble if the people behind him make a move against us.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 842: 2-Star Heaven Realm
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] was already at the Qiao Clan in the Red Sun Realm, and he immediately infiltrated Qiao Liangren's big brother's room, but he was greeted by an unpleasant scene inside. A young woman was chained to one of the walls of the room naked, and her body was covered in various injuries.
Another woman was lying on the bed with a drunken expression, and she was also naked, with her lower body oozing out her fluids mixed with blood.
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath, looking at the condition of the two women. 'Senior Liangren's big brother has gone mad, and he treated these two women so horribly.'
[Master, Qiao Jinggong is in the bathroom, so you must act quickly.]

Even though the condition of the two women was miserable, Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately help them and checked their souls first, ensuring whether they were worthy of being saved. After he confirmed everything, he helped the two women to swallow some healing and qi recovery pills, and he also used his light qi on them in the hope that they could recover faster.

Zhang Fei [5] approached the table, took out a pill, crushed it into powder, and mixed it into the wine there. He then waited for Qiao Jinggong to come out of the bathroom before acting. 'Fortunately, this room is equipped with a soundproof formation, so Qiao Qingfeng and the others won't notice.'
After waiting for a few minutes, Qiao Jinggong came out of the bathroom, and he first drank the wine on the table before approaching the woman in bed.

Qiao Jinggong was confused because his room was suddenly filled with darkness, especially after Zhang Fei [5] used the darkness corruption. The moment he used his qi to get rid of the darkness, the qi in his body stirred and flowed in reverse, causing him to vomit blood as a result of the backlash.

"Cough... Cough..." Qiao Jinggong suddenly saw two blood-red eyes from the darkness, and the figure of the owner of those eyes frightened him. "Impossible! No! Don't come any closer, Qin Yue! You are dead! I killed you with my hands!"
Zhang Fei [5] was able to disguise himself as Qin Yue after Lin Moxian shared his memories of the woman with Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he deliberately used her form to scare Qiao Jinggong.
Qiao Jinggong was even more frightened when the fake Qin Yue grinned and glared at him, and he tried to attack Zhang Fei [5], which made his condition worse.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately attacked Qiao Jinggong back and pierced his chest with the bloodthirsty fang blade, but he avoided his vital organs. After that, he used the demon-absorbing technique to absorb his cultivation and soul power, causing him to continue screaming in agony. 'How much Qi do I need to break through to the 2-Star Heaven Realm, Mei?'
[Six million, Master. If my calculations are not wrong, you will break through to that stage after you absorb all of Qiao Jinggong's cultivation.]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. 'That's good! After I break through, I will find Lin Jingxia again to buy the Nine Revolutions Pill to stabilize my cultivation.'
[Ding]
[You gained 8,500,000 Qi from Qiao Jinggong.]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 2 Star Heaven Realm.]

After Qiao Jinggong died, Zhang Fei [5] left the Qiao Clan residence, and he took the two women with him. However, he entrusted them to the Hong Clan and went straight to the Divine Flame Realm to break through.

Feng Xishui, who was still in that realm, was slightly surprised by the Qi fluctuations within Zhang Fei [5]'s body. After all, he broke through to the 1-Star Heaven Realm two weeks ago, and now he has already reached the 2-Star level.

Feng Xishui accompanied Zhang Fei [5] to break through, and he also used his aura to keep people away from the location where he was breaking through, especially since his lightning tribulation had already begun.
In the Hong Clan, Cai Yinzhi and the others were confused by Zhang Fei [5]'s action. "What exactly happened, Mother? Why did he suddenly kill Qiao Jinggong? Did they have problems before?"
"No." Cai Yinzhi shook her head. "I'm sure Zhang Fei [5] and Qiao Jinggong didn't have any problems before, and he probably did it for other reasons."

"I think I know Zhang Fei's [5] reason for killing him." They turned to Hong Quan directly. "Qin Yue was Qiao Liangren's lover, and they almost got married at that time, but Qiao Jinggong violated her to death."

"Qiao Liangren taught Zhang Fei [5] the soul cultivation path, and he also introduced him to Hun Di until they became brothers under one master." Hong Quan and the two women nodded in agreement with Hong Chong. "That kid may seem easygoing at times, but he can also be quite vicious. Since Little Liangren has helped him a lot, he paid his debt of gratitude by killing Qiao Jinggong."
Cai Yinzhi then asked. "What do you think will happen next to the Qiao Clan? Qiao Jinggong was their main successor, but Zhang Fei [5] killed him."

"Let Old Qiao handle the matter himself; we don't need to interfere in it." Hong Quan then talked about something else. "Fortunately, that kid managed to bring back the Nameless One and the others in time, and the situation in the Xianjin realm should be under control with their presence."
"Are we going to the Xianjin Realm, Father?"
"Let's wait for that kid to complete his breakthrough first, and I'll talk to him after that."

Yan Yizhen then told them something else. "Xin'er informed me that she is on her way to the Blossom Heaven Realm to capture one of the higher-ups of the Alchemy Union, and Zhang Fei [5] has already taken over the organization. Additionally, that kid has already begun his plans for the lower and middle realms, and all the realms there will surely fall under his influence soon."
Yan Yizhen's words made the three seniors release soft sighs. "That kid acted too quickly and efficiently."

In the Nine Stars Realm, Tantai Lingyan and the others were watching Zhang Xiaolong [3] floating high in the sky, with Lei Que below him. Even though they were senior cultivators and had been through it many times, they were still frightened by his lightning tribulation, which became stronger every time he broke through.
"How could he suddenly break through, Senior Brother?" Yan Yinqing asked Lin Moxian.

"Because of him." Lin Moxian responded by pointing at Qiao Liangren, causing confusion. "That kid just killed Qiao Jinggong, and I'm sure he did it by absorbing his cultivation, which allowed him to directly break through to the second stage."
"Why did he kill your brother, Liangren?"

Instead, Murong Qianying answered Tantai Lingyan. "Since you didn't live in our realm, you don't know about the situation there. It's no longer a secret that Qiao Jinggong was a lecherous man, and he did many terrible things to many women. Most of his victims were women from minor clans who were too weak to fight the Qiao Clan, so they accepted their daughter's death. One of his victims was Qiao Liangren's lover, Qin Yue."
"Is that why you chose to be alone for so long, Senior Brother?"

Qiao Liangren nodded to Shang Yingyue. "Qin Yue was my first love and my true love, and we almost got married before that incident. I didn't have the guts to kill Qiao Jinggong, especially since he was my blood brother. Our junior brother offered me to kill him, and I agreed."

"Since your brother is dead now, you should be able to move on with your life, right?" Qiao Liangren gave Yan Yinqing a light nod. "In that case, you can start thinking about Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue, especially since she loves you so much."
"Cough... Cough..." Qiao Liangren coughed at that. "Senior Sister Yan, I have never liked Senior Sister Jing, and I have always regarded her as a sister, so I cannot accept her."

"Is that so?" Yan Yinqing inquired, her lips curling into a playful smile. "Senior Sister Jing has always held back her feelings because she understands your feelings, but you no longer have any burdens in your heart. If I tell her about this matter, she will definitely become aggressive in approaching you."

Qiao Liangren turned to Yan Yinqing and shook his head vigorously. "Senior Sister Yan, please don't tell Senior Sister Jing about this matter. I would rather not disappoint her, especially since I will never be able to accept her."
"Too late." Yan Yinqing replied with her tongue sticking out. "I just told Senior Sister Jing, and she said she would meet us at the Xianjin Realm."
Qiao Liangren let out a soft sigh, and his expression was filled with resignation, making Lin Moxiang and Shang Yingyue laugh.
Lin Moxian immediately patted Qiao Liangren's shoulder. "The saying goes that love can be cultivated by time, so you can try exploring your relationship with Jing Qiuyue first."
"Haha! Senior Brother! You haven't conquered Xi Hongyan yet, so you're not worthy of advising Liangren about love." Yan Yinqing made fun of Lin Moxian as she laughed out loud.
"Shut up, old sage!" Lin Moxian replied harshly. "Your mother has wanted a grandchild for a long time, and you still don't have a lover!"
Yan Yinqing shrugged. "My mother can have another child after she becomes our junior brother's wife."
"Qing'er! Don't spout nonsense!" Tantai Lingyan was embarrassed because Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue were giving her strange looks.
"Hehe." Murong Qianying chuckled at her blush. "I didn't expect you would also fall for him, Lingyan. Zhang Fei is too skilled in bed; you will be satisfied doing it with him."
'Shameless!' Tantai Lingyan screamed in her heart and walked away immediately.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s tribulation had stopped, and he sent Lei Que back into the beast space before floating down in front of the others. "Do you want to return to your clan, Senior Liangren?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded at him. "I want to visit Qin Yue's grave to tell her that my brother is dead so she can rest in peace there."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate to the Red Sun Realm, and Qiao Liangren rushed in. Murong Qianying also wanted to return to that realm, but she spoke to him first. "You can talk to Yaolin after this, and don't forget to go to the Shang Clan. Fei Qinyuan has been asking about you, and the three of us can have fun together later."

"My husband and I will also go back there, and we will bring our daughter with us, especially since her grandparents miss her." Shang Yingyue immediately contacted Wu Xueming and asked him to bring Wu Lianzhi with him.

After Murong Qianying, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, and Wu Lianzhi returned to the Red Sun Realm. Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Lin Moxian, Tantai Lingyan, and Yan Yinqing back to the Xianjin Realm to monitor the situation there.

Zhang Fei led all his women into the training space and instructed them to gather their belongings from the two mansions. He also removed the Celestial Spring Pool from the Cloud Mansion, especially since he was going to move it to the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion.

After they were done, Zhang Fei shrank the two mansions and kept them, and he took out the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion, which was still in miniature. Just like the two mansions, the pavilion expanded itself after he activated it; its size was much larger and more spacious than the combined size of the two mansions.
The Heavenly Bliss Pavilion left Liu Qingyu and the others speechless, especially since Zhang Fei was still hiding the existence of the system from them.

"Fortunately, this training space is also very spacious, or else it can't accommodate this pavilion." Zhang Fei then led them into it. "Since this pavilion is so spacious and it also provides extraordinary effects for dual cultivation, all of us will live here together from now on."
Zhang Yue and the other women were amazed when they entered the pavilion, especially since it was no less luxurious than the two mansions.

At the center of the pavilion lies a medium-sized pool, connected to several small artificial rivers. The water inside was clear and rich in Yin Qi, which comes from the lustrous rocks inside. Moreover, the Boundless Yin-Yang Array covered the pavilion, and the inner area was surrounded by various plants that continuously produce Yin and Yang Qi. Not to mention, it was built using the ancient Moon Jade Vein and the Lustrous Moon Jade, making the air inside full of both.

"Wow! We haven't started living here yet, but I already feel at home, Big Brother." Zhang Lin spoke as she enjoyed the air inside. "Moreover, the Yang and Yin Qi inside here is so rich and powerful; I'm sure our cultivation will improve even faster if we continue to live here."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with his little sister. "I got this pavilion by luck, and it's the perfect place for dual cultivators like us."

"Luck, my ass!" Boitata shouted at Zhang Fei. "How long are you going to hide everything from us, husband? Do you think we're stupid? Everything you have, including this pavilion, seems too fantastic to be real, yet it is undeniably real.
Zhang Lingxue and the others also looked suspiciously at Zhang Fei. Naturally, they were happy and satisfied with all those items, but they also wanted to know the truth.
Zhang Fei shook his head at them. "As I promised before, I will tell you all the truth after I become truly strong and no one can defeat me anymore."
"Tch!" Boitata clicked her tongue in response, and the other women helplessly shook their heads.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei installed the Celestial Spring Pool in one of the open areas, and they could soak in it while enjoying the atmosphere. Moreover, no other men would enter the pavilion, so he didn't have to worry about them peeping on them. Additionally, he placed the Yin-Yang Union Bed in the main room, so all his main harem members could significantly enhance their cultivation by dual cultivating with him there.
After he had finished everything, Zhang Fei left all his women in the pavilion, and he left the training space to meet Shang Yaolin at their residence.
Shang Yaolin sat alone on a rock by the southern ocean, and her eyes stared far ahead, thinking about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Shang Yaolin was startled when Zhang Fei hugged her from behind. "Are you still unwilling to forgive me, Yaolin?"
"I—" Shang Yaolin swallowed back her words that were almost out of her mouth.
Zhang Fei sighed softly, lifted Shang Yaolin to her feet, and turned her to face him. "Please give me a chance, and I will never lie to you again."
Shang Yaolin lowered her head. "Are you really not going to lie to me again?"
"I promise, I will never lie to you again, and lightning will—"

"Stop it! They previously said my feelings were selfish, but I am a woman, and my feelings are like this." Tears suddenly fell from Shang Yaolin's eyes, and she hugged Zhang Fei while burying her face in his chest. "They are women like me, and they should have experienced my position before becoming your wives, so they should be able to understand my feelings. I love you very much, and I have given myself to you, but your lies hurt my feelings."
Zhang Fei hugged Shang Yaolin and rubbed her back. "I'm sorry; I know I hurt your feelings before. I will never do that again, and I will treat you better in the future."
"Please." Shang Yaolin hugged Zhang Fei tighter. "Please promise me, don't hurt my feelings ever again."
"I promise." Zhang Fei pushed Shang Yaolin back a little, lifted her chin, and kissed her.

Shang Yaolin responded to Zhang Fei by closing her eyes, wrapping her hands around his neck, and kissing him back. She loved him so much, and they hadn't seen each other for months, which made her miss him so much.
