"Senior Sister Yan, please don't tell Senior Sister Jing about this matter.
I would rather not disappoint her, especially since I will never be able to accept her."
"Too late." Yan Yinqing replied with her tongue sticking out.
"I just told Senior Sister Jing, and she said she would meet us at the Xianjin Realm."
Qiao Liangren let out a soft sigh, and his expression was filled with resignation, making Lin Moxiang and Shang Yingyue laugh.
Lin Moxian immediately patted Qiao Liangren's shoulder.
"The saying goes that love can be cultivated by time, so you can try exploring your relationship with Jing Qiuyue first."
"Haha!
Senior Brother!
You haven't conquered Xi Hongyan yet, so you're not worthy of advising Liangren about love." Yan Yinqing made fun of Lin Moxian as she laughed out loud.
"Shut up, old sage!" Lin Moxian replied harshly.
"Your mother has wanted a grandchild for a long time, and you still don't have a lover!"
Yan Yinqing shrugged.
"My mother can have another child after she becomes our junior brother's wife."
"Qing'er!
Don't spout nonsense!" Tantai Lingyan was embarrassed because Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue were giving her strange looks.
"Hehe." Murong Qianying chuckled at her blush.
"I didn't expect you would also fall for him, Lingyan.
Zhang Fei is too skilled in bed; you will be satisfied doing it with him."
'Shameless!' Tantai Lingyan screamed in her heart and walked away immediately.
Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s tribulation had stopped, and he sent Lei Que back into the beast space before floating down in front of the others.
"Do you want to return to your clan, Senior Liangren?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded at him.
"I want to visit Qin Yue's grave to tell her that my brother is dead so she can rest in peace there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate to the Red Sun Realm, and Qiao Liangren rushed in.
Murong Qianying also wanted to return to that realm, but she spoke to him first.
"You can talk to Yaolin after this, and don't forget to go to the Shang Clan.
Fei Qinyuan has been asking about you, and the three of us can have fun together later."

"My husband and I will also go back there, and we will bring our daughter with us, especially since her grandparents miss her." Shang Yingyue immediately contacted Wu Xueming and asked him to bring Wu Lianzhi with him.
After Murong Qianying, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, and Wu Lianzhi returned to the Red Sun Realm.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Lin Moxian, Tantai Lingyan, and Yan Yinqing back to the Xianjin Realm to monitor the situation there.
Zhang Fei led all his women into the training space and instructed them to gather their belongings from the two mansions.
He also removed the Celestial Spring Pool from the Cloud Mansion, especially since he was going to move it to the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion.
After they were done, Zhang Fei shrank the two mansions and kept them, and he took out the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion, which was still in miniature.
Just like the two mansions, the pavilion expanded itself after he activated it; its size was much larger and more spacious than the combined size of the two mansions.
The Heavenly Bliss Pavilion left Liu Qingyu and the others speechless, especially since Zhang Fei was still hiding the existence of the system from them.
"Fortunately, this training space is also very spacious, or else it can't accommodate this pavilion." Zhang Fei then led them into it.
"Since this pavilion is so spacious and it also provides extraordinary effects for dual cultivation, all of us will live here together from now on."
Zhang Yue and the other women were amazed when they entered the pavilion, especially since it was no less luxurious than the two mansions.
At the center of the pavilion lies a medium-sized pool, connected to several small artificial rivers.
The water inside was clear and rich in Yin Qi, which comes from the lustrous rocks inside.
Moreover, the Boundless Yin-Yang Array covered the pavilion, and the inner area was surrounded by various plants that continuously produce Yin and Yang Qi.
Not to mention, it was built using the ancient Moon Jade Vein and the Lustrous Moon Jade, making the air inside full of both.
"Wow!
We haven't started living here yet, but I already feel at home, Big Brother." Zhang Lin spoke as she enjoyed the air inside.
"Moreover, the Yang and Yin Qi inside here is so rich and powerful; I'm sure our cultivation will improve even faster if we continue to live here."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with his little sister.
"I got this pavilion by luck, and it's the perfect place for dual cultivators like us."
"Luck, my ass!" Boitata shouted at Zhang Fei.
"How long are you going to hide everything from us, husband?
Do you think we're stupid?
Everything you have, including this pavilion, seems too fantastic to be real, yet it is undeniably real.
Zhang Lingxue and the others also looked suspiciously at Zhang Fei.
Naturally, they were happy and satisfied with all those items, but they also wanted to know the truth.
Zhang Fei shook his head at them.
"As I promised before, I will tell you all the truth after I become truly strong and no one can defeat me anymore."
"Tch!" Boitata clicked her tongue in response, and the other women helplessly shook their heads.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei installed the Celestial Spring Pool in one of the open areas, and they could soak in it while enjoying the atmosphere.
Moreover, no other men would enter the pavilion, so he didn't have to worry about them peeping on them.
Additionally, he placed the Yin-Yang Union Bed in the main room, so all his main harem members could significantly enhance their cultivation by dual cultivating with him there.
After he had finished everything, Zhang Fei left all his women in the pavilion, and he left the training space to meet Shang Yaolin at their residence.
Shang Yaolin sat alone on a rock by the southern ocean, and her eyes stared far ahead, thinking about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Shang Yaolin was startled when Zhang Fei hugged her from behind.
"Are you still unwilling to forgive me, Yaolin?"
"I—" Shang Yaolin swallowed back her words that were almost out of her mouth.
Zhang Fei sighed softly, lifted Shang Yaolin to her feet, and turned her to face him.
"Please give me a chance, and I will never lie to you again."
Shang Yaolin lowered her head.
"Are you really not going to lie to me again?"
"I promise, I will never lie to you again, and lightning will—"
"Stop it!

They previously said my feelings were selfish, but I am a woman, and my feelings are like this." Tears suddenly fell from Shang Yaolin's eyes, and she hugged Zhang Fei while burying her face in his chest.
"They are women like me, and they should have experienced my position before becoming your wives, so they should be able to understand my feelings.
I love you very much, and I have given myself to you, but your lies hurt my feelings."
Zhang Fei hugged Shang Yaolin and rubbed her back.
"I'm sorry; I know I hurt your feelings before.
I will never do that again, and I will treat you better in the future."
"Please." Shang Yaolin hugged Zhang Fei tighter.
"Please promise me, don't hurt my feelings ever again."
"I promise." Zhang Fei pushed Shang Yaolin back a little, lifted her chin, and kissed her.
Shang Yaolin responded to Zhang Fei by closing her eyes, wrapping her hands around his neck, and kissing him back.
She loved him so much, and they hadn't seen each other for months, which made her miss him so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Zhang Fei's New Plans
paragraphs: Zhang Fei decided to bring Shang Yaolin to the pavilion, but some of them greeted her with cold shoulders, such as Boitata, Zhang Yue, and several others.
Although she had met them all before, Shang Yaolin still felt uncomfortable seeing dozens of women gathered together in one place, especially since they belonged to one man, including herself.
Zhang Fei told them about his marriage to Helian Yueyi, but they were not surprised by his decision, and they had long thought that he would take her as his woman.

Some of them felt quite sorry for Helian Yueyi, especially since Zhang Fei toyed with her feelings in such an extreme way before. Her situation was still sad, even though she could no longer remember any of it. Moreover, he indirectly killed Huangfu Shou through Li Tiannan, especially since he was one of his slaves.

Zhang Fei took Bai Shushi away with him, and he asked her to marry him so that he could complete his new marriage mission. However, she refused to marry him unless he also married her daughter, Bai Tian'er. He agreed to her request.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei returned to his residence and informed Zhang Chen, who was overjoyed to hear the news. After all, Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er have been living with them for quite a long time now due to the difference in time flow, and she liked them.

Since he had enslaved the three leaders of the alchemy union, Zhang Fei decided to bring Nanfeng Yunxi and Luo Xuejia back to the Nine Stars Realm to take care of his shops in all the kingdoms, except his shop in the nature races' kingdom. He asked the two women to stay at his residence, making it easier for them to commute to all the shops via the teleportation devices.

Zhang Fei wanted to ask Huangfu Lian to open a shop in the Huangfu Kingdom, but Mei advised him to build a small city on an empty island and connect it to all the kingdoms. This way, he did not need to take care of many shops at once, and people from all kingdoms could go to the small town via teleportation devices.

Zhang Fei agreed with Mei's idea, and he immediately gathered the former emperors in one place. He also invited Long Huang and Long Baiyun to join them, and he did not forget to pick up Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling in the Phoenix Realm.

The people from the Xian, Yun, Zhou, Bai, Huangfu, and Demon Kingdoms naturally didn't mind that, especially since all of them had joined under Zhang Fei's banner. However, the situation was different with the other two kingdoms, especially the Natural Races' Kingdom.
"Do you really want to unite all the races?" Xian Lianghua asked.

Zhang Fei nodded to him. "Isn't that a good thing? There are several realms out there where humans, demons, beasts, and natural races can coexist together. If they are able to achieve this, perhaps we can as well. This realm has long been divided because everyone has their own ambitions, and some people threaten the safety of others. However, the situation is much safer now, and almost all of us are united presently, except for your kingdom and the beast kingdom. If you two are willing to open yourselves to accept each other, this realm will be more peaceful, and everyone can grow together."

"Your idea is indeed good, and I agree with it, but it is difficult to realize." Long Huang spoke. "You yourself know the character of my beast races; most of them have inflated egos and look down on humans or demons."

Xian Lianghua also spoke. "I also agree with your idea, but my natural races always hate humans and demons because of past problems. The hatred has been ingrained for several generations, so it is difficult to change their minds."

"Naturally, I am aware of that, especially since my home realm is also experiencing the same situation." Zhang Fei paused for a while as he looked at them one by one. "Honestly, I have an idea to unite all the races in this realm, but I want to know your opinions first."
"What's your idea?"

"Since we can't use soft methods to unite them, I will use the hardest methods for that. All the kingdoms will remain as they are now, but I will unite them all and form a new force." All of them immediately frowned, especially the two emperors and empresses of the Beast and Natural Race Kingdoms. "I have no intention to interfere or take over them, and I will use the new force as a formality to force all races to unite."
"A formality?"

Zhang Fei nodded at them. "The new force will only have a name, and all of you will be its members. It does not have any role in the affairs of any kingdom, and you guys remain in control of your respective kingdoms. I will ask one of my acquaintances to suppress all the races in this realm, and I will force them to submit to me."

Long Huang and Xian Lianghua briefly exchanged glances before one of them posed a question. "Are you sure you want to do that? They may unite if necessary, but it won't resolve the main issue, and they may revolt in the future."

"Do you think they will do that, Emperor Long?" Zhang Fei asked with a smile. "We beasts always prioritize our egos and pride, but we will also acknowledge the strongest. I can suppress them myself with my heavenly fox bloodline, but I will ask a much stronger beast to help me, and I'm sure they won't dare to rebel. Moreover, you already know the benefits of my pills, so it would be unwise for them to rebel."

Long Huang let out a soft sigh after hearing that, especially since he already knew about Feng Yao. The phoenix princess was clearly much stronger than him and his wife, and she could suppress all the beasts in their kingdom easily if she wanted to.
"Then, what about our natural races?" Xue Jingling asked him.

Zhang Fei thought for a while before answering her. "I don't have a solution about your people yet, but I know someone from the natural race. She lives in the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, one of the realms in the upper realms. She is likely waiting for me to visit her realm, and I intend to go there soon. She should be able to help me convince them, but I will discuss this matter with her first."
"She?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "Honestly, I don't know her true identity yet because she came to me using her avatar, but I believe she is powerful."

Xue Jingling nodded in understanding. "In that case, you should go to her and talk to her first. If you suppress your natural races to such an extent, they will never accept you, and they will undoubtedly fight you until the end. Therefore, you should use more subtle methods against them, and your chances of success will increase if another natural race helps you convince them."

"All right." Zhang Fei then spoke to the leaders of the human and demon kingdoms. "I've already chosen a location for the new city, so I want you to send people to the island to build it. Once the construction is complete, I'll move all of my shops and restaurants to the island, and I'll install several teleportation devices to connect all the kingdoms to the island."
"Are you just going to use the city for your shop and restaurant?" Shi Qingzhuang asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "I will focus the new city specifically for my shop and restaurant, and I want to build some there. This way, people can shop and eat more comfortably without having to jostle with each other, and the city will become a gathering place for all races. However, I will implement harsh and strict regulations, and I will also place a powerful guard there. I will give him the freedom to punish anyone who dares to create chaos there, whether they are humans, beasts, natural races, or demons."

Xian Feng then spoke to the others. "Since we have retired and our sons have taken over our duties, I think we can stay in the new city. We will watch over them while focusing on our cultivation, and we will ascend to the upper realms once our cultivation breaks through to the Divine Manifestation Realm."
"I agree with you, Brother Feng." Yun Shang said.
Bai Yaowei also agreed with that. "Since the situation on our island is safe and stable, I think it is the best decision for us, and our sons will fully take care of our kingdoms."

"In that case, we should send those people to the island, and they will immediately start building the new city." Guo Xuehua then spoke to Zhang Fei. "To facilitate the construction, you should install some teleportation first. That way, they can go back and forth to get building materials more easily, which will speed up construction."
"All right." After that, Zhang Fei sent them back to their respective kingdoms, but he sent Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling back to the Phoenix Realm.
Zhang Fei immediately returned to the pavilion, where he had a good time with Shang Yaolin. Having been apart for several months, they were eager to express their longing for each other.
Qiao Liangren stood in front of a grave, and his expression was full of longing. He placed many flowers around it, and he also burned some items for the owner of the grave.

Qiao Liangren then poured wine on the tombstone. "Please forgive me, Yue'er. For hundreds of years, I have never been able to avenge your death, especially since Qiao Jinggong was my big brother. However, he is dead now, and my junior brother killed him for me. I don't know if you've been reincarnated, but I hope you can rest in peace. If there is a second chance, I want to be with you again, and I will protect you with all my life."
*Tap... Tap...*
Suddenly, the sound of light footsteps walked towards him, and Qiao Liangren immediately turned to the owner, finding a young woman in her early twenties casually walking towards him.
The young woman's face was not beautiful, and her appearance was quite shabby, but Qiao Liangren sensed a familiar feeling from her. "Who are you, Big Brother? Do you know the owner of this grave?"
"Qin Yue is my lover." The young woman was momentarily surprised by Qiao Liangren's answer. "Who are you, little girl?"

"My name is Yue Qinhua." Qiao Liangren raised his eyebrows for a moment as he thought in his heart. "Actually, I don't know the owner of this grave, and I found it when I visited my aunt's tomb. For some reason, the name Qin Yue felt familiar to me, so I visited her grave every time I went to see my aunt."
Qiao Liangren inhaled deeply and inquired. "Little girl, I won't hurt you, but I want to check your soul. Can I do that?"
"Eh?" Yue Qinhua looked at Qiao Liangren with repeated blinks. "Are you a soul cultivator, Big Brother?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded to her. "I just want to confirm something from you, so I hope you don't mind that."
"All right."

After Yue Qinhua gave her consent, Qiao Liangren carefully examined her soul. Unfortunately, the results were not as he had expected, especially since her soul was different from Qin Yue's. 'Sigh! What the hell was I thinking? There can't be such a coincidence. I must have missed Yue'er too much, and I thought this little girl was her reincarnation.'
Qiao Liangren let out a soft sigh and asked. "Where did you learn the soul cultivation?"

"My late aunt taught me about the soul cultivation path, and she left many notes for me. Unfortunately, my talent is not good, so my soul cultivation is still stuck at the early stage of the soul core level." Yue Qinhua then showed the notes to Qiao Liangren. "What level is your soul at, Big Brother?"

"I'm almost at the perfection stage of the heavenly soul level." Hearing that, Yue Qinhua's jaw fell, prompting Qiao Liangren to read the notes directly. "Do you still have family? Do you want to be my disciple? I'm not yet a master in the soul cultivation path, but I can teach you a lot about it, and your soul level will rise faster."

"Big Brother, I still have my parents, but I live with my late aunt most of the time. Even though my aunt has passed away, I continue to live in her residence." Yue Qinhua then asked. "Do you really want to teach me about the soul cultivation path, Big Brother?"

Qiao Liangren nodded at her. "For a young cultivator of your age, your soul level is already quite high, which proves your talent for the soul cultivation path. Unfortunately, the notes left by your late aunt are only the basics, so you have difficulty improving your soul level. If you are willing to be my disciple, I will give you better methods, and I believe you will surpass me in the future."

"Can I really surpass you, Big Brother?" Qiao Liangren nodded to Yue Qinhua, who dropped to her knees straight away. "Big brother, I am willing to be your disciple, and please teach me more about the soul cultivation path."

"You don't need to be like this, Qinhua." Qiao Liangren helped her up. "For now, we have to meet your parents first and ask for their permission, so they won't worry about you. After we meet them, I will take you to my clan, and we will go to another realm after that."
"Yes, Big Brother." Yue Qinhua suddenly realized she didn't know his name. "What's your name, Big Brother?"
"Qiao Liangren, and you can call me Big Brother Qiao."
"Eh?" Yue Qinhua froze in place after hearing his name. "Can I call you Big Brother Liang? I don't know why, but I want to call you that."
This time, Qiao Liangren stiffened, and his eyes trembled as he stared at Yue Qinhua.
"What happened, Big Brother? Can't I call you that?" Yue Qinhua asked in a sad tone.
'I have to take her to my master to confirm the truth.' Qiao Liangren patted her head. "You can call me that, Qinhua."
"Hehe." Yue Qinhua was delighted to hear that. "Let's go, Big Brother Liang! I'll take you to see my parents, but I'm sure they won't have a problem with that."
Sometime later, Qiao Liangren had brought Yue Qinhua to the Qiao Clan after they met her parents, who agreed with her decision to become his disciple.

The situation in the Qiao Clan was not good, especially after they found Qiao Jinggong's dried-up corpse. Qiao Liangren found his grandparents, parents, uncles, and aunts in the main hall, with his mother crying loudly beside his big brother's corpse.
Yue Qinhua timidly followed behind Qiao Liangren; she did not expect that he was a member of one of the famous clans in their realm.
"Liangren." Qiao Qingfeng called softly. "Your big brother, he—"

"Grandpa, you should already know I don't care about him, and I'm satisfied because he's dead." Qiao Liangren's words only added to their sadness, but none of them blamed him. "I came to say goodbye to all of you, and I don't know when I'll return to this realm again."
"Are you going with your master and the others again?" Qiao Liangren's father asked him.

Qiao Liangren nodded. "We were forced to end our previous adventure because of the problems in the Xianjin realm, and we plan to continue it after everything is settled. Moreover, I have taken this little girl as my disciple, and I want to focus on guiding her on the soul cultivation path. As for our clan's affairs, I am not interested in being the patriarch, and you can leave it to my little brother or cousin."
Qiao Qingfeng and the others sighed heavily. "All right, you can focus on your own business, and we will take care of our clan's affairs."
"Farewell."

If there is a second chance, I want to be with you again, and I will protect you with all my life."
*Tap...
Tap...*
Suddenly, the sound of light footsteps walked towards him, and Qiao Liangren immediately turned to the owner, finding a young woman in her early twenties casually walking towards him.
The young woman's face was not beautiful, and her appearance was quite shabby, but Qiao Liangren sensed a familiar feeling from her.
"Who are you, Big Brother?
Do you know the owner of this grave?"
"Qin Yue is my lover." The young woman was momentarily surprised by Qiao Liangren's answer.
"Who are you, little girl?"
"My name is Yue Qinhua." Qiao Liangren raised his eyebrows for a moment as he thought in his heart.
"Actually, I don't know the owner of this grave, and I found it when I visited my aunt's tomb.
For some reason, the name Qin Yue felt familiar to me, so I visited her grave every time I went to see my aunt."
Qiao Liangren inhaled deeply and inquired.
"Little girl, I won't hurt you, but I want to check your soul.
Can I do that?"
"Eh?" Yue Qinhua looked at Qiao Liangren with repeated blinks.
"Are you a soul cultivator, Big Brother?"
"Yes." Qiao Liangren nodded to her.
"I just want to confirm something from you, so I hope you don't mind that."
"All right."
After Yue Qinhua gave her consent, Qiao Liangren carefully examined her soul.
Unfortunately, the results were not as he had expected, especially since her soul was different from Qin Yue's. 'Sigh!
What the hell was I thinking?
There can't be such a coincidence.
I must have missed Yue'er too much, and I thought this little girl was her reincarnation.'
Qiao Liangren let out a soft sigh and asked.
"Where did you learn the soul cultivation?"
"My late aunt taught me about the soul cultivation path, and she left many notes for me.
Unfortunately, my talent is not good, so my soul cultivation is still stuck at the early stage of the soul core level." Yue Qinhua then showed the notes to Qiao Liangren.
"What level is your soul at, Big Brother?"
"I'm almost at the perfection stage of the heavenly soul level." Hearing that, Yue Qinhua's jaw fell, prompting Qiao Liangren to read the notes directly.
"Do you still have family?
Do you want to be my disciple?
I'm not yet a master in the soul cultivation path, but I can teach you a lot about it, and your soul level will rise faster."
"Big Brother, I still have my parents, but I live with my late aunt most of the time.
Even though my aunt has passed away, I continue to live in her residence." Yue Qinhua then asked.
"Do you really want to teach me about the soul cultivation path, Big Brother?"
Qiao Liangren nodded at her.
"For a young cultivator of your age, your soul level is already quite high, which proves your talent for the soul cultivation path.
Unfortunately, the notes left by your late aunt are only the basics, so you have difficulty improving your soul level.
If you are willing to be my disciple, I will give you better methods, and I believe you will surpass me in the future."
"Can I really surpass you, Big Brother?" Qiao Liangren nodded to Yue Qinhua, who dropped to her knees straight away.
"Big brother, I am willing to be your disciple, and please teach me more about the soul cultivation path."
"You don't need to be like this, Qinhua." Qiao Liangren helped her up.
"For now, we have to meet your parents first and ask for their permission, so they won't worry about you.
After we meet them, I will take you to my clan, and we will go to another realm after that."
"Yes, Big Brother." Yue Qinhua suddenly realized she didn't know his name.
"What's your name, Big Brother?"
"Qiao Liangren, and you can call me Big Brother Qiao."
"Eh?" Yue Qinhua froze in place after hearing his name.
"Can I call you Big Brother Liang?
I don't know why, but I want to call you that."
This time, Qiao Liangren stiffened, and his eyes trembled as he stared at Yue Qinhua.
"What happened, Big Brother?
Can't I call you that?" Yue Qinhua asked in a sad tone.
'I have to take her to my master to confirm the truth.' Qiao Liangren patted her head.
"You can call me that, Qinhua."
"Hehe." Yue Qinhua was delighted to hear that.
"Let's go, Big Brother Liang!
I'll take you to see my parents, but I'm sure they won't have a problem with that."
Sometime later, Qiao Liangren had brought Yue Qinhua to the Qiao Clan after they met her parents, who agreed with her decision to become his disciple.
The situation in the Qiao Clan was not good, especially after they found Qiao Jinggong's dried-up corpse.
Qiao Liangren found his grandparents, parents, uncles, and aunts in the main hall, with his mother crying loudly beside his big brother's corpse.
Yue Qinhua timidly followed behind Qiao Liangren; she did not expect that he was a member of one of the famous clans in their realm.
"Liangren." Qiao Qingfeng called softly.
"Your big brother, he—"
"Grandpa, you should already know I don't care about him, and I'm satisfied because he's dead." Qiao Liangren's words only added to their sadness, but none of them blamed him.
"I came to say goodbye to all of you, and I don't know when I'll return to this realm again."
"Are you going with your master and the others again?" Qiao Liangren's father asked him.
Qiao Liangren nodded.
"We were forced to end our previous adventure because of the problems in the Xianjin realm, and we plan to continue it after everything is settled.
Moreover, I have taken this little girl as my disciple, and I want to focus on guiding her on the soul cultivation path.
As for our clan's affairs, I am not interested in being the patriarch, and you can leave it to my little brother or cousin."
Qiao Qingfeng and the others sighed heavily.
"All right, you can focus on your own business, and we will take care of our clan's affairs."
"Farewell."

paragraphs: [Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
"What are you going to do now?" Feng Xishui asked Zhang Fei [5], who had just killed the last beast.

As he searched for the beast cores from the pile of beasts' corpses, Zhang Fei [5] answered him. "I'm going to the Nine Stars Realm to take care of some matters, and I'll return to this realm afterward."
"In that case, you can go to that realm, and I'll wait in this realm."
"Don't you want to return to the Phoenix Realm, Senior?"
"My princess ordered me to help you, so I'll stay in this realm as long as you still have other matters here."
'This guy is loyal to Feng Yao, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] then asked him. "Do you know the closest realm to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm?"

"Do you want to meet the spirit races in that realm?" Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Feng Xishui about Li Mengmeng, the mysterious woman in the Yin-Yang Pavilion. "The Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm is not too far from the Wilderness Expanse Realm, about two days' travel if I use my fastest speed. However, a formation hides that realm from the public, and not everyone can enter it."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Since the Wilderness Expanse Realm is close to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, we will go straight to that realm after I settle matters in the Nine Stars Realm."
"Let's go then." Zhang Fei [5] immediately took Feng Xishui to the Nine Stars Realm.

Upon arrival, Zhang Fei [5] removed the half parts of all the teleportation devices from all his shops, and he moved them to a special place according to the results of his discussions with the former emperors and empresses. He moved the other half of them to the small island he had previously chosen, and the workers from all the kingdoms could go there more easily to build the small town. As for the shops and restaurants, he had to wait for them to finish building the town first.

Feng Xishui was not surprised by Zhang Fei [5]'s intention to build all that. Unfortunately, the Nine Stars Realm used coins as its currency, and they were useless in other realms, especially since the majority of them used jewels.
After he rearranged all the teleportation devices, Zhang Fei [5] took Feng Xishui to the Wilderness Expanse Realm, and they immediately left for the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm.

After the two notifications appeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] picked up Qiao Liangren and Yue Qinhua at the Red Sun Realm and brought them to the Xianjin Realm.

Yue Qinhua's arrival surprised Lin Moxian and the others, and they were even more surprised after Qiao Liangren told them that he accepted the young girl as his disciple. "Qinhua, the woman is my senior sister, Yan Yinqing. Actually, I still have two other senior sisters, but they are still in their respective realms, and you will meet them soon. As for the two men, Lin Moxian is my senior brother, and Zhang Fei is my junior brother."
"Senior Aunt and two Senior Uncles, Qinhua pays her respects to the three of you." Yue Qinhua spoke as she cupped her hands toward them.

"Haish!" Yan Yinqing walked up to Yue Qinhua and grabbed her shoulders. "Little girl, we are not that old yet, so you don't need to address us as aunts and uncles. Instead, you can address us as big sisters and big brothers, like you call Liangren."
"Haha." Yue Qinhua laughed awkwardly and nodded. "Okay, Big Sister Yan."

Lin Moxian patted Qiao Liangren's shoulder and asked. "Did you accept this little girl as your disciple because of her resemblance to Qin Yue? Her name is similar to hers, but the spelling is reversed, and Hua is added to the end of her name."
"Qin Yue and Yue Qin." Yan Yinqing muttered to herself as she realized it.
Yue Qinhua had only just realized this, and she looked at Qiao Liangren questioningly.
Qiao Liangren shook his head at them. "I chose Qinhua for her talent in soul cultivation, not her name."

"This little girl does have talent in the soul cultivation path." Lin Moxian replied with an affirmative nod. "She's in her twenties, and she's only learned the basics, but she's able to reach the early stage of the soul core level."
Yan Yinqing also agreed with that. "Our master will be excited to meet this little girl, so we have to take her to see him now."
"I will join you later, and I will meet Senior Lin Jingxia to buy the first pill." Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke to them.
"Let's go."

A while later, Lin Moxian and the others had arrived at Hun Di's room, and the soul emperor observed Yue Qinhua seriously, making the young girl tense. "This little girl's talent is one of the best I have ever met, and her future is bright in the soul cultivation path. Since you have decided to take her as your disciple, you must guide her well and teach her everything I have taught you."

"Yes, Master." Qiao Liangren then told Hun Di and the others about his strange feelings for Yue Qinhua. "Since I was little, Qin Yue was the only one who addressed me as Big Brother Liang, but Qinhua wanted to address me as such."
"Oh?" Hun Di looked at Yue Qinhua once again. "Why do you want to address Liangren like that?"

"I don't know, Grandmaster." Yue Qinhua then pressed his palm to his chest. "When Big Brother Liang told me his name, I suddenly had a strange feeling in my heart, and I wanted to address him as such because of it."

Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing were shocked to hear that, and they turned to Hun Di, who nodded his head with repeated light nods. "In fact, reincarnation is real, and Huli Xianniang is one of them. However, I don't know whether this little girl is really Qin Yue's reincarnation, especially since I don't understand my reincarnation."
"Master, Feng Yao is a reincarnator." Hun Di turned to Lin Moxian in surprise. "Actually, I heard about this matter from Zhang Fei, and he heard it from him directly, so it shouldn't be wrong."

Hun Di nodded in understanding. "Since she was born, Feng Yao has shown many unusual phenomena, especially due to her high innate cultivation level. As she grew up, she continued to show other phenomena, and her cultivation progressed too rapidly, surpassing all cultivators, including me. Even when her cultivation was still in the core realm, she was able to defeat a cultivator in the Seven Divine Realm in mere seconds. However, no one ever suspected that she was a reincarnator, and it explained all the strange phenomena she had shown in the past. Since she is a reincarnator, she might be able to give us answers about this little girl."
"I will ask Zhang Fei to bring Feng Yao here." Lin Moxian immediately sent him a voice transmission.

Yun Qinhua, on the other hand, kept staring at Qiao Liangren in confusion, especially after listening to their conversation. 'Am I really Qin Yue's reincarnation? Is that the reason he is willing to accept me as his disciple?'

Qiao Liangren turned to her and patted her head. "You don't have to think about that, okay? For now, I will impart some techniques to you, and you can read them all first. If you have any questions about them, you can ask us directly."
"Yes, Big Brother Liang." After Qiao Liangren imparted those techniques, Yue Qinhua immediately read everything seriously, making Hun Di smile with satisfaction.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was sitting in front of Lin Jingxia, who immediately gave him two of the Nine Revolutions Pills. "I only have two of them left, so you can use these for now. However, you should stop taking shortcuts like this, especially since it will only harm you in the long run. This pill can quickly stabilize your foundation, but it will be less stable than if you did it manually, and it will be vulnerable if you keep using it.
"Is there a pill that is better than this pill, Senior?"

"There is one pill that is better, but the ingredients are difficult to find. Even if you find them, their price is exorbitant, and their quantity is only enough for one batch of pills." Lin Jingxia then took out five different types of herbs and placed them in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Azure Spirit Grass, Dragon Blood Ginseng, Spirit Vein Grass, Flowing Essence Herb, and Foundation Fortifying Leaf. These are the ingredients for concocting the true foundation pill, and the concocting process takes half a year."
"Half a year?" Lin Jingxia nodded to the shocked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I think I can do something about these herbs, Senior."
"What do you want to do with these herbs?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and asked. "What if I duplicate these herbs?"
"Can you really do that?" Lin Jingxia asked in disbelief.
"I can't do it, but one of my wives can." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately summoned Lillea out of the training space.
Lin Jingxia experienced a brief moment of shock. "A dryad, huh?"
"Lillea is not just a dryad, but she is the dryad queen."

"I see." Lin Jingxia nodded in understanding. "I didn't expect you to have her by your side. I've heard of a dryad's ability to manipulate plants, including duplicating them and accelerating their growth."
"Do you want me to duplicate these herbs, husband?" Lillea asked him.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "You can duplicate them as much as possible, and I will use them to concoct the true foundation pill, which has better effects than the Nine Revolutions Pills. That way, our foundation can stabilize faster and be firmer, and we don't need to hold back from breaking through."
Lillea immediately sat on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side and started duplicating the herbs. Since the herbs are rare, she does it cautiously so as not to damage them and reduce their effects.
Lin Jingxia was truly amazed to witness Lillea's abilities with her own eyes. "What exactly is your goal? Why are you in such a hurry to break through?"

"An old friend is bothering me, Senior." Lin Jingxia raised her eyebrows after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "She was my childhood friend, but her family took her away, and they have been living in the Paradise Realm ever since. Before they left, her parents sealed my memories of her, and I only remembered her after I encountered her soul imprint in the Star Tower. Furthermore, a senior from that realm told me that the flow of time there was much faster than in the three mortal realms, and she should be over five hundred years old by now. Therefore, I want to go to that realm as soon as possible, or she will be too old by the time I can go there. Unfortunately, I must first reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and cultivating in the usual way will take too long, so I intend to utilize every possible means to expedite my progress."

'This kid! Are there only women in his brain? He's even willing to take such risks just for the sake of a woman.' Lin Jingxia then asked. "How much different is the flow of time in that realm from our realm?"

"Fifty times faster." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer caused Lin Jingxia's eyes to widen in shock, especially since the difference in time flow was simply too great. "Senior, you have cultivated for over ten thousand years, but you have yet to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. If I use ordinary methods, I will waste too much time, perhaps thousands of years."
Lin Jingxia nodded to him. "By the way, the true foundation pill is a rank 7 pill, so you won't be able to concoct it with your current level."
"Do you remember Huoyun Zhiyan, Senior?"
"Did you enslave him?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately admitted it. "I enslaved Huoyun Zhiyan and a friend of his because their organization repeatedly harassed me, and Hong Xinxin was on her way to capture the last person. They should be able to concoct a rank 7 pill, so I will ask them to focus on that pill."
"As I recall, Huoyun Zhiyan is a saint rank alchemist, so he should be able to concoct the true foundation pill." Lin Jingxia asked again. "You enslaved them for another purpose, right?"

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "Senior, there are so many people by my side, and they need a lot of cultivation resources. By relying on Lillea's abilities and their alchemy skills, I can provide them with many resources, and I can also collect many jewels for my future trip to the Paradise Realm."

Lin Jingxia massaged her forehead as she felt dizzy listening to all that. "Cultivators of your generation are still enjoying their leisurely lives, but you have already thought so far ahead, even to the Paradise Realm."

"Honestly, I want to enjoy my life like them, but I can't do that, especially since my responsibilities are too big." Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh before continuing. "High targets actually spur my enthusiasm to become stronger, and I deliberately set high targets for myself. Once I successfully achieve my targets, I will enjoy a relaxed and peaceful life with my entire family, and I will start thinking about my descendants then."

Lin Jingxia admired Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s mindset. "In the world of cultivation, strength is everything. If we have strength, we can have a calm and peaceful life, but vice versa, we will suffer without it. Moreover, the Paradise Realm is stronger than our realm, so we must prepare ourselves as best as possible before we set foot there."
"That's right."

Sometime later, Lillea had finished duplicating all the herbs, and she duplicated a hundred of each herb. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take all of them, and he gave three-quarters of them to Lin Jingxia.

After they left Lin Jingxia's room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sent Lillea into the Sealed World Pearl together with Janette and Shi Wu, and he asked the three women to duplicate more of the five types of herbs there.
Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to pick up Feng Yao and brought her to meet Hun Di and the others.

Feng Yao stood in front of Yue Qinhua, who was still studying the soul techniques with her eyes closed. After she confirmed it, she told them about the little girl. "She is indeed a reincarnator, but her memories have not returned. I can't say for sure when her memories will return, but the process might be faster since she is a soul cultivator."
Qiao Liangren trembled after Feng Yao said that, and he looked at Yue Qinhua with a loving gaze. 'Yue'er... my Yue'er has returned to my side.'

Lin Moxian and Hun Di were happy to hear that, but not Yan Yinqing, who had always wanted to match Qiao Liangren with Jing Qiuyue. 'Tch! What would happen if Senior Sister Jing knew that this little girl was Qin Yue's reincarnation? She had always loved Liangren, and she was willing to wait for him for so long, but this girl suddenly appeared.'
Feng Yao turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "When are you going to see Feng Yichen?"

"I will use one of my clones to go to that realm today, but I don't have any other flying artifacts, especially since one of them is on his way to the Blue Water Realm." Feng Yao immediately lent her flying artifact to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I will send you back to the Phoenix Realm now."

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Ten-Tailed Fox's Second Soul
paragraphs: "You've finally come, Zhang Fei."

Along with that voice, many golden lights gathered in one place and became one, turning into a woman with straight golden hair that cascaded down her shoulders, framing a face of flawless beauty. A delicate golden sigil adorned her forehead, glowing faintly with an ethereal aura. Her eyes were deep as the ocean, yet sharp as a blade. Two delicate rosy lips stick perfectly above the oval chin, tempting any man to kiss her.

Her attire was a combination of white and gold fluttering with intricate golden leaf patterns and a golden rose blooming on her fairly large chest, symbolizing purity and elegance. Two golden wings flapped behind her back, and her hourglass curves looked perfect. Every part of her reflected divinity; her presence felt like a beacon of light, inspiring awe and possessing absolute authority.
Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui felt a little pressured by the woman's aura. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Alright.]
Name: Tianshi Shengjie
Age: 150,000+ Years Old
Race: Celestial Dragon
Gender: Female
Cultivation: Unknown
Element: Light [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Light [Perfection Stage]
Core: Light Core [Peak Rank]
Physique: Celestial Dragon
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: None
Like: Living being
Dislike: Destruction

'She's a celestial dragon, huh? Since the system can't detect her cultivation, she must have reached the Five Celestial Realm. She's much younger than Feng Xueying and the others, so she must have come from the Paradise Realm.' Zhang Fei [5] then answered. "Unlike your avatar that you use to disguise yourself, your true self is truly beautiful, Tianshi Shengjie. Back then, you said that you were a member of the natural races, but you turned out to be a powerful beast, to be precise, a celestial dragon."
"I don't know how you recognized me, but I guessed it from the start." Tianshi Shengjie replied with a smile.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed in response. "What is a powerful celestial dragon like you doing in the three mortal realms? I'm sure you came down from the Paradise Realm not just to wait for the successor of the Ten-Tailed Fox, and I'm certain you have other goals."
Tianshi Shengjie shook her head at him. "I had no other goal but to look for the successor of the Ten-Tailed Fox, and I have found his successor now."

"You are mistaken." Zhang Fei [5] denied it directly. "As long as I haven't evolved to ten-tailed, I will never consider myself as his successor. Moreover, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing still have the chance to become his successors, so all possibilities are still there."
Tianshi Shengjie did not respond to that and turned to leave. "Follow me; I will take you to a place reserved for you."
Feng Xishui immediately returned to human form; he and Zhang Fei [5] then flew behind Tianshi Shengjie.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm.]
[Generating new quests]
[Quest: Enter The Sacred Place.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Obtain the Ten-Tailed Fox's soul.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Defeat the Ten-Tailed Fox's soul.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Defeat the natural races' leader.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]
[Quest: Convince the natural races.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]

Sometime later, they had arrived in front of a small lake with a waterfall on the north side. Tianshi Shengjie immediately led them into a cave behind the waterfall, where a statue of a ten-tailed fox stood at the back end. "You should know what you have to do, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately walked in front of the statue and injected his heavenly fox aura into it.
*Rumble...Rumble...*

The wall at the end of the cave immediately splits in two, opening the path to a garden filled with precious and rare herbs. However, they could feel a powerful aura from within it, and Zhang Fei [5] naturally knew that it was the aura of the ten-tailed fox's soul.

However, Zhang Fei [5] felt that it was different from the calm and comfortable aura he felt in the Fairy Forest in the Jade Sky Realm. It was wilder, more aggressive, and filled with anger. Even Feng Xishui shivered in fear because of the aura emanating from within, and he chose to take a few steps back.
"What's going on? Why is this soul's aura different from the one that merged with mine? Zhang Fei [5] asked.
Tianshi Shengjie shook her head. "I don't know the reason, and you can find it out for yourself after you meet him. Go in now, and the two of us will wait for you here."
Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh, nodded, and walked into the garden. The garden entrance closed behind him, and a new notification appeared in his mind.
[Quest: Enter the Sacred Place.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]
'Open the reward, Mei.'
[Obtained x1 Soul Ascension Pill.]

[Soul Ascension Pill: The pill is concocted under starlight using sacred materials such as Soul-Essence Lotus, Void Spirit Ice, and the Heavenly Will Dew, forcibly breaking through the soul power by one stage.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei [5]'s expression was momentarily surprised before turning to joy, especially since he had long wanted to break through to the early stage of the Heavenly Soul Level. Unfortunately, his soul level was still far from breaking through, and the pill could help him to achieve that.
[Master, your current soul power doesn't seem to be enough to absorb the ten-tailed fox's soul, so the system gave you such a pill.]

'I think so.' Before his second meeting with the will of the universe, Zhang Fei [5] always questioned the young girl's identity, including her abilities to create the system, Mei, and all the items. Even though he still has many questions about her, he no longer doubts her abilities to create them, especially since the will of the universe said that her existence transcended the universe itself.

Zhang Fei [5] had always thought that the young girl gave Mei and the system to him as a return gift after she killed him, but he also felt that she had other intentions in giving them to him, especially after his conversation with the will of the universe.

Even though the will of the universe did not say it outright at that time, Zhang Fei [5] was sure that the existence of another world beyond the Paradise Realm was real, which made him think that the little girl came from that world. However, he would rather not think too much about it, especially since he had not yet broken through to the Seven Divine Realm and the Paradise Realm was still out of his reach, let alone the realm beyond it.

Zhang Fei [5] did not continue going inside and sat down on the ground. He released his soul, took out the soul ascension pill, and swallowed it directly. He closed his eyes and used his Qi to dissolve the pill directly, releasing a torrent of pure soul essence that flowed through his veins and soul. His soul space violently surged, waves of soul power crashing into him, shocking Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu, who lived in it.
The dark female figure, who was also in Zhang Fei [5]'s soul space, absorbs his soul power, strengthening her soul rapidly.

Unlike his previous soul breakthroughs, Zhang Fei [5] felt immense pain, and the source came from his soul. He clenched his jaw, blood seeping from the corners of his mouth because the pain was sharp, burning, and devastating. It felt as if his very existence was being torn apart and rebuilt, especially since the soul was the most essential part of the body. As he absorbed the effects of the pill, the dozens of lotus buds in his soul immediately rotated by themselves, and several lotus petals began to bloom beneath them.
Zhang Fei [5]'s soul breakthrough caused panic in several places, especially since his real body and the other four clones experienced the same incident.
In Cheng Gaoji's residence, Hun Di and the others gathered in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s room, and they immediately knew that he was breaking through to the early stage of the Heavenly Soul Level.
In the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion, Shang Yaolin and his other wives also tensed up seeing Zhang Fei in so much pain. They witnessed the constant torment and reconstruction of his soul.
Feltia [2], who previously cultivated at the icy lake, was forced to stop, especially since the pain was truly unbearable, making Zhang Yue, Xian Lianghua, and Xue Jingling worry about him.

Balena, who was still on her way to the Blue Water Realm, was worried about Zhang Fei [1]'s condition. Unlike her, the two female foxes looked relaxed, and they believed they would be free if something happened to him.

Feng Yao, who accompanied Zhang Fei [4] to look for Feng Yichen, looked very relaxed even though he looked like he was in a lot of pain. Huo Ling also came out of her body to watch him break through in his soul level.

At the end of the garden, the soul of the ten-tailed fox arrogantly and condescendingly looked at Zhang Fei [5]. Unlike his first soul, his second soul looks much fiercer, showing off his pointy and sharp fangs. "Is this weakling destined to inherit my power? He is too weak, and he will tarnish my name."

After he had been tormented for some time, Zhang Fei [5]'s soul had transformed, and his body floated into the middle of the air. Before him floated a great phantom—his own soul, now much larger, about hundreds of feet tall, shrouded in brilliant light and light chains. They were the chains of mortality, forged by the limits of his previous realm.

The dozens of lotus buds in Zhang Fei [5]'s soul no longer had ten but twenty-four petals, and they continued to rotate, releasing a huge amount of soul power, breaking the chains one by one, and freeing his soul from their restraints. At the same time, his soul space also underwent changes, and its size became wider, forming a soul sea, which increased his soul power to an extent.

A brand symbol appeared on Zhang Fei [5]'s soul's forehead, inscribed with the ancient character for "Heaven". The symbol glowed for a few moments before sinking into his soul, indicating that his soul breakthrough was successful.
[Ding]
[The host soul level increases to the early stage of the heavenly soul level.]
After his soul returned to his body, Zhang Fei [5]'s eyes snapped open. He then used his senses to confirm the changes in himself, and he found them to be stronger and spread further.

Zhang Fei [5] tried to enter his soul space, which had now turned into a soul sea. He smiled in satisfaction seeing the size of his soul sea because it had become expansive, about 250 miles (ca. 402 km).

"You're awesome, kid." Ma Kuangyu spoke as he appeared in front of Zhang Fei [5] along with Nalan Yushu. "Usually, the soul sea of a soul cultivator would not be this wide when breaking through for the first time, and the initial area is around 50 to 100 miles (ca. 161 km). However, your soul sea is 250 miles (ca. 402 km) wide, and it will expand every time you break through to the next stage. This way, you can store more soul power, and a soul cultivator at your level will not be able to fight you."
"I also didn't expect that my soul sea would be this wide." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a satisfied smile on his face.

Nalan Yushu then informed him. "Master, your recent soul breakthrough has affected the female dark fairy, making her soul clearer. If you continue to supply her with your soul power, she might wake up soon."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I will check on her later, and I will go out to settle my business with the soul of the ten-tailed fox first."
Zhang Fei [5] went straight to the end of the garden, but he got an unpleasant welcome from the soul of the ten-tailed fox, who immediately attacked him with his right claw.
*Boom*
Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] easily avoided his attack, and he floated a little distance in front of the soul of the ten-tailed fox. "I've met your two souls, but they weren't as arrogant as you."
"Hahaha." The soul of the ten-tailed fox laughed at that. "Bullshit! This soul is my second soul, so there's no way you've met the other two."
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh and shook his head. "You've grown senile due to your prolonged confinement in this place, don't you think? You should know the second soul I'm referring to, right?"
"Hmm?" The soul of the ten-tailed fox furrowed his brows. "I see! You have met my evil soul."
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "I accidentally met your evil soul. Although he is evil, he is not as arrogant as you, and I think he is a little better than you."
Hearing that, the soul of the ten-tailed fox used his ten tails to attack him, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword and blocked them.
The soul of the ten-tailed fox then used his soul power to suppress him, but Ma Kuangyu helped Zhang Fei [5] to fight back using his soul power.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox furiously roared after he failed to attack and suppressed Zhang Fei [5], pushing him back several steps.

"I don't understand how you can be different from your first soul, but since you don't like the easy way, I will absorb your soul using the hard way." Zhang Fei [5] then used the Nine Nether Fiends Summoning, and nine darkness creatures immediately appeared around him before moving to attack the soul of the ten-tailed fox.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox blew them away with another roar, and its ten tails attacked the nine darkness creatures, obliterating them instantly.

However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used the fourth sub-technique of the origin soul art, and his soul manifestation directly attacked the soul of the ten-tailed fox. Naturally, Ma Kuangyu assisted him with his own soul power, strengthening his.
The soul of the ten-tailed fox seemed shocked at that, but he dashed and attacked Zhang Fei [5]'s soul manifestation using his right claw, causing the two's attacks to clash with each other.
*Boom*
The explosion knocked both of them quite far back, but they hurriedly stabilized themselves and attacked each other again.
Even though it was only a small part of his soul, and he had also been sealed for so long, the soul of the ten-tailed fox was still too strong for Zhang Fei [5]'s soul.
Normally, Zhang Fei [5]'s soul would not be able to keep up with the soul of the ten-tailed fox, but he was lucky because of the existence of Ma Kuanyu in his soul space.

Furthermore, Zhang Fei [5] had another advantage over the soul of the ten-tailed fox, especially since he was still alive. As soon as their souls clashed with each other, he immediately jumped onto the fox's soul and used his demon-absorbing ability.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox roared once again. "Bastard! You cheated!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Old fox, all methods are lawful in battle, especially when facing an opponent who is much stronger than me, like you. You should stop wasting time and surrender to me, and we can unite our souls."

"I'll kill you, you bastard!" Just as the soul of the ten-tailed fox was about to attack Zhang Fei [5], Nalan Yushu's soul immediately emerged from his soul sea and possessed the fox's soul. "Who the fuck are you! How dare you enter my soul, you filthy bitch!"

After his soul returned to his body, Zhang Fei [5]'s eyes snapped open.
He then used his senses to confirm the changes in himself, and he found them to be stronger and spread further.
Zhang Fei [5] tried to enter his soul space, which had now turned into a soul sea.
He smiled in satisfaction seeing the size of his soul sea because it had become expansive, about 250 miles (ca.
"You're awesome, kid." Ma Kuangyu spoke as he appeared in front of Zhang Fei [5] along with Nalan Yushu.
"Usually, the soul sea of a soul cultivator would not be this wide when breaking through for the first time, and the initial area is around 50 to 100 miles (ca.
However, your soul sea is 250 miles (ca.
402 km) wide, and it will expand every time you break through to the next stage.
This way, you can store more soul power, and a soul cultivator at your level will not be able to fight you."
"I also didn't expect that my soul sea would be this wide." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a satisfied smile on his face.
Nalan Yushu then informed him.
"Master, your recent soul breakthrough has affected the female dark fairy, making her soul clearer.
If you continue to supply her with your soul power, she might wake up soon."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"I will check on her later, and I will go out to settle my business with the soul of the ten-tailed fox first."
Zhang Fei [5] went straight to the end of the garden, but he got an unpleasant welcome from the soul of the ten-tailed fox, who immediately attacked him with his right claw.
*Boom*
Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] easily avoided his attack, and he floated a little distance in front of the soul of the ten-tailed fox.
"I've met your two souls, but they weren't as arrogant as you."
"Hahaha." The soul of the ten-tailed fox laughed at that.
"Bullshit!
This soul is my second soul, so there's no way you've met the other two."
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh and shook his head.
"You've grown senile due to your prolonged confinement in this place, don't you think?
You should know the second soul I'm referring to, right?"
"Hmm?" The soul of the ten-tailed fox furrowed his brows.
"I see!
You have met my evil soul."
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him.
"I accidentally met your evil soul.
Although he is evil, he is not as arrogant as you, and I think he is a little better than you."
Hearing that, the soul of the ten-tailed fox used his ten tails to attack him, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword and blocked them.
The soul of the ten-tailed fox then used his soul power to suppress him, but Ma Kuangyu helped Zhang Fei [5] to fight back using his soul power.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox furiously roared after he failed to attack and suppressed Zhang Fei [5], pushing him back several steps.

"I don't understand how you can be different from your first soul, but since you don't like the easy way, I will absorb your soul using the hard way." Zhang Fei [5] then used the Nine Nether Fiends Summoning, and nine darkness creatures immediately appeared around him before moving to attack the soul of the ten-tailed fox.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox blew them away with another roar, and its ten tails attacked the nine darkness creatures, obliterating them instantly.
However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used the fourth sub-technique of the origin soul art, and his soul manifestation directly attacked the soul of the ten-tailed fox.
Naturally, Ma Kuangyu assisted him with his own soul power, strengthening his.
The soul of the ten-tailed fox seemed shocked at that, but he dashed and attacked Zhang Fei [5]'s soul manifestation using his right claw, causing the two's attacks to clash with each other.
*Boom*
The explosion knocked both of them quite far back, but they hurriedly stabilized themselves and attacked each other again.
Even though it was only a small part of his soul, and he had also been sealed for so long, the soul of the ten-tailed fox was still too strong for Zhang Fei [5]'s soul.
Normally, Zhang Fei [5]'s soul would not be able to keep up with the soul of the ten-tailed fox, but he was lucky because of the existence of Ma Kuanyu in his soul space.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei [5] had another advantage over the soul of the ten-tailed fox, especially since he was still alive.
As soon as their souls clashed with each other, he immediately jumped onto the fox's soul and used his demon-absorbing ability.
*Roar*
The soul of the ten-tailed fox roared once again.
"Bastard!
You cheated!"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"Old fox, all methods are lawful in battle, especially when facing an opponent who is much stronger than me, like you.
You should stop wasting time and surrender to me, and we can unite our souls."
"I'll kill you, you bastard!" Just as the soul of the ten-tailed fox was about to attack Zhang Fei [5], Nalan Yushu's soul immediately emerged from his soul sea and possessed the fox's soul.
"Who the fuck are you!
How dare you enter my soul, you filthy bitch!"

chapters.title: Chapter 847 847: Fighting The Natural Races
paragraphs: *Roar*

The ten-tailed fox's soul continued to roar angrily, but Nalan Yushu had already taken control of his soul. Moreover, she and Zhang Fei [5] continued to absorb his soul power, slowly weakening him. "Give up, old fox. If your soul were still intact, this battle would have gone differently. The current you is only a small part of your soul, and my soul is still intact, so you won't be able to break free from my control."
"Bastard!" The ten-tailed fox's soul looked up, but Zhang Fei [5]'s soul manifestation directly punched his head, slamming his head into the ground. "Gah!"
Zhang Fei [5]'s soul manifestation didn't stop there, and he repeatedly struck the ten-tailed fox's soul, causing him to continuously groan in pain.
"Gah!"
A few hours later, the ten-tailed fox's soul finally weakened, and Zhang Fei [5] decided to do something else against him.
"Old fox, I would rather not do this, but you forced me to do it." Zhang Fei [5] immediately used one of his curse techniques. "Soulbinding Curse."
"Stop it, you bastard!"

"Too late, old fox." Soon, a connection was established between Zhang Fei [5]'s soul and the ten-tailed fox soul. He then withdrew his soul manifestation and spoke to Nalan Yushu. "Go back to my soul sea."
"Yes, Master." Nalan Yushu immediately released control of the ten-tailed fox's soul and entered Zhang Fei [5]'s soul sea.

'Phew! Luckily, I have Old Ma and Nalan Yushu by my side, or else I would have spent a lot of time defeating this soul.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately jumped down from the ten-tailed fox's soul and stood in front of him, but the old fox continued to stare at him hatefully. "What actually happened to you? How could your soul be different from the first one I met?"

"Tch!" The ten-tailed fox's soul gritted his teeth. "Back then, I split my soul into several parts, and this soul carried my pride and arrogance. The one you met back then was my soul that carried my lustful nature."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that, but he finally realized the reason behind the increase in his lustful nature after their souls merged back then. "So, there are still five other souls out there, right?"
"No." The ten-tailed fox's answer confused Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you think the seven emotions are everything? There are still other emotions, which is why I divided my soul into multiple parts."
"Some others?"
"My bloodlust, my kindness, and many others."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "You can do such a thing, huh? Does that mean one of your souls is driven by bloodlust?"

"Yes." The ten-tailed fox nodded. "That particular soul of mine lacks memories and was born from my bloodlust. My bloodlust is too deadly, and it will scare many living creatures, so I separated it from me after the beast war ended."

"Speaking of the beast war, I've heard that you mediated to end it. However, it makes me curious about your true strength, especially since your enemies are the Primordial Nihility Beast and the Primordial Genesis Beast." The ten-tailed fox stared at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, especially since he supposedly still didn't know about the two beasts. "How strong were you really in the past? What is your true origin?"

"I won't answer your questions, and you will know everything after you get all my souls scattered in this universe." The ten-tailed fox directly touched Zhang Fei [5]'s head. "Before you merge with my evil soul, you must first find my other soul, which was born from my kindness. Otherwise, my evil nature will take over you, and you will become a true evil."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I've met your evil soul, so I understand a little about him. If your evil nature was weak, you wouldn't have separated it from yourself in the first place. However, it's hard to understand why a powerful beast like you, who could stand on equal footing with the two primordial beasts, would decide to weaken yourself. Besides, you would rather isolate yourself in the three moral realms than stay in the Paradise Realm or above."

"Collect all my souls and evolve to ten tails, and you'll get all the answers by then." Zhang Fei [5] released a disappointed sigh, and the ten-tailed fox immediately began the process of merging their souls, causing his soul to fade rapidly. "My soul that materialized from my bloodlust is sealed in the Slaughter Blood Domain, and you will face resistance from the Asura Demon there, especially the Asura Demon God."

Before Zhang Fei [5] could ask again, a bright white aura suddenly enveloped the ten-tailed fox's soul, dazzling him. It only lasted a few seconds, and the white aura immediately disappeared, as did the ten-tailed fox's soul.

"As expected! My soul level broke through again after his soul merged with mine." Zhang Fei [5] muttered in satisfaction, especially since increasing his soul power was much more difficult than increasing his cultivation.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to clear all the herbs in the garden, but the place was no longer sealed, and the natural races could enter there. Therefore, he only took a few stalks of each type of herb, and he sent them to Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu in the Sealed World Pearl.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly left the garden, but Tianshi Shengjie was no longer there. "Why did she go?"
"That woman asked me to give these two to you." Feng Xishui immediately handed Zhang Fei [5] a golden token and a letter.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned and read the letter directly.
[My duty in the three mortal realms is complete, so I have to return to the Paradise Realm, and I will wait for you in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. PS: Get ready to face your next enemy.]

"Tch! That woman is deliberately toying with me! She asked me to meet her in this realm, but she has now run away and returned to the Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [5] immediately saved the golden token and a letter.
[You obtained the Celestial Dragon Token.]
Zhang Fei [5] then opened the map to check the outside, and he found many red dots heading towards them. "Senior, we have a new problem now."

"Hmm?" Feng Xishui immediately spread his senses out of the cave. "This cave seems to be their sacred place, and they didn't notice our presence before because of that woman. Since she has left this realm, they immediately noticed our presence and rushed here. Their leader is clearly much stronger than I am, so we will face a tough fight."
"Let's go out then."

As soon as they arrived outside the cave, they were surrounded by hundreds of natural races from various races. However, Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised after he saw their leader, especially since he was a giant race. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Da Xiongmao
Age: 15,000+ Years Old
Race: Giant
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Element: Earth [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Earth [Half Perfection Stage]
Core: Earth Core [Upper Rank]
Physique: Stone Giant
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: Da Feiyue
Like: Natural races
Dislikes: Humans
Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh in his heart, especially since Da Xiongmao was simply too strong for him and Feng Xishui.
*Bam*

Da Xiongmao slammed the handle of his giant hammer onto the ground, causing tremors in the surrounding area; even the water in the lake gushed upwards. "Who the hell are you two? How did you find our sacred place?"

"Are you not mistaken?" Zhang Fei [5] then pointed his thumb behind him. "This cave is indeed in your realm, but it is not your sacred place, especially since you can't do anything to the fox statue. However, I have opened it now, and you can enter the place to harvest the treasures inside."

Da Xiongmao immediately turned to one of the members of the natural races, and a male fairy rushed to check inside the cave. Not long after, he returned and reported what he saw in the garden to the giant. "How did you manage to open that place?"
"Can you still not recognize my identity?" Da Xiongmao narrowed his eyes, forcing Zhang Fei [5] to use his heavenly fox form.
"A heavenly fox?" Da Xiongmao and the others gasped.

Zhang Fei [5] returned to his half-fox directly and patted Feng Xishui's shoulder. "I am indeed a heavenly fox, and this senior is a fire phoenix. I came here because of the fox statue, and I have found what I was looking for now. Therefore, we will leave this realm, and you can use all the herbs here for yourselves."

"You two cannot leave before you hand over the secret of the fox statue to us." Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui turned to the female giant beside Da Xiongmao, who was none other than Da Feiyue. "We can't do anything to the statue, but it's still part of our realm, so we have the right to get it more than you two."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "I have met so many natural races of all races, but I have never met one as greedy and shameless as you. No wonder the number of giant races in this universe is too small, especially since you guys are too greedy."
*Boom*
Da Feiyue's hammer slammed into Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui's spot in an instant, but both of them had already vanished, shocking everyone.

They then looked up at the waterfall because Feng Xishui and Zhang Fei [5] were already there. "Your cultivation is indeed higher than ours, but the two of us are not weak persimmons. I would prefer to avoid conflict, but I will defend myself if you try to prevent us from leaving."
*Bam... Bam...*
"Hahaha!" Da Xiongmao laughed as he smashed his hammer against the ground a few times, and the other natural races also laughed at Zhang Fei [5]. "Surround them!"

The people immediately surrounded Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui, and some of them chanted strange incantations. In a few moments, a barrier enveloped the area, putting pressure on both of their cultivation and souls.
Da Xiongmao immediately jumped onto the waterfall as he swung his hammer at it, which produced quite a loud explosion.
*Boom*

The dirt and dust above the waterfall immediately scattered into the air, as did the water that flowed down into the lake. However, Da Xiongmao and the others were in shock after the dust cleared, especially since Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui were not there.
"Heh!" Da Xiongmao looked up to the sky and saw them standing outside their barrier. "Big body but small brain! Since you attacked us first, don't blame me."

In an instant, the sky above them turned pitch black, and black lightning began to flash above them, especially after Zhang Fei [5] used the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation. He did not stop there, and a giant ethereal demon claw appeared before him, followed by nine darkness creatures.

'What the hell is with this brat? How can he use so many techniques at once? Moreover, he is a heavenly fox, but all his techniques are darkness techniques.' These were the thoughts of those who witnessed Zhang Fei [5] using the three techniques.

Zhang Fei [5] grinned faintly as he threw a sizable black ball into the sky, and it immediately emitted an unusual aura, causing those with low mental strength to be controlled by their madness and become berserk.
Within seconds, Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui could hear their maddened screams, and some of them started attacking each other due to the effects of the Cursed Black Sun.

Da Xiongmao and several of them immediately flew into the sky to attack the two of them, but Zhang Fei [5] took Feng Xishui to teleport to another area. Darkness soon spread from his body, rapidly enveloping the area and obscuring their vision.

However, the natural races with the light and wind elements immediately countered Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness, causing it to disappear quickly and catching him by surprise. 'Oh? This is the first time I've encountered an enemy who can eliminate my darkness corruption so easily.'

Zhang Fei [5] immediately ordered the nine darkness creatures to attack Da Xiongmao and the others. He also activated the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation, causing the black lightning bolts to rain down on them, followed by the ethereal demon claw. However, the barrier those people had previously created blocked their path.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his darkness Qi into it, and slashed downwards. "Soul-breaking demon howl."
In an instant, a darkness lion shot out from Zhang Fei [5]'s sword, dashed toward them, and released a loud roar.
*Roar*

Those with low soul strength instantly collapsed to the ground, and their bodies convulsed a few times before falling unconscious with foam coming out of their mouths, especially since Zhang Fei [5]'s attack just now had directly attacked their souls.
"Bastard!" Da Xiongmao shouted furiously. "Spread out and attack them!"
*Roar*

Zhang Fei [5] unleashed the demon king's roar, instilling fear and confusion in them. Afterwards, he used the hellflame incantation to surround him and Feng Xishui, forcing Da Xiongmao and the others to move away, especially since the flames were not ordinary flames but hell flames, and the heat was too extreme.

Feng Xishui, who had not yet launched an attack, finally decided to make a move. He shot his phoenix flames into the sky, and they quickly transformed into hundreds of small fire phoenixes, which charged straight at them.

Unlike Zhang Fei [5]'s attacks, Da Xiongmao and the others were able to easily repel Feng Xishui's attacks, mainly due to the difference in their cultivation. "Zhang Fei! We should retreat first! Your technique affects those who are weak, but those giants and the others are not affected by their effects."

"I will send you back to the Divine Flame Realm, and I will deal with them myself." Feng Xishui wanted to refuse, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate and threw him inside before closing it again.
Zhang Fei [5] then teleported several times, leaving his enemies confused as they searched for him.
"Hey! I'm here." Da Xiongmao and the others looked up into the distance, but their expressions turned serious once they saw the dark flames and the ice in Zhang Fei [5]'s hands.

"I created this technique a long time ago, but I have never tested it in battle. Since you guys are my enemies, I will test it against you all now." Zhang Fei [5] immediately merged his dark flames and ice elements, forming a dark flame ice lotus. After he strengthened the lotus with his three elemental laws, he launched it at his enemies. "Taste my Hellflame Frost Lotus!"
The natural races were shocked to see that fire and ice could merge into one, and the aura that emerged from Zhang Fei [5]'s Hellflame Frost Lotus was quite frightening to them.

Da Xiongmao, Da Feiyue, and several others immediately unleashed their maximum strength to attack Zhang Fei. Meanwhile, several others formed a protective barrier to resist the dark flame lotus. "Attack him!"
In a few moments, Da Xiongmao's and the others' attacks directly clashed with Zhang Fei [5]'s Hellflame Frost Lotus.
*Crack... Crack...*
Despite their superior strength, their attacks could not stop the Hellflame Frost Lotus, mainly because Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness corrupted their attacks, and his ice element froze them.
"Dodge!" Da Xiongmao warned the others.
To Be Continued -
