Da Xiongmao immediately jumped onto the waterfall as he swung his hammer at it, which produced quite a loud explosion.
*Boom*
The dirt and dust above the waterfall immediately scattered into the air, as did the water that flowed down into the lake.
However, Da Xiongmao and the others were in shock after the dust cleared, especially since Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui were not there.
"Heh!" Da Xiongmao looked up to the sky and saw them standing outside their barrier.
"Big body but small brain!
Since you attacked us first, don't blame me."
In an instant, the sky above them turned pitch black, and black lightning began to flash above them, especially after Zhang Fei [5] used the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation.
He did not stop there, and a giant ethereal demon claw appeared before him, followed by nine darkness creatures.
'What the hell is with this brat?
How can he use so many techniques at once?
Moreover, he is a heavenly fox, but all his techniques are darkness techniques.' These were the thoughts of those who witnessed Zhang Fei [5] using the three techniques.

Zhang Fei [5] grinned faintly as he threw a sizable black ball into the sky, and it immediately emitted an unusual aura, causing those with low mental strength to be controlled by their madness and become berserk.
Within seconds, Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui could hear their maddened screams, and some of them started attacking each other due to the effects of the Cursed Black Sun.
Da Xiongmao and several of them immediately flew into the sky to attack the two of them, but Zhang Fei [5] took Feng Xishui to teleport to another area.
Darkness soon spread from his body, rapidly enveloping the area and obscuring their vision.
However, the natural races with the light and wind elements immediately countered Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness, causing it to disappear quickly and catching him by surprise. 'Oh?
This is the first time I've encountered an enemy who can eliminate my darkness corruption so easily.'
Zhang Fei [5] immediately ordered the nine darkness creatures to attack Da Xiongmao and the others.
He also activated the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation, causing the black lightning bolts to rain down on them, followed by the ethereal demon claw.
However, the barrier those people had previously created blocked their path.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his darkness Qi into it, and slashed downwards.
"Soul-breaking demon howl."
In an instant, a darkness lion shot out from Zhang Fei [5]'s sword, dashed toward them, and released a loud roar.
*Roar*

Those with low soul strength instantly collapsed to the ground, and their bodies convulsed a few times before falling unconscious with foam coming out of their mouths, especially since Zhang Fei [5]'s attack just now had directly attacked their souls.
"Bastard!" Da Xiongmao shouted furiously.
"Spread out and attack them!"
*Roar*
Zhang Fei [5] unleashed the demon king's roar, instilling fear and confusion in them.

Afterwards, he used the hellflame incantation to surround him and Feng Xishui, forcing Da Xiongmao and the others to move away, especially since the flames were not ordinary flames but hell flames, and the heat was too extreme.
Feng Xishui, who had not yet launched an attack, finally decided to make a move.
He shot his phoenix flames into the sky, and they quickly transformed into hundreds of small fire phoenixes, which charged straight at them.
Unlike Zhang Fei [5]'s attacks, Da Xiongmao and the others were able to easily repel Feng Xishui's attacks, mainly due to the difference in their cultivation.
"Zhang Fei!
We should retreat first!
Your technique affects those who are weak, but those giants and the others are not affected by their effects."

"I will send you back to the Divine Flame Realm, and I will deal with them myself." Feng Xishui wanted to refuse, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate and threw him inside before closing it again.
Zhang Fei [5] then teleported several times, leaving his enemies confused as they searched for him.
"Hey!
I'm here." Da Xiongmao and the others looked up into the distance, but their expressions turned serious once they saw the dark flames and the ice in Zhang Fei [5]'s hands.
"I created this technique a long time ago, but I have never tested it in battle.
Since you guys are my enemies, I will test it against you all now." Zhang Fei [5] immediately merged his dark flames and ice elements, forming a dark flame ice lotus.
After he strengthened the lotus with his three elemental laws, he launched it at his enemies.
"Taste my Hellflame Frost Lotus!"
The natural races were shocked to see that fire and ice could merge into one, and the aura that emerged from Zhang Fei [5]'s Hellflame Frost Lotus was quite frightening to them.
Da Xiongmao, Da Feiyue, and several others immediately unleashed their maximum strength to attack Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, several others formed a protective barrier to resist the dark flame lotus.
"Attack him!"
In a few moments, Da Xiongmao's and the others' attacks directly clashed with Zhang Fei [5]'s Hellflame Frost Lotus.
*Crack...
Crack...*
Despite their superior strength, their attacks could not stop the Hellflame Frost Lotus, mainly because Zhang Fei [5]'s darkness corrupted their attacks, and his ice element froze them.
"Dodge!" Da Xiongmao warned the others.
To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 848 848: The Heavenly Foxes Fled
paragraphs: Da Xiongmao and the others looked around the area while taking a deep breath. Half of the area, including the lake and waterfall, was frozen. The other half was burning with dark flames, making rocks, trees, and everything else charred.

They then looked towards Zhang Fei [5], but he was no longer alone in the sky. Since his enemies were numerous and powerful, Zhang Fei and two other clones went to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm to help his fifth clone.

The Hellflame Frost Lotus had already appeared in their hands, forcing the natural races to think twice about attacking the three of them, especially since the power of the previous lotus was already so strong.
'Husband, how can he have three real clones?' Da Feiyue questioned her husband, Da Xiongmao. 'Look at them; everything about them is completely similar in appearance, aura, and cultivation.'

'This is also my first time seeing such realistic clones.' Da Xiongmao then ordered the other natural races to be careful, especially since the impact would be devastating if Zhang Fei and his three clones launched all four Hellflame Frost Lotuses.

Zhang Fei and his three clones also did not immediately launch the four Hellflame Frost Lotuses, especially since they were waiting for the system to finish scanning the entire area of the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm.
Since their focus was on Zhang Fei and his three clones, Da Xiongmao and the others did not notice that there were several other people standing far away behind the clouds.

They were Hun Di, Feng Jiu, Lin Moxian, Yan Yinqing, Qiao Liangren, and Tantai Lingyan. At first, they witnessed Zhang Xiaolong [3] breaking through to the heavenly soul level, and they decided to go with him when he wanted to go to that realm.
"Have you ever seen a fight as absurd as theirs, Master?" Yan Yinqing asked.

Hun Di shook his head slightly. "The two giants' cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and the other five are at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm. Not to mention, there are still a few others at that stage, yet Zhang Fei has the upper hand against them."

"My daughter told me many things about Zhang Fei, but witnessing their situation made me realize that his true strength was beyond my previous imagination." Feng Jiu then pointed at them. "Observe those four lotuses; the fusion of darkness, fire, and ice elements created them. One lotus caused the area to be so chaotic, and those natural races will suffer even more if he uses four lotuses at once to attack them."

"It's not an easy task to combine his three elements to create the lotus, yet he managed to accomplish it in just a few seconds while also fortifying it with three elemental laws." Tantai Lingyan spoke with admiration.

Lin Moxian told them straightaway. "His main advantage is not in his cultivation but in his speed, and he also has many techniques that I have never seen before. His mastery of all his techniques is top-notch, including his speed in executing them. Moreover, his clones are also extraordinary, and their strength is on par with his real body. Fighting against one of them is already troublesome, let alone having to fight against several of them at once."

Hun Di nodded in agreement with them. "Their fight is almost reaching its climax, and the outcome depends on Zhang Fei. These natural races, despite their high cultivation, will suffer serious injuries if Zhang Fei launches all four lotuses."
[Ding]
[The process of mapping the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm is complete.]
[The host can check the entire realm area on the map.]

"I told you that I didn't come here to find trouble, and I came specifically for the fox statue, but you guys insisted on attacking me." Zhang Fei and his three clones immediately raised the four lotuses in their hands up, making Da Xiongmang and the others panic. "The fox statue belongs to the ten-tailed fox, and the other natural races from other realms know that he is the ancestor of the heavenly fox. Do you think you have more right to own the statue than I do, considering I am a heavenly fox? If you guys don't admit you're wrong right now, I will destroy this realm directly."

Da Feiyue was furious because of Zhang Fei's threat, but Da Xiongmang immediately stopped her. 'Don't be careless! They can create all four lotuses in a matter of seconds, and they will create another four once they launch the ones in their hands.'
'Are we really going to admit our wrongs to that bastard? He has already infiltrated our realm and sacred ground.' Da Feiyue spoke with an angry tone.
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and threw the lotus in his hand toward them.
"Shit! Run!" Da Xiongmang shouted as he pulled his wife, flying away from their position, followed by the other natural races.
However, Zhang Fei suddenly teleported to the front of them, attacking Da Xiongmang and Da Feiyu directly.
*Bam... Bam...*
Da Xiongmang and Da Feiyu blocked his attacks and attacked him back, but Zhang Fei teleported away as he used the demon king's roar on them.
*Roar*

Da Xiongmang and the other spirit races were confused for a few seconds before returning to normal, but the fear effect remained within them, even more so when they realized Zhang Fei's Hellflame Frost Lotus was close behind them.

"Protect yourselves!" They took out protective artifacts and activated them right away, but Zhang Fei's Hellflame Frost Lotus smashed into their barriers directly, burning and freezing them at the same time.

Zhang Fei immediately pulled out the new weapon that Cheng Gaoji and Duan Zhao had created some time ago. He channeled his four elements into it and shot it into their barriers several times in succession.
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*

"What the hell is that?" Da Xiongmang and the other spirit races realized it too late, and Zhang Fei's attack penetrated their barriers and shattered them directly. As a result, his Hellflame Frost Lotus moved towards them again before exploding.
*Boom*
"Argh!"
"Help!"
"Save me!"
Zhang Fei's dark flames burned some of them, while others began to freeze.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
Dozens of dark lightning bolts suddenly descended from the sky and struck those people directly.
"Gahhh!"
"I surrender! I surrender!" Da Xiongmang shouted at Zhang Fei very loudly. "Please stop attacking us!"
[Quest: Defeat the natural races' leader.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes, stretched his hand forward, and the dark flames that burned them instantly disappeared. He also stopped his ice elements from freezing them, but some were already frozen; their high cultivation kept them alive.

Zhang Fei and his three clones surrounded them, and their Hellflame Frost Lotuses were still burning in their hands in case Da Xiongmang and the other spirit races changed their minds and attacked them.

Those people immediately swallowed several pills, including healing pills, to speed up the recovery of their injuries. However, they were shocked as soon as the other six people appeared around them; they immediately recognized Hun Di and Feng Jiu. "Soul Emperor and Phoenix Empress!"

"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled. "You guys are foolish and greedy, Xiongmang. All of you already know that the statue belongs to the ten-tailed fox, but you still think about taking it from this kid. Unfortunately, you all have to deal with the wrong person today, and you are lucky that he didn't kill you immediately."
Hun Di then spoke to them. "Considering our old relationship, I will forgive all of you today, even though you have attacked my disciple."
"What?" Da Xiongmang and the others exclaimed in shock as they stared at Zhang Fei. "Is... is this kid really your disciple, Soul Emperor?"
"Do you guys think I'm going to talk nonsense?" Hun Di responded with narrowed eyes.
Those people swallowed their saliva. "Please forgive us, Soul Emperor. We did not know that he was your disciple."

"Foolish people." Hun Di replied with a shake of his head. "Even if he is not my disciple, you should not have attacked him, let alone ganged up on him. What would people say if senior cultivators like you all attacked a junior like him?"

"There's no need to talk to them much, Master." Zhang Fei then spoke to them. "I usually kill my enemies, but since your population is smaller than humans, I spared you and your realm. Moreover, one of your ancestors has given me something valuable, so I will spare you all this once. However, I will not spare you again if you seek trouble with me in the future, and you should already be aware that I have the ability to back up my words."
"Our ancestors?" Those people looked confused when they heard that.

"I won't say anything." Mei suddenly reminded him, but Zhang Fei ignored it. 'With my current soul power, I will have difficulty controlling them unless my master is willing to help me. I'm sure he won't be willing to do that, so I want to see their next move first. If they still seek trouble with me again, I will kill the two giants and force the rest to submit to me.' "So, what's your decision?"
"We refuse." Da Feiyue answered Zhang Fei, and she also asked her husband to reject the offer.

Da Xiongmang immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "I admit that your strength is indeed extraordinary, but we would rather not follow anyone, and we want to continue living freely in this realm without interfering in outside affairs."
"Hey—"
"You don't need to say anything to them, Senior Sister." After he stopped Yan Yinqing, Zhang Fei immediately opened three different gates.
The natural races were momentarily surprised to see the three gates, but they knew that it was Zhang Fei's ability as a heavenly fox.
Feltia [2] immediately returned to the phoenix realm, and Zhang Fei [5] returned to the Divine Flame Realm to meet Feng Xishui.
"Master."
"Yeah." Hun Di led his three disciples, Feng Jiu, Tantai Lingyan, and Wang Yourou, back to the Xianjin Realm, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3].

After he closed the three gates, Zhang Fei immediately disappeared from the sight of Da Xiongmang and the others. However, he didn't immediately leave the realm, and he remained hidden in an invisible state, monitoring them through the map and the demon eye's orb.
"What about our frozen people?" An old male fairy asked Da Xiongmang.
Da Xiongmang looked at the frozen people before releasing a heavy sigh. "Bring them back first, and we will slowly melt the ice on their bodies."

After they left, Da Feiyue spoke to her husband again. "What do you think if we report that kid's existence to Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing? He has the darkness element, and those two old foxes will be eager to capture him. This way, we don't have to take revenge on him; we let them handle him. Even if Soul Emperor and Phoenix Empress were by his side, they wouldn't be able to protect him from those two old foxes."

"Hmm?" Da Xiongmang thought for a moment before agreeing with his wife. "All right, we should go back now, and I will contact Tian Baitian to tell him about that kid. I still don't understand how he can be so strong, even though his cultivation is still at the 2-Star Heaven Realm. He will be a threat to us if we let him live, so we will use the two old foxes to get rid of him as quickly as possible."
An evil smile spread across Da Feiyue's face, and a glimmer of hatred flashed through her eyes, especially after Zhang Fei and his three clones had humiliated them to such an extent.

As soon as Da Xiongmang and Da Feiyue disappeared, Zhang Fei appeared in the area again. [Master, those two giants are really idiots! You have forgiven them, but they want to report you to Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing.]

"Yeah." Zhang Fei gave a light nod. "Unfortunately, they don't know the situation in the Heavenly Moon Realm, and I'm sure those two old foxes won't dare to leave their realm at this time, especially since Xereth could arrive there at any time. I hope that demon will wreak havoc in their realm, and they won't bother me if their situation gets worse."
[What are your plans for the two giants?]
"Didn't you already know that, Mei?" Zhang Fei immediately entered the training space after that.

"What happened to you, Brother?" Tian Baitian immediately told Tian Baixing about the information he had just gotten from Da Xiaongmang. "I didn't expect that kid to have gone to the upper realm, and he also became Hun Di's disciple, so Tian Jianxun's trip to the middle realms was in vain. Do you want to send our people to the Xianjin Realm?"

Tian Baitan shook his head immediately. "Xereth will arrive at this realm at any time now, so we don't need to bother with that kid for now. Once we get through the danger, I will go to the Xianjin Realm myself to capture him. What about our young generation? Have they fled to that realm?"

"Yes." Tian Baixing replied with a nod. "Currently, only the two of us and a few elders are still staying in this realm, so we don't need to worry about them. If we can't face Xereth, we will immediately flee from this realm."

Tian Baitan took a deep breath and looked at their realm areas. "We have lived in this realm since we were born in this universe, and we have always succeeded in repelling the demons who wanted to invade it. However, I did not expect that Xereth would suddenly return with such a powerful force, and I felt helpless for the first time in facing a demon."

"If the ten-tailed fox hadn't planted that seal in our souls, we would have reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm long ago, and we would have already ascended to that realm." Tian Baixing wanted to say something else, but they suddenly felt a deadly aura coming from outside their realm. "Xereth!"
*Boom*

The entire realm shook violently after the powerful explosion, and the elders of the heavenly fox race immediately gathered around Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing. "What should we do now, Ancestors? Judging from this demon's aura, his strength is clearly several times above ours, and we can't possibly fight him even if they join together to fight him."

Instead of responding to the male fox, Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing turned their attention to Xereth, who was standing outside their realm. Moreover, he was not alone, and they saw many demons from several realms joining him to attack their realm.
*Boom*
Once again, the entire area of their realm shook violently because of Xereth's attempt to destroy the barrier that protected it.

Tian Baitian clicked his tongue before opening the gate. "I don't want to run away, but Xereth is too strong for us, and he brought an army of demons. We should leave now, and we will return to this realm after the situation calms down."

Xereth's attack shattered the barrier into pieces shortly after they vanished through the gate. The demon immediately appeared at their location, but he turned furious because Tian Baitian and the others ran away. "Bastard! How could they know about my coming to this realm? Who told them about me? Damn it! I couldn't break into the Abyssal Realm, and now I've also failed to capture those two foxes! If they also fail to do their job, Master Taotie will definitely blame me and punish me."
Soon, three demons wearing royal robes landed by Xereth's side. "Are they running away from us, Lord?"
"Are you blind?" Xereth responded sharply. "Order your subordinates to destroy this realm! You three, search the nearby realms for those two foxes."
"Yes, Lord."
Xereth then contacted his other subordinates to find out the progress of their plans, but he frowned after he couldn't contact Long Jiutian. "Did something happen to that foolish dragon?"
- To Be Continued -

He will be a threat to us if we let him live, so we will use the two old foxes to get rid of him as quickly as possible."
An evil smile spread across Da Feiyue's face, and a glimmer of hatred flashed through her eyes, especially after Zhang Fei and his three clones had humiliated them to such an extent.
As soon as Da Xiongmang and Da Feiyue disappeared, Zhang Fei appeared in the area again.
[Master, those two giants are really idiots!
You have forgiven them, but they want to report you to Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei gave a light nod.

"Unfortunately, they don't know the situation in the Heavenly Moon Realm, and I'm sure those two old foxes won't dare to leave their realm at this time, especially since Xereth could arrive there at any time.
I hope that demon will wreak havoc in their realm, and they won't bother me if their situation gets worse."
[What are your plans for the two giants?]
"Didn't you already know that, Mei?" Zhang Fei immediately entered the training space after that.
"What happened to you, Brother?" Tian Baitian immediately told Tian Baixing about the information he had just gotten from Da Xiaongmang.
"I didn't expect that kid to have gone to the upper realm, and he also became Hun Di's disciple, so Tian Jianxun's trip to the middle realms was in vain.
Do you want to send our people to the Xianjin Realm?"
Tian Baitan shook his head immediately.
"Xereth will arrive at this realm at any time now, so we don't need to bother with that kid for now.
Once we get through the danger, I will go to the Xianjin Realm myself to capture him.
What about our young generation?
Have they fled to that realm?"
"Yes." Tian Baixing replied with a nod.
"Currently, only the two of us and a few elders are still staying in this realm, so we don't need to worry about them.
If we can't face Xereth, we will immediately flee from this realm."
Tian Baitan took a deep breath and looked at their realm areas.
"We have lived in this realm since we were born in this universe, and we have always succeeded in repelling the demons who wanted to invade it.
However, I did not expect that Xereth would suddenly return with such a powerful force, and I felt helpless for the first time in facing a demon."

"If the ten-tailed fox hadn't planted that seal in our souls, we would have reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm long ago, and we would have already ascended to that realm." Tian Baixing wanted to say something else, but they suddenly felt a deadly aura coming from outside their realm.
"Xereth!"
*Boom*
The entire realm shook violently after the powerful explosion, and the elders of the heavenly fox race immediately gathered around Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing.
"What should we do now, Ancestors?
Judging from this demon's aura, his strength is clearly several times above ours, and we can't possibly fight him even if they join together to fight him."
Instead of responding to the male fox, Tian Baitan and Tian Baixing turned their attention to Xereth, who was standing outside their realm.
Moreover, he was not alone, and they saw many demons from several realms joining him to attack their realm.
*Boom*
Once again, the entire area of their realm shook violently because of Xereth's attempt to destroy the barrier that protected it.
Tian Baitian clicked his tongue before opening the gate.
"I don't want to run away, but Xereth is too strong for us, and he brought an army of demons.
We should leave now, and we will return to this realm after the situation calms down."
Xereth's attack shattered the barrier into pieces shortly after they vanished through the gate.
The demon immediately appeared at their location, but he turned furious because Tian Baitian and the others ran away.
"Bastard!
How could they know about my coming to this realm?
Who told them about me?
Damn it!
I couldn't break into the Abyssal Realm, and now I've also failed to capture those two foxes!
If they also fail to do their job, Master Taotie will definitely blame me and punish me."
Soon, three demons wearing royal robes landed by Xereth's side.
"Are they running away from us, Lord?"
"Are you blind?" Xereth responded sharply.
"Order your subordinates to destroy this realm!
You three, search the nearby realms for those two foxes."
"Yes, Lord."
Xereth then contacted his other subordinates to find out the progress of their plans, but he frowned after he couldn't contact Long Jiutian.
"Did something happen to that foolish dragon?"
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 849 849: Two Foxes' Plan
paragraphs: *Swoosh... Swoosh...*

"Shit!" Xereth cursed as dozens of golden swords came flying at him, and he hurriedly flew to avoid them. However, those golden swords changed direction and chased after him. "This bitch! She follows me everywhere I go like a ghost!"
Tian Huangjin suddenly appeared in front of him and thrust her sword at him, but Xereth parried her attack with his black scythe, which bounced him backward.
Tian Huangjin immediately flew in front of Xereth and slashed her sword, but the demon once again repelled her attack before launching a counterattack.
Tian Huangjin dodged it by flying into the sky, stretching her arms forward, and shooting several golden rays toward Xereth. "Judgment light."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
"Humph." Xereth snorted, stomped his right leg forward, and swung his scythe from bottom to top. A crescent-shaped darkness qi instantly shot out and collided with Tian Huangjin's attacks.
*Boom*
A loud explosion sounded, and dust scattered into the air, followed by a wave of Qi sweeping across the area, making the area around them quite messy.
"Sacred Wing Severance!"
"Crap!" Xereth looked up at the sky covered by golden feathers, and they immediately swooped down toward him, forcing him to flee from his original position.
Those golden feathers immediately stuck into the ground at Xereth's previous location, but Tian Huangjin right away attacked him using another technique. "Sundering Radiance."
A bright golden light instantly enveloped Tian Huangjin's body and spread over the area, blinding Xereth's vision. At the same time, a long, huge golden sword swooped down toward the demon.

Unlike before, Xereth did not dare to block the attack from Tian Huang Jin, and he immediately abandoned his current body, turning it into a black statue. The golden sword directly slashed the statue, along with the ground beneath it, leaving a long and deep slash mark there.

"Sigh." Tian Huangjin sighed in disappointment as he failed to kill Xereth once again. She then directed her attention toward the demons destroying the realm and eliminated them. "That demon has prepared too many statues in the three mortal realms, allowing him to flee as soon as he is in danger."
Tian Huangjin then took out a device to track Xereth's whereabouts, but the device didn't show any reaction, confusing her.

"Where did that filthy creature go? Why can't I track him?" After thinking about it, Tian Huangjin immediately left the Heavenly Moon Realm and went to another realm. "I hope my guess is wrong, or that kid will be in danger if Xereth appears in that realm."

Xereth appeared somewhere else, but he was furious to find out that he was in the void, and he immediately realized that something had gone terribly wrong. "Damn! Long Jiutian has made a blunder! If he hadn't made a mistake, this statue of mine wouldn't be here, and he might have been dead by now."
Xereth thought about several things before abandoning his statue to get out of the void.

Sometime later, Xereth appeared again in another realm, but he didn't move to the Xianjin Realm, and he moved to another realm instead. He then contacted Feng Yichen to ask about her location and condition, and the female dark phoenix told him that she was in terrible shape as a result of Feng Yao's phoenix flames. He immediately flew out of the realm at high speed. "Fuck! Those two bitches have ruined all my plans! I have to pick up Yichen now, and we will attack the Xianjin Realm together."
Unlike usual, Tian Baitian stood on a hill in his human form as he looked into the distance, thinking about the possibility that Xereth would find them in their hidden realm.

By his side, Tian Baixing was also in her human form. "This Whitebone Beast Realm is quite far from our own; I doubt Xereth will be able to find us here. However, we can't keep hiding here, and we have to think of something to fight against that demon."

"How should we fight Xereth?" Unlike his usual self-confidence, Tian Baitian did not have the confidence to face the demon. "Feng Yao said that his cultivation has already broken through to the stages beyond the Seven Divine Realms, so we are not his opponent. The only way for us to be able to fight him is to surpass our limit, but our ancestor's seal is blocking us."

"Brother, I think our best choice is to go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm." Tian Baitian turned to Tian Baixing with a frown. "We both know that realm is the strongest realm in the upper realms, and there are some ancient people who lived there. With their vast knowledge, I believe one of them has a way to open the seal in our souls, and we can surpass our limits if we manage to find someone who can do it. If that happens, we no longer need to fear Xereth, and we will work together to kill him."

"Do you think it's that easy to surpass our limits?" Tian Baitian asked this question while shaking his head. "Even if one of them manages to break the seal on our souls, we won't be able to surpass our limits right away. We have no information about the stages beyond the Seven Divine Realms, and I'm sure the Divine Qi in our bodies is useless in helping us break through to those stages unless we go to the realm beyond the upper realm. Unfortunately, we don't know the way to that place, or I would have brought our race members there long ago."

Tian Baixing agreed with her brother, but she still felt that her thoughts were the best for them. "Regardless, I think going to the Sovereign Heaven Realm is the best choice for us now, and we will search for information about all those things there. The members of our race will be safe as long as they stay in this realm, and the two of us should go to that realm right now."

"All right, we are going to that realm, and I hope you are right about all that." After Tian Baitian gave some instructions to all members of the heavenly fox race, he and Tian Baixing returned to their fox forms before leaving the realm for the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

In the Xianjin Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt awkward, especially since Yan Yinqing and the others kept looking at him like they were looking at a freak. "I told you all that I found a pill in that cave, and my soul level was able to break through to the early stage of the heavenly soul level because of it. As for the intermediate stage, I broke through to this stage after the soul of the ten-tailed fox fused with my soul."

"Still, your development is too absurd." Shang Yingyue, who had returned from the Red Sun Realm, said this. "The first time you became a soul cultivator was nine and a half months ago, but your soul level has already reached this stage now. Senior Liangren and I have been soul cultivators much longer than you, but his soul level is still at the half-perfection stage. As for me, my soul level is at the early stage, and I broke through to this stage because of your help."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose. "Senior Sister Yingyue, you have met my entire family, and all the women by my side are soul cultivators, remember? Unlike you all, I practiced dual-soul cultivation with them every day, so it's natural that my soul level increases faster than yours."

Lin Moxian shook his head and answered Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Even if you dual soul cultivate with them every day, our soul level is different from our cultivation. Our soul level cannot increase as quickly as our cultivation, which makes Yingyue's observation about your progress being too rapid valid. Although I'm not familiar with the lotuses in your soul, I believe they significantly enhance the development of your soul power."

"Hey, Junior Brother, teach me and Yingyue to form a lotus in my soul." Yan Yinqing sat beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] and hugged his arm. "Since you can teach all your women to form one, you can also teach us both, right?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] rejected her outright. "Senior Sister, I wanted to teach you that technique, but it can only be learned by couples who share a deep bond, unwavering hearts, and absolute trust in each other. You are my senior sister, and our relationship is not that deep yet, so you will not be able to learn it. Senior Sister Yingyue is different from you, and her relationship with Senior Brother Xueming is already deep, so she can learn it together with him."

"Sigh." Yan Yinqing released a disappointed sigh after hearing that, but she suddenly got a voice message and immediately stood up. "My grandfather and the others have just arrived in this realm, so my mother and I will meet them first."
"Do you want to learn that technique, Senior Sister Yingyue?"
"Is it okay if I learn that technique?"

"Why not? Besides Senior Brother Liangren, you also guided me in my first steps on the soul cultivation path, and you also often dual-soul cultivated with me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shared the Lotus Ascension Art with Shang Yingyue. "Learn that technique first and don't rush into forming the lotus, as failing will injure both of your souls."
"Thank you, Junior Brother." Shang Yingyue sincerely said. "I will go see my husband now to learn the technique."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at Qiao Liangren and Lin Moxian. "I will teach that technique to both of you once you find a partner."
"We didn't think much about it."
Qiao Liangren directly left Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s room. "I'm going to see Yue Qinhua now."
"Has your soul space changed?" Lin Moxian asked him.
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered with a light nod. "My soul space has become a soul sea now, and my soul power has increased significantly because of it."
"I'll go see someone now." Lin Moxian immediately left.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to enter his soul sea, but Feng Jiu suddenly came to him. "What are your plans for Da Xiongmang and Da Feiyue? I'm sure they won't be able to swallow the humiliation they received earlier, and I'm certain they'll think of something else to get back at you."

"They contacted Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and they told them about my whereabouts in the upper realms." Feng Jiu had expected that, so she was no longer surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer. "Back then, I was always worried that the two old foxes would find me, but I'm no longer afraid of them, and I will face them if they attack me. However, I believe they won't come for me anytime soon, especially since they have to face Xereth. I don't know if that demon has already arrived in their realm, but his presence will cause big problems for them."

"The Nameless One asked me to meet you, and he wants you to leave this realm first." Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared perplexed by this, prompting Feng Jiu to provide an explanation. "Feng Shen and the others have already arrived in this realm, and many of them are not good people. All your actions have reached their ears, and they will probably view you as a threat that must be eliminated. Moreover, he will declare an emergency soon, and you won't be able to leave once he activates the realm's main barrier."
"The main barrier?"

Feng Jiu immediately explained. "The main barrier was created using the Nameless One's and Xue Bao's void elements, and it will seal everything related to the space element. Your abilities as a heavenly fox are related to the space element, and you won't be able to escape from those people if they think of attacking you together. Even if we want to help you, it will only worsen our situation, so I hope you can leave this realm now."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Thank you for your warning, Empress Feng. I know you guys want me to leave for my sake and everyone's sake, but I can't leave now."
"Why?"
"I can't tell you the real reason, and I have to stay in this realm until this problem is resolved."
"Are you sure you want to stay in this realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded firmly. "You don't need to worry about me because this body is just my clone, and I will cancel it immediately if things go south."
Feng Jiu nodded in response. "All right, I will convey your decision to the Nameless One."

After Feng Jiu left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately entered his soul sea to check on the female dark fairy. Although her soul had become clearer than before, she still looked like a mindless puppet and did not give him any reaction.

After he chatted with Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu for quite some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] exited his soul sea to cultivate. He used the Demon Eye's orb to monitor several areas of the Xianjin Realm, especially the area where the beasts of the various beast races live. 'Mei, inform me if those beasts want to find trouble with me.'
[Yes, Master.]
Feng Jiu had already arrived at Zhe Wuming's place and informed him about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s decision. "Are you going to declare an emergency now?"

"Yes." Zhe Wuming nodded at her. "Everyone is gathered now, and only three black demon statues are left. Once Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji successfully get rid of the three, I will immediately activate the main barrier. This way, Xereth will not be able to attack us directly, and I believe it will take him quite some time to destroy our barrier."
After he said that, Zhe Wuming spread his senses to all corners of the Xianjin Realm, and he used his Qi to speak to all the residents of that realm.

Panic immediately swept across the entire Xianjin realm, and many of them decided to leave to save themselves. Despite this, many of them decided to stay behind to help Zhe Wuming and the others deal with the danger, especially the older generation of cultivators.
Zhe Wuming then summoned all of them to gather in a special place, where they began to devise several strategies to deal with Xereth if he really attacked their realm.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei [1] opened his eyes as soon as the three notifications appeared, and he immediately met Balena outside. "If there are no obstacles, we will arrive at the Blue Water Realm tomorrow. I'm not sure of the situation in your realm, but we must be vigilant when we get there, especially since the two demons may be there."
"Can you defeat them?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded confidently. "The two demons' cultivation is indeed high, but I have fought several cultivators at their level before. I am confident that I can defeat them, but if they control your people and use them to attack us, it will be complicated."
"Sigh." Balena released a soft sigh. "Will you kill them if that happens?"

"I don't have an answer for that yet." Zhang Fei [1] then hugged Balena from behind. "I understand your feelings, but I will take action depending on the situation. If the two demons control them to attack us, I will not kill them, and I may have a way to return them to normal conditions. However, if they attack us without their control, I will have to resort to extreme measures to deal with them, including eradicating them."
Balena leaned against his chest and nodded slightly. "I hope that won't happen, so they won't die in your hands."
"Let's wait for the results tomorrow."
- To Be Continued -

"All right, I will convey your decision to the Nameless One."
After Feng Jiu left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately entered his soul sea to check on the female dark fairy.
Although her soul had become clearer than before, she still looked like a mindless puppet and did not give him any reaction.
After he chatted with Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu for quite some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] exited his soul sea to cultivate.

He used the Demon Eye's orb to monitor several areas of the Xianjin Realm, especially the area where the beasts of the various beast races live. 'Mei, inform me if those beasts want to find trouble with me.'
[Yes, Master.]
Feng Jiu had already arrived at Zhe Wuming's place and informed him about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s decision.
"Are you going to declare an emergency now?"
"Yes." Zhe Wuming nodded at her.
"Everyone is gathered now, and only three black demon statues are left.
Once Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji successfully get rid of the three, I will immediately activate the main barrier.
This way, Xereth will not be able to attack us directly, and I believe it will take him quite some time to destroy our barrier."
After he said that, Zhe Wuming spread his senses to all corners of the Xianjin Realm, and he used his Qi to speak to all the residents of that realm.
Panic immediately swept across the entire Xianjin realm, and many of them decided to leave to save themselves.
Despite this, many of them decided to stay behind to help Zhe Wuming and the others deal with the danger, especially the older generation of cultivators.
Zhe Wuming then summoned all of them to gather in a special place, where they began to devise several strategies to deal with Xereth if he really attacked their realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 850: Blue Water Realm
paragraphs: Zhang Fei has just arrived at the Hong Clan because Hong Quan contacted him and asked him to come. "Why did you call me here, Grandpa Hong?"
"How about the situation in the Xianjin Realm? Has Xereth arrived in that realm?" Hong Quan asked him in return.

"Not yet." Zhang Fei then told him about the situation in the Xianjin Realm. "Originally, I wanted to send you guys to that realm, but so many powerful cultivators have already arrived there. The ancestors of the various beast races have also gathered there, so I think you don't need to go there anymore."

Hong Quan nodded in understanding. "The Xianjin Realm is the responsibility of all cultivators in the upper realms, so I thought about going there anyway. Jin Ruyue and the others thought the same, and they were on their way here, so I want you to send us to that realm when they arrive."
"If you want that, I will send you there later." After he discussed other matters with Hong Quan and the others, Zhang Fei went straight to the Shang Clan.

However, Zhang Fei discovered something different about the residence, especially since Murong Qianying replaced the Shang Clan's nameplate with the Zhang Clan's. He had asked her not to replace the nameplate, but she ignored his request and did it anyway.

When Zhang Fei entered the residence, he saw that the people from the Murong Clan had already moved in, as had the people from the Lunar Shadow Cat race under Mai Xiaomeng's leadership. The families of Shang Yifen and Shang Xiyun had also moved from the Hong Clan and joined them in the residence.
Fortunately, the residence was spacious enough to accommodate hundreds of people, and it still had so many empty rooms, even though they were already living there.

Meanwhile, the main members of the Shang Clan were exiled to the residence of one of the branch clans; they became the branch clan instead. Fei Qinyuan remained in the main residence, but she no longer had her old status, and Murong Qianying controlled all affairs, including all property and business belonging to the Shang Clan.

When he arrived at the main hall, Zhang Fei found Murong Qianying and Fei Qinyuan talking to two guests. Based on the information Mei got from the system scan, they were Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu, and both of them were at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm.
Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu turned to him, but Zhang Fei immediately unleashed his killing intent, especially after Murong Qianying told him that those two people were close allies of Shang Huaqiang.

The corners of Murong Qianying's lips curled upwards at Zhuang Qiaoming's and Ying Wu's expressions, and she could see that the two people were affected by Zhang Fei's killing intent to the point their bodies were shaking.
Fei Qinyuan, on the other hand, released a soft sigh. She had already guessed that Zhang Fei would suppress them, so she had warned Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu not to do anything.

Zhang Fei immediately sat in the head seat with Murong Qianying shamelessly sitting on his lap. He then questioned Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu. "What is the purpose of your coming to my residence? Are you thinking of taking revenge for Shang Huaqiang's death?"

"We're not that stupid." Zhuang Qiaoming replied with a shake of his head. "Shang Huaqiang was indeed our close ally in the past, but he died because of his mistakes and ambitions. Moreover, you were able to take over such a powerful Shang Clan and unite almost all the clans in this realm; thus, my Zhuang Clan is not your opponent, and I will not act foolishly by fighting you."
Zhang Fei responded with a faint smile. "So, what is the purpose of you two coming here?"

"We received information that you are an alchemist, so we came specifically to meet you to discuss this matter." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow before turning to Fei Qinyuan for clarification, but she shook her head as a sign that she did not tell Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu about that. "We heard this from Huo Jiguang."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, but he didn't expect that Huo Jiguang would have such a big mouth. "Do you want me to open a shop in your realm?"

"Yes." Zhuang Qiaoming nodded at him. "Our realm is the Sky Dragon Realm, which is located on the border with the middle realms. Our realm is far from the Void Heaven Realm, so it is difficult for us to obtain a supply of high-level pills. Moreover, Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia are not willing to open an alchemy shop in our realm, and Huo Jiguang told us about your ability to concoct high-level pills. Therefore, we came here to meet you, and we hope that you are willing to open an alchemy shop in our realm."
"Before I give my answer, I want to know whether your realm has a true dragon or not."
"What kind of dragon are you looking for?"
"Flame dragon."

Zhuang Qiaoming immediately told him. "Actually, those mythical beasts have branch clans in our realm, including the dragon and phoenix races. In fact, they control more than half of our realm, but they have never attacked us humans. There are many flame dragons there, but I'm not sure if they will be willing to meet you."

"I don't need the stronger ones, and I just need to meet the young ones." Zhang Fei's answer confused Zhuang Qiaoming. "I don't need anything difficult from them, and I only need their dragon flames for something. How far is your realm from the border?"
"Two days' journey after you cross the border."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I need many resources for my cultivation, so I will go to your realm. I want to open my shop there, but I can't manage it myself, so please find someone you trust to help."
"Consider it done." Zhuang Qiaoming then asked. "Do you want to go to our realm with us?"
"No." Zhang Fei refused with a shake of his head. "I'll go with someone from the Phoenix Realm so you two can return to your realms, and we'll meet there."
"All right, we will go back now, and we will prepare a building for you." Zhuang Qiaoming immediately lifted his wife to her feet, and they hurriedly left the Red Sun Realm.
Zhang Fei turned to Fei Qinyuan. "Are they both trustworthy?"
"You can trust Zhang Qiaoming and Ying Wu, but you can't trust their two clans." Fei Qinyuan then told Zhang Fei about the two clans.

Zhang Fei was not worried about the Zhuang and Ying Clans, and he was more worried about those mythical beasts. However, he needed dragon flames to improve his Yin-Yang Fire Art, so he had no other choice but to go to that realm.
"Do you want to have fun with us now?" Fei Qinyuan fiercely glared at Murong Qianying, but she pretended not to notice.

Since Murong Qianying and Fei Qinyuan would not be able to betray him, Zhang Fei decided to send the two women to the training space, and he asked them to practice using the gravity feature first. Thereafter, he returned to the Hong Clan and waited for the people from the other clans to arrive. Once they arrived, he dispatched them to the Xianjin Realm and promptly returned to the pavilion.
The Divine Flame Realm.

After he checked his shop and restaurant in that realm, Zhang Fei [5] explained to Feng Xishui about his desire to go to the Sky Dragon Realm, and the male phoenix immediately took him to leave that realm. "Senior, I remember Feng Yao said that the Blazing Phoenix Sect also exists in the upper realms, but she hasn't told me the location."
"Do you want to join our sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "Joining a sect is no longer useful to me, so I won't do that. Instead, I want to find the family members of some of my wives, and Feng Yao once told them that some of them joined your sect."

"Coincidentally, the sects of all the beast races are in the Sky Dragon Realm, including our Blazing Phoenix Sect, especially since most cultivators who ascend to the upper realms will land there. If you want to meet them, I can bring you there once we arrive in that realm."
Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised to hear that. "All right, we will immediately go to the Blazing Phoenix Sect once we arrive there."
"Hold on tight! I'll use my maximum speed."
"All right."
On the flying artifact, Zhang Fei [4] and Feng Yao stood side by side. "I forgot to ask you this, but where is the location of the Earth and Sky Fire?"

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at that. "I thought you had forgotten about them because of your busy life. The Earth Flame is located in the Scorching Earth Realm, and the Sky Flame is in the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
"The Scorching Earth Realm?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "Cultivators and beasts with fire elements primarily inhabit that realm, as it is the hottest among the upper realms. My phoenix race also has a branch clan in that realm, but they are few in number. Do you want to go to that realm?"

"Naturally." Zhang Fei [4] then summoned his flames. "My flames are much stronger after I got your phoenix flames and the soul flames, and I will get the dragon flames soon. Since almost all my problems have been settled, I will focus on taking care of other things, such as looking for the Earth and Sky Flames. After we find Feng Yichen, we will go to the Scorching Earth Realm, and I will go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm after the affairs in the Xianjin Realm are settled."
"All right, I will take you to the Scorching Earth Realm after we find the dark phoenix." Feng Yao then informed him. "I plan to go to the Paradise Realm."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [4] turned to her in shock. "Why did you suddenly decide to go to that realm?"
"Don't you realize that your progress is too fast?"

"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei [4] replied with a nod. "However, I'm still far from the Seven Divine Realms, let alone the Five Celestial Realms. I think your plan to go to the Paradise Realm is too soon, and we won't see each other for a long time if you leave now."

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed at that. "I'm not your lover, so it doesn't matter if we don't see each other for a long time, right? Moreover, I have a lot of business in the Paradise Realm, so I decided to go there earlier than I originally planned."
"What business do you have in the Paradise Realm?"

"Secret." Feng Yao replied with a wink, which made him sigh. "After I leave, you should focus on your cultivation. If necessary, you must forget about your affairs in the outside world and enter seclusion until your cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms. This way, you will be able to challenge the Star Tower to the top floor, and you can go to the Paradise Realm after."
"How are you going to the Paradise Realm? Do you have another way to get there?"

Feng Yao answered him immediately. "I have another way to go to the Paradise Realm, but I can't take you there because you are not strong enough to go through that route, and your body will be destroyed immediately if you go there."

"I see." Zhang Fei [4] then took out a bracelet and handed it to Feng Yao. "If you go to that realm, please help me give this bracelet to Luo Yunxiao. I forged it myself according to the bracelet she wore when we were little, so she will definitely recognize it."
"You keep thinking about Luo Yunxiao, huh?" Feng Yao said this as she received the bracelet. "I was planning to meet her, so I will help you give her this bracelet."
"Thank you."
"No need."

A few hours passed quickly, and another day came. After they flew in outer space for two weeks, Zhang Fei [1] and Balena finally arrived at the Blue Water Realm.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated the stealth feature of the Pandora Odyssey and flew it into the realm.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Blue Water Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Blue Water Realm.]

As Balena told him long ago, the Blue Realm only had 1 percent of land, and almost the entire area of the realm was covered by oceans of varying depths. Even so, the water in the realm's ocean was clear enough that Zhang Fei [1] could see inside without having to use his senses, revealing numerous underwater buildings.
Aquatic demon beasts of various sizes swim happily in it, circling those buildings. Many of them repeatedly jumped out of the sea before diving in again, and some of them had giant bodies.
"Fei, look over there." Zhang Fei [1] followed the direction pointed by Balena. "The ruins of the Sunken Empire are in that area, so the Abyssal Leviathan Demon should be there too."

Since the system had just started mapping the areas of the realm, Zhang Fei [1] had not been able to inspect the inside of that area yet. Therefore, he let his flying artifact fly slowly in the air while waiting for the mapping to complete. "Where does your family live?"
"In that area." Balena pointed at another area. "Look at that big underwater building; that is where my family lives. Can you check if the two demons have arrived in this realm?"

"I'll try it." Before Zhang Fei [1] could spread his senses, they already saw two demons flying out of one of the underwater buildings, followed by several aquatic demons from that realm. They went to the area where the Sunken Empire was located. "There they are! They should be Chao Mojie and Mo Xieshen, and their cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, just like Long Jiutian. By the way, who owns that underwater building?"

"In the past, the underwater building belonged to Nyxxora the Demon Manta. However, due to my extended absence, I am uncertain about the current owner of the underwater building. Balena then asked him. "Shall we go see my parents first? I hope they haven't forgotten me and aren't under the influence of those two demons, and we can gain a lot of information about the situation in this realm from them."

"All right, we will meet them now." Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his demon transformation to disguise himself as an aquatic demon beast. After he stored the Pandora Odyssey, he took Balena into the invisible state, and the two of them immediately dived into the ocean.
Before long, they arrived in front of the underwater building owned by Balena's family, but they didn't see anyone there. "Did the two demons capture them?"
"Who was your closest acquaintance in the past?"
Balena pointed to an underwater building a little far from their location. "Let's go there; that building belongs to my childhood friend's family, but I don't know if they still live there."
Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought Balena to the building, and they found several octopus demons living there. "Do you recognize them?"
"Yes." Balena nodded to him. "Let's go inside; one of them is my childhood friend, Naelith."
Balena immediately led Zhang Fei [1] into the building, surprising several people who were gathered there.
Naelith immediately asked. "Balena? Is it really you?"
